senses.example_en: She had a beautiful silk scarf on at the dinner party.
senses.example_zh: 她在晚宴上戴着一条漂亮的丝巾。

senses.example_en: You can't be serious—are you having me on?
senses.example_zh: 你不是认真的吧——你在拿我寻开心吗？

senses.example_en: Do you have anything on this Friday evening?
senses.example_zh: 这周五晚上你有什么安排吗？

senses.example_en: We're planning to have our neighbors over for drinks this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们打算周末请邻居来家里喝一杯。

senses.meaning: 与某人直截了当地摊牌；争辩以求彻底解决分歧
senses.example_en: I was sick of his excuses, so I decided to have it out with him once and for all.
senses.example_zh: 我受够了他的借口，于是决定直接跟他摊牌彻底做个了断。

senses.meaning: 储备（食物、饮料或日常用品）
senses.example_en: We'd better make sure we have plenty of food in for the snowstorm.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雪要来了，我们最好确保家里储备了充足的食物。

senses.meaning: 请（专业人员）来家里施工或维修
senses.example_en: We're having a painter in next week to redecorate the living room.
senses.example_zh: 我们下周要请一位粉刷工来重新装修客厅。

senses.example_en: He had two wisdom teeth out under local anesthesia yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 他昨天在局部麻醉下拔掉了两颗智齿。

senses.meaning: 同某人坦诚沟通消除误会；公开争辩
senses.example_en: They had their disagreement out in private and cleared the air.
senses.example_zh: 他们私下摊开谈了彼此的分歧，化解了误会。

senses.meaning: 对某人心存不满；故意找某人麻烦；怀恨在心
senses.example_en: Ever since I disagreed with him in the meeting, he's really had it in for me.
senses.example_zh: 自从我在会议上反对了他的观点，他就处处针对我。

senses.meaning: 掌握某人的把柄或罪证
senses.example_en: The police couldn't arrest him because they didn't have anything on him.
senses.example_zh: 警方无法逮捕他，因为抓不到他的任何把柄。

senses.example_en: I'm having next Monday off to take my parents to the hospital.
senses.example_zh: 我下周一请了假，要带父母去医院检查。

senses.example_en: Can I have my book back once you've finished reading it?
senses.example_zh: 你看完后能把我的书还给我吗？

senses.example_en: We really enjoyed their company and promised to have them back soon.
senses.example_zh: 我们和他们相处得很愉快，并承诺很快会再请他们来作客。

senses.meaning: 因违法犯罪传讯某人出庭受审；起诉某人
senses.example_en: He was had up for reckless driving and had his license suspended.
senses.example_zh: 他因危险驾驶被传讯受审，驾照也被吊销了。

senses.meaning: 邀请某人到自己家里（用餐、聚会等）
senses.example_en: Why don't we have Mark and Sarah round for dinner on Saturday?
senses.example_zh: 我们周六请马克和萨拉来家里吃晚饭怎么样？

senses.example_en: He drew his sword and shouted, 'Have at you!'
senses.example_zh: 他拔出宝剑大喊道：“接招吧！”

senses.meaning: 竭力尝试；全力投入解决（某任务）
senses.example_en: Here's the spreadsheet; have at it and see if you can balance the budget.
senses.example_zh: 这是电子表格，你动手试试看能不能把预算做平。

senses.meaning: 带某人同行；邀请某人一起参加
senses.example_en: We're driving to the lake this weekend and would love to have you along.
senses.example_zh: 我们这个周末要开车去湖边，非常欢迎你和我们一起去。

senses.meaning: 百感交集；喜忧参半；内心矛盾
senses.example_en: She had mixed feelings about moving abroad for her career.
senses.example_zh: 为了事业移居海外，她心里真是百感交集。

idioms.phrase: have a bone to pick with sb

senses.meaning: 有牢骚要理论；有笔账要算；对某事心存不满需找人当面说清
senses.example_en: I have a bone to pick with you regarding your comments in yesterday's meeting.
senses.example_zh: 关于你在昨天会议上的言论，我可得找你好好理论理论。

senses.meaning: 忙得不可开交；应接不暇
senses.example_en: With three newborn puppies and a toddler, they certainly have their hands full.
senses.example_zh: 养着三只刚出生的小狗还有一个刚学会走路的孩子，他们确实忙得不可开交。

senses.example_en: Thanks to their cutting-edge technology, they have the upper hand in negotiations.
senses.example_zh: 凭借尖端技术，他们在谈判中牢牢占据了上风。

senses.meaning: 忐忑不安；感到极度紧张心慌
senses.example_en: Every time I step onto the stage to give a presentation, I have butterflies in my stomach.
senses.example_zh: 每次走上讲台做演示汇报时，我心里总是七上八下的。

senses.meaning: 产生疑虑；重新考虑并改变主意
senses.example_en: After evaluating the excessive risks, the investors began to have second thoughts.
senses.example_zh: 评估了过高的风险后，投资者们开始打退堂鼓重新考虑。

senses.meaning: 发发慈悲；行行好；宽容一点
senses.example_en: Have a heart and give him another chance to fix his mistake.
senses.example_zh: 发发善心吧，再给他一次弥补过错的机会。

senses.meaning: 对……产生重要影响或作用
senses.example_en: The newly introduced policy will have a profound impact on local businesses.
senses.example_zh: 新出台的政策将对当地企业产生深远的影响。

senses.meaning: 有权使用；能够接近或获取
senses.example_en: All employees should have access to the internal learning database.
senses.example_zh: 所有员工都应该有权访问内部学习数据库。

senses.meaning: 做某事有困难；难以完成某事
senses.example_en: Many international students have difficulty adapting to the humid climate.
senses.example_zh: 很多留学生很难适应这种潮湿的气候。

senses.example_en: Despite recent setbacks, the board continues to have absolute faith in her leadership.
senses.example_zh: 尽管最近遭遇挫折，董事会仍然对她的领导能力坚信不疑。

senses.meaning: 与……有共同之处；共享相似特质
senses.example_en: Although they come from different backgrounds, the two artists have a great deal in common.
senses.example_zh: 尽管出身背景不同，这两位艺术家却有着极多的共同点。

collocations.phrase: have no choice but to do

senses.example_en: Facing severe financial deficits, they had no choice but to lay off staff.
senses.example_zh: 面对严重的财政赤字，他们别无选择只能裁员。

senses.meaning: 对……有独特的鉴赏力或敏锐眼光
senses.example_en: She has a trained eye for discovering exceptional vintage jewelry.
senses.example_zh: 她练就了一副敏锐的眼光，极擅长发掘绝佳的古董珠宝。

senses.meaning: 将某人看作；认定某人是某种性格或身份
senses.example_en: I'd always had him down as a quiet person, but he was surprisingly outgoing.
senses.example_zh: 我一直以为他是个文静少话的人，没想到他出奇地外向。

senses.meaning: 反对；反感；对……持有异议或不满
senses.example_en: What do you have against my proposal? It's completely reasonable.
senses.example_zh: 你对我的提议有什么不满？它完全合情合理啊。

senses.meaning: 没有……也行；设法对付过去；放弃
senses.example_en: There's no sugar left, so you'll just have to do without.
senses.example_zh: 没有白糖了，你只能将就一下了。

senses.example_en: The government plans to do away with the outdated tax regulations.
senses.example_zh: 政府计划废除这项过时的税收条例。

senses.example_en: Rumors spread that the dictator had done away with his political rivals.
senses.example_zh: 有传言称那个独裁者已经除掉了他的政敌。

senses.example_en: It's freezing outside, so make sure you do up your coat.
senses.example_zh: 外面冷得要命，务必把大衣扣好。

senses.example_en: They bought a dilapidated farmhouse and spent two years doing it up.
senses.example_zh: 他们买下了一座破旧的农舍，花了两年时间把它翻修一新。

senses.example_en: She was all done up in an elegant evening gown for the premiere.
senses.example_zh: 她盛装打扮，穿了一袭优雅的晚礼服去参加首映式。

senses.example_en: My supervisor rejected the draft, so I had to do the whole report over.
senses.example_zh: 主管打回了初稿，我不得不把整份报告重新写一遍。

senses.example_en: We're going to do over the spare bedroom before the guests arrive.
senses.example_zh: 在客人到来之前，我们打算把客房重新粉刷装修一下。

senses.example_en: While they were away on holiday, their apartment was completely done over.
senses.example_zh: 他们出门度假期间，公寓被盗贼洗劫一空。

senses.example_en: He was cornered in a dark alley and done over by a local gang.
senses.example_zh: 他在一条昏暗的巷子里被堵住，遭到当地团伙的一顿暴打。

senses.meaning: 极想得到；非常需要；很乐意有
senses.example_en: I've been working non-stop all day; I could really do with a cold beer.
senses.example_zh: 我连轴转忙了一整天，真想来杯冰镇啤酒。

senses.meaning: 与……有关（多用于 have to do with）
senses.example_en: Her sudden resignation had nothing to do with her health.
senses.example_zh: 她的突然辞职与她的健康状况毫无关系。

senses.meaning: 处理；处置；安置（常与 what 连用）
senses.example_en: What did you do with the spare set of car keys?
senses.example_zh: 你把备用汽车钥匙放到哪里去了？

senses.meaning: 容忍；相处；忍受（常用于 negative 语境 can't do with）
senses.example_en: I really can't do with people who are constantly whining.
senses.example_zh: 我实在受不了那些整天怨天尤人的人。

senses.example_en: That steep hike up the mountain really did me in.
senses.example_zh: 爬那座陡峭的山真把我给累垮了。

senses.example_en: The villain threatened to do him in if he went to the police.
senses.example_zh: 歹徒威胁说如果他敢报警就结果了他的性命。

senses.example_en: Mrs. Hudson has been doing for the elderly gentleman for nearly a decade.
senses.example_zh: 哈德森太太照料那位老先生的家务已经快十年了。

senses.example_en: That bad knee injury finally did for his professional football career.
senses.example_zh: 那次严重的膝伤最终彻底毁了他的职业足球生涯。

senses.example_en: This old jacket isn't fancy, but it will do for gardening.
senses.example_zh: 这件旧夹克不算体面，但用来干园艺活足够了。

senses.meaning: 贬低；诋毁；贬损某人的声誉或成就
senses.example_en: Stop doing yourself down—you did a fantastic job on this project.
senses.example_zh: 别再妄自菲薄了——你在这个项目上干得非常出色。

senses.meaning: 彻底打扫，整理收拾（房间、抽屉等）
senses.example_en: I spent the entire morning doing out the garage and throwing away old junk.
senses.example_zh: 我花了一整个上午彻底清理车库，把旧破烂都扔了。

senses.example_en: They had the study done out in warm shades of green.
senses.example_zh: 他们把书房粉刷成了温暖的绿色调。

senses.meaning: 对待（某人，常与 well/badly 搭配）
senses.example_en: The company has always done well by its employees during difficult times.
senses.example_zh: 在艰难时期，这家公司始终厚待自己的员工。

senses.meaning: 用……装饰或布置（房间、环境）
senses.example_en: The wedding hall was tastefully done out in white roses and satin ribbons.
senses.example_zh: 婚礼大厅用白玫瑰和缎带精心布置，显得高雅别致。

senses.meaning: 奏效；达到预期效果；解决难题
senses.example_en: A little bit of lubricant on the hinges should do the trick to stop that squeak.
senses.example_zh: 在铰链上涂一点润滑剂应该就能奏效，消除那咯吱咯吱的噪音。

senses.example_en: Could you do me a favor and review these figures before the presentation?
senses.example_zh: 你能不能帮我个忙，在汇报前帮我核对一下这些数据？

senses.example_en: The medical rescue team did their utmost to save every trapped survivor.
senses.example_zh: 医疗救援团队竭尽全力抢救每一位受困的幸存者。

senses.meaning: 创造奇迹；产生神奇惊人的良好效果
senses.example_en: A brief holiday in the mountains will do wonders for your mental health.
senses.example_zh: 去山里度个短假会对你的心理健康产生神奇的舒缓效果。

senses.meaning: 孤注一掷；不成功便成仁；破釜沉舟
senses.example_en: The final championship match is a do-or-die situation for the entire franchise.
senses.example_zh: 这场总冠军决赛对于整个俱乐部来说是一场背水一战的生死决战。

senses.meaning: 对某人有益；改善某人的身心状态
senses.example_en: You have been staring at the monitor all day; fresh air will do you good.
senses.example_zh: 你盯着显示器看了一整天了，去户外透透新鲜空气对你有好处。

senses.meaning: 够了；行了；到此为止（用于制止不当行为或表示数量已足）
senses.example_en: That will do, children! Settle down and turn to page twenty.
senses.example_zh: 够了，孩子们！安静下来，翻到第二十页。

senses.meaning: 与……开展业务往来或商业合作
senses.example_en: It has always been an absolute pleasure to do business with your company.
senses.example_zh: 与贵公司开展商业合作始终是一件非常愉快的事。

senses.meaning: 对……进行调查或科学研究
senses.example_en: The laboratory is doing pioneering research into neurodegenerative diseases.
senses.example_zh: 该实验室正在对神经退行性疾病开展开创性的科学研究。

senses.meaning: 对……造成实质性损害或危害
senses.example_en: Prolonged exposure to ultraviolet rays will do severe damage to your skin.
senses.example_zh: 长时间暴露在紫外线下会对你的皮肤造成严重损伤。

senses.example_en: Don't stress over the final outcome, as long as you know you did your best.
senses.example_zh: 只要知道自己已经尽了最大努力，就不要为最终结果而焦虑。

senses.meaning: 公平对待；如实展现……的美好或价值
senses.example_en: A photograph cannot do justice to the breathtaking grandeur of the Grand Canyon.
senses.example_zh: 单凭一张照片根本无法真正展现大峡谷那令人屏息的壮阔之美。

senses.meaning: 滑稽模仿某人的神情或言行举止
senses.example_en: He had the entire room laughing by doing an accurate impression of the boss.
senses.example_zh: 他惟妙惟肖地模仿了老板的言行，逗得全场哄堂大笑。

senses.meaning: 清洗碗盘 / 洗衣服（核心家务动宾搭配）
senses.example_en: If you prepare dinner tonight, I'll gladly do the dishes afterward.
senses.example_zh: 如果你今晚负责做饭，饭后我很乐意把碗洗了。

senses.meaning: 欺诈骗取某人应得之物；剥夺某人合法利益
senses.example_en: His dishonest partner did him out of his rightful share of the profits.
senses.example_zh: 他不诚实的合伙人耍手段骗走了他应得的利润份额。

senses.meaning: 盛情款待某人；周到招待
senses.example_en: The hosts really did us proud with a lavish five-course feast.
senses.example_zh: 主人们准备了奢华的五道菜大餐，盛情款待了我们。

senses.meaning: 使某人深感骄傲或面子十足
senses.example_en: You did your school proud by winning the national championship.
senses.example_zh: 你赢得了全国冠军，为母校争了光。

senses.example_en: I usually get up at six every morning to go for a run.
senses.example_zh: 我通常每天早上六点起床去跑步。

senses.example_en: The whole audience got up and applauded when the speech ended.
senses.example_zh: 演讲结束时，全场观众起立鼓掌。

senses.example_en: They are trying to get up a petition against the new building plan.
senses.example_zh: 他们正试图发起一份反对新建筑规划的请愿书。

senses.meaning: 从（疾病、打击、悲伤）中恢复
senses.example_en: It took him months to get over the shock of losing his job.
senses.example_zh: 他花了数月时间才从失业的打击中缓过来。

senses.example_en: We must find a way to get over these financial difficulties.
senses.example_zh: 我们必须想办法克服这些财政困难。

senses.example_en: Hurry up and get on the bus, or we'll be late.
senses.example_zh: 快点上公交车，不然我们要迟到了。

senses.example_en: Do you get on well with your new roommates?
senses.example_zh: 你和新室友们相处得融洽吗？

senses.example_en: How are you getting on with your master's thesis?
senses.example_zh: 你的硕士毕业论文写得怎么样了？

senses.example_en: Remember to take all your belongings before you get off the train.
senses.example_zh: 下火车前请记得带好所有的随身物品。

senses.example_en: I usually get off at five, but today I have to work overtime.
senses.example_zh: 我平时五点下班，但今天必须加班。

senses.example_en: He was lucky to get off with just a small fine.
senses.example_zh: 他很幸运，仅交了一笔小额罚款就免受进一步惩处。

senses.example_en: We should get off early tomorrow to avoid the morning traffic.
senses.example_zh: 我们明天应该早点出发，避开早高峰。

senses.example_en: What time does your flight get in tonight?
senses.example_zh: 你今晚的航班什么时候到达？

senses.example_en: She was thrilled to find out that she got in to medical school.
senses.example_zh: 得知自己被医学院录取，她欣喜若狂。

senses.example_en: The farmers worked quickly to get the crops in before the rain.
senses.example_zh: 农民们赶在下雨前迅速抢收庄稼。

senses.example_en: I need to get out of the office for a breath of fresh air.
senses.example_zh: 我需要离开办公室出去透透气。

senses.example_en: If word gets out about the merger, the stock price will soar.
senses.example_zh: 如果关于合并的消息传出去，股价就会飙升。

senses.example_en: The band hopes to get out their new album by the end of the year.
senses.example_zh: 该乐队希望在年底前发行他们的新专辑。

senses.example_en: The thief dropped the bag and managed to get away on a motorbike.
senses.example_zh: 小偷扔下包，骑着一辆摩托车侥幸逃脱了。

senses.example_en: I'm hoping to get away from the meeting a bit early today.
senses.example_zh: 我希望今天能早点从会议中脱身。

senses.example_en: We're planning to get away to the coast for the weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们打算周末去海边度个假。

senses.meaning: 做坏事未受惩罚，侥幸逃脱
senses.example_en: You can't expect to cheat on the exam and get away with it.
senses.example_zh: 你别指望考试作弊还能安然无恙。

senses.example_en: The robbers got away with thousands of dollars in cash.
senses.example_zh: 劫匪携带着数千美元现金潜逃了。

senses.example_en: She gets along well with all her colleagues in the department.
senses.example_zh: 她与部门里的所有同事都相处得非常融洽。

senses.example_en: How are you getting along with your new business venture?
senses.example_zh: 你的新创业项目进展如何？

senses.example_en: We didn't get back from our trip until after midnight.
senses.example_zh: 我们旅行直到过半夜才回到家。

senses.example_en: I lent him my umbrella last week, but I never got it back.
senses.example_zh: 上周我把雨伞借给他，但一直没拿回来。

senses.example_en: He swore he would get back at them for ruining his reputation.
senses.example_zh: 他发誓一定要报复他们败坏自己声誉的行为。

senses.example_en: I'm in a meeting right now, but I'll get back to you shortly.
senses.example_zh: 我正在开会，稍后会马上回复你。

senses.meaning: 重新回到（某话题或某项活动）
senses.example_en: Let's take a short break and then get back to work.
senses.example_zh: 我们休息一会儿，然后重新投入工作。

senses.example_en: My salary is low, but it's enough to get by on.
senses.example_zh: 我的薪水不高，但勉强够维持生活。

senses.example_en: His French isn't fluent, but he knows enough to get by while traveling.
senses.example_zh: 他的法语不算流利，但旅行时应付日常交流足够了。

senses.meaning: 完成，度过，通过（难关、考试）
senses.example_en: Her support helped him get through the darkest period of his life.
senses.example_zh: 她的支持帮助他度过了人生中最黑暗的时期。

senses.example_en: I tried calling customer service several times, but I couldn't get through.
senses.example_zh: 我给客服打了好几次电话，但都没能打通。

senses.example_en: I just can't seem to get through to him no matter how much I explain.
senses.example_zh: 不管我怎么解释，似乎都没法让他明白。

senses.example_en: Don't let the rainy weather get you down.
senses.example_zh: 别让阴雨连绵的天气搞得你心情低落。

senses.example_en: Did you get down the address she just mentioned?
senses.example_zh: 你记下她刚才说的那个地址了吗？

senses.example_en: The medicine tasted terrible, but I managed to get it down.
senses.example_zh: 这药太苦了，但我还是硬咽了下去。

senses.meaning: 认真开始处理，着手做（严肃事务）
senses.example_en: Now that the introductions are done, let's get down to business.
senses.example_zh: 既然介绍完毕，我们就言归正传、开始谈正事吧。

senses.example_en: It's very easy to get around the city using public transportation.
senses.example_zh: 乘坐公共交通在这个城市里出行非常方便。

senses.example_en: News of their secret engagement quickly got around.
senses.example_zh: 他们秘密订婚的消息很快就传开了。

senses.example_en: The company hired lawyers to get around strict environmental regulations.
senses.example_zh: 该公司聘请律师来规避严苛的环保法规。

senses.example_en: I don't really understand what you're getting at.
senses.example_zh: 我真不明白你到底想表达什么意思。

senses.example_en: Put the cleaning chemicals on a high shelf where the kids can't get at them.
senses.example_zh: 把清洁剂放在高处的架子上，别让孩子们够得着。

senses.example_en: The committee is determined to get at the truth behind the accident.
senses.example_zh: 委员会下定决心要查明事故背后的真相。

senses.example_en: Why are you always getting at me for every little mistake?
senses.example_zh: 你为什么总是抓着我的每一个小错误不放？

senses.meaning: 使观点、信息）被理解，传达明白
senses.example_en: The speaker used clear diagrams to get her message across effectively.
senses.example_zh: 演讲者使用了清晰的图表，有效地传达了她的观点。

senses.meaning: 取得成功，出人头地，领先
senses.example_en: In this competitive field, continuous learning is essential to get ahead.
senses.example_zh: 在这个竞争激烈的领域，持续学习是脱颖而出立于不败之地的关键。

senses.meaning: 摸清……的诀窍，掌握……的使用方法
senses.example_en: It was difficult at first, but after a few tries I finally got the hang of the software.
senses.example_zh: 起初有点难，但试了几次之后我终于掌握了这个软件的诀窍。

senses.meaning: 惹恼某人，让某人心烦意乱
senses.example_en: The continuous ticking sound of that old clock is really getting on my nerves.
senses.example_zh: 那座老挂钟持续不断的滴答声真让我心烦意乱。

senses.meaning: 在行动前）临阵退缩，心生恐惧
senses.example_en: The groom got cold feet right before the ceremony and almost ran away.
senses.example_zh: 新郎在婚礼仪式开始前突然临阵退缩，差点跑掉。

senses.example_en: The party quickly got out of hand when uninvited guests started showing up.
senses.example_zh: 当不请自来的客人开始出现时，派对迅速失控了。

senses.meaning: 振作起来，整顿好自己的状态以高效行事
senses.example_en: If you don't get your act together soon, you risk losing your scholarship.
senses.example_zh: 如果你还不赶紧振作起来好好表现，你的奖学金可能就保不住了。

senses.meaning: 启动某事，促使事情开局运转
senses.example_en: Let's get the ball rolling by brainstorming a few initial concepts for the campaign.
senses.example_zh: 我们先为这次营销活动头脑风暴几个初步构想，把事情启动起来吧。

senses.meaning: 控制住情绪，冷静下来，镇定自若
senses.example_en: Stop panicking, take a deep breath, and get a grip on yourself.
senses.example_zh: 别慌了，深吸一口气，让自己冷静下来。

senses.example_en: We need to clear out the attic and get rid of all these broken appliances.
senses.example_zh: 我们得把阁楼清理一下，扔掉所有这些坏掉的电器。

senses.example_en: Please get in touch with our representative if you have any further questions.
senses.example_zh: 如果您有任何进一步的问题，请与我们的代表取得联系。

senses.meaning: 联系到某人；获得，弄到某物
senses.example_en: I've been trying to get hold of the landlord all morning to report the leak.
senses.example_zh: 我一整个上午都在试图联系房东反映漏水的问题。

senses.example_en: It takes time to get used to the humid climate in this tropical region.
senses.example_zh: 适应这个热带地区潮湿的气候需要一段时间。

senses.example_en: Hurry up and get ready, otherwise we're going to miss the opening scene.
senses.example_zh: 赶紧准备好，否则我们就要错过开场戏了。

senses.meaning: 迷路；走开，滚开（祈使句中）
senses.example_en: Without a reliable GPS navigation app, it's very easy to get lost in the old town.
senses.example_zh: 如果没有好用的导航软件，在老城区很容易迷路。

senses.example_en: He pretended to have a headache to get out of doing the dishes.
senses.example_zh: 他假装头痛，想逃避洗碗。

senses.example_en: What did you get out of attending that leadership seminar?
senses.example_zh: 你参加那个领导力讲座有什么收获？

senses.example_en: She recently got into yoga and practices it every morning.
senses.example_zh: 她最近迷上了瑜伽，每天早晨都练。

senses.example_en: He worked tirelessly all year to get into his dream university.
senses.example_zh: 他整年孜孜不倦，终于考入了心仪的大学。

senses.example_en: Be careful with your investments, or you might get into serious debt.
senses.example_zh: 投资时要谨慎，否则你可能会深陷严重的债务危机。

senses.example_en: Try not to get into the habit of staying up late reading on your phone.
senses.example_zh: 尽量不要养成熬夜看手机的坏习惯。

senses.example_en: He made up an excuse about his car breaking down so he wouldn't look bad.
senses.example_zh: 他编了个车坏了的借口，免得显得太尴尬。

senses.example_en: Women make up over fifty percent of the student body at this university.
senses.example_zh: 这所大学里女生占学生总数的百分之五十以上。

senses.example_en: They had a huge fight last night, but they've already kissed and made up.
senses.example_zh: 他们昨晚大吵了一架，但现在已经和好如初了。

senses.example_en: She took nearly an hour to make herself up before the banquet.
senses.example_zh: 赴宴前她花了将近一个小时化妆打扮。

senses.example_en: I could barely make out the street sign through the thick fog.
senses.example_zh: 透过浓雾，我几乎辨认不出路标。

senses.meaning: 理解，弄明白（原因或行为）
senses.example_en: I can never make out why he acts so defensively around strangers.
senses.example_zh: 我一直弄不懂他面对陌生人时为什么总是那么戒备。

senses.meaning: 开立，填写（支票、收据、表格等）
senses.example_en: Please make the cheque out to the local charity.
senses.example_zh: 请把支票开给当地的慈善机构。

senses.example_en: The teenagers were caught making out in the back row of the cinema.
senses.example_zh: 那对年轻人在电影院后排亲热时被撞见了。

senses.example_en: He worked overtime all weekend to make up for the lost hours.
senses.example_zh: 他整个周末都在加班，以弥补损失的工时。

senses.example_en: As soon as the bell rang, the children made for the exit.
senses.example_zh: 下课铃一响，孩子们就奔向了出口。

senses.example_en: Clear communication and mutual respect make for a healthy workplace.
senses.example_zh: 沟通顺畅与相互尊重有助于营造健康的工作氛围。

senses.example_en: The burglar made off as soon as the burglar alarm went off.
senses.example_zh: 防盗警报一响，窃贼就仓皇逃窜了。

senses.example_en: Thieves broke into the gallery and made off with three priceless paintings.
senses.example_zh: 盗贼闯入画廊，盗走了三幅无价的名画。

senses.example_en: The design team completely made over the outdated kitchen in just two days.
senses.example_zh: 设计团队仅用两天时间就将那个老旧的厨房彻底翻新了。

senses.meaning: 把（财产、权利等）法定转让给
senses.example_en: Before retiring abroad, he made over all his business assets to his daughter.
senses.example_zh: 在去国外定居养老前，他将所有的商业资产转让给了女儿。

senses.example_en: She always makes up to the senior partners in hopes of getting promoted.
senses.example_zh: 她总是巴结高级合伙人，希望能获得晋升。

senses.example_en: The crooked accountant made away with millions of company funds.
senses.example_zh: 那个不良会计卷走了数百万公款后潜逃了。

senses.example_en: In the thriller, the villain ruthlessly makes away with anyone who crosses him.
senses.example_zh: 在那部悬疑片中，反派残忍地除掉了所有阻碍他的人。

senses.meaning: 拿出来，提供，展示（口语，多用于祈使句）
senses.example_en: Come on, make with the answers—we've been waiting long enough.
senses.example_zh: 得了吧，赶紧把答案拿出来——我们已经等得够久了。

senses.example_en: With the sharp rise in living costs, many families struggle to make ends meet.
senses.example_zh: 随着生活成本急剧上升，许多家庭都在勉强维持生计。

senses.meaning: 兴风作浪；挑起事端；引起骚动
senses.example_en: As a newcomer in the firm, she preferred to blend in rather than make waves.
senses.example_zh: 作为公司的新人，她宁愿低调融入，也不愿惹是生非。

idioms.phrase: make a mountain out of a molehill

senses.example_en: It was merely an honest typing typo, so there is no need to make a mountain out of a molehill.
senses.example_zh: 那不过是一个无心的打字错误，完全没必要小题大做。

senses.example_en: Even small volunteer contributions can make a tremendous difference to local communities.
senses.example_zh: 即便是微小的志愿者贡献，也能对当地社区产生巨大的积极影响。

senses.example_en: We didn't have professional photography equipment, so we had to make do with our smartphones.
senses.example_zh: 我们没有专业摄影器材，只能用智能手机将就应付。

senses.example_en: Hearing that her scientific paper was accepted by the journal made her day.
senses.example_zh: 得知自己的科研论文被该期刊录用，她开心了一整天。

senses.meaning: 当众大吵大闹；失态大闹
senses.example_en: Please lower your voice; there's no reason to make a scene in a quiet restaurant.
senses.example_zh: 请放低声音，没必要在安静的餐厅里当众大闹。

senses.meaning: 讲得通/有道理；理解/搞懂
senses.example_en: I have reread the cryptic instruction multiple times, but I cannot make sense of it.
senses.example_zh: 我把那条隐晦的指示重读了好几遍，依然无法理解。

senses.example_en: Make sure that all the laboratory windows are securely latched before leaving.
senses.example_zh: 离开前务必确保实验室的所有窗户都已插紧锁好。

senses.example_en: You need to make a conscious effort to improve your pronunciation.
senses.example_zh: 你需要自觉努力来改善自己的发音。

senses.example_en: They moved the heavy bookshelf to make room for a baby crib.
senses.example_zh: 他们搬走了厚重的书架，为婴儿床腾出空间。

senses.example_en: The research team has made remarkable progress in decoding the gene sequence.
senses.example_zh: 研究团队在破译该基因序列方面取得了显著进展。

senses.example_en: We should make the most of the sunny weekend and go on a camping trip.
senses.example_zh: 我们应该充分利用这个晴朗的周末，去露营一番。

senses.meaning: 对……有某种理解或看法，看待
senses.example_en: What did you make of the CEO's sudden announcement this morning?
senses.example_zh: 你对今天早上首席执行官的突然声明怎么看？

senses.example_en: After years of struggling in small clubs, the band finally made it big.
senses.example_zh: 在小型俱乐部打拼多年后，这支乐队终于一举成名。

senses.example_en: Hurry up or we won't make it to the station before the train departs.
senses.example_zh: 快点，不然我们就赶不上在火车开出前到站了。

senses.meaning: 度过难关，幸免于难，活下来
senses.example_en: The doctors told his family that he was critically ill, but he managed to make it.
senses.example_zh: 医生曾通知家属他病危，但他最终挺了过来。

senses.example_en: He made as if to speak, but thought better of it and kept quiet.
senses.example_zh: 他做出一副要说话的样子，但转念一想还是保持了沉默。

senses.meaning: 用……原料制成，由……加工而成
senses.example_en: The sculpture was cleverly made out of scrap metal found in junkyards.
senses.example_zh: 这座雕塑巧妙地利用了废品场里的废金属制作而成。

senses.example_en: They are planning to make the old warehouse into modern loft apartments.
senses.example_zh: 他们计划把旧仓库改建成现代阁楼公寓。

senses.example_en: Please go on with your presentation; don't let me interrupt you.
senses.example_zh: 请继续你的汇报，别让我打扰了你。

senses.example_en: I had no idea what was going on behind closed doors.
senses.example_zh: 我根本不知道闭门会议里究竟发生了什么。

senses.example_en: The streetlights usually go on just before dusk.
senses.example_zh: 路灯通常在黄昏前亮起。

senses.meaning: 警报/闹钟）响起；（炸弹）爆炸
senses.example_en: My alarm goes off at six every morning without fail.
senses.example_zh: 每天早晨六点我的闹钟都会准时响起。

senses.example_en: The milk will go off quickly if you leave it out of the fridge.
senses.example_zh: 如果你把牛奶放在冰箱外面，它很快就会变质。

senses.example_en: She went off to get a drink and never came back.
senses.example_zh: 她走开去拿饮料，然后就再也没回来。

senses.example_en: Do you feel like going out for dinner tonight?
senses.example_zh: 今晚你想出去吃晚饭吗？

senses.example_en: Suddenly the lights went out, plunging the room into darkness.
senses.example_zh: 灯突然灭了，房间陷入一片黑暗。

senses.example_en: That style of jeans went out of fashion years ago.
senses.example_zh: 那种款式的牛仔裤好几年前就过时了。

senses.meaning: 经历，经受（艰难、痛苦或危机）
senses.example_en: He went through a very difficult time after losing his job.
senses.example_zh: 失业后，他经历了一段非常艰难的时期。

senses.example_en: Let's go through the contract again before signing it.
senses.example_zh: 签字之前我们再把合同仔细审查一遍吧。

senses.meaning: 法案、提议、交易）获通过，达成
senses.example_en: The merger finally went through after months of negotiations.
senses.example_zh: 经过数月的谈判，这笔并购交易终于达成了。

senses.meaning: 价格、数量、温度等）上升，上涨
senses.example_en: Gas prices have gone up dramatically over the past month.
senses.example_zh: 上个月汽油价格大幅上涨。

senses.meaning: 建筑物等）拔地而起，兴建
senses.example_en: New office blocks are going up all over the city centre.
senses.example_zh: 市中心各处都建起了一座座新的写字楼。

senses.example_en: The old wooden warehouse went up in flames within minutes.
senses.example_zh: 那座老旧的木质仓库几分钟内就陷入了一片火海。

senses.example_en: The unemployment rate has gone down slightly this quarter.
senses.example_zh: 本季度失业率略有下降。

senses.meaning: 计算机系统、服务器等）宕机，瘫痪
senses.example_en: Our website went down for two hours due to a technical glitch.
senses.example_zh: 由于技术故障，我们的网站瘫痪了两个小时。

senses.example_en: This historic speech will go down in history.
senses.example_zh: 这篇历史性的演讲将被载入史册。

senses.example_en: I need to go over my notes before tomorrow's exam.
senses.example_zh: 明天的考试前我得把笔记好好复习一遍。

senses.meaning: 走过去，前往（某地/某人身边）
senses.example_en: He went over to the window and looked out at the rain.
senses.example_zh: 他走到窗前，看着外面的雨。

senses.example_en: The CEO's new policy didn't go over well with the staff.
senses.example_zh: 首席执行官的新政策并没有受到员工的好评。

senses.example_en: It's getting late; we should probably go back home.
senses.example_zh: 天色不早了，我们大概该回家了。

senses.example_en: The tradition of this festival goes back to the fourteenth century.
senses.example_zh: 这个节日的传统可以追溯到十四世纪。

senses.example_en: David and I go back a long way; we met in primary school.
senses.example_zh: 我和戴维相识已久，我们小学时就认识了。

senses.example_en: I think I'll go for the grilled salmon instead of the steak.
senses.example_zh: 我想我选烤三文鱼，不吃牛排了。

senses.example_en: You have the talent, so go for the championship!
senses.example_zh: 你有这份天赋，去全力争取冠军吧！

senses.example_en: What I just said goes for all of you in this room.
senses.example_zh: 我刚才说的话对这个房间里的所有人都适用。

senses.example_en: The guard dog suddenly went for the intruder's leg.
senses.example_zh: 那只看门狗突然扑向入侵者的腿。

senses.meaning: 赞同，顺从，配合（提议、决定或观点）
senses.example_en: I don't entirely agree, but I'll go along with the majority's decision.
senses.example_zh: 我并不完全赞同，但我会服从多数人的决定。

senses.example_en: As time goes by, you'll realize it was for the best.
senses.example_zh: 随着时间的流逝，你会明白这一切都是最好的安排。

senses.example_en: Going by what the weather forecast said, it should clear up by noon.
senses.example_zh: 根据天气预报所说，中午前天就会转晴。

senses.example_en: I saw them standing outside as I went by the cafe.
senses.example_zh: 我路过那家咖啡馆时看到他们站在外面。

senses.meaning: 着手进行，准许发生（常用于祈使句鼓励对方行动）
senses.example_en: If you really want to apply for that position, go ahead.
senses.example_zh: 如果你真想申请那个职位，就大胆去干吧。

senses.example_en: You go ahead, and I'll catch up with you in a minute.
senses.example_zh: 你先往前走，我马上就追上你。

senses.example_en: We're planning to go away to the countryside this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们计划这个周末离开城市去乡下度假。

senses.meaning: 疼痛、问题、感觉等）消退，消失
senses.example_en: I took some aspirin, but the headache just won't go away.
senses.example_zh: 我吃了阿司匹林，但头痛还是消退不了。

senses.meaning: 忍受缺乏，在没有...的情况下勉强应付
senses.example_en: During the blizzard, many families had to go without electricity for days.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雪期间，许多家庭不得不忍受连续数日断电。

senses.meaning: 着手处理，着手做（日常事务或任务）
senses.example_en: How should we go about resolving this customer complaint?
senses.example_zh: 我们该如何着手解决这桩客户投诉？

senses.example_en: There's a rumor going about that the company is about to be sold.
senses.example_zh: 到处流传着公司即将被出售的传言。

senses.example_en: Does this red tie go with my blue shirt?
senses.example_zh: 这条红领带配我的蓝衬衫好看吗？

senses.example_en: High responsibility usually goes with higher pay.
senses.example_zh: 高责任往往伴随着高薪资。

senses.example_en: After much debate, we decided to go with the second design proposal.
senses.example_zh: 经过深入讨论，我们决定选用第二套设计方案。

senses.meaning: 坚持完成（艰难、令人不快或有争议的事）
senses.example_en: Despite her family's objections, she went through with the divorce.
senses.example_zh: 尽管家里人反对，她还是坚持办完了离婚手续。

senses.meaning: 付出超出预期的努力，格外卖力
senses.example_en: Our customer support team is always willing to go the extra mile to resolve issues.
senses.example_zh: 我们的客服团队总是愿意加倍努力来解决问题。

senses.example_en: Instead of overplanning the vacation, let's just relax and go with the flow.
senses.example_zh: 与其把假期规划得太满，不如放松下来顺其自然。

senses.example_en: It goes without saying that hard work is indispensable for achieving long-term success.
senses.example_zh: 不言而喻，努力奋斗是取得长期成功必不可少的。

senses.meaning: 特意，格外费心（去帮助他人）
senses.example_en: My neighbor went out of his way to help me repair the broken fence during the rain.
senses.example_zh: 我邻居冒雨格外热心地帮我修理坏掉的栅栏。

senses.example_en: Many small tech startups went belly up when funding dried up suddenly.
senses.example_zh: 当资金骤然枯竭时，许多小型初创科技公司纷纷倒闭。

idioms.phrase: go back to the drawing board

senses.meaning: 从头再来，重新制定计划
senses.example_en: The prototype failed the safety test, so the engineers had to go back to the drawing board.
senses.example_zh: 原型机未通过安全测试，工程师们不得不推倒重来。

senses.example_en: No matter how meticulously you plan, things can still go wrong.
senses.example_zh: 无论你计划得多么周密，事情仍有可能出差错。

senses.meaning: 在网络上）迅速走红，病毒式传播
senses.example_en: The short rescue video went viral within hours and attracted millions of views.
senses.example_zh: 那段救援短视频在几小时内走红网络，吸引了数百万次观看。

senses.example_en: The retail chain was forced to go bankrupt after accumulating massive debts.
senses.example_zh: 在背负巨额债务后，该零售连锁店被迫宣告破产。

senses.example_en: Several key documents went missing right before the audit took place.
senses.example_zh: 就在审查开展前夕，几份关键文件不翼而飞了。

senses.example_en: The ecstatic crowd went crazy when the singer walked onto the stage.
senses.example_zh: 当歌手走上舞台时，狂喜的观众们陷入了疯狂。

senses.example_en: Her diligent contributions to the department did not go unnoticed by senior management.
senses.example_zh: 她对部门的辛勤贡献并没有被管理层忽视。

senses.example_en: We don't need to go into details right now; let's stick to the main points.
senses.example_zh: 我们现在不需要细究，先抓住重点。

senses.meaning: 从事，投身于（某行业或职业）
senses.example_en: After graduating from college, she decided to go into journalism.
senses.example_zh: 大学毕业后，她决定从事新闻行业。

senses.example_en: A tremendous amount of work went into preparing this exhibition.
senses.example_zh: 筹备这次展览投入了极其庞大的工作量。

senses.meaning: 计算机网络等）因超时而自动中断/失效
senses.example_en: The banking session timed out because of several minutes of inactivity.
senses.example_zh: 网银操作因数分钟无活动而超时自动中断。

senses.example_en: The basketball coach decided to time out with only ten seconds remaining.
senses.example_zh: 篮球教练在仅剩10秒钟时决定请求暂停。

senses.meaning: 选定……的时间以配合；使与……同步发生
senses.example_en: The publisher timed the book's release to coincide with the film's premiere.
senses.example_zh: 出版商特意安排了该书的发行时间，使其与电影首映同步。

senses.meaning: 在最后一刻，千钧一发之际
senses.example_en: Paramedics arrived in the nick of time to save the drowning swimmer.
senses.example_zh: 急救医护人员在千钧一发之际赶到，挽救了溺水游泳者的生命。

senses.example_en: His visionary architectural designs were so far ahead of their time that few appreciated them initially.
senses.example_zh: 他前瞻性的建筑设计极为超前，以至于起初鲜有人能真正赏识。

senses.meaning: 时间会证明，日久见人心
senses.example_en: Whether the bold corporate merger was the right move remains uncertain; only time will tell.
senses.example_zh: 这次大胆的企业合并是否是明智之举尚无定论；唯有时间会证明一切。

senses.meaning: 陈旧落伍，赶不上时代步伐
senses.example_en: Relying on manual paper filing makes their administrative office look terribly behind the times.
senses.example_zh: 依靠手工纸质归档让他们的行政办公室显得极其落伍于时代。

idioms.phrase: have the time of one's life

senses.meaning: 过得极开心，享受生命中最美妙的时光
senses.example_en: The kids had the time of their lives riding rollercoasters at the amusement park.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们在游乐园坐过山车，玩得尽兴极了。

senses.example_en: Even though they live far apart, the old college roommates still meet up from time to time.
senses.example_zh: 尽管彼此住得很远，这几位大学室友依然会不时聚一聚。

senses.example_en: I browsed through the airport duty-free shops just to kill time before boarding.
senses.example_zh: 登机前我逛了逛机场免税店，纯粹为了消磨时间。

senses.example_en: No matter how frantic his work schedule is, he always makes time for his family.
senses.example_zh: 无论工作日程多么繁忙，他总会腾出时间陪伴家人。

senses.example_en: There's no hurry to complete the questionnaire, so please take your time.
senses.example_zh: 完成这份调查问卷无需着急，请慢慢填写。

senses.example_en: The speaker ran out of time before she could present her final conclusions.
senses.example_zh: 演讲者还没来得及展示最终结论，时间就用光了。

senses.example_en: During the long power outage, we played board games to pass the time.
senses.example_zh: 在漫长的停电期间，我们玩棋盘游戏来打发时间。

senses.example_en: Our five-year-old daughter has just learned how to tell the time on an analog clock.
senses.example_zh: 我们五岁的女儿刚刚学会了如何在指针式钟表上看时间。

senses.example_en: Stop wasting time arguing over minor details and focus on the main objective.
senses.example_zh: 别再把时间浪费在为细枝末节争执上了，专注于核心目标吧。

senses.example_en: We will continue using the legacy software for the time being until the upgrade is tested.
senses.example_zh: 在升级测试完毕之前，我们暂时会继续使用旧版软件。

senses.meaning: 把……的时机掌握得很好/很糟
senses.example_en: She timed her entrance well and stole the spotlight immediately.
senses.example_zh: 她入场的时机把握得非常好，立刻吸引了全场的焦点。

senses.meaning: 因超过限定时间而自动退出/失效
senses.example_en: Students will time out of the online test if they do not submit their answers in time.
senses.example_zh: 如果学生未能及时提交答案，系统将因超时而自动退出在线考试。

senses.example_en: If you time your property investment right, you can make substantial profits.
senses.example_zh: 如果你把房产投资的时机把握得恰到好处，就能赚取可观的利润。

senses.example_en: The radar timed the speeding car at over ninety miles per hour.
senses.example_zh: 测速雷达测得那辆超速汽车的时速超过90英里。

senses.meaning: 征求意见）觉得……怎么样，对……意下如何
senses.example_en: What do you say to a quick walk in the park before dinner?
senses.example_zh: 晚饭前去公园散散步，你觉得怎么样？

senses.example_en: What did the committee say to your proposal for budget cuts?
senses.example_zh: 委员会对你削减预算的提议作何表态？

senses.meaning: 大声说出；毫不顾忌地直说
senses.example_en: If you disagree with the decision, please say it out loud.
senses.example_zh: 如果你不同意这项决定，请坦率直说。

senses.meaning: 谈论；对……发表看法或评价
senses.example_en: What did the critics say about the director's latest film?
senses.example_zh: 影评人对这位导演的最新电影有何评价？

senses.meaning: 就……发表进一步意见或看法
senses.example_en: Do you have anything further to say on the matter under discussion?
senses.example_zh: 针对目前讨论的这件事情，你还有什么要补充的吗？

senses.example_en: Say on, we are all eager to hear how the story ends.
senses.example_zh: 接着说吧，我们都很想听听故事的结局。

senses.meaning: 重复朗诵；默念；逐字复述
senses.example_en: She said the phone number over several times so that she wouldn't forget it.
senses.example_zh: 她把那个电话号码默念了好几遍，以免忘记。

senses.meaning: 退一步说；往轻了说；至少可以这么说
senses.example_en: The transition period has been challenging, to say the least.
senses.example_zh: 往轻了说，这一过渡时期充满了挑战。

senses.example_en: We will provide full logistics, that is to say, transport, meals, and lodging.
senses.example_zh: 我们将提供全面的后勤保障，也就是说包括交通、餐饮和住宿。

senses.meaning: 不用说；不言而喻；显而易见
senses.example_en: Needless to say, the sudden announcement left everyone in utter shock.
senses.example_zh: 不用说，这一突如其来的消息让所有人都震惊不已。

senses.example_en: It goes without saying that safety remains our topmost priority.
senses.example_zh: 不言而喻，安全始终是我们最优先考虑的事项。

idioms.phrase: when all is said and done

senses.example_en: When all is said and done, execution matters far more than mere strategy.
senses.example_zh: 归根结底，执行力远比单纯的策略重要得多。

senses.meaning: 一点也没错；我完全同意
senses.example_en: "It's freezing outside!" — "You can say that again."
senses.example_zh: “外面太冷了！”——“可不是嘛，一点没错。”

senses.example_en: I must say, your presentation was one of the most persuasive I've seen.
senses.example_zh: 我不得不说，你的演讲是我见过的最具说服力的演讲之一。

senses.meaning: 对某事）有发言权；有决定权
senses.example_en: Employees demand to have a say in major corporate restructuring decisions.
senses.example_zh: 员工要求在公司重大重组决策中拥有发言权。

senses.meaning: 无话可说；无可奉告；拒绝评论
senses.example_en: The spokesperson had nothing to say regarding the ongoing investigation.
senses.example_zh: 发言人对正在进行的调查表示无可奉告。

senses.meaning: 一言不发；守口如瓶；不泄露秘密
senses.example_en: She promised not to say a word about the surprise party to anyone.
senses.example_zh: 她保证对惊喜派对的事守口如瓶，绝不对任何人透露。

senses.example_en: After weighing the risks, the board finally decided to say yes to the merger.
senses.example_zh: 权衡风险后，董事会最终决定批准这项合并案。

senses.example_en: It only takes a moment to say thanks to those who support you every day.
senses.example_zh: 对那些日常支持你的人说声谢谢，其实只需片刻。

senses.example_en: It is hard to say whether the new market regulations will stimulate growth.
senses.example_zh: 很难说新的市场监管法规是否会刺激经济增长。

senses.example_en: As they say, time and tide wait for no man.
senses.example_zh: 常言道，岁月不饶人，时不我待。

senses.example_en: I said to myself that things would surely improve with time.
senses.example_zh: 我心里琢磨着，事情肯定会随着时间好转的。

senses.example_en: "Where did I leave my keys?" she said to herself as she searched the room.
senses.example_zh: “我把钥匙放哪儿了？”她在屋里翻找时自言自语道。

senses.example_en: What do you have to say for yourself after arriving two hours late?
senses.example_zh: 迟到了整整两个小时，你为自己有什么好解释的？

senses.meaning: 爱说话，善于自我表达（常用于否定句）
senses.example_en: He is very shy and never has much to say for himself at parties.
senses.example_zh: 他非常害羞，在聚会上总是不怎么说话。

senses.meaning: 反对；提出不利于……的意见；说……的坏话
senses.example_en: Nobody had a single negative word to say against her work ethic.
senses.example_zh: 没有人对她的职业操守提出过任何负面看法。

senses.meaning: 了解……的情况；知晓关于……的事情
senses.example_en: Did you know about the sudden change in tomorrow's schedule?
senses.example_zh: 你知道明天日程突然变动的事吗？

senses.example_en: He really knows about classic cars and restores them as a hobby.
senses.example_zh: 他对老爷车非常懂行，平时以改装修复它们为爱好。

senses.meaning: 分清；辨别（两者或多个相似事物）
senses.example_en: The twin brothers look so similar that only their mother can know them apart.
senses.example_zh: 那对双胞胎兄弟长得太像了，只有他们的母亲能分辨出来。

senses.example_en: I didn't see his face, but I knew him at once by his unique voice.
senses.example_zh: 我没看到他的脸，但凭他独特的声音立刻就认出了他。

senses.meaning: 以……名字为人所知（常用于被动态）
senses.example_en: She was known by her childhood nickname long after she grew up.
senses.example_zh: 长大成人很久之后，大家依然习惯叫她小时候的绰号。

senses.example_en: The coastal town is known for its fresh seafood and sandy beaches.
senses.example_zh: 这座海滨小镇以新鲜的海鲜和沙滩而闻名遐迩。

senses.meaning: 懂得更多道理而不至于做错事；心知肚明；明智得不至于
senses.example_en: You know better than to click on suspicious email attachments.
senses.example_zh: 你明白事理，绝不至于去点击可疑的邮件附件。

senses.meaning: 懂得门道；摸清诀窍；熟悉行规流程
senses.example_en: Once you know the ropes, handling daily client requests will be much smoother.
senses.example_zh: 一旦你摸清了门道，处理日常客户需求就会顺手得多。

senses.meaning: 对……了如指掌；对……极为精通
senses.example_en: Having maintained the software for a decade, she knows the code inside out.
senses.example_zh: 维护该软件整整十年后，她对这段代码了如指掌。

senses.meaning: 知情的；消息灵通的；掌握内部信息的
senses.example_en: Insiders in the know suggest that a leadership reshuffle is imminent.
senses.example_zh: 消息灵通的内部人士暗示，领导层大换血迫在眉睫。

senses.meaning: 据我所知；天晓得；说不定（常表推测与不确定）
senses.example_en: He hasn't called for days; for all I know, he might have already left town.
senses.example_zh: 他好几天没打电话了；天晓得，说不定他早就离开这座城市了。

idioms.phrase: not know the first thing about

senses.example_en: He agreed to fix the engine despite not knowing the first thing about mechanics.
senses.example_zh: 尽管对机械一窍不通，他还是答应去修那台发动机。

senses.meaning: 明白事理；懂得世故；心里有数
senses.example_en: Ask Sarah for career advice—she has been in the industry long enough to know what's what.
senses.example_zh: 向萨拉请教职业建议吧——她入行已久，深谙行业门道。

collocations.phrase: know for sure / know for certain

senses.example_en: We won't know for sure whether the bid was accepted until Friday morning.
senses.example_zh: 要到周五上午我们才能确切知道竞标是否被采纳。

senses.example_en: The orientation program helps freshmen get to know their peers and faculty.
senses.example_zh: 迎新培训项目有助于新生逐渐熟悉同龄人和教职员工。

senses.example_en: He knew full well that his decision violated the company's code of conduct.
senses.example_zh: 他心知肚明自己的决定违反了公司的行为准则。

senses.example_en: Please let me know as soon as the revised draft is ready for review.
senses.example_zh: 修改稿准备好审阅时，请第一时间通知我。

senses.example_en: As far as I know, the contract terms have not yet been finalized.
senses.example_zh: 据我所知，合同条款目前尚未敲定。

senses.example_en: The actor rehearsed every monologue until he knew the entire script by heart.
senses.example_zh: 该演员反复排练每段独白，直到把整个剧本倒背如流。

senses.meaning: 自我介绍；使自己为人所知；引人注目
senses.example_en: Upon arriving at the conference, she immediately made herself known to the keynote speaker.
senses.example_zh: 一到达研讨会现场，她便立刻主动向主旨发言人作了自我介绍。

senses.meaning: 听说过；知晓……的存在（但无深入了解）
senses.example_en: I know of the author, but I haven't read any of her recent novels.
senses.example_zh: 我听说过这位作家，但还没读过她近期的任何小说。

senses.example_en: When it comes to local ingredients, the head chef certainly knows best.
senses.example_zh: 说到当地食材，主厨自然最有发言权。

senses.meaning: 自以为是；自作聪明（常含讽刺意味）
senses.example_en: He refused to listen to advice, confident that he knew best.
senses.example_zh: 他拒绝听取任何建议，总觉得自己最聪明。

senses.meaning: 以……著称；被称作；被公认为
senses.example_en: The city is known as the cultural capital of the region.
senses.example_zh: 这座城市被公认为该地区的文化之都。

senses.example_en: Children need to be taught to know right from wrong at an early age.
senses.example_zh: 孩子从小就应该被教导辨别是非黑白。

senses.example_en: Please take off your shoes before entering the house.
senses.example_zh: 进屋前请脱鞋。

senses.example_en: The plane took off on time despite the heavy fog.
senses.example_zh: 尽管大雾弥漫，飞机还是准时起飞了。

senses.example_en: Her career really took off after the release of her debut novel.
senses.example_zh: 她的首部小说出版后，事业真正开始腾飞。

senses.example_en: I'm planning to take a few days off next week to visit my parents.
senses.example_zh: 我打算下周请几天假去探望父母。

senses.example_en: She took on extra responsibilities after her manager resigned.
senses.example_zh: 经理辞职后，她承担了额外的工作职责。

senses.example_en: The company is expanding and plans to take on twenty new staff members.
senses.example_zh: 公司正在扩张，计划招募二十名新员工。

senses.example_en: The old street took on a festive appearance during the holiday season.
senses.example_zh: 节日期间，这条老街呈现出一派喜庆的景象。

senses.example_en: Our team is ready to take on the defending champions in the finals.
senses.example_zh: 我们队已做好在决赛中挑战卫冕冠军的准备。

senses.meaning: 开始从事（爱好、职业或学习）
senses.example_en: He decided to take up photography as a hobby in his spare time.
senses.example_zh: 他决定在业余时间把摄影当作一项爱好。

senses.example_en: Sorting through those emails took up the entire morning.
senses.example_zh: 整理那些电子邮件占用了整整一个上午的时间。

senses.meaning: 采纳，接受（建议、挑战或提议）
senses.example_en: The committee decided to take up the proposal at the next meeting.
senses.example_zh: 委员会决定在下次会议上审议该提案。

senses.meaning: 接管，接手（职位、业务或控制权）
senses.example_en: She will take over as CEO when the current director retires.
senses.example_zh: 现任总裁退休后，她将接任首席执行官一职。

senses.meaning: 通过收购等方式）兼并，占有
senses.example_en: A multinational corporation is attempting to take over the local firm.
senses.example_zh: 一家跨国公司正试图收购这家当地企业。

senses.example_en: Automated systems are slowly taking over routine administrative tasks.
senses.example_zh: 自动化系统正在逐步取代常规的行政工作。

senses.meaning: 领会，理解，吸收（知识或信息）
senses.example_en: The lecture was so complex that I could hardly take it all in.
senses.example_zh: 那场讲座太深奥了，我几乎无法完全理解吸收。

senses.meaning: 欺骗，蒙骗（常用于被动态）
senses.example_en: Don't be taken in by his charming smiles and empty promises.
senses.example_zh: 别被他迷人的微笑和空洞的承诺蒙骗了。

senses.meaning: 收留，接纳（借宿者或无家可归者）
senses.example_en: They generously took in several stranded travelers during the blizzard.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雪期间，他们慷慨地收留了几名滞留的旅客。

senses.example_en: She lost weight, so she had to have her dresses taken in.
senses.example_zh: 她瘦了，所以不得不把裙子改小一些。

senses.example_en: He took out his wallet and paid for the groceries in cash.
senses.example_zh: 他掏出钱包，用现金支付了杂货款。

senses.meaning: 带……外出（用餐、约会等并通常买单）
senses.example_en: I'm going to take my parents out for dinner this Friday.
senses.example_zh: 这个星期五我打算带父母出去吃晚饭。

senses.meaning: 取得，办理（贷款、保险、执照等）
senses.example_en: They had to take out a mortgage to buy their first home.
senses.example_zh: 他们不得不办理按揭贷款来购买第一套住房。

senses.example_en: The airstrike managed to take out the enemy's radar installation.
senses.example_zh: 空袭成功摧毁了敌方的雷达设施。

senses.meaning: 收回（所说的话），承认错误
senses.example_en: I take back what I said earlier; you were completely right.
senses.example_zh: 我收回我之前说的话，你完全是对的。

senses.example_en: If the sweater doesn't fit, you can take it back to the store.
senses.example_zh: 如果这件毛衣不合身，你可以把它拿回商店退换。

senses.example_en: Hearing that old song took me back to my college days.
senses.example_zh: 听到那首老歌，勾起了我大学时代的回忆。

senses.example_en: The secretary took down every word said during the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 秘书把会议上说的每句话都记录了下来。

senses.meaning: 拆卸，拆除（建筑、账篷等结构）
senses.example_en: It took them two hours to take down the camping tents.
senses.example_zh: 他们花了两个小时才把露营帐篷拆卸完毕。

senses.example_en: She reached up to take down a thick volume from the top shelf.
senses.example_zh: 她伸手从最上面的书架上取下一本厚厚的书。

senses.meaning: 击败，挫败（对手），挫某人锐气
senses.example_en: The champion was unexpectedly taken down in the third round.
senses.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在第三轮意外被击败。

senses.meaning: 相貌或性格）像（父母或长辈
senses.example_en: In terms of patience, she definitely takes after her father.
senses.example_zh: 说到耐心，她显然很像她父亲。

senses.example_en: He took the watch apart to see why the gears had stopped turning.
senses.example_zh: 他把手表拆开，想看看齿轮为什么停转了。

senses.meaning: 严厉批评，全盘剖析推翻（论点等）
senses.example_en: The critic took apart the politician's economic plan piece by piece.
senses.example_zh: 评论家对这位政客的经济方案进行了逐条批驳。

senses.example_en: The home team completely took apart the visitors with a 5-0 win.
senses.example_zh: 主队以 5 比 0 轻松击溃客队。

senses.example_en: The waiter took away the empty plates once we finished eating.
senses.example_zh: 我们吃完后，服务员收走了空盘子。

senses.example_en: The medication helped take away the throbbing pain in his knee.
senses.example_zh: 这种药物帮助消除了他膝盖的剧烈抽痛。

senses.example_en: Two coffees to take away, please.
senses.example_zh: 请给我打包两杯咖啡。

senses.meaning: 汲取，领悟（经验、主要信息）
senses.example_en: The key message to take away from this workshop is effective communication.
senses.example_zh: 从这次研讨会中需要领会的核心要点是有效沟通。

senses.example_en: The puppy took to the new family almost immediately.
senses.example_zh: 小狗几乎立刻就喜欢上了新主人一家。

senses.meaning: 养成……的习惯，开始沉溺于
senses.example_en: Under immense stress, he unfortunately took to drinking heavily.
senses.example_zh: 在巨大的压力下，他不幸染上了酗酒的毛病。

senses.example_en: Villagers took to the hills when the rising river breached its banks.
senses.example_zh: 当上涨的河水决堤时，村民们逃往了山丘。

senses.example_en: I'm sorry, I took you for someone else in that dim light.
senses.example_zh: 对不起，在昏暗的光线下我把你错认成别人了。

senses.example_en: Do you take me for a fool to believe such a transparent lie?
senses.example_zh: 你把我当傻子吗，会相信这么显而易见的谎言？

senses.meaning: 向……详细解释，指导……逐步了解
senses.example_en: Let me take you through the onboarding procedure step by step.
senses.example_zh: 让我一步步向你详细讲解入职流程。

senses.meaning: 使吃惊，使大吃一惊（常用于被动态）
senses.example_en: I was taken aback by how bluntly she criticized the proposal.
senses.example_zh: 她对提案批评得如此直白，令我深感震惊。

senses.meaning: 与……结交，开始同……频繁交往
senses.example_en: He has taken up with a rather suspicious crowd recently.
senses.example_zh: 他最近开始和一帮形迹可疑的人混在一起。

senses.meaning: 向……提出（问题、投诉等）讨论
senses.example_en: You should take that issue up with human resources directly.
senses.example_zh: 你应该直接向人力资源部门反映那个问题。

senses.meaning: 拿……出气，将不良情绪发泄到……身上
senses.example_en: I know you had a bad day at work, but don't take it out on the kids.
senses.example_zh: 我知道你今天工作不顺心，但别拿孩子们出气。

senses.meaning: 认为...理所当然；对...不以为意/不加重视
senses.example_en: We often take clean running water for granted until a drought hits the region.
senses.example_zh: 在干旱席卷该地区之前，我们往往把干净的自来水视作理所当然。

idioms.phrase: take sth with a grain of salt

senses.meaning: 对某事持保留/半信半疑的态度
senses.example_en: Online rumors should always be taken with a grain of salt until credible proof emerges.
senses.example_zh: 在可靠证据出现之前，网络传言总应持保留态度看待。

idioms.phrase: take the bull by the horns

senses.example_en: Instead of waiting for matters to worsen, she took the bull by the horns and settled the dispute directly.
senses.example_zh: 她没有坐视事态恶化，而是迎难而上，直接化解了纠纷。

senses.example_en: The doctor advised him to take it easy for a couple of weeks following the surgical procedure.
senses.example_zh: 医生建议他在手术后的几周内放慢节奏、好好静养。

senses.meaning: 产生负面影响；造成严重损坏/损耗
senses.example_en: Years of relentless shift work finally took a heavy toll on his overall health.
senses.example_zh: 长年累月的倒班工作终于对他的整体健康造成了沉重损害。

senses.meaning: 美得让人屏息；令人惊叹不已
senses.example_en: The panoramic vista from the summit was so spectacular that it took our breath away.
senses.example_zh: 山顶俯瞰的壮丽全景美得令人屏息凝神。

senses.meaning: 走光明正大的路；采取宽宏大量/道德高尚的做法
senses.example_en: Rather than retaliating against the insult, she chose to take the high road and remain silent.
senses.example_zh: 面对侮辱，她没有施加报复，而是选择采取宽容大度的姿态保持沉默。

senses.example_en: The committee must take into account local weather patterns when designing the drainage system.
senses.example_zh: 委员会在设计排水系统时，必须把当地的天气状况考虑在内。

senses.meaning: 利用（机会/有利条件）；占...便宜
senses.example_en: Young graduates should take advantage of every internship opportunity to gain practical experience.
senses.example_zh: 年轻毕业生应当把握每一个实习机会以获取实践经验。

senses.example_en: Hundreds of energetic volunteers eagerly took part in the annual coastal cleanup.
senses.example_zh: 数百名热情的志愿者积极参与了一年一度的海滩清理活动。

senses.example_en: Don't fret about the billing discrepancy; our accounting team will take care of it immediately.
senses.example_zh: 别为账单出入发愁，我们的财务团队会立即处理妥当。

senses.example_en: Regulatory authorities need to take decisive action against illicit financial operations.
senses.example_zh: 监管机构需要对非法金融运作采取果断措施。

senses.example_en: The international trade conference is scheduled to take place in Geneva this November.
senses.example_zh: 该国际贸易峰会定于今年十一月在日内瓦举行。

senses.example_en: Entrepreneurs are often required to take calculated risks to achieve breakthrough innovations.
senses.example_zh: 创业者往往需要承担经过审慎权衡的风险，才能实现突破性创新。

senses.example_en: I need some quiet time alone to think about what went wrong.
senses.example_zh: 我需要一个人静静思考一下到底是哪里出了差错。

senses.example_en: We're thinking about moving closer to the city center next year.
senses.example_zh: 我们正考虑明年搬到离市中心更近的地方。

senses.example_en: She often thinks about her happy childhood spent on the farm.
senses.example_zh: 她常常回想起在农场度过的快乐童年。

senses.meaning: 仔细考虑，认真掂量（提议、决定等）
senses.example_en: It's a major career move, so please think it over before deciding.
senses.example_zh: 这是职业生涯的重大转变，所以在做决定前请仔细考虑。

senses.meaning: 充分推敲，全面考虑（后果、细节或可行性）
senses.example_en: They clearly hadn't thought the consequences through before acting.
senses.example_zh: 他们行动前显然没有把后果通盘考虑清楚。

senses.meaning: 想出，虚构，捏造（主意、借口等）
senses.example_en: He had to think up a plausible excuse for arriving two hours late.
senses.example_zh: 他不得不编出一个合理的借口来解释迟到两个小时的原因。

senses.meaning: 仔细规划，精心构思（常用于 well-thought-out）
senses.example_en: The marketing strategy was thoroughly thought out before the campaign launched.
senses.example_zh: 该营销策略在活动启动前经过了缜密的构思与规划。

senses.meaning: 回想，追忆过去（常与 to 搭配）
senses.example_en: Thinking back to my early days in the industry, I made so many mistakes.
senses.example_zh: 回想起我刚入行时的那些日子，我犯过很多错误。

senses.meaning: 未雨绸缪，提前规划，作长远打算
senses.example_en: Good managers always think ahead and prepare for unexpected market shifts.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的管理者总是未雨绸缪，为意料之外的市场变化做准备。

senses.meaning: 跳出固有思维/创造性思考
senses.example_en: To conquer this competitive market, the design department must think outside the box.
senses.example_zh: 为了攻克这个竞争激烈的市场，设计部门必须打破常规、创新思考。

senses.meaning: 头脑反应敏捷/临场应变迅速
senses.example_en: During press conferences, political spokespersons must be capable of thinking on their feet.
senses.example_zh: 在新闻发布会上，政治发言人必须具备随机应变、迅速作答的能力。

senses.example_en: You ought to think twice before investing your life savings in such an unproven market.
senses.example_zh: 把毕生积蓄投入这样一个未经检验的市场之前，你务必三思而后行。

senses.meaning: 胸怀大志/放开眼界去设想
senses.example_en: If you wish to build an enduring global empire, you need to dare to think big from day one.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想打造一个持久的全球商业帝国，第一天起就得敢于立大志、做宏图规划。

senses.example_en: To my way of thinking, prioritizing product durability will earn stronger consumer trust.
senses.example_zh: 依我看来，把产品耐用度放在首位会赢得消费者更坚实的信任。

senses.meaning: 回想起来/话又说回来（突然意识到某事）
senses.example_en: Come to think of it, I don't recall seeing his car parked outside this morning at all.
senses.example_zh: 话说回来，我仔细一想，今早根本没印象在外面见过他的车。

senses.example_en: The professor's closing remarks on ethical artificial intelligence gave us all food for thought.
senses.example_zh: 教授最后关于伦理人工智能的点评引人深思，给所有人带来了启迪。

senses.example_en: Senior executives think highly of her analytical acumen and leadership potential.
senses.example_zh: 高管层对她的敏锐分析能力与领导潜能评价极高。

senses.meaning: 自言自语/把想法说出来以帮助梳理
senses.example_en: I'm just thinking out loud here, so feel free to point out any flaws in my reasoning.
senses.example_zh: 我只是把心里所想随口念叨出来，大家尽管挑我逻辑上的漏洞。

senses.example_en: The judge thought fit to reduce the defendant's sentence in light of fresh evidence.
senses.example_zh: 鉴于新出示的证据，法官认为适当减轻被告的刑罚是合理的。

senses.meaning: 头脑清醒/有条理地理性思考
senses.example_en: After hours of nonstop negotiations, fatigue made it nearly impossible to think straight.
senses.example_zh: 经过数小时不间断的谈判后，极度疲劳让人几乎无法保持清醒理性的思考。

senses.example_en: If we stop to think about the environmental costs, we may revise our production strategy.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们停下来反思一下环境代价，就可能会修正我们的生产策略。

senses.meaning: 往好处想/抱持积极乐观的心态
senses.example_en: Maintaining resilience during economic crises requires leaders to think positively.
senses.example_zh: 在经济危机期间保持韧性，要求领导者抱持积极乐观的心态去面对。

collocations.phrase: think poorly of / think ill of

senses.meaning: 对...评价低/看轻/对...有成见
senses.example_en: She feared that resigning so soon would make colleagues think poorly of her commitment.
senses.example_zh: 她担心这么快辞职会让同事看轻她对工作的投入与责任心。

senses.example_en: I can see his face clearly, but I can't think of his name.
senses.example_zh: 我清楚记得他的模样，但就是想不起他的名字。

senses.example_en: Have you ever thought of starting your own business abroad?
senses.example_zh: 你有没有考虑过去国外自己创业？

senses.example_en: What did you think of the new director's first presentation?
senses.example_zh: 你觉得新总监的第一次汇报怎么样？

senses.meaning: 打消念头，改变主意（自知原想法不明智）
senses.example_en: He opened his mouth to argue, but thought better of it and stayed silent.
senses.example_zh: 他张嘴想争辩，但转念一想觉得不妥，便保持了沉默。

senses.example_en: Over the years, the neighbors came to think of each other as family.
senses.example_zh: 多年来，邻里之间已经把彼此看作家人一般。

senses.example_en: All his friends gathered at the airport to see him off.
senses.example_zh: 他所有的朋友都赶到机场为他送行。

senses.example_en: The defending champions managed to see off their rivals in a tense final.
senses.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在紧张的决赛中成功击败了对手。

senses.meaning: 驱赶，赶走（入侵者或动物）
senses.example_en: The guard dog barked fiercely and saw off the trespassers.
senses.example_zh: 看门狗狂吠不止，将非法闯入者赶了出去。

senses.meaning: 看穿，识破（骗局、谎言或伪装）
senses.example_en: It didn't take long for the investors to see through his false promises.
senses.example_zh: 投资者没过多久就识破了他的虚假承诺。

senses.meaning: 支持…渡过难关，够…用一段时间
senses.example_en: These savings should see us through the winter until business picks up.
senses.example_zh: 这笔储蓄应该足够支撑我们度过冬天，直到生意好转。

senses.meaning: 将（困难的项目或决定）坚持到底，贯彻到底
senses.example_en: Even when funds ran low, the team was determined to see the project through.
senses.example_zh: 即使资金紧张，团队也决心将这个项目贯彻到底。

senses.example_en: Don't worry about the catering for the party; I'll see to it.
senses.example_zh: 别担心聚会的餐饮问题，我会负责照料妥当的。

senses.example_en: I need to see about booking train tickets for our upcoming trip.
senses.example_zh: 我得去着手安排我们即将出行的火车票预订事宜了。

senses.meaning: 查问，考虑；（口语，表示怀疑或阻止）等等看，走着瞧
senses.example_en: He thinks he can take my job, but we'll see about that!
senses.example_zh: 他以为能抢走我的饭碗，咱们走着瞧！

senses.meaning: 送（客人）到大门口，送客出门
senses.example_en: There's no need to see me out; I know the way to the front door.
senses.example_zh: 不必送我出门了，我认得去大门的路。

senses.meaning: 熬过，度过（特定时期）；够用至…结束
senses.example_en: The elderly man was not expected to see out the harsh winter.
senses.example_zh: 那位老人原本被认为很难熬过这个严冬。

senses.example_en: She decided to stay with the company to see out her contract.
senses.example_zh: 她决定继续留在公司，直到履行完合同期。

senses.example_en: The receptionist will see the new client in as soon as the meeting room is ready.
senses.example_zh: 会议室一准备好，前台接待员就会领新客户进来。

senses.meaning: 迎接，庆祝（新年、新纪元等）的到来
senses.example_en: Thousands gathered in the square to see in the New Year with fireworks.
senses.example_zh: 数千人聚集在广场上，以烟花迎接新年的到来。

senses.meaning: 参观，游览，察看（建筑或景点）
senses.example_en: The estate agent took us to see around the newly renovated apartment.
senses.example_zh: 房产中介带我们参观了那套刚翻修过的公寓。

senses.meaning: 仔细视察，巡视，逐个察看（房屋、地产）
senses.example_en: We arranged an appointment to see over the house before making an offer.
senses.example_zh: 在出价之前，我们预约去仔细察看了一番那栋房子。

senses.meaning: 护送…穿过（马路、河流等危险地带）
senses.example_en: The crossing guard saw the schoolchildren safely across the busy avenue.
senses.example_zh: 交通协管员护送小学生们安全穿过了繁忙的大街。

senses.example_en: It is quite late, so I will see you back to your hotel.
senses.example_zh: 时间不早了，我送你回酒店吧。

senses.meaning: 送（某人）下楼；护送离开楼上区域
senses.example_en: My assistant will see you down to the lobby and call a taxi for you.
senses.example_zh: 我的助理会送你下楼到大厅，并为你叫一辆出租车。

senses.example_en: Although they are business partners, they rarely see eye to eye on long-term strategy.
senses.example_zh: 他们虽然是商业合伙人，但在长期战略上却极少达成共识。

senses.example_en: Whenever he hears people belittling his family's sacrifices, he sees red.
senses.example_zh: 每当听到有人贬低他家庭做出的牺牲，他就会火冒三丈。

senses.meaning: 恍然大悟，改邪归正；问世，公之于众
senses.example_en: After years of making poor financial bets, he finally saw the light and began saving regularly.
senses.example_zh: 在经历了多年的糟糕金融投机之后，他终于幡然醒悟，开始定期存钱。

senses.example_en: The editor saw fit to delete the most controversial paragraphs without consulting the author.
senses.example_zh: 编辑在未征询作者意见的情况下，自行决定删除了最具争议的段落。

idioms.phrase: as far as the eye can see

senses.example_en: In the desert, shimmering golden dunes stretch out as far as the eye can see.
senses.example_zh: 在沙漠中，金色的沙丘泛着波光，一望无际地延展向天边。

idioms.phrase: see sth coming a mile off

senses.meaning: 早就看出来，料事如神，早就预见到
senses.example_en: Their messy breakup was no surprise to anyone; our friends saw it coming a mile off.
senses.example_zh: 他们难看的收场让大家都不感到意外，朋友们早就预见到了这一天。

senses.example_en: This antique leather armchair has certainly seen better days, but it is still remarkably comfortable.
senses.example_zh: 这把老式真皮扶手椅确实风光不再、略显破旧，但坐起来依然非常舒适。

senses.example_en: We cannot predict how the market will respond to the interest rate hike; we will just have to wait and see.
senses.example_zh: 我们无法预测市场会对加息做出何种反应，我们只能拭目以待、静观其变。

senses.meaning: 明白意义所在，领会意图
senses.example_en: I understand your technical explanation, but I still fail to see the point of changing the entire interface.
senses.example_zh: 我听懂了你的技术解释，但我仍然没看出来彻底更换界面的意义何在。

senses.meaning: 明白事理，接受劝告，服理
senses.example_en: We argued with him for two hours before he finally saw reason and agreed to compromise.
senses.example_zh: 我们劝了他两个小时，他才终于听劝并同意做出妥协。

senses.example_en: If that persistent chest cough does not clear up by Friday, you must go see a doctor.
senses.example_zh: 如果那顽固的咳嗽到周五还没好，你必须去医院看医生。

senses.meaning: 看出幽默风趣之处，苦中作乐
senses.example_en: Even when the tent collapsed during the rainstorm, Sarah managed to see the funny side of the disaster.
senses.example_zh: 即便暴风雨中帐篷被吹塌了，萨拉依然能从中找到风趣可乐的一面。

senses.example_en: The manager saw no harm in letting the team work from home on Friday afternoons.
senses.example_zh: 经理觉得周五下午让团队在家办公无伤大雅。

senses.example_en: Her grandfather saw active service as a navy officer in the Mediterranean during the war.
senses.example_zh: 她祖父在战争期间作为海军军官在地中海服过现役并参加了战斗。

senses.example_en: The hospital saw a marked improvement in patient recovery times following the procedural overhaul.
senses.example_zh: 在该流程全面改革之后，医院见证了患者康复时间的显著缩短。

senses.example_en: Please see to it that all the doors are locked before you leave the building.
senses.example_zh: 离开大楼前，请务必确保所有的门都已锁好。

senses.example_en: He offered to see her home after the party ended past midnight.
senses.example_zh: 聚会过午夜结束后，他主动提出护送她回家。

senses.meaning: 押送/驱逐出场，将…驱离场地
senses.example_en: Security guards quickly intervened and saw the disorderly patron off the premises.
senses.example_zh: 安保人员迅速介入，将那名扰乱秩序的顾客驱离了现场。

senses.meaning: 调查，探察…的真相或内部情况
senses.example_en: The committee promised to see into the allegations of financial misconduct.
senses.example_zh: 委员会承诺将深入调查有关财务不端行为的指控。

senses.meaning: 洞察，看穿（某人的内心或本质）
senses.example_en: A perceptive mentor can see into a student's hidden potential.
senses.example_zh: 一位富有洞察力的导师能看清学生身上隐藏的潜能。

senses.example_en: She works out at the local gym three times a week.
senses.example_zh: 她每周在当地健身房锻炼三次。

senses.example_en: We need to work out the total cost before booking the venue.
senses.example_zh: 在预订场地之前，我们需要把总费用算出来。

senses.meaning: 情况）进展顺利，结果良好
senses.example_en: Don't worry too much; everything will work out in the end.
senses.example_zh: 别太担心，一切最终都会好起来的。

senses.meaning: 致力于，从事于（某项目或技能）
senses.example_en: He is currently working on his second novel.
senses.example_zh: 他目前正在创作他的第二部小说。

senses.example_en: I haven't convinced my dad yet, but I'm working on him.
senses.example_zh: 我还没说服我爸，但我正在努力做他的工作。

senses.meaning: 激起，唤起（食欲、情绪、热情等）
senses.example_en: A long walk in the countryside always helps me work up an appetite.
senses.example_zh: 在乡间漫步一番总能让我胃口大开。

senses.example_en: She started as an intern and worked up a successful career in publishing.
senses.example_zh: 她从实习生做起，逐步在出版界开创了成功的事业。

senses.meaning: 克服，理清（负面情绪、心理创伤或复杂困难）
senses.example_en: Therapy helped her work through her childhood grief.
senses.example_zh: 心理咨询帮助她走出了童年的悲伤阴影。

senses.meaning: 逐步完成，耐心地处理（清单或任务）
senses.example_en: It took us the entire afternoon to work through the pile of documents.
senses.example_zh: 我们花了一下午才逐一处理完这叠文件。

senses.meaning: 通过体力运动消除，发泄（压力、热量或怒气）
senses.example_en: Going for a run is the best way for him to work off stress.
senses.example_zh: 对他来说，跑步是排解压力的最佳方式。

senses.meaning: 以工代偿，用工作偿还（债务）
senses.example_en: He offered to paint the house to work off his debt.
senses.example_zh: 他主动提出粉刷房屋来抵清欠款。

senses.meaning: 抽时间把……安排进（紧凑日程）
senses.example_en: The dentist is very busy, but she can work you in at four o'clock.
senses.example_zh: 牙医日程很满，但她可以在四点钟抽空见你。

senses.meaning: 巧妙地融入，添加（想法、食材或细节）
senses.example_en: Try to work some humor into your opening remarks.
senses.example_zh: 尽量在你的开场白中融入一点幽默。

senses.meaning: 避开，绕过（困难、限制或障碍）
senses.example_en: The software bug was serious, but the engineering team found a way to work around it.
senses.example_zh: 这个软件故障很严重，但工程团队找到了绕过它的解决办法。

senses.meaning: 逐渐增加到，逐步上升到（某一水平）
senses.example_en: Start by jogging ten minutes a day and gradually work up to an hour.
senses.example_zh: 从每天慢跑十分钟开始，逐步增加到一个小时。

senses.example_en: It took him weeks to work up to asking for a promotion.
senses.example_zh: 他做了几个星期的心理建设才鼓起勇气要求升职。

senses.example_en: She sat quietly in the corner, working away at her laptop.
senses.example_zh: 她静静地坐在角落里，在笔记本电脑前埋头苦干。

senses.meaning: 重新仔细修改，彻底翻修
senses.example_en: The editor gave the manuscript a thorough working over.
senses.example_zh: 编辑对这份书稿进行了彻底的修改打磨。

senses.example_en: The thugs worked him over in a back alley.
senses.example_zh: 那帮暴徒在后巷狠狠揍了他一顿。

senses.meaning: 努力改善，致力于提升（技能或关系）
senses.example_en: A successful marriage requires both partners to work at it every day.
senses.example_zh: 一段美满的婚姻需要双方日复一日地共同努力经营。

senses.example_en: I really enjoy working with such a talented group of designers.
senses.example_zh: 我非常享受与这样一群才华横溢的设计师一起工作。

senses.meaning: 善用，妥善处理（现有条件、限制或材料）
senses.example_en: We don't have a huge budget, so we must work with what we have.
senses.example_zh: 我们预算不多，所以必须就地取材、因陋就简。

senses.meaning: 逆向推导，从结果反向追溯
senses.example_en: To set the project timeline, start from the final deadline and work back.
senses.example_zh: 要设定项目时间表，应从最终截止日期开始倒推规划。

senses.meaning: 创造奇迹；产生极佳效果
senses.example_en: A cup of warm chamomile tea can work wonders when you are struggling with insomnia.
senses.example_zh: 当你饱受失眠困扰时，一杯温热的洋甘菊茶能产生奇效。

senses.example_en: I applied his troubleshooting trick to my laptop, and it worked like a charm.
senses.example_zh: 我把他排查故障的小窍门用在笔记本上，立刻灵验奏效了。

senses.meaning: 面临艰巨任务；有硬仗要打
senses.example_en: With a deadline only two days away, the audit team will certainly have their work cut out.
senses.example_zh: 距离截止日期仅剩两天，审计团队肯定面临极其繁重的任务。

senses.meaning: 日常工作的一部分；家常便饭
senses.example_en: Rescuing frightened cats from tall trees is all in a day's work for local firefighters.
senses.example_zh: 从高树上营救受惊的猫咪对于当地消防员来说只是家常便饭。

idioms.phrase: work one's fingers to the bone

senses.meaning: 拼命苦干；辛劳累断筋骨
senses.example_en: She worked her fingers to the bone for decades to send all her three children to college.
senses.example_zh: 几十年来她辛劳苦干，终于供三个孩子全都念完了大学。

senses.example_en: He worked like a dog for months to ensure the startup's successful initial public offering.
senses.example_zh: 他拼命苦干了数月，确保了这家初创公司成功首次公开募股。

senses.example_en: Employees were offered extra bonuses if they agreed to work overtime during the holiday season.
senses.example_zh: 员工如果同意在节假日期间加班，将获得额外的奖金。

senses.example_en: The modern tech firm allows its software engineers to work remotely from anywhere in the world.
senses.example_zh: 这家现代科技公司允许其软件工程师在世界任何地方远程办公。

senses.example_en: The hiring manager emphasized that the ideal candidate must be capable of working under extreme pressure.
senses.example_zh: 招聘经理强调，理想的候选人必须能够在极端压力下胜任工作。

senses.meaning: 把...投入使用；使...发挥效益
senses.example_en: He decided to put his savings to work by investing in diversified index funds.
senses.example_zh: 他决定投资多元化指数基金，让自己的积蓄产生效益。

senses.example_en: Without wasting any time, the repair crew set to work fixing the ruptured pipeline.
senses.example_zh: 维修人员没有浪费任何时间，立即动手抢修破裂的管道。

senses.example_en: She chose to work full-time after graduation to gain immediate professional experience.
senses.example_zh: 毕业后她选择全职工作，以便立即获取专业从业经验。

senses.meaning: 为……而努力，争取实现（目标）
senses.example_en: Both nations are actively working towards a lasting peace agreement.
senses.example_zh: 两国都在积极努力达成一项持久的和平协议。

senses.example_en: Gently work the moisturizer into your skin until fully absorbed.
senses.example_zh: 将保湿霜轻轻揉进皮肤，直至完全吸收。

senses.meaning: 使（某人/自己）陷入（某种情绪或精神状态）
senses.example_en: He had worked himself into a state of panic before the exam.
senses.example_zh: 考试前他就已经把自己搞得恐慌不已。

senses.example_en: His lack of managerial experience might work against him in the interview.
senses.example_zh: 缺乏管理经验可能会在面试中对他产生不利影响。

senses.example_en: We used up all the flour baking cookies this morning.
senses.example_zh: 今天早上烤饼干把我们所有的面粉都用光了。

senses.meaning: 把……用于（特定用途或目标）
senses.example_en: What kind of tool do you normally use for stripping wire?
senses.example_zh: 你平时一般用什么工具剥电线皮？

senses.meaning: 在……中采用，使用（材料、成分或技术）
senses.example_en: Olive oil is extensively used in Mediterranean cooking.
senses.example_zh: 橄榄油被广泛应用于地中海料理中。

senses.meaning: 在……身上施加，使用（手段、技巧或药品）
senses.example_en: Do not use this ointment on broken or irritated skin.
senses.example_zh: 切勿将此药膏涂抹在破损或发炎的皮肤上。

senses.meaning: 过去常常（通常以 used to 形式后接动词原形）
senses.example_en: My grandfather used to take a walk along the river every evening.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父过去常常每天傍晚沿着河边散步。

senses.meaning: 用以，用于（be used to do 表示用途）
senses.example_en: Solar panels are used to generate clean electricity for the household.
senses.example_zh: 太阳能电池板用于为家庭生产清洁电力。

senses.meaning: 急需/很想得到；来一个正合适
senses.example_en: After five continuous hours of meetings, I could really use a strong cup of black coffee.
senses.example_zh: 连续开了五个小时的会，我真想来一杯浓浓的黑咖啡。

senses.example_en: Students should make full use of the university library's comprehensive digital archives.
senses.example_zh: 学生们应当充分利用大学图书馆丰富的数字化档案资源。

senses.meaning: 物尽其用；使...发挥良好作用
senses.example_en: She decided to put her multilingual skills to good use by volunteering as an international liaison.
senses.example_zh: 她决定发挥自己的多语种优势，志愿担任国际联络员以物尽其才。

senses.example_en: Arguing over who was at fault is of no use now that the project has been cancelled.
senses.example_zh: 既然项目已经被取消，现在争论到底是谁的错也无济于事了。

senses.meaning: 何必呢；有什么用（表示无奈或放弃）
senses.example_en: What's the use of worrying constantly about things that are entirely beyond our control?
senses.example_zh: 整天为那些完全超出我们掌控的事情担忧又有什么用呢？

senses.meaning: 不需要；极度讨厌/看不惯某人或某事
senses.example_en: Our straightforward manager has no use for hypocrites who flatter rather than deliver results.
senses.example_zh: 我们直率的经理极为厌恶那些只会阿谀奉承而不做实事的人。

senses.example_en: The new transit payment system will officially come into use early next month.
senses.example_zh: 新的公交支付系统将于下月初正式投入使用。

senses.example_en: Many archaic English idioms have gradually fallen out of common use over time.
senses.example_zh: 许多古旧的英语习语随着时间的推移已逐渐不再被常用。

senses.example_en: This rugged laptop is engineered specifically to withstand heavy use in harsh outdoor environments.
senses.example_zh: 这款坚固型笔记本电脑专为承受恶劣户外环境中的高频使用而设计。

senses.meaning: 一直在使用中；持续占用
senses.example_en: The communal kitchen microwave is in constant use throughout the lunch rush hour.
senses.example_zh: 在午餐高峰期间，公共厨房的微波炉一直处于被使用的状态。

senses.example_en: The primary selling point of the new mobile operating system is its remarkable ease of use.
senses.example_zh: 这款新手机操作系统的主要卖点在于其出色的易用性。

senses.meaning: 谨慎行事；自行斟酌裁决
senses.example_en: Airport security officers are advised to use discretion when dealing with anxious travelers.
senses.example_zh: 建议机场安检人员在对待焦虑的旅客时酌情谨慎行事。

senses.example_en: During the power outage, they used candles as their only light source.
senses.example_zh: 停电期间，他们把蜡烛当作唯一的光源。

senses.meaning: 利用（弱点、言论等）来对付，打击
senses.example_en: Anything you confess now could be used against you in court.
senses.example_zh: 你现在承认的任何事情都可能在法庭上被用作对你不利的证据。

senses.meaning: 将（款项、补贴等）用于支付……
senses.example_en: She decided to use her year-end bonus towards a deposit on an apartment.
senses.example_zh: 她决定把年终奖拿来支付公寓的首期定金。

senses.example_en: As soon as they saw how profitable the project was, several investors wanted in.
senses.example_zh: 一看到这个项目利润丰厚，好几位投资人都想入伙。

senses.example_en: The cat is scratching at the back door because it wants in.
senses.example_zh: 猫咪在抓后门，它想进屋了。

senses.meaning: 想要退出/摆脱（协议、关系或困境）
senses.example_en: She felt trapped in the partnership and decided she wanted out.
senses.example_zh: 她觉得自己被合伙关系束缚住了，决定退出。

senses.example_en: The dog was whining by the front door, clearly wanting out.
senses.example_zh: 小狗在前门边呜呜直叫，显然是想出去。

senses.meaning: 缺少/匮乏（多用于否定句表示“一无所缺/应有尽有”）
senses.example_en: Growing up in a wealthy family, the children wanted for nothing.
senses.example_zh: 生长在富裕家庭，孩子们衣食无忧，应有尽有。

senses.example_en: I lent him my favorite jacket, but now I want it back.
senses.example_zh: 我把我最喜欢的夹克借给了他，但现在我想把它要回来。

senses.meaning: 希望与某人复合/重归于好
senses.example_en: Months after the breakup, he realized he still wanted her back.
senses.example_zh: 分手几个月后，他意识到自己依然渴望与她复合。

senses.example_en: Ring the bell if you want off at the next stop.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想在下一站下车，就按一下铃。

senses.meaning: 想退出/免除（项目或任务）
senses.example_en: The workload became unmanageable, and two team members wanted off the project.
senses.example_zh: 工作负荷变得难以承受，两名团队成员希望能退出该项目。

senses.meaning: 希望某人过来（家里或办公室）
senses.example_en: My parents want us over for dinner this Sunday.
senses.example_zh: 我父母希望我们这周日过去一起吃晚饭。

senses.meaning: 想被抱起来（常用于小孩或宠物）
senses.example_en: The toddler raised his arms, signaling that he wanted up.
senses.example_zh: 那个蹒跚学步的孩子举起双手，表示想让人抱起来。

senses.example_en: The puppy was too small to climb the stairs, but it clearly wanted up.
senses.example_zh: 小狗太小爬不了楼梯，但它显然很想上楼。

senses.meaning: 想下来/落地（常用于小孩或宠物）
senses.example_en: After sitting on my lap for a few minutes, the cat started wiggling because it wanted down.
senses.example_zh: 在我腿上坐了几分钟后，猫开始扭动身子，想要下地了。

senses.example_en: She stood at the top of the steep staircase, crying because she wanted down.
senses.example_zh: 她站在陡峭的楼梯顶端大哭，因为她想下楼去。

senses.example_en: The expedition failed not from lack of courage, but for want of proper supplies.
senses.example_zh: 探险队的失败并非因为缺乏勇气，而是因为缺少充足的物资。

senses.meaning: 坚决不想参与某事；不愿与…有任何瓜葛
senses.example_en: He made it clear that he wanted no part of their dishonest scheme.
senses.example_zh: 他明确表示，绝不想卷入他们不光彩的阴谋中。

idioms.phrase: you don't want to do that

senses.meaning: 委婉的劝告或警告）你最好别那样做
senses.example_en: You don't want to open that email attachment; it looks suspicious.
senses.example_zh: 你最好别打开那个邮件附件，它看起来很可疑。

senses.meaning: 想要两全其美；既要…又要…（多指妄图兼得不可兼得之物）
senses.example_en: You can't have flexible hours and a rigid corporate salary; you can't want it both ways.
senses.example_zh: 你不可能既要弹性工时又要体制内死工资，世上哪有两全其美的事。

idioms.phrase: what do you want from me?

senses.meaning: 表示挫败或无奈）你究竟想让我怎样？
senses.example_en: I've already apologized twice; what do you want from me?
senses.example_zh: 我已经道过两次歉了，你到底还想让我怎样？

senses.meaning: 找不到合适的词句表达（多作 not want for words 伶牙俐齿/从不词穷）
senses.example_en: She was so overwhelmed with gratitude that for once she wanted for words.
senses.example_zh: 她感激涕零，破天荒地一时语塞、找不出合适的话来。

senses.example_en: She wanted the promotion desperately after years of dedication.
senses.example_zh: 奉献了这么多年，她极度渴望得到这次晋升。

collocations.phrase: want nothing to do with sb/sth

senses.meaning: 不想与某人/某事发生任何牵扯
senses.example_en: Ever since the argument, he wants nothing to do with his former partners.
senses.example_zh: 自从那次争吵后，他就不想和过去的合伙人有任何瓜葛了。

senses.meaning: 要求给出解释/寻求真相与答案
senses.example_en: The victims' families are demanding justice and want answers from officials.
senses.example_zh: 受害者家属要求伸张正义，并要求官方给出确切说法。

senses.meaning: 寻求释怀；想要一个彻底的了结
senses.example_en: Meeting her ex-husband one last time helped her find the closure she wanted.
senses.example_zh: 最后见前夫一面，帮助她获得了梦寐以求的心灵释怀。

collocations.phrase: want nothing more than to do sth

senses.example_en: After a grueling shift, he wanted nothing more than to sleep undisturbed.
senses.example_zh: 在高强度值班结束后，他别无所求，只想安安静静睡一觉。

senses.example_en: We can rearrange the furniture however you want.
senses.example_zh: 我们可以完全按照你的想法重新摆放家具。

senses.example_en: I came across an old photo album while cleaning the attic.
senses.example_zh: 我在清理阁楼时偶然发现了一本旧相册。

senses.example_en: He came across as confident and articulate during the interview.
senses.example_zh: 在面试中，他给人留下了自信且善于表达的印象。

senses.meaning: 观点或信息）被理解/表达清楚
senses.example_en: Your main argument didn't really come across in the presentation.
senses.example_zh: 在演讲中，你的核心论点并没有真正表达清楚。

senses.example_en: How is your new book coming along?
senses.example_zh: 你的新书写得进展如何了？

senses.example_en: We're going to the cinema—do you want to come along?
senses.example_zh: 我们要去看电影，你想一起去吗？

senses.example_en: Opportunities like this don't come along very often.
senses.example_zh: 这样的好机会可不是经常有的。

senses.example_en: The antique chair came apart when he sat on it.
senses.example_zh: 当他坐上去时，那把古董椅子散架了。

senses.meaning: 情绪）崩溃；（计划或体系）瓦解
senses.example_en: Under intense pressure, his carefully laid plans began to come apart.
senses.example_zh: 在巨大的压力下，他精心策划的计划开始土崩瓦解。

senses.example_en: Don't worry, she will eventually come around to our way of thinking.
senses.example_zh: 别担心，她最终会转变想法赞同我们的。

senses.example_en: The patient came around a few hours after the surgery.
senses.example_zh: 手术几小时后，病人苏醒了过来。

senses.example_en: Why don't you come around for coffee this evening?
senses.example_zh: 今晚顺道过来喝杯咖啡怎么样？

senses.meaning: 定期事件）再次来临/周而复始
senses.example_en: Christmas seems to come around quicker every year.
senses.example_zh: 圣诞节似乎一年比一年来得更快。

senses.example_en: What time did you come back from the trip?
senses.example_zh: 你旅行什么时候回来的？

senses.meaning: 重新流行/卷土重来/复出
senses.example_en: Flared jeans seem to have come back into fashion.
senses.example_zh: 喇叭裤似乎又重新流行起来了。

senses.example_en: Once I saw her face, all the memories came back.
senses.example_zh: 一看到她的脸，所有的回忆都涌上了心头。

senses.example_en: She came back with a witty response that silenced her critic.
senses.example_zh: 她机智地回怼了一句，让批评她的人哑口无言。

senses.meaning: 设法获得/搞到（尤指难得之物）
senses.example_en: Affordable housing is very hard to come by in this city.
senses.example_zh: 在这座城市，价格合理的住房非常难得。

senses.example_en: Feel free to come by my office anytime if you have questions.
senses.example_zh: 如果有任何疑问，欢迎随时顺道来我办公室。

senses.example_en: We decided to buy the house once the price came down.
senses.example_zh: 一旦房价降下来，我们就决定买下那栋房子。

senses.example_en: The rain was really coming down, so we took shelter under a bridge.
senses.example_zh: 大雨瓢泼而下，所以我们躲到了桥下。

senses.example_en: This traditional recipe has come down through generations.
senses.example_zh: 这个传统食谱代代相传至今。
