senses.example_en: The committee came down in favor of building the new library.
senses.example_zh: 委员会最终决定支持兴建新图书馆。

senses.example_en: In the end, success comes down to hard work and persistence.
senses.example_zh: 归根结底，成功取决于努力与坚持。

senses.meaning: 染上/患上（非致命疾病，如感冒）
senses.example_en: I think I'm coming down with the flu because my throat hurts.
senses.example_zh: 我想我是感冒了，因为我嗓子疼。

senses.meaning: 挺身而出；主动自荐/提供帮助或证词
senses.example_en: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
senses.example_zh: 警方已呼吁目击证人挺身而出提供线索。

senses.example_en: The morning train from Chicago has just come in.
senses.example_zh: 从芝加哥开来的早班列车刚刚进站。

senses.example_en: Fresh strawberries are coming in early this year.
senses.example_zh: 今年新鲜草莓上市得比较早。

senses.example_en: Her horse came in second in the final race.
senses.example_zh: 她的马在决赛中获得了第二名。

senses.example_en: Keep that extra blanket handy; it will come in useful tonight.
senses.example_zh: 把那条多余的毯子放在手边，今晚会派上用场的。

senses.example_en: A button came off my shirt while I was rushing to work.
senses.example_zh: 我急匆匆赶去上班时，衬衫上的一颗扣子掉了。

senses.example_en: Their bold marketing strategy actually came off.
senses.example_zh: 他们大胆的营销策略居然真的奏效了。

senses.example_en: He came off well in the debate, winning over many undecided voters.
senses.example_zh: 他在辩论中表现出色，赢得了许多摇摆选民的支持。

senses.meaning: 快点/加油（用于催促或鼓励）
senses.example_en: Come on, or we'll miss the start of the movie!
senses.example_zh: 快点，不然我们就赶不上电影开场了！

senses.meaning: 疾病、情绪、天气等）悄然袭来/发作
senses.example_en: I can feel a severe headache coming on.
senses.example_zh: 我感觉一阵剧烈的头痛正悄悄袭来。

senses.example_en: The street lights come on automatically at dusk.
senses.example_zh: 黄昏时分，路灯会自动亮起。

senses.example_en: Her English has really come on since she moved to London.
senses.example_zh: 自从移居伦敦后，她的英语水平有了很大长进。

senses.example_en: His next novel is scheduled to come out this November.
senses.example_zh: 他的下一部小说定于今年十一月出版。

senses.meaning: 秘密/真相）暴露/大白于天下
senses.example_en: The full truth about the scandal finally came out.
senses.example_zh: 这桩丑闻的全部真相最终大白于天下。

senses.example_en: The cake came out much better than I expected.
senses.example_zh: 这个蛋糕烤出来的效果比我预期的好得多。

senses.example_en: The cherry blossoms are beginning to come out in the park.
senses.example_zh: 公园里的樱花正开始绽放。

senses.example_en: Can you come over and help me move this heavy table?
senses.example_zh: 你能过来帮我搬一下这张重桌子吗？

senses.example_en: A wave of dizziness suddenly came over her.
senses.example_zh: 一阵眩晕感突然向她袭来。

senses.example_en: He came over as slightly arrogant during the discussion.
senses.example_zh: 在讨论过程中，他表现得略显傲慢。

senses.example_en: With proper treatment, he came through the illness without complications.
senses.example_zh: 经过合理治疗，他战胜了病痛且没有出现并发症。

senses.meaning: 兑现承诺/在关键时刻提供支持
senses.example_en: When we desperately needed funding, our investors came through.
senses.example_zh: 当我们极度需要资金时，投资人们兑现了承诺施以援手。

senses.meaning: 官方信息/款项/批准）传达/获批
senses.example_en: My visa finally came through after six weeks of waiting.
senses.example_zh: 经过六周的等待，我的签证终于批下来了。

senses.example_en: When the boxer came to, he was lying in the locker room.
senses.example_zh: 当拳击手苏醒过来时，他正躺在更衣室里。

senses.example_en: The dinner bill came to eighty dollars including the tip.
senses.example_zh: 晚饭账单算上小费总共是八十美元。

senses.meaning: 谈及/涉及（常用于 when it comes to）
senses.example_en: When it comes to negotiation, she is unmatched in our firm.
senses.example_zh: 说到商务谈判，她在我们律所可以说是无人能敌。

senses.example_en: The issue of budget cuts came up during the board meeting.
senses.example_zh: 削减预算的问题在董事会议上被提及。

senses.meaning: 意外情况等）突然发生/出现
senses.example_en: I'm sorry I can't attend; something urgent has just come up.
senses.example_zh: 很抱歉我不能出席了，刚刚突然发生了一件急事。

senses.meaning: 升起（太阳/月亮）；走近/上前
senses.example_en: A stranger came up to me and asked for directions.
senses.example_zh: 一个陌生人走到我面前问路。

senses.meaning: 想出/提出（计划、主意、解决办法）
senses.example_en: She came up with a brilliant solution to the logistical problem.
senses.example_zh: 她想出了一个绝妙的方案来解决这个物流问题。

senses.example_en: They had only forty-eight hours to come up with the deposit.
senses.example_zh: 他们只有四十八小时来筹措出这笔定金。

senses.meaning: 逐渐接受/妥协/面对（严酷的现实）
senses.example_en: It took him years to come to terms with the end of his athletic career.
senses.example_zh: 他花了好几年时间才坦然接受自己运动生涯的结束。

senses.example_en: The accountant decided to come clean about the irregular financial entries.
senses.example_zh: 会计决定全盘坦白那些违规的财务账目。

senses.example_en: Keep this pocketknife with you; you never know when it might come in handy.
senses.example_zh: 随身带上这把折叠刀，说不定什么时候就能派上大用场。

senses.meaning: 兜了一圈回到原点；重回起点
senses.example_en: His career came full circle when he returned to teach at the high school he once attended.
senses.example_zh: 当他回到曾经就读的高中任教时，他的职业生涯仿佛兜了个圈又回到了原点。

senses.meaning: 成年；走向成熟/达到鼎盛期
senses.example_en: Artificial intelligence has truly come of age over the past few years.
senses.example_zh: 在过去的几年里，人工智能技术已真正走向成熟阶段。

senses.example_en: The company came under fire for failing to protect user privacy.
senses.example_zh: 该公司因未能保护用户隐私而遭到了口诛笔伐。

senses.meaning: 无论发生什么；不管怎样
senses.example_en: I will stand by your side and support your choice, come what may.
senses.example_zh: 无论发生什么，我都将站在你身边支持你的选择。

senses.example_en: The golden era of cheap energy has finally come to an end.
senses.example_zh: 廉价能源的黄金时代终于落下了帷幕。

senses.example_en: New evidence came to light during the secondary investigation.
senses.example_zh: 在二次调查过程中，新的证据浮出了水面。

senses.example_en: The strict environmental regulations will come into effect starting next January.
senses.example_zh: 严格的环保法规将于明年一月起正式生效实施。

senses.example_en: Production came to a complete halt due to a widespread power outage.
senses.example_zh: 由于大范围停电，生产陷入了彻底停滞状态。

senses.example_en: Her abrupt resignation came as a massive surprise to everyone on the board.
senses.example_zh: 她的突然辞职让董事会里的每一个人都深感震惊与意外。

senses.example_en: After evaluating all data, researchers came to the conclusion that the hypothesis was sound.
senses.example_zh: 在评估所有数据后，研究人员得出了该假说完全成立的结论。

senses.example_en: She comes from a small coastal town in Spain.
senses.example_zh: 她来自西班牙的一个海滨小镇。

senses.example_en: Much of his anxiety comes from overthinking small problems.
senses.example_zh: 他的大部分焦虑都源于对细枝末节的过度思虑。

senses.example_en: He came into a small fortune after his grandfather passed away.
senses.example_zh: 祖父去世后，他继承了一笔不菲的财产。

senses.meaning: 开始具备/卷入（如进入视野、发挥作用等）
senses.example_en: Several unexpected factors came into play during the negotiation.
senses.example_zh: 谈判过程中，几个意想不到的因素开始发挥作用。

senses.meaning: 言辞或行动）意指，意思是
senses.example_en: What exactly do you mean by that remark?
senses.example_zh: 你那句话究竟是什么意思？

senses.example_en: This gift was originally meant for my sister, but you can have it.
senses.example_zh: 这件礼物原本是打算送给我妹妹的，不过你可以拿去。

senses.meaning: 预定使……成为，打算让……承担
senses.example_en: His parents had always meant him for the family business.
senses.example_zh: 他的父母一直打算让他继承家族企业。

senses.example_en: I'm sorry I stepped on your foot; I didn't mean to do it.
senses.example_zh: 对不起踩到了你的脚，我不是故意的。

senses.meaning: 天生适合，命中注定属于
senses.example_en: From the moment they met, they knew they were meant for each other.
senses.example_zh: 从相遇的那一刻起，他们就知道彼此是天造地设的一对。

senses.example_en: This medication is not meant for children under the age of twelve.
senses.example_zh: 这种药物不适用于十二岁以下的儿童。

senses.example_en: You were meant to hand in the report yesterday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 你照理应该在昨天下午就提交这份报告的。

senses.example_en: The new law is meant to protect consumers from online fraud.
senses.example_zh: 这项新法律旨在保护消费者免受网络诈骗。

senses.meaning: 对……有重要意义，对……很有价值
senses.example_en: Your constant support really means a lot to our team.
senses.example_zh: 你一直以来的支持对我们团队来说意义重大。

senses.meaning: 对……毫无价值，对……无关紧要
senses.example_en: All those empty promises mean nothing to the striking workers.
senses.example_zh: 那些空洞的承诺对罢工工人而言毫无意义。

senses.meaning: 态度严肃认真；动真格的，绝非儿戏
senses.example_en: When the CEO canceled the weekend off, we knew she meant business.
senses.example_zh: 当首席执行官取消了周末休假时，我们知道她是动真格的了。

senses.meaning: 我是认真的；我绝不开玩笑
senses.example_en: Stop tracking mud across the clean carpet right now—I mean it!
senses.example_zh: 立刻别把泥巴踩在干净的地毯上了——我是认真的！

senses.meaning: 对某人来说至关重要；是某人的全部
senses.example_en: Her children mean the absolute world to her.
senses.example_zh: 她的孩子们对她来说就是全世界。

senses.meaning: 理解某人的想法；明白某人的意思
senses.example_en: Now that you point out the flaw in the layout, I see what you mean.
senses.example_zh: 既然你指出了版面上的缺陷，我明白你的意思了。

senses.meaning: 绝无冒犯之意；无心之失
senses.example_en: No offense meant, but your calculations don't quite add up.
senses.example_zh: 无意冒犯，但你的计算结果似乎有些不对劲。

senses.meaning: 你懂我意思吧（口语中用于寻求对方认同或共鸣）
senses.example_en: It's just exhausting dealing with bureaucracy all day, you know what I mean?
senses.example_zh: 整天应付官僚程序真让人筋疲力尽，你懂我意思吧？

senses.example_en: Don't be angry with your mother; she meant well when she tidied your desk.
senses.example_zh: 别生你母亲的气，她收拾你的书桌完全是出于一片好意。

senses.meaning: 预示着麻烦；意味着惹上祸事
senses.example_en: Those dark gathering storm clouds mean trouble for our sailing trip.
senses.example_zh: 那些聚积的乌云意味着我们的航行要遇到大麻烦了。

senses.example_en: The barking dog sounds terrifying, but he doesn't mean any harm.
senses.example_zh: 那只狗叫起来声音吓人，但它并无恶意。

senses.meaning: 说话算数；言出必行；说的是真心话
senses.example_en: If he promised to back your project, you can trust that he means what he says.
senses.example_zh: 如果他答应支持你的项目，你可以相信他绝对说到做到。

senses.meaning: 字字发自肺腑；完全是由衷之言
senses.example_en: I thanked them profusely for their hospitality, and I meant every word.
senses.example_zh: 我对他们的热情款待连连致谢，且字字句句发自肺腑。

senses.example_en: Having the support of her family meant everything to the young athlete.
senses.example_zh: 得到家人的全力支持，对这位年轻的运动员而言意味着一切。

senses.meaning: 本意是作为，当作……来表达
senses.example_en: It was meant as a constructive suggestion, not a personal attack.
senses.example_zh: 这本是建设性的提议，绝非针对个人的攻击。

senses.meaning: 尤指在困难或繁忙时）帮忙，协助分担
senses.example_en: Could you help out with the dishes while I prepare dinner?
senses.example_zh: 我做晚饭的时候你能帮忙洗下碗吗？

senses.meaning: 给某人盛（饭）、夹（菜）或斟（饮料）
senses.example_en: The host warmly helped each guest to another slice of roast beef.
senses.example_zh: 主人热情地给每位客人又夹了一块烤牛肉。

senses.meaning: 搀扶起，扶起（摔倒或坐着的人）
senses.example_en: She slipped on the ice, but a passerby quickly helped her up.
senses.example_zh: 她在冰上滑倒了，但一位路人很快把她扶了起来。

senses.meaning: 帮某人脱去（大衣、外套等）
senses.example_en: The waiter stepped forward to help her off with her heavy winter coat.
senses.example_zh: 服务员上前帮她脱下了厚重的冬大衣。

senses.meaning: 帮某人穿上（大衣、夹克等外套）
senses.example_en: He courteously helped his grandmother on with her woolen cardigan.
senses.example_zh: 他礼貌地帮祖母穿上了羊毛开衫。

senses.meaning: 搀扶某人下来（从高处、梯子或车上）
senses.example_en: The firefighter carefully helped the frightened child down from the tree.
senses.example_zh: 消防员小心翼翼地把受惊的孩子从树上扶了下来。

senses.example_en: Adequate rest and good nutrition will help your recovery along.
senses.example_zh: 充足的休息和良好的营养会促进你的康复。

senses.example_en: The nurse helped the injured soldier along the hospital corridor.
senses.example_zh: 护士搀扶着受伤的士兵沿着医院走廊前行。

senses.meaning: 推动，促进（事业、计划或运动）向前发展
senses.example_en: Generous public donations have helped forward the cancer research project.
senses.example_zh: 公众的慷慨捐赠推进了这项癌症研究项目的进展。

senses.example_en: I couldn't help laughing when the puppy chased its own tail in circles.
senses.example_zh: 当看到小狗绕着圈追自己的尾巴时，我忍不住笑出了声。

senses.example_en: Listening to his tragic story, we could not help but sympathize with him.
senses.example_zh: 听完他悲惨的遭遇，我们禁不住深表同情。

senses.meaning: 请自便；请随意取用（食物、饮品或物品）
senses.example_en: There's fresh coffee and warm bagels on the counter, so please help yourself.
senses.example_zh: 吧台上备有新鲜咖啡和热百吉饼，请各位随意享用。

idioms.phrase: not if I can help it

senses.meaning: 只要我能阻止，就绝不让它发生；绝不答应
senses.example_en: They won't shut down the neighborhood library—not if I can help it.
senses.example_zh: 他们休想关掉社区图书馆——只要我能阻止，就绝不答应。

senses.meaning: 聚沙成塔；微小的努力也能发挥作用
senses.example_en: Even donating a single dollar helps the shelter, because every little helps.
senses.example_zh: 即使只向收容所捐赠一美元也有所助益，因为聚沙成塔，滴水成河。

senses.meaning: 向上帝发誓，绝无虚言；（口语中用于表气愤或发誓）我保证
senses.example_en: I will tell the whole truth in court tomorrow, so help me God.
senses.example_zh: 明天在法庭上我将陈述全部实情，向上帝发誓绝无虚言。

senses.example_en: It is a sign of strength, not weakness, to seek professional help for mental health.
senses.example_zh: 为心理健康寻求专业帮助是坚强的表现，而非软弱。

senses.meaning: 主动提供协助；施以援手
senses.example_en: Several local volunteers arrived promptly to offer help after the flash flood.
senses.example_zh: 山洪暴发后，几名当地志愿者迅速赶来提供援助。

senses.meaning: 请求援助；开口求人帮忙
senses.example_en: Don't hesitate to ask for help if you run into difficulties with the assignment.
senses.example_zh: 如果你在作业中遇到困难，请毫不犹豫地寻求帮助。

senses.example_en: Your prompt feedback on the draft helped a great deal in refining our proposal.
senses.example_zh: 你对草案的及时反馈对我们完善方案起到了极大的帮助。

senses.example_en: She took a part-time job on campus to help pay for her tuition and textbooks.
senses.example_zh: 她在校内找了一份兼职，以协助支付学费和书本费。

senses.meaning: 大声呼救；（引申）极度迫切需要救助
senses.example_en: The dilapidated rural clinic is crying out for help and modern equipment.
senses.example_zh: 这家破旧的乡村诊所急需援助与现代化设备。

senses.meaning: 搀扶某人离开或走出（车厢、房间等）
senses.example_en: He opened the taxi door and helped his elderly father out of the car.
senses.example_zh: 他打开出租车门，搀扶年迈的父亲下了车。

senses.example_en: An emergency loan helped the firm out of its financial crisis.
senses.example_zh: 一笔紧急贷款帮助这家公司渡过了财务危机。

senses.example_en: She helped the toddler out of his wet snowsuit.
senses.example_zh: 她帮幼儿脱掉了湿漉漉的防寒服。

senses.meaning: 搀扶或引导某人进入（车辆、轮椅、房间等）
senses.example_en: The nurse gently helped the patient into the wheelchair.
senses.example_zh: 护士温柔地搀扶病人坐进轮椅。

senses.example_en: You should try on the jacket before buying it to make sure it fits.
senses.example_zh: 买之前你最好先试穿一下这件夹克，确保合身。

senses.meaning: 试探底线，耍花招（尤指试探忍耐度或权威）
senses.example_en: Don't try that on with me—I know exactly what you're up to.
senses.example_zh: 别跟我耍这种花招，我很清楚你在打什么算盘。

senses.meaning: 试用，试验（新设备、方法或想法）
senses.example_en: The lab is trying out a new method to reduce carbon emissions.
senses.example_zh: 实验室正在试验一种减少碳排放的新方法。

senses.meaning: 参加选拔，参加选秀/试训
senses.example_en: Over fifty young players turned up to try out for the academy.
senses.example_zh: 五十多名年轻球员赶来参加青训营的选拔。

senses.meaning: 参加…的选拔，试镜（以获得角色或加入团队）
senses.example_en: She decided to try out for the lead role in the school play.
senses.example_zh: 她决定去竞选学校话剧的主角。

senses.meaning: 谋求，争取获得；试图达到（某个目标或职位）
senses.example_en: He plans to try for a scholarship to study abroad next year.
senses.example_zh: 他打算争取明年的出国留学奖学金。

senses.meaning: 故意试探底线；企图蒙骗某人
senses.example_en: The shop assistant tried it on by charging me extra, but I noticed the discrepancy.
senses.example_zh: 店员想糊弄我多收钱，但被我识破了差额。

senses.meaning: 向某人搭讪调情，企图求欢
senses.example_en: He had a few drinks and started trying it on with one of my colleagues.
senses.example_zh: 他喝了几杯酒后，就开始搭讪调戏我的一位女同事。

senses.meaning: 电话中）稍后再打，过会儿再试
senses.example_en: Dr. Evans is in surgery right now; could you try back in an hour?
senses.example_zh: 埃文斯医生正在做手术，您能过一个小时再打来吗？

senses.meaning: 在某人身上试验；向某人试探征求对某想法的意见
senses.example_en: Let me try out my new presentation on you before the big meeting.
senses.example_zh: 在大考前，让我先对着你把新演示文稿试讲一遍吧。

senses.example_en: After retiring from teaching, he decided to try his hand at pottery.
senses.example_zh: 从教师岗位退休后，他决定初试身手学做陶艺。

senses.meaning: 考验某人的耐心，使人忍无可忍
senses.example_en: The child's constant whining was beginning to try the mother's patience.
senses.example_zh: 孩子持续不断的哭闹开始挑战这位母亲的耐心极限。

senses.example_en: He went to Hollywood to try his luck as an actor.
senses.example_zh: 他前往好莱坞碰碰运气，想当一名演员。

senses.meaning: 无论怎样努力，尽管竭尽全力
senses.example_en: Try as he might, he simply couldn't open the jammed safe.
senses.example_zh: 尽管他竭尽全力，却无论如何也打不开卡住的保险箱。

senses.meaning: 尝试一下，试一试某事物
senses.example_en: If you've never eaten sushi before, you really ought to give it a try.
senses.example_zh: 如果你以前从没吃过寿司，真应该尝试一下。

idioms.phrase: don't try to run before you can walk

senses.meaning: 不要未学走先学跑，做事要循序渐进
senses.example_en: Master the basic chords first; don't try to run before you can walk.
senses.example_zh: 先把基础和弦练扎实，别还没学会走就想跑。

idioms.phrase: try every trick in the book

senses.meaning: 使出浑身解数，千方百计
senses.example_en: The defense attorney tried every trick in the book to clear his client.
senses.example_zh: 辩护律师使出了浑身解数，试图为他的委托人洗脱罪名。

senses.example_en: We must try our utmost to reduce carbon emissions across all sectors.
senses.example_zh: 我们必须竭尽全力削减各领域的碳排放。

senses.example_en: The paramedics tried in vain to revive the unconscious driver.
senses.example_zh: 急救人员徒劳地尝试唤醒那名失去知觉的司机。

senses.example_en: The judge will try the high-profile fraud case next Monday.
senses.example_zh: 法官将于下周一审理这起备受瞩目的诈骗案。

senses.example_en: Since traditional advertising failed, the company tried a new approach using influencer marketing.
senses.example_zh: 由于传统广告收效甚微，公司尝试了一种利用网红营销的新策略。

senses.example_en: Trapped climbers tried desperately to stay warm through the blizzard.
senses.example_zh: 被困的登山者拼命挣扎着在暴风雪中保持体温。

senses.meaning: 惹某人发火，考验某人的脾气
senses.example_en: Dealing with rude customers every day will certainly try anyone's temper.
senses.example_zh: 每天跟粗鲁的顾客打交道绝对会考验任何人的脾气。

senses.example_en: Here are the boots in a size nine—try them on for size.
senses.example_zh: 这是9码的靴子——你试穿一下看大小合适不合适。

senses.meaning: 试着考虑，权衡体验（新建议或想法）
senses.example_en: Try this idea on for size: what if we launch the product online first?
senses.example_zh: 你琢磨琢磨这个主意：如果我们先在网上首发该产品怎么样？

senses.meaning: 坦白，认错，爽快承认（做了错事）
senses.example_en: No one would own up to breaking the window, so the whole class was kept after school.
senses.example_zh: 没有人愿意承认打破了窗户，所以全班都被罚放学后留堂。

senses.meaning: 公开承认，供认（过错、罪行或责任）
senses.example_en: He had the courage to own up to his mistakes and apologize publicly.
senses.example_zh: 他勇于承认自己的错误并公开道歉。

senses.meaning: 承认，供认（某种情感、缺点或事实）
senses.example_en: She owned to a feeling of deep disappointment when the deal fell through.
senses.example_zh: 交易告吹时，她承认自己感到非常失望。

senses.meaning: 归……所有，由……拥有（资产、公司、版权等）
senses.example_en: The media group is majority-owned by an international conglomerate.
senses.example_zh: 该媒体集团由一家跨国企业集团控股拥有。

senses.meaning: 受……完全控制，被……牵着鼻子走
senses.example_en: Critics argued that the senator was completely owned by the gun lobby.
senses.example_zh: 批评人士称，这位参议员完全受到了枪支游说集团的操纵。

senses.meaning: 充分展现才能；得到应有的地位和承认；大显身手
senses.example_en: She really came into her own once she was promoted to head of research.
senses.example_zh: 一旦被提升为研发主管，她便真正开始大显身手。

senses.meaning: 坚守阵地；不落下风，表现得毫不逊色；（病人）情况未恶化
senses.example_en: Despite her lack of experience, she held her own in the debate against seasoned politicians.
senses.example_zh: 尽管缺乏经验，她在与老练政客的辩论中依然不落下风。

senses.meaning: 独自一人；自食其力，独立自主地；全凭自己
senses.example_en: She has lived on her own since she graduated from university at twenty-two.
senses.example_zh: 她从二十二岁大学毕业起就一直一个人独立生活。

idioms.phrase: have a mind of one's own

senses.meaning: 极有主见，不随波逐流；（机器、物体等）不听使唤，自顾自运转
senses.example_en: You won't convince him easily; he definitely has a mind of his own.
senses.example_zh: 你很难说服他；他是个极有主见的人。

idioms.phrase: in a league of one's own

senses.meaning: 独步天下，独树一帜；无与伦比，无可比拟
senses.example_en: When it comes to violin technique, the young prodigy is in a league of his own.
senses.example_zh: 谈到小提琴演奏技法，这位年轻的神童可谓独步天下。

idioms.phrase: stand on one's own two feet

senses.meaning: 独立自主；自立自强，不依赖他人
senses.example_en: It is time for him to stop relying on his parents' money and stand on his own two feet.
senses.example_zh: 他该停止依赖父母的资助、学着自立自强了。

idioms.phrase: take the law into one's own hands

senses.meaning: 公然违法擅自解决；私设公堂，私自以暴力执法
senses.example_en: Frustrated by police inaction, the villagers decided to take the law into their own hands.
senses.example_zh: 由于对警方的无所作为感到愤怒，村民们决定擅自采取私刑。

senses.example_en: The investment firm owns a significant stake in the renewable energy startup.
senses.example_zh: 这家投资公司在这家可再生能源初创企业中持有可观的股份。

senses.example_en: The local agency is a wholly owned subsidiary of a global corporation.
senses.example_zh: 这家本地机构是一家跨国公司的全资子公司。

senses.meaning: 拥有……的版权/专有经营权
senses.example_en: The studio owns the exclusive rights to the best-selling novel.
senses.example_zh: 该电影制片厂拥有这部畅销小说的独家改编版权。

senses.meaning: 正视并坦然面对……的事实；大方承认
senses.example_en: You need to own the fact that your behavior hurt the people around you.
senses.example_zh: 你必须正视并承认你的行为伤害了身边人的事实。

senses.meaning: 私有的 / 公有的（国有或上市公司所有的）
senses.example_en: The country is moving toward privatizing several major state-owned enterprises.
senses.example_zh: 该国正逐步推进对数家主要国有企业的私有化进程。

senses.meaning: 置业；购置并拥有房产/不动产
senses.example_en: Rising interest rates have made it harder for young adults to own property.
senses.example_zh: 利率上升使年轻人购置房产变得更加困难。

senses.meaning: 彻底击垮，完胜，狠狠压制（对手）
senses.example_en: Our team completely owned them in the second half of the match.
senses.example_zh: 我们在比赛下半场彻底碾压了他们。

senses.meaning: 全款持有，完全拥有（无抵押或分期负债）
senses.example_en: After making the final mortgage payment, they finally own the house outright.
senses.example_zh: 还清最后一笔房贷后，他们终于全款拥有了这套房子。

senses.meaning: 共同所有，合伙持有（产权、股权、财产等）
senses.example_en: The business and its underlying intellectual property are owned jointly by the two founders.
senses.example_zh: 该企业及其底层知识产权由两位创始人共同持有。

senses.meaning: 无留置权地全权拥有，无任何债务负担地持有（资产）
senses.example_en: They worked hard for decades to own their family farm free and clear.
senses.example_zh: 他们辛勤打拼了几十年，终于无债一身轻地全权拥有了自家的农场。

senses.meaning: 食物、金钱、储备等）足够支撑到结束
senses.example_en: We brought just enough drinking water to last out until rescue arrived.
senses.example_zh: 我们带的饮用水刚好够撑到救援人员赶到。

senses.example_en: I was exhausted, but somehow I managed to last out the final round.
senses.example_zh: 我筋疲力尽，但不知怎的还是咬牙撑完了最后一轮。

senses.meaning: 熬过，挺过，平安度过（艰苦时期、严冬、风暴等）
senses.example_en: Many small businesses struggled just to last through the harsh winter.
senses.example_zh: 许多小企业为了熬过严冬而苦苦挣扎。

senses.meaning: 持续达（某段具体的时间或跨度）
senses.example_en: The heavy rain lasted for three uninterrupted days, causing localized flooding.
senses.example_zh: 大雨连续下了整整三天，导致了局部洪涝。

senses.meaning: 延续超过（预期期限、寿命或界限）
senses.example_en: Their influence on modern architecture lasted far beyond their own lifetimes.
senses.example_zh: 他们对现代建筑的影响力远远超越了他们自身的寿命。

senses.meaning: 熬完，坚持度过（漫长枯燥或艰难的时期、会议、任期等）
senses.example_en: He was already feeling sick, but he forced himself to last the meeting out.
senses.example_zh: 他已经觉得身体不舒服了，但还是硬撑着坚持开完了会议。

senses.meaning: 终于，最终；历经波折后终于
senses.example_en: After months of grueling delays, the new bridge was opened to traffic at long last.
senses.example_zh: 经过数月令人疲惫的延误后，新大桥终于通车了。

senses.meaning: 压死骆驼的最后一根稻草；忍无可忍的最后一击
senses.example_en: When he lied about his finances again, it proved to be the last straw for her.
senses.example_zh: 当他再次对自己的财务状况撒谎时，彻底成了压垮她耐心的最后一根稻草。

senses.meaning: 笑到最后；最终取得胜利（让曾经嘲笑者哑口无言）
senses.example_en: They ridiculed his startup idea at first, but he had the last laugh when it went public.
senses.example_zh: 起初他们嘲笑他的创业构想，但在公司上市后，他笑到了最后。

senses.example_en: And last but not least, I want to thank my family for their unwavering support.
senses.example_zh: 最后但同样重要的一点是，我要感谢家人坚定不移的支持。

senses.meaning: 直到最后一刻；坚持到底；至死
senses.example_en: The old soldier remained fiercely loyal to his comrades to the last.
senses.example_zh: 这位老兵直到生命的最后一刻，依然对战友怀着无比深厚的忠诚。

idioms.phrase: be the last person / thing to do sth

senses.meaning: 最不可能做某事的人/物；最不情愿做某事的人/物
senses.example_en: She is the last person I would expect to gossip about a colleague.
senses.example_zh: 她是那类我最不可能料到会说同事闲话的人。

senses.meaning: 讽刺）自满的大话；言之过早的自信断言
senses.example_en: 'Don't worry, this project will only take an hour.' — Famous last words!
senses.example_zh: “别担心，这个项目只要一小时搞定。”——真是典型的大话！

senses.meaning: 经久耐用；做工扎实，结构结实
senses.example_en: These vintage mechanical watches were truly built to last for generations.
senses.example_zh: 这些老式机械表确实做工扎实，经久耐用，能代代相传。

senses.example_en: The lessons learned during those formative years will last a lifetime.
senses.example_zh: 在那些成长岁月中所汲取的教训将让人受益终生。

senses.meaning: 跑完全程；坚持到底，经受住长久考验
senses.example_en: Analysts wonder whether the fragile coalition can last the distance until the next election.
senses.example_zh: 分析人士怀疑这个脆弱的执政联盟能否撑到下次大选。

senses.meaning: 维持不了多久；短暂易逝
senses.example_en: Given their constant bickering, the partnership probably won't last long.
senses.example_zh: 鉴于他们频繁争执，这段合作关系恐怕维持不了多久。

senses.meaning: 万不得已的手段；最后的救命稻草
senses.example_en: Military intervention should always be considered only as a last resort.
senses.example_zh: 军事干预应始终仅作为万不得已时的最后手段。

senses.meaning: 事无巨细地；详尽无遗地，精确到每一处细节
senses.example_en: The security team planned the president's visit down to the last detail.
senses.example_zh: 安保团队把总统出访的行程计划精确到了每一个细节。

senses.meaning: 钱款、物品等）足够某人用/维持（某段时间
senses.example_en: A single full charge will easily last you for two full days.
senses.example_zh: 充满一次电轻松足够你使用整整两天。

senses.meaning: 一直延续到，持续到（某个具体时间点）
senses.example_en: The truce is expected to last until midnight on Sunday.
senses.example_zh: 停火协议预计将持续到周日午夜。

senses.meaning: 延续进入（下一季节、世纪、时代或阶段）
senses.example_en: The heatwave is forecast to last well into next week.
senses.example_zh: 据预测，这股热浪将一直延续到下周。

senses.meaning: 舍弃，放弃，出让（尤指不舍得或不情愿地）
senses.example_en: I could never part with this old guitar; it was a gift from my grandfather.
senses.example_zh: 我绝不会卖掉这把旧吉他，这是我祖父送给我的礼物。

senses.meaning: 拆件出售（将汽车、电脑等设备拆解后分批售卖零件）
senses.example_en: Instead of selling the damaged car whole, he decided to part it out for more money.
senses.example_zh: 他没有将受损的汽车整车出售，而是决定拆成零件卖以赚取更多收益。

senses.meaning: 隔开，划分（用隔板、屏风等隔出独立空间）
senses.example_en: They used a wooden screen to part off a quiet study area in the living room.
senses.example_zh: 他们用木质屏风在客厅里隔出了一个安静的学习区域。

senses.meaning: 因……而产生分歧；因……而各自分开
senses.example_en: The two co-founders eventually parted over how to spend the investment funds.
senses.example_zh: 两位联合创始人最终因如何使用投资资金产生分歧而分道扬镳。

senses.meaning: 分开，解散，断绝恋爱关系
senses.example_en: After three years of dating, they realized they wanted different things and parted up.
senses.example_zh: 恋爱三年后，他们发现彼此追求不同，于是和平分手了。

senses.meaning: 梳分（头发），在某处分出头缝
senses.example_en: She parted her hair down the middle before tying it into braids.
senses.example_zh: 她在把头发编成辫子之前，先在中间分出了一道发缝。

senses.meaning: ……不可或缺的一部分，必不可少的要素
senses.example_en: Dealing with demanding clients is part and parcel of being a public relations consultant.
senses.example_zh: 与苛刻的客户打交道是作为公关顾问必不可少的一部分。

idioms.phrase: a fool and his money are soon parted

senses.meaning: 傻瓜存不住钱；愚人聚财易散财
senses.example_en: He lost thousands on that fraudulent scheme—truly, a fool and his money are soon parted.
senses.example_zh: 他在那个诈骗项目上损失了数千元——真是傻瓜存不住钱。

senses.meaning: 至死不渝，直到死亡将我们分开
senses.example_en: They exchanged marriage vows, promising to love and cherish each other till death do them part.
senses.example_zh: 他们交换了结婚誓言，承诺彼此相爱珍重，至死不渝。

senses.example_en: For my part, I have no objections whatsoever to the revised proposal.
senses.example_zh: 就我而言，我对修改后的提案没有任何异议。

senses.meaning: 站在某人一边，支持/偏袒某人
senses.example_en: Whenever my brother and I argued, my grandmother would always take my part.
senses.example_zh: 每当我和弟弟争吵时，祖母总是站在我这一边。

senses.example_en: Diet and regular physical activity play a crucial part in preventing chronic illnesses.
senses.example_zh: 饮食和规律运动在预防慢性疾病方面起着至关重要的作用。

senses.meaning: 分道扬镳，各自谋生；中止合作
senses.example_en: The band parted ways due to irreconcilable creative differences.
senses.example_zh: 由于无法调和的创作分歧，乐队最终分道扬镳。

senses.meaning: 和平分手，友好协商解约
senses.example_en: Although the contract was terminated prematurely, both parties parted amicably.
senses.example_zh: 尽管合同提前终止，但双方是和平友善解约的。

senses.example_en: Security guards quickly parted the crowd to allow the ambassador to exit safely.
senses.example_zh: 安保人员迅速拨开人群，确保大使安全撤离。

senses.meaning: 微微张嘴，启齿（欲言或表惊讶）
senses.example_en: She parted her lips in astonishment upon hearing the stunning news.
senses.example_zh: 听到这个震惊的消息，她惊讶得微微张开了嘴。

senses.example_en: He parted the heavy velvet curtains to let the morning sunlight illuminate the room.
senses.example_zh: 他拉开厚重的天鹅绒窗帘，让清晨的阳光照亮整个房间。

senses.example_en: They parted reluctantly at the gate, promising to write every single day.
senses.example_zh: 他们在检票口依依不舍地道别，并承诺每天都要写信。

senses.example_en: After walking together to the station, they parted company and headed home.
senses.example_zh: 一起走到车站后，他们便分道扬镳，各自回家了。

senses.meaning: 终止合作关系；（因意见不合而）断绝往来
senses.example_en: The band decided to part company with their longtime manager over creative differences.
senses.example_zh: 因创作理念分歧，乐队决定与合作多年的经纪人终止合作。

senses.example_en: It broke her heart to part from her children even for a few days.
senses.example_zh: 哪怕只是和孩子们分开几天，她也感到心碎。

senses.meaning: 将……置于（特定状态、困境中）
senses.example_en: His unexpected resignation placed the entire team in an awkward situation.
senses.example_zh: 他的突然辞职使整个团队陷入了尴尬的境地。

senses.example_en: The agency helped place her in a prestigious law firm after graduation.
senses.example_zh: 毕业后，职介机构帮助将她安置在了一家知名律师事务所工作。

senses.example_en: The coach placed high expectations on the young striker.
senses.example_zh: 主教练对这位年轻的前锋寄予了厚望。

senses.example_en: Strict restrictions were placed on foreign imports to protect local industries.
senses.example_zh: 为了保护本土产业，外国进口商品被施加了严格的限制。

senses.meaning: 使处于……之下（逮捕、监视、管辖等）
senses.example_en: The suspect was immediately placed under arrest at the airport.
senses.example_zh: 嫌疑人在机场当场被捕。

senses.meaning: 使处于（麻醉、重压等）生理或心理状态
senses.example_en: The patient was placed under general anesthesia before the surgery began.
senses.example_zh: 手术开始前，患者接受了全身麻醉。

senses.example_en: The company decided to place out the website redesign to a digital agency.
senses.example_zh: 公司决定将网站重新设计的工作外包给一家数字化代理机构。

senses.example_en: Social services worked hard to place out the orphans with loving families.
senses.example_zh: 社会福利部门努力将这些孤儿安置到有爱心的家庭中寄养。

senses.meaning: 将（订单、投资等）交给，托付给
senses.example_en: We chose to place our annual order with a certified local supplier.
senses.example_zh: 我们选择将年度订单托付给当地一家有资质的供应商。

senses.meaning: 把（孩子、宠物等）安置给，交给……照料
senses.example_en: The shelter successfully placed the rescued puppy with a young couple.
senses.example_zh: 救助站成功把这只获救的小狗安置在了一对年轻夫妇家中。

senses.meaning: 将……呈递给，提交给（供审阅或考虑）
senses.example_en: The committee placed the final proposal before the board for approval.
senses.example_zh: 委员会将最终提案提交给董事会审批。

senses.example_en: A responsible doctor always places the patient's well-being before financial gain.
senses.example_zh: 负责任的医生总是将患者的福祉置于经济利益之前。

senses.meaning: 将……抛在脑后，告别（痛苦或不快的过往）
senses.example_en: After years of counseling, she was finally able to place her trauma behind her.
senses.example_zh: 经过多年的心理咨询，她终于能够将曾经的创伤抛在脑后。

senses.example_en: The entire faculty placed their support behind the student-led reform.
senses.example_zh: 全体教职员工全力支持这场由学生主导的改革。

senses.meaning: 将某人奉若神明，盲目崇拜，偶像化
senses.example_en: Fans often place movie stars on a pedestal, forgetting that they are flawed human beings.
senses.example_zh: 粉丝常把影星奉若神明，却忘了他们也只是有缺点的凡人。

senses.meaning: 认不出某人，记不得某人在何处见过
senses.example_en: Her face seems strikingly familiar, but for the life of me, I simply cannot place her.
senses.example_zh: 她的面孔看着极其眼熟，但我无论如何也想不起在哪儿见过她。

senses.meaning: 乱七八糟，毫无条理；到处都是；心神不宁
senses.example_en: His presentation was all over the place and failed to make a convincing argument.
senses.example_zh: 他的演讲毫无头绪、东拉西扯，完全没有说服力。

senses.meaning: 起初，一开始；（用于列举或解释原因）首先
senses.example_en: If you had read the instructions carefully in the first place, we wouldn't be facing this mess.
senses.example_zh: 要是你一开始就仔细阅读说明书，我们现在就不会面临这种烂摊子了。

senses.meaning: 格格不入的，不相称的；不合时宜的
senses.example_en: Dressed in casual jeans at the black-tie gala, he felt distinctly out of place.
senses.example_zh: 穿着休闲牛仔裤出席这场要求穿燕尾礼服的盛会，他感觉格外格格不入。

senses.meaning: 有利地位，显要位置，扬名立万的机会
senses.example_en: After decades of tireless research, the young scientist finally secured her place in the sun.
senses.example_zh: 经过数十年的不懈研究，这位年轻的科学家终于赢得了属于自己的一席之地。

senses.example_en: Customers can place an order online and receive delivery within twenty-four hours.
senses.example_zh: 顾客可以在线提交订单，并在24小时之内收到送达的货物。

senses.example_en: Voters placed their faith in the progressive candidate's pledge to tackle inequality.
senses.example_zh: 选民们把信任寄托在激进派候选人解决不平等问题的承诺上。

senses.example_en: Modern tech companies place a high premium on creativity and adaptability.
senses.example_zh: 现代科技企业极其重视员工的创造力与适应能力。

senses.example_en: The local council decided to place strict restrictions on vehicular traffic in the old town.
senses.example_zh: 市政委员会决定对老城区的机动车通行实施严格限制。

senses.example_en: The emergency dispatcher placed a call directly to the nearest fire station.
senses.example_zh: 应急调度员直接向最近的消防局拨通了电话。

senses.meaning: 将过错/责任推卸给某人
senses.example_en: It is totally unfair to place all the blame on the junior engineer for system collapse.
senses.example_zh: 把整个系统崩溃的责任完全推卸到初级工程师身上是极其不公的。

senses.example_en: The educational curriculum places special emphasis on critical thinking and problem-solving.
senses.example_zh: 该教学大纲特别注重培养批判性思维与解决问题的能力。

senses.meaning: 将……置于……之上，把……看得重于一切
senses.example_en: He has always placed honesty and integrity above personal success.
senses.example_zh: 他始终把诚实和正直看得高于个人成就。

senses.example_en: The laser-guided missile homed in on the military bunker with pinpoint precision.
senses.example_zh: 激光制导导弹以极高的精度瞄准并摧毁了该军事掩体。

senses.meaning: 敏锐地抓住；把全部注意力集中于
senses.example_en: Auditors quickly homed in on several unexplained discrepancies in the financial records.
senses.example_zh: 审计人员迅速抓住了财务记录中几处无法解释的漏洞。

senses.meaning: 无线电信号或导航）向……导向；对准目标
senses.example_en: The rescue aircraft was able to home on the beacon transmitted by the life raft.
senses.example_zh: 搜救飞机依靠救生筏发出的信标信号成功完成了目标导向飞行。

senses.meaning: 让某人深刻认识到；使某人深切体会到
senses.example_en: The graphic photos of the crash site brought home to the teenagers the gravity of reckless driving.
senses.example_zh: 车祸现场触目惊心的照片让这群年轻人深刻体会到了危险驾驶的严重后果。

senses.meaning: 击中要害；触及痛处；引起深切触动
senses.example_en: Her mentor's blunt feedback hit home, making her reconsider her entire approach.
senses.example_zh: 导师毫不留情的反馈击中了要害，使她重新反思起自己的整套方法。

senses.meaning: 触及痛处；让人感同身受（尤指引发不安）
senses.example_en: The drama about sudden job layoffs felt a bit too close to home for many in the audience.
senses.example_zh: 这部关于突遭裁员的戏剧让许多观众感到触及痛处、深有同感。

senses.meaning: 请自便；别客气（如同在自己家一样）
senses.example_en: Please come inside, take off your coat, and make yourself at home.
senses.example_zh: 请进，脱掉外套，别客气就当在自己家一样。

collocations.phrase: home in on the core issue

senses.meaning: 切入核心问题；紧扣要害
senses.example_en: The mediator helped both sides home in on the core issue stalling the negotiations.
senses.example_zh: 调解员帮助双方切入并聚焦阻碍谈判的核心症结。

senses.meaning: 感到自在舒适；如鱼得水
senses.example_en: Thanks to a supportive mentor, she quickly felt at home in her new research lab.
senses.example_zh: 多亏了导师的悉心支持，她在新的研究实验室里很快便感到适应自在。

senses.example_en: Before attempting to export abroad, the brand established dominance in its home market.
senses.example_zh: 在尝试向海外出口之前，该品牌已在本土市场确立了主导地位。

senses.meaning: 破碎家庭（指父母离异或分居）
senses.example_en: Social workers offered extra counseling to teenagers coming from broken homes.
senses.example_zh: 社工们为来自破碎家庭的青少年提供了额外的心理辅导。

senses.example_en: We need to find out what really happened before making any assumptions.
senses.example_zh: 在做出任何假设之前，我们需要查明真相。

senses.meaning: 识破某人的欺骗行为，查出某人的劣迹
senses.example_en: He told lies about his qualifications, but the company soon found him out.
senses.example_zh: 他在学历上撒了谎，但公司很快就识破了他的底细。

senses.meaning: 法官或陪审团）裁定……胜诉
senses.example_en: The jury found for the plaintiff and awarded substantial compensation.
senses.example_zh: 陪审团裁定原告胜诉，并判给其巨额赔偿。

senses.meaning: 打听，深入了解（某事或某人）
senses.example_en: I'm trying to find out about local schools before we move there.
senses.example_zh: 我正打算在我们搬过去之前多了解一下当地的学校情况。

senses.meaning: 适应新环境，逐渐自信熟练
senses.example_en: It took him a couple of months to find his feet in the new role.
senses.example_zh: 他在新岗位上花了几个月才慢慢适应并进入状态。

senses.meaning: 敢于公开发表意见；找到独特的表达风格
senses.example_en: She was timid at first, but she soon found her voice during debates.
senses.example_zh: 起初她很胆小，但在辩论中很快就敢于自信表达观点了。

senses.meaning: 找到去...的路线；辗转流入/进入
senses.example_en: A significant amount of plastic waste finds its way into the oceans each year.
senses.example_zh: 每年有大量的塑料废弃物流入海洋。

senses.example_en: No matter what we do, our manager always manages to find fault with our work.
senses.example_zh: 不管我们怎么做，经理总能挑出我们工作中的毛病。

idioms.phrase: find a needle in a haystack

senses.example_en: Searching for one lost earring on the crowded beach was like finding a needle in a haystack.
senses.example_zh: 在拥挤的海滩上寻找一只遗失的耳环犹如大海捞针。

senses.meaning: 寻求共同点，达成一致意见
senses.example_en: Despite ideological differences, the two leaders managed to find common ground on trade.
senses.example_zh: 尽管存在意识形态差异，两位领导人仍在贸易问题上找到了共同语言。

senses.meaning: 得到...的青睐，受到赏识或支持
senses.example_en: The proposed tax reforms did not find favour with the business community.
senses.example_zh: 拟议中的税收改革方案并未受到商界的青睐。

collocations.phrase: find it hard / easy to do sth

senses.meaning: 发觉做某事很困难/容易
senses.example_en: Many foreigners find it hard to adapt to the local climate.
senses.example_zh: 很多外国人发觉很难适应当地的气候。

senses.example_en: Engineers are working around the clock to find a solution to the software bug.
senses.example_zh: 工程师们正在夜以继日地工作，以找出修复该软件漏洞的解决方案。

senses.example_en: Despite a packed schedule, she always finds time to exercise daily.
senses.example_zh: 尽管日程排得满满当当，她每天总能挤出时间锻炼身体。

senses.meaning: 在...中体现出来，通过...表达出来
senses.example_en: His deep dissatisfaction found expression in a series of protest songs.
senses.example_zh: 他的深重不满在一系列抗议歌曲中得到了充分体现。

senses.example_en: Working parents constantly strive to find a balance between career and family life.
senses.example_zh: 在职父母一直在努力寻求事业与家庭生活之间的平衡点。

senses.meaning: 吃亏/付出代价后才明白
senses.example_en: He found out to his cost that cheap tools often break on the first use.
senses.example_zh: 他付出了代价才懂得廉价工具往往第一次用就会坏。

senses.meaning: 不知不觉身处（某种境地）
senses.example_en: After wandering for an hour, she found herself in an unfamiliar part of town.
senses.example_zh: 闲逛了一个小时后，她发现自己不知不觉来到了一处陌生街区。

senses.meaning: 认识自我，明确人生目标
senses.example_en: He took a gap year traveling abroad to find himself.
senses.example_zh: 他休学一年出国旅行，以明确自己真正的人生追求。

collocations.phrase: find in oneself to do sth

senses.meaning: 常用于否定或疑问句）鼓起勇气/下定决心做某事
senses.example_en: She could not find it in herself to forgive his repeated lies.
senses.example_zh: 她下定不了决心去原谅他一次又一次的谎言。

senses.example_en: The tribunal found the officer not guilty of misconduct.
senses.example_zh: 审判庭裁定该名警官渎职罪名不成立。

senses.meaning: 法官或陪审团）裁定……败诉
senses.example_en: The court found against the defendant due to insufficient evidence.
senses.example_zh: 由于证据不足，法庭裁定被告败诉。

senses.example_en: I've been looking for my glasses everywhere, but I still can't find them.
senses.example_zh: 我到处找我的眼镜，但还是没找到。

senses.example_en: You're looking for trouble if you walk down that dark alley alone at night.
senses.example_zh: 要是你大半夜独自走那条漆黑的小巷，纯粹是自找麻烦。

senses.example_en: Look at that colorful bird sitting on the branch.
senses.example_zh: 看那只停在树枝上的色彩斑斓的鸟。

senses.example_en: The management team is looking at several ways to cut operating costs.
senses.example_zh: 管理层正在研究几种降低运营成本的方案。

senses.example_en: Could you look after my dog while I'm away on a business trip?
senses.example_zh: 我出差期间你能帮我照看一下我的狗吗？

senses.example_en: Don't worry about the conference logistics; my assistant will look after that.
senses.example_zh: 别担心会议后勤的事，我的助理会负责处理。

senses.example_en: We are all looking forward to our annual summer vacation.
senses.example_zh: 我们大家都十分期盼一年一度的暑假。

senses.example_en: If you don't recognize the word, look it up in the online dictionary.
senses.example_zh: 如果你不认识这个词，就在线查一下字典。

senses.example_en: Sales were slow last winter, but business is finally looking up.
senses.example_zh: 去年冬天销售低迷，但生意终于开始好转了。

senses.example_en: Be sure to look me up next time you are in New York.
senses.example_zh: 下次你来纽约，一定要来找我坐坐。

senses.example_en: Young athletes around the world look up to her as an inspirational leader.
senses.example_zh: 全世界的年轻运动员都视她为鼓舞人心的榜样并敬佩她。

senses.example_en: She never looks down on anyone just because they come from a humble background.
senses.example_zh: 她绝不会仅仅因为别人出身平凡而看不起对方。

senses.example_en: Looking back on his long career, he had very few regrets.
senses.example_zh: 回顾自己漫长的职业生涯，他几乎没有什么遗憾。

senses.example_en: She closed the gate behind her and walked away without looking back.
senses.example_zh: 她关上身后的大门，头也不回地走了。

senses.example_en: Look out! That ladder is about to fall over.
senses.example_zh: 小心！那个梯子快要倒了。

senses.example_en: The French windows look out over a quiet garden.
senses.example_zh: 落地窗朝外正对着一座宁静的花园。

senses.example_en: Drivers need to look out for pedestrians when turning at intersections.
senses.example_zh: 司机在路口转弯时需要留心行人。

senses.example_en: Good colleagues always look out for each other during stressful projects.
senses.example_zh: 好同事在面对高压项目时总会互相照应。

senses.example_en: I quickly looked through the headlines while drinking my morning coffee.
senses.example_zh: 我喝早咖啡时快速浏览了一下新闻头条。

senses.example_en: She looked through every drawer trying to find the missing passport.
senses.example_zh: 她翻遍了每一个抽屉，试图找到丢失的护照。

senses.example_en: He looked straight through me in the corridor, pretending we had never met.
senses.example_zh: 他在走廊里对我视而不见，装作我们从未认识一样。

senses.example_en: Could you look over my presentation slides and give me some suggestions?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我过目一下演讲幻灯片并提些建议吗？

senses.example_en: The mechanic carefully looked over the engine before giving us an estimate.
senses.example_zh: 机械师在给我们报价前仔细查看了发动机。

senses.example_en: He stood in the middle of the room and looked around suspiciously.
senses.example_zh: 他站在房间中央，狐疑地四处打量。

senses.example_en: We spent the whole afternoon looking around the old cathedral.
senses.example_zh: 我们花了整个下午参观那座古老的大教堂。

senses.meaning: 顺道探望，顺便拜访（确认是否安好）
senses.example_en: I promised to look in on my elderly neighbor on my way back from the store.
senses.example_zh: 我答应从商店回来的路上去顺道探望一下上了年纪的邻居。

senses.example_en: The surgical procedure looked so intense that she had to look away.
senses.example_zh: 那个手术过程看起来太吓人了，她不得不转过脸去。

senses.example_en: A visionary leader must look ahead and anticipate upcoming market shifts.
senses.example_zh: 有远见的领导者必须展望未来，预判即将到来的市场变革。

senses.example_en: Dressed in that tailored tuxedo, he looked like a million dollars.
senses.example_zh: 穿上那套定制礼服，他看起来容光焕发、魅力非凡。

senses.meaning: 一路走向成功；势如破竹
senses.example_en: Since launching her startup last year, she has never looked back.
senses.example_zh: 自从去年创立公司以来，她一路走高、蒸蒸日上。

senses.meaning: 假装没看见；熟视无睹；姑息纵容
senses.example_en: Officials were accused of looking the other way while illegal dumping occurred.
senses.example_zh: 官员们被指控对非法倾倒垃圾的行为熟视无睹。

senses.meaning: 乐观面对；看到事物积极的一面
senses.example_en: Even when the flight was delayed, she looked on the bright side and read a good book.
senses.example_zh: 即便航班延误，她也往好的一面看，读了一本好书。

senses.example_en: His colleague looked daggers at him for revealing the surprise during the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 同事因他在会议上泄露了惊喜而对他怒目而视。

senses.example_en: It is crucial to look before you leap when making major investment decisions.
senses.example_zh: 在做出重大投资决策时，三思而后行至关重要。

senses.example_en: Let's take a closer look at the financial data before reaching a conclusion.
senses.example_zh: 在得出结论之前，让我们仔细审视一下这组财务数据。

senses.meaning: 直视某人的眼睛（以示坦荡或诚实）
senses.example_en: He couldn't look me in the eye when he gave his weak explanation.
senses.example_zh: 他给出牵强的解释时，甚至不敢正眼看我。

senses.meaning: 穿戴整洁利落；动作快点
senses.example_en: Make sure you look sharp for your job interview tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 务必穿戴利落整洁去参加明早的求职面试。

senses.meaning: 给某人一个眼神；瞪某人一眼
senses.example_en: My mother gave me a stern look across the dinner table to quiet me down.
senses.example_zh: 母亲在餐桌另一端严厉地瞪了我一眼，示意我安静。

senses.meaning: 理论上看似可行；表面上看起来不错
senses.example_en: The strategic plan looked good on paper, but practical execution failed.
senses.example_zh: 这项战略计划在纸面上看起来很棒，但实际执行却失败了。

senses.example_en: Let me have a look at your engine to see what is causing that strange noise.
senses.example_zh: 让我看一下你的发动机，找出异响的成因。

senses.example_en: The police are looking into the circumstances surrounding the sudden accident.
senses.example_zh: 警方正在调查围绕该突发事故的具体情况。

senses.example_en: I have always looked upon him as an older brother rather than just a mentor.
senses.example_zh: 我一直把他当作兄长看待，而不仅仅是一位导师。

senses.example_en: A crowd of onlookers merely looked on while the two drivers argued.
senses.example_zh: 当两名司机争吵时，一群围观者只是在旁边冷眼旁观。

senses.meaning: 需要某人返回，需要某人重新效力
senses.example_en: The company has hit a crisis and desperately needs its former CEO back.
senses.example_zh: 公司陷入了危机，迫切需要前任CEO重返岗位。

senses.meaning: 需要要回某物，需要某物归还
senses.example_en: You can borrow my laptop for the weekend, but I need it back by Monday morning.
senses.example_zh: 周末你可以借用我的笔记本电脑，但我周一早上必须用，得还给我。

senses.example_en: The puppy is scratching at the back door because it needs in.
senses.example_zh: 小狗正在抓后门，因为它想要进屋来。

senses.meaning: 渴望参与，想要分一杯羹
senses.example_en: This new venture looks extremely profitable, and several investors need in.
senses.example_zh: 这个新项目看起来利润极其丰厚，好几个投资人都渴望参与分一杯羹。

senses.example_en: The cat is sitting by the patio door meowing loudly because she needs out.
senses.example_zh: 猫咪坐在露台门边喵喵大叫，因为它想要出去。

senses.meaning: 迫切想要退出，想要摆脱/脱身
senses.example_en: He realized the partnership was going nowhere and knew he needed out immediately.
senses.example_zh: 他意识到这种合伙关系毫无前途，深知自己必须立即抽身离开。

senses.meaning: 需要某人在身边照料或陪伴
senses.example_en: While recovering from the major surgery, she really needs someone around at all times.
senses.example_zh: 从大手术中恢复期间，她身边的确随时都需要有人照料陪伴。

senses.example_en: Rapid urban development has created an urgent need for better public transit.
senses.example_zh: 快速的城市发展催生了对更好公共交通系统的迫切需求。

senses.meaning: 需要起床；需要被抱起/扶起
senses.example_en: The baby just woke up from her nap and is crying because she needs up.
senses.example_zh: 小宝宝刚午睡醒来，哭着要人抱起来。

senses.meaning: 需要下来；需要被放下来
senses.example_en: The toddler climbed onto the high chair on his own, but now he needs down.
senses.example_zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子自己爬上了高脚椅，但现在需要大人把他抱下来。

idioms.phrase: need sth like a hole in the head

senses.meaning: 根本不需要某物；极不想要某物
senses.example_en: With all my current deadlines, I need another project like a hole in the head.
senses.example_zh: 眼下各种截稿期催得紧，我再接一个项目简直就是自找倒霉。

senses.example_en: We can reschedule the team meeting for next Monday if need be.
senses.example_zh: 如果有需要，我们可以把团队会议推迟到下周一。

idioms.phrase: a friend in need is a friend indeed

senses.example_en: He stood by me during my bankruptcy, proving that a friend in need is a friend indeed.
senses.example_zh: 在我破产时他对我施以援手，证明了患难见真情。

senses.meaning: 妇孺皆知；无需赘言介绍
senses.example_en: Our guest speaker tonight is a legend who needs no introduction.
senses.example_zh: 今晚的演讲嘉宾是一位家喻户晓的传奇人物，无需赘述介绍。

senses.meaning: 还用我多说吗？；不言而喻
senses.example_en: The revenue dropped by eighty percent in one quarter; need I say more?
senses.example_zh: 单季度营收暴跌了百分之八十，还用我多说什么吗？

senses.meaning: 谁稀罕呢？；何必自讨苦吃
senses.example_en: Dealing with all that political infighting every day—who needs it?
senses.example_zh: 每天都要应对那种勾心斗角的内耗——谁稀罕受那份罪呢？

senses.example_en: The local clinic is in dire need of fresh medical supplies and staff.
senses.example_zh: 当地诊所急需补充医疗物资和医护人员。

senses.example_en: The software update was customized to meet the specific needs of enterprise clients.
senses.example_zh: 该软件更新进行了定制，以满足企业客户的特定需求。

senses.example_en: The new resort caters to the needs of families traveling with young children.
senses.example_zh: 这家新度假村专门迎合带着幼儿出行的家庭需求。

collocations.phrase: feel the need to do sth

senses.example_en: I did not feel the need to defend myself against groundless accusations.
senses.example_zh: 我觉得没有必要针对莫须有的指责去为自己辩解。

collocations.phrase: have no need to do sth

senses.meaning: 无需做某事；没必要做某事
senses.example_en: You have no need to apologize for an honest mistake made in good faith.
senses.example_zh: 对于出于善意而犯的无心之失，你完全没必要道歉。

senses.example_en: The drought-stricken farmlands desperately need rain to save this year's harvest.
senses.example_zh: 遭受旱灾的农田急需降雨来挽救今年的收成。

senses.meaning: 发生，展现，展开（事件或情节）
senses.example_en: We'll just have to wait and see how the situation plays out.
senses.example_zh: 我们只能静观事态如何发展。

senses.example_en: The drama played out against the backdrop of the Cold War.
senses.example_zh: 这出戏剧在冷战时期的背景下缓缓落下帷幕。

senses.meaning: 使筋疲力尽，耗尽（常作 be played out）
senses.example_en: By the end of the marathon, all the runners were completely played out.
senses.example_zh: 马拉松结束时，所有选手都已精疲力竭。

senses.example_en: The government tried to play down the seriousness of the economic crisis.
senses.example_zh: 政府试图淡化这场经济危机的严重性。

senses.example_en: The media played up the minor scandal to boost their ratings.
senses.example_zh: 媒体大肆渲染这起小丑闻以提高收视率。

senses.example_en: The children always play up when they have a substitute teacher.
senses.example_zh: 一遇到代课老师，孩子们总是调皮捣蛋。

senses.meaning: 机器或身体部位）出毛病，疼痛
senses.example_en: My old knee injury has been playing up again in this damp weather.
senses.example_zh: 在这种潮湿天气里，我膝盖的老毛病又犯了。

senses.meaning: 假装配合，顺水推舟，暂时顺从
senses.example_en: I decided to play along with his plan until I figured out what he was really up to.
senses.example_zh: 我决定先顺着他的计划配合，直到弄清他的真实意图。

senses.example_en: He put on a jazz record and played along on his saxophone.
senses.example_zh: 他放了一张爵士唱片，跟着用萨克斯合奏起来。

senses.meaning: 利用（他人的弱点、恐惧、情感等）
senses.example_en: The advertisement plays on parents' fears about their children's safety.
senses.example_zh: 该广告利用了父母对孩子安全的担忧心理。

senses.meaning: 挑拨离间，使两方相争（play sb off against sb）
senses.example_en: She skillfully played the two rival companies off against each other to get a higher salary.
senses.example_zh: 她巧妙地让两家竞争公司互相竞价，从而获得了更高的薪水。

senses.example_en: Because of the tie, the two teams will have to play off next week.
senses.example_zh: 由于比分打平，两队下周必须进行加赛决出胜负。

senses.example_en: Stop playing around and finish your homework before dinner.
senses.example_zh: 别闹了，晚饭前把作业写完。

senses.example_en: Don't play around with that power drill—you might hurt yourself.
senses.example_zh: 别乱动那个电钻，小心伤到自己。

senses.meaning: 出轨，搞婚外情，寻欢作乐
senses.example_en: She divorced him after discovering he had been playing around behind her back.
senses.example_zh: 在发现他背着自己寻欢出轨后，她与他离了婚。

senses.example_en: He nervously played with his wedding ring during the interview.
senses.example_zh: 面试期间，他紧张地把玩着手上的婚戒。

senses.example_en: She realized that he was just playing with her feelings all along.
senses.example_zh: 她意识到他从始至终都只是在玩弄她的感情。

senses.meaning: 姑且考虑，不严肃地琢磨（想法、计划）
senses.example_en: We've been playing with the idea of moving to the countryside.
senses.example_zh: 我们最近一直在琢磨搬去乡下住的想法。

senses.example_en: The detective played back the surveillance video to catch any missed details.
senses.example_zh: 侦探回放了监控录像，以捕捉任何遗漏的细节。

senses.meaning: 心不在焉地做，漫不经心地搞（玩票）
senses.example_en: He's not a real painter; he's just playing at art.
senses.example_zh: 他并不是真正的画家，只不过是在艺术圈里玩票罢了。

senses.example_en: The children were playing at being astronauts in the backyard.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们在后院里假扮宇航员玩耍。

senses.meaning: 从头到尾演完或弹奏完
senses.example_en: The pianist played through the sonata once more before the concert.
senses.example_zh: 钢琴家在音乐会前又将那首奏鸣曲从头到尾弹了一遍。

senses.meaning: 高尔夫）让后一组先行穿过打球
senses.example_en: The group ahead of us was moving slowly, so they let us play through.
senses.example_zh: 前面的那一组打得比较慢，所以他们让我们先打过去。

senses.example_en: It took him nearly forty hours to play through the entire campaign.
senses.example_zh: 他花了将近四十个小时才把整个游戏战役通关。

senses.example_en: He was always playing up to the boss in hopes of getting a promotion.
senses.example_zh: 他总是巴结老板，希望能获得升职。

senses.meaning: 在脑海中）反复回想，重温
senses.example_en: She kept playing the awkward conversation over in her mind.
senses.example_zh: 她在脑海中一遍又一遍地回想着那段尴尬的对话。

senses.example_en: Let me play that tape over again so you can hear what she said.
senses.example_zh: 让我把那段录音再放一遍，好让你听听她说了什么。

senses.example_en: We don't have a strict itinerary for tomorrow, so let's just play it by ear.
senses.example_zh: 我们明天没有固定的行程，所以到时候看情况见机行事吧。

senses.meaning: 玩火；冒极大风险惹火烧身
senses.example_en: Investing your life savings in high-risk stocks is really playing with fire.
senses.example_zh: 把一生的积蓄投资在高风险股票上无异于玩火。

senses.meaning: 采取强硬手段；态度坚决不妥协
senses.example_en: If the union refuses our reasonable offer, management will have to play hardball.
senses.example_zh: 如果工会拒绝我们合理的报价，管理层就不得不采取强硬手段了。

senses.meaning: 故意唱反调；充当反对者以激发深入讨论
senses.example_en: I agree with your proposal, but let me play devil's advocate to test its robustness.
senses.example_zh: 我赞同你的提议，但我先故意唱个反调，来检验它是否足够严密。

senses.meaning: 欲擒故纵；摆架子故作难以接近
senses.example_en: Don't respond to his text immediately; play hard to get for a bit.
senses.example_zh: 别马上回复他的短信，稍微欲擒故纵一下。

senses.meaning: 屈居次席；充当副手；居于次要地位
senses.example_en: After years of playing second fiddle, she finally took over as the head chef.
senses.example_zh: 在当了多年副手后，她终于接任成为主厨。

senses.meaning: 出牌得当；行事明智；处理得体
senses.example_en: If you play your cards right, this internship could lead to a permanent job.
senses.example_zh: 如果你处理得当，这次实习可能会转为正式职位。

senses.example_en: Diet and exercise play a crucial role in maintaining heart health.
senses.example_zh: 饮食和锻炼在维持心脏健康方面起着至关重要的作用。

senses.meaning: 谨慎行事；稳扎稳打；不冒风险
senses.example_en: Instead of launching a radical redesign, the company decided to play safe.
senses.example_zh: 公司决定谨慎行事，不进行彻底的重新设计。

senses.example_en: In any healthy competition, all participants are expected to play fair.
senses.example_zh: 在任何良性竞争中，所有参与者都应当公平竞争。

senses.meaning: 耍花招；虚伪不诚实；玩弄心机
senses.example_en: Stop playing games and tell me directly what your bottom line is.
senses.example_zh: 别耍心机了，直接告诉我你的底线是什么。

senses.meaning: 捉弄；开……玩笑；（幻觉等）使产生错觉
senses.example_en: The dim lighting was playing tricks on my eyes, making shadows look like figures.
senses.example_zh: 昏暗的灯光让我产生了错觉，把影子看成了人影。

senses.example_en: He always plays the fool to defuse tension during awkward social moments.
senses.example_zh: 在尴尬的社交场合，他总是装疯卖傻来缓和紧张气氛。

senses.meaning: 体育运动中）从（困境、沙坑等恶劣位置）击出或化解
senses.example_en: The golfer managed to play out of the deep bunker with incredible precision.
senses.example_zh: 那位高尔夫球手以惊人的精准度成功将球从深沙坑中打了出来。

senses.meaning: 出任不熟悉的位置（体育竞赛）
senses.example_en: He was forced to play out of position due to several injuries in the squad.
senses.example_zh: 由于队内多人受伤，他不得不改打不熟悉的位置。

senses.meaning: 正中……下怀，落入……圈套（常用 play into sb's hands）
senses.example_en: Losing your temper will only play into their hands.
senses.example_zh: 你要是发脾气，就正好中他们的下怀了。

senses.example_en: Don't give up now; you're so close to reaching your goal.
senses.example_zh: 别在这个时候放弃，你离目标就差一步了。

senses.example_en: His doctor advised him to give up smoking immediately.
senses.example_zh: 医生建议他立刻把烟戒掉。

senses.example_en: Surrounded by the police, the suspect finally gave up without a fight.
senses.example_zh: 在被警方包围后，嫌疑人最终束手就擒。

senses.meaning: 让出，把（时间、座位等）交出
senses.example_en: A young man gave up his seat to the elderly woman on the crowded bus.
senses.example_zh: 在拥挤的公交车上，一位年轻小伙把座位让给了一位老妇人。

senses.meaning: 对……绝望，死心，放弃对……的希望
senses.example_en: Despite his repeated failures, his parents never gave up on him.
senses.example_zh: 尽管他屡遭失败，父母却从未对他失去信心。

senses.example_en: After hours of negotiation, the management finally gave in to the union's demands.
senses.example_zh: 经过数小时的谈判，管理层最终向工会的要求做出了让步。

senses.example_en: Students must give in their essays by five o'clock on Friday.
senses.example_zh: 学生必须在周五下午五点前交上论文。

senses.example_en: The bakery gives away unsold bread to the local shelter at the end of each day.
senses.example_zh: 面包店每天打烊时都会把没卖完的面包免费送给当地庇护所。

senses.example_en: His trembling voice gave away how terrified he actually was.
senses.example_zh: 他颤抖的声音暴露了他内心其实有多么恐惧。

senses.meaning: 婚礼上父亲等）将新娘交给新郎
senses.example_en: Her father proudly walked her down the aisle to give her away.
senses.example_zh: 父亲自豪地挽着她走过红毯，将她交到了新郎手中。

senses.example_en: Volunteers were giving out free bottles of water along the marathon route.
senses.example_zh: 志愿者们在马拉松沿途分发免费瓶装水。

senses.meaning: 用尽，耗竭；（机器或体力）出故障，支撑不住
senses.example_en: After climbing for six hours, his legs finally gave out.
senses.example_zh: 连续攀爬六个小时后，他的双腿终于支撑不住了。

senses.example_en: The results of the examination will be given out tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 考试成绩将于明天上午公布。

senses.meaning: 散发出（气味、光、热、气体等）
senses.example_en: The rotting vegetation gave off a foul chemical odor.
senses.example_zh: 腐烂的植被散发出一股难闻的化学异味。

senses.example_en: Make sure you give back the library books before the due date.
senses.example_zh: 务必在到期日之前将图书馆的书归还。

senses.example_en: Now that he is successful, he wants to give back to his hometown.
senses.example_zh: 如今功成名就，他希望能回馈自己的家乡。

senses.example_en: The physical therapy gave her back the use of her legs.
senses.example_zh: 理疗帮助她重新恢复了双腿的行走能力。

senses.example_en: He gave over the management of the firm to his daughter.
senses.example_zh: 他将公司的经营管理权移交给了女儿。

senses.meaning: 停止（常用于祈使句，指讨厌的行为）
senses.example_en: Oh, give over complaining and help me with the dishes!
senses.example_zh: 哎呀，别再抱怨了，快来帮我洗碗！

senses.meaning: 专用于，拨作……之用（常用于被动语态）
senses.example_en: Most of the ground floor was given over to an open-plan kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 一楼的大部分空间都被改造成了开放式厨房。

senses.meaning: 沉溺于，全身心投入（常接 oneself to）
senses.example_en: He gave himself over to grief after his wife passed away.
senses.example_zh: 妻子去世后，他整个人沉浸在巨大的悲痛之中。

senses.meaning: 发出，散发出（声音、气味、光等）
senses.example_en: The night-blooming flowers gave forth a sweet, intoxicating scent.
senses.example_zh: 夜间盛开的花朵散发出一股甜美而令人陶醉的芬芳。

senses.example_en: The spokesperson gave forth a statement denying all allegations.
senses.example_zh: 发言人发表声明，否认了所有指控。

senses.meaning: 屈服于，纵容（诱惑、压力、欲望等）
senses.example_en: Try not to give in to the temptation of snacking between meals.
senses.example_zh: 尽量克制，不要向两餐之间吃零食的诱惑妥协。

senses.meaning: 互谅互让；相互妥协；交流互动
senses.example_en: Any enduring marriage requires a fair amount of give and take.
senses.example_zh: 任何持久的婚姻都需要相当程度的互谅互让。

senses.meaning: 饶了某人；别苛求某人；给某人一次机会
senses.example_en: Give him a break; it's only his first day on the job.
senses.example_zh: 饶了他吧，今天只是他入职的第一天。

idioms.phrase: give sb the benefit of the doubt

senses.meaning: 先相信某人是无辜的/善意的；姑且信之
senses.example_en: I wasn't sure if his apology was sincere, but I decided to give him the benefit of the doubt.
senses.example_zh: 我拿不准他的道歉是否真诚，但我还是决定先相信他一次。

senses.example_en: Ever since their argument, she has been giving him the cold shoulder.
senses.example_zh: 自从两人争吵之后，她就一直对他爱理不理。

idioms.phrase: give sb a run for their money

senses.meaning: 成为强劲对手；让某人全力以赴才获胜
senses.example_en: The underdog team gave the defending champions a real run for their money.
senses.example_zh: 这支不被看好的队伍给卫冕冠军制造了极其激烈的竞争。

senses.example_en: The ambiguous clause in the contract gave rise to numerous disputes.
senses.example_zh: 合同中那条含糊不清的条款引发了诸多争议。

idioms.phrase: give it a shot / give it a whirl

senses.example_en: I've never tried rock climbing before, but I'm eager to give it a shot.
senses.example_zh: 我以前从未攀过岩，但我很想尝试一下。

senses.example_en: Have you given any serious thought to what you want to study at university?
senses.example_zh: 你有没有认真考虑过大学想学什么专业？

senses.meaning: 优先考虑；置于首要地位
senses.example_en: The council decided to give priority to green energy projects this fiscal year.
senses.example_zh: 理事会决定在本财政年度优先考虑绿色能源项目。

senses.example_en: Could you give me a hand moving this heavy bookcase into the study?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我一把，把这个沉重的书柜搬进书房吗？

senses.example_en: We must give credit to the research team for their tireless dedication.
senses.example_zh: 我们必须对研发团队不知疲倦的奉献予以肯定和赞赏。

senses.example_en: The doctor cannot perform the operation until the patient gives consent.
senses.example_zh: 在病人同意之前，医生不能进行手术。

senses.example_en: The witness was asked to give a detailed account of the accident.
senses.example_zh: 目击者被要求详细叙述事故的经过。

senses.example_en: The old wooden bridge gave way under the weight of the heavy truck.
senses.example_zh: 那座老木桥在重型卡车的重压下轰然坍塌。

senses.example_en: Neither side was willing to give way during the bitter dispute.
senses.example_zh: 在激烈的争论中，双方谁也不肯退让。

senses.example_en: Drivers entering the roundabout must give way to traffic already on it.
senses.example_zh: 进入环岛的车辆必须给已在环岛内的车辆让行。

senses.meaning: 被……取代，让位于（give way to）
senses.example_en: Her initial shock soon gave way to profound relief.
senses.example_zh: 她最初的震惊很快转变为深深的释然。

senses.meaning: 慷慨付出，全心奉献（常与 oneself 连用）
senses.example_en: She generously gave of her free time to mentor underprivileged students.
senses.example_zh: 她毫不吝啬地奉献出自己的业余时间来辅导贫困学生。

senses.example_en: The fugitive decided to give himself up to the police after months on the run.
senses.example_zh: 潜逃数月后，这名逃犯决定向警方自首。

senses.meaning: 沉溺于，沉浸在（某种情感中）
senses.example_en: She gave herself up to despair when she heard the tragic news.
senses.example_zh: 听到那个不幸的消息时，她陷入了绝望之中。

senses.meaning: 门、窗、建筑）通向，朝向，俯瞰
senses.example_en: The French doors in the living room give onto a sunlit balcony.
senses.example_zh: 客厅里的法式落地门通向一个洒满阳光的阳台。

senses.meaning: 阐明自己的论点/理由，为自己的立场辩护
senses.example_en: The union representatives were given thirty minutes to state their case before management.
senses.example_zh: 工会代表获得了三十分钟时间在管理层面前陈述他们的诉求与理由。

senses.meaning: 说人尽皆知的大实话，讲显而易见的废话
senses.example_en: At the risk of stating the obvious, running out of cash will bankrupt the firm.
senses.example_zh: 虽然说这可能是句显而易见的废话，但资金链断裂确实会让公司破产。

senses.meaning: 开出条件，明确提出要求或底线
senses.example_en: The kidnappers stated their terms in a short recorded message delivered to the police.
senses.example_zh: 绑匪在递交给警方的一段简短录音中开出了他们的条件。

senses.meaning: 表明态度，正式表态立场
senses.example_en: The prime minister clearly stated her position regarding national sovereignty.
senses.example_zh: 首相在国家主权问题上明确表明了她的坚定立场。

senses.meaning: 正式表达偏好，明确声明意向
senses.example_en: When asked about the relocation, none of the employees stated a clear preference.
senses.example_zh: 当被问及岗位调动时，没有一位员工明确表达过自己的偏好。

senses.meaning: 清楚/明确地陈述，毫无含糊地说明
senses.example_en: The policy states clearly that refunds are not permitted after thirty days.
senses.example_zh: 该政策明确规定三十天后概不退款。

senses.meaning: 毫不含糊地声明，斩钉截铁地表示
senses.example_en: The spokesperson stated unequivocally that no troops would be deployed.
senses.example_zh: 发言人斩钉截铁地声明绝不会派驻军队。

senses.example_en: The senator has publicly stated that he will not seek another term.
senses.example_zh: 这位参议员已公开声明他将不再寻求连任。

senses.example_en: As stated above, all expenditures must be approved by the chief financial officer.
senses.example_zh: 如上所述，所有支出均须经首席财务官批准。

senses.example_en: The employee resigned without stating a reason for his sudden departure.
senses.example_zh: 该员工离职时并未陈述他突然离开的原因。

senses.meaning: 郑重声明，正式记录在案（作为法定或正式用语）
senses.example_en: I wish to state for the record that I strongly object to this decision.
senses.example_zh: 我想郑重声明并记录在案：我强烈反对这项决定。

senses.meaning: 宣誓陈述，在宣誓后作证
senses.example_en: The witness stated under oath that she saw the defendant at the scene.
senses.example_zh: 证人宣誓陈述称，她确实在案发现场见到了被告。

senses.example_en: Any amendment to the agreement must be stated in writing and signed by both parties.
senses.example_zh: 协议的任何修改均须以书面形式列明，并由双方签字。

senses.meaning: 详细陈述，逐一具体说明
senses.example_en: The applicant was asked to state in detail their relevant work experience.
senses.example_zh: 申请人被要求详细说明其相关的工作经历。

senses.meaning: 陈述如下，具体内容列明如下
senses.example_en: The official policy regarding refunds states as follows.
senses.example_zh: 关于退款的官方政策内容陈述如下。

senses.meaning: 作出相反陈述/声明，提出反对意见
senses.example_en: Unless the contract states to the contrary, the delivery fee is paid by the buyer.
senses.example_zh: 除非合同中另有相反声明，否则运费由买方承担。

senses.example_en: Please state in full your name, date of birth, and current address.
senses.example_zh: 请完整填写您的全名、出生日期以及现居住址。

senses.meaning: 把……当作事实陈述，指称某事为定论
senses.example_en: You cannot state as a fact something that has not been scientifically verified.
senses.example_zh: 你不能把尚未经过科学验证的事情当作既定事实来陈述。

senses.example_en: Please send the finalized contract to legal right away for their signature.
senses.example_zh: 请立即把定稿的合同发给法务部门签字。

senses.meaning: 从一开始，立即，开门见山
senses.example_en: Right off the bat, she made it clear that budget cuts would be inevitable.
senses.example_zh: 她一开场就明确表示削减预算是不可避免的。

senses.meaning: 按理说，照理应该，按理应当
senses.example_en: By rights, the championship trophy belongs to our team based on overall performance.
senses.example_zh: 按理说，根据整体表现，冠军奖杯本应属于我们队。

senses.example_en: No one in their right mind would attempt to cross the desert on foot in midsummer.
senses.example_zh: 任何神志正常的人都不会尝试在仲夏徒步穿过沙漠。

senses.meaning: 走在正确的轨道上，思路正确，方向对头
senses.example_en: Your preliminary test results show that you are definitely on the right track with this research.
senses.example_zh: 你的初步测试结果表明，这项研究的方向绝对是正确的。

senses.meaning: 切中要害；拿捏得恰到好处；引起广泛共鸣
senses.example_en: Her keynote speech hit the right note with both younger staff and senior executives.
senses.example_zh: 她的主旨演讲拿捏得恰到好处，引起了年轻员工和高层主管的共鸣。

senses.meaning: 就在某人眼皮底下（却未被察觉）
senses.example_en: The missing documents had been sitting on the conference table right under his nose.
senses.example_zh: 遗失的文件一直就放在会议桌上，就在他的眼皮底下。

idioms.phrase: have two left feet / put a foot wrong

senses.meaning: 犯错，失足（反义表达：never put a foot right / never put a foot wrong）
senses.example_en: Throughout the rigorous press conference, the seasoned diplomat didn't put a foot wrong.
senses.example_zh: 在整场严苛的记者会上，这位经验丰富的外交官没有出任何差错。

senses.meaning: 平反冤屈；纠正错误；拨乱反正
senses.example_en: The newly discovered forensic evidence helped right a devastating judicial wrong.
senses.example_zh: 新发现的法医物证帮助平反了一起毁灭性的司法冤案。

senses.meaning: 收拾局面；纠正错误；恢复正常秩序
senses.example_en: He promised to do whatever it takes to set things right with his estranged family.
senses.example_zh: 他承诺将不惜一切代价来修复与疏远家人的关系，让一切重归于好。

senses.example_en: It serves him right that he got a speeding ticket after driving so recklessly.
senses.example_zh: 他开车那么鲁莽，被开超速罚单真是活该。

senses.meaning: 把……做对；准确理解；恰当处理
senses.example_en: It took several attempts to get the delicate recipe exactly right.
senses.example_zh: 经过多次尝试，才把这份讲究的食谱拿捏得完全到位。

collocations.phrase: have the right to do sth

senses.example_en: Every citizen has the fundamental right to express their opinions peacefully.
senses.example_zh: 每一位公民都拥有和平表达个人意见的基本权利。

senses.meaning: 捍卫自己的权益；挺身维护权利
senses.example_en: The union encouraged all employees to stand up for their rights to fair wages.
senses.example_zh: 工会鼓励所有员工挺身而出，捍卫自己获得合理薪酬的权利。

senses.example_en: Entering the emerging electric vehicle market at the right time proved crucial to their success.
senses.example_zh: 在恰当的时机切入新兴的电动汽车市场，对他们的成功起到了至关重要的作用。

senses.example_en: He slipped on the icy patch but quickly managed to right himself.
senses.example_zh: 他在结冰的路面上滑了一下，但很快稳住了身形。

senses.example_en: After years of reckless living, he finally made an effort to right himself.
senses.example_zh: 经过多年的放荡生活后，他终于努力改过自新。

senses.meaning: 船只等）自行扶正，恢复平衡
senses.example_en: The lifeboat was designed to right itself even in severe waves.
senses.example_zh: 这艘救生艇设计成即使在巨浪中也能自行扶正。

senses.meaning: 局势、经济等）自发好转，重回正轨
senses.example_en: Given enough time, the market will naturally right itself.
senses.example_zh: 只要给足够的时间，市场自然会重回正轨。

senses.meaning: 把（翻倒的物体）扶正，摆正
senses.example_en: The workers rushed over to right up the fallen scaffolding.
senses.example_zh: 工人们赶过去把倒塌的脚手架扶正摆好。

senses.example_en: She righted up in her seat as the interviewers entered the room.
senses.example_zh: 当面试官走进房间时，她在座位上挺直了身子。

senses.meaning: 彻底整顿纠正；平息平定下来
senses.example_en: The new manager worked hard to right down the administrative confusion in the office.
senses.example_zh: 新经理努力彻底整顿办公室内部的行政混乱局面。

senses.example_en: The mechanic used a hydraulic clamp to right out the bent frame.
senses.example_zh: 修理工使用液压钳将弯曲的车架彻底拉直复位。

senses.example_en: We need a transparent discussion to right out these misunderstandings.
senses.example_zh: 我们需要进行一次坦诚的讨论，以彻底消除这些误解。

senses.meaning: 掉转方向并纠偏；使彻底改观
senses.example_en: The captain ordered the crew to right about the vessel before reaching the shallow water.
senses.example_zh: 船长命令船员在到达浅水区之前将船只掉转方向以纠正航向。

senses.meaning: 把（倾斜或翻转的物体）彻底翻正过来
senses.example_en: They used a crane to right over the overturned truck on the highway.
senses.example_zh: 他们用起重机把高速公路上翻倒的卡车彻底翻正过来。

senses.meaning: 全面贯穿调整；彻底修正到位
senses.example_en: The engineering team reviewed the system to right through all critical safety issues.
senses.example_zh: 工程团队对系统进行了全面审查，彻底修正了所有关键的安全隐患。

senses.meaning: 认真钻研，突击温习（某一主题）
senses.example_en: I need to study up on tax laws before the client meeting tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 在明天见客户之前，我得突击学习一下税法。

senses.example_en: She had the privilege of studying under one of the world's finest pianists.
senses.example_zh: 她有幸师从于世界上最杰出的钢琴大师之一。

senses.meaning: 为（考试、学位、资格证等）备考学习
senses.example_en: He spends nearly six hours a day studying for the bar exam.
senses.example_zh: 他每天花将近六个小时备考律师资格考试。

senses.example_en: I walked into the library and saw her studying away in the quiet corner.
senses.example_zh: 我走进图书馆，看到她正在安静的角落里埋头苦读。

senses.meaning: 彻底想通，琢磨透彻；拟定出（方案）
senses.example_en: It took the engineers several weeks to study out a workable solution to the glitch.
senses.example_zh: 工程师们花了数周时间才琢磨出解决该故障的可行方案。

senses.meaning: 从头到尾研读，通读详查
senses.example_en: You should study through the contract thoroughly before putting your signature on it.
senses.example_zh: 在签字之前，你应该把这份合同从头到尾仔细研读一遍。

senses.example_en: Take some time to study over the job offer before making your final decision.
senses.example_zh: 在做最终决定之前，抽点时间把这份录用条件仔细斟酌一下。

senses.meaning: 领悟力强的人，学得快的人
senses.example_en: She had no background in programming, but she proved to be a remarkably quick study.
senses.example_zh: 她虽然没有编程背景，但事实证明她是个领悟力极强的人。

senses.meaning: 鲜明的对比，截然相反的对照物
senses.example_en: The twin brothers are a study in contrasts: one is introverted and analytical, while the other is boisterous and impulsive.
senses.example_zh: 这对双胞胎兄弟形成了鲜明的对比：一个内向理性，另一个却喧闹冲动。

senses.example_en: He sat staring blankly into the distance, lost in a deep brown study until the doorbell rang.
senses.example_zh: 他呆呆地注视着远方陷入了深思，直到门铃响起才回过神来。

senses.meaning: 审时度势；研判赛马/竞争对手的以往表现
senses.example_en: Savvy investors always study the market form thoroughly before committing any venture capital.
senses.example_zh: 精明的投资者在投入风险资金前总会透彻研判市场走势。

senses.meaning: 专门研究某事物，对某事下苦功观察
senses.example_en: Over the past decade, she has made a detailed study of traditional herbal medicine in rural areas.
senses.example_zh: 在过去的十年里，她对乡村地区的传统草药学进行了系统而深入的研究。

senses.example_en: Gaining cross-cultural perspective is one of the main reasons students choose to study abroad.
senses.example_zh: 获得跨文化视野是学生们选择出国留学的主要原因之一。

senses.example_en: The detective studied the surveillance footage closely to catch any overlooked details.
senses.example_zh: 侦探密切查看了监控录像，以捕捉任何被忽略的细节。

senses.meaning: 开展/实施一项调查研究
senses.example_en: Independent researchers were commissioned to conduct a comprehensive study on the ecological impact.
senses.example_zh: 独立研究人员受托就生态影响开展一项综合性研究。

senses.meaning: 论证/研究某事的可行性
senses.example_en: The urban planning board met yesterday to study the feasibility of building a light rail network.
senses.example_zh: 城市规划委员会昨天开会论证了修建轻轨网络的可行性。

senses.meaning: 实证研究 / 纵向追踪研究
senses.example_en: This thirty-year longitudinal study provides compelling evidence on the cognitive benefits of bilingualism.
senses.example_zh: 这项长达三十年的追踪研究为双语对认知能力的有益影响提供了令人信服的证据。

senses.example_en: Linguistic variation among online subcultures has become a popular object of academic study.
senses.example_zh: 网络亚文化中的语言变体已成为一个热门的学术研究对象。

senses.example_en: The committee was formed to study into the long-term effects of the policy.
senses.example_zh: 该委员会的成立旨在深入调查这项政策的长期影响。

senses.example_en: I promised to be there for him, and I really don't want to let him down.
senses.example_zh: 我答应过要支持他，真的不想让他失望。

senses.example_en: She let her hair down after a long day at the office.
senses.example_zh: 在办公室忙碌了一整天后，她把头发披散了下来。

senses.example_en: Some pranksters let down the tires on my bicycle overnight.
senses.example_zh: 有些恶作剧的人昨夜把我的自行车车胎给放了气。

senses.example_en: Could you please open the front door and let the cat in?
senses.example_zh: 你能开一下前门把猫放进来吗？

senses.example_en: These worn boots are starting to let in water.
senses.example_zh: 这双穿旧的靴子开始渗水了。

senses.example_en: He opened the gate and let the sheep out into the pasture.
senses.example_zh: 他打开栅栏门，把羊群放到牧场上去。

senses.example_en: She let out a deep sigh of relief when the exam results were announced.
senses.example_zh: 考试成绩公布时，她长长地舒了一口气。

senses.example_en: I've gained some weight, so I need to have this skirt let out.
senses.example_zh: 我长胖了些，得把这条裙子放宽一点。

senses.example_en: School lets out early on the Friday before Thanksgiving break.
senses.example_zh: 感恩节假期前的那个周五，学校提前放学。

senses.example_en: The police officer decided to let him off with just a warning.
senses.example_zh: 交警决定从轻处理，只对他进行了口头警告。

senses.example_en: The kids gathered in the backyard to let off firecrackers on New Year's Eve.
senses.example_zh: 除夕夜孩子们聚在后院放鞭炮。

senses.example_en: The driver let the passengers off right outside the subway station.
senses.example_zh: 司机在地铁站正门口让乘客下了车。

senses.example_en: We're planning a surprise party for Sarah, so don't let on.
senses.example_zh: 我们正在给莎拉筹备惊喜派对，你可千万别说漏嘴。

senses.example_en: He let on that he was an expert, but he clearly had no idea what he was doing.
senses.example_zh: 他装得像个专家，但显然根本不懂自己在做什么。

senses.meaning: 风雨、坏天气等）减弱，减缓
senses.example_en: We waited under the awning until the heavy downpour let up.
senses.example_zh: 我们在雨棚下等候，直到倾盆大雨渐渐减弱。

senses.meaning: 努力、速度或压力）放松，停歇
senses.example_en: With finals just around the corner, this is no time to let up.
senses.example_zh: 期末考在即，现在可不是松懈的时候。

senses.meaning: 放行，准许通过（关卡、筛查等）
senses.example_en: Customs officials checked our passports and let us through.
senses.example_zh: 海关官员核对了我们的护照后予以放行。

senses.meaning: 告诉（某人内情），让……参与/知悉秘密
senses.example_en: Are you going to let me in on what you two are laughing about?
senses.example_zh: 你们俩到底在笑什么，能不能也让我知道一下？

senses.example_en: He can barely afford to feed his own family, let alone buy a luxury sports car.
senses.example_zh: 他连养活自己的家人都捉襟见肘，更不用说买一辆豪华跑车了。

idioms.phrase: let the cat out of the bag

senses.meaning: 走漏风声，泄露天机，露出马脚
senses.example_en: We wanted the merger to stay under wraps, but an anonymous tip let the cat out of the bag.
senses.example_zh: 我们本想对并购案保密，但一条匿名爆料让消息彻底走漏了风声。

senses.meaning: 莫招惹是非，勿重提旧怨，过去的就让它过去
senses.example_en: Reopening that settled grievance will only cause bitter friction; it is better to let sleeping dogs lie.
senses.example_zh: 重新翻开那桩已了结的恩怨只会引起惨痛的冲突，最好还是莫惹是非，息事宁人。

senses.example_en: After years of estrangement, the brothers shook hands and agreed to let bygones be bygones.
senses.example_zh: 在疏远多年后，兄弟二人握手言和，同意对往事既往不咎。

senses.meaning: 卸下防备，尽情放松欢闹
senses.example_en: The corporate gala was a rare occasion for the executives to let their hair down and enjoy themselves.
senses.example_zh: 这场公司盛典是高管们难得卸下包袱、尽情欢聚放松的时刻。

senses.meaning: 待人宽容，各行其是；宽以待人，互不干涉
senses.example_en: I may not agree with his lifestyle choices, but my personal motto has always been to live and let live.
senses.example_zh: 我可能不赞同他的生活方式，但我个人的座右铭历来是待人宽容、互不干涉。

senses.meaning: 静观其变，等待事态平息/尘埃落定
senses.example_en: Rather than making a hasty decision amidst the crisis, let's wait a week and let the dust settle.
senses.example_zh: 与其在危机中仓促做决定，倒不如等上一周，静待事态平息。

senses.example_en: Please let me know as soon as you have confirmed your travel itinerary.
senses.example_zh: 一旦确认了您的出行行程，请尽早告知我。

senses.meaning: 释放，放任；大发雷霆，纵情发泄
senses.example_en: When the final whistle blew, the jubilant fans let loose a deafening roar across the arena.
senses.example_zh: 终场哨声响起时，狂喜的球迷们在整个赛场上爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼声。

senses.meaning: 痛斥某人，狠狠训诫；痛击某人
senses.example_en: The sergeant let the recruits have it after catching them sneaking out after curfew.
senses.example_zh: 在抓到新兵们宵禁后偷溜出去之后，士官狠狠把他们痛斥了一顿。

senses.example_en: Doctors advised against unnecessary invasive interventions, preferring to let nature take its course.
senses.example_zh: 医生建议不要进行不必要的侵入性干预，主张顺其自然。

senses.example_en: He hesitated for too long and let a once-in-a-lifetime career opportunity slip by.
senses.example_zh: 他犹豫了太久，以致白白错失了一生难逢的职业发展良机。

senses.meaning: 放下顾虑，抛开束缚，敞开心扉
senses.example_en: Dancing around the campfire helped the introverted teenager finally let go of his inhibitions.
senses.example_zh: 围着篝火起舞帮助这个内向的少年终于抛开了束缚与顾虑。

senses.example_en: Hold on tight to the railing and don't let go.
senses.example_zh: 抓紧扶手，千万别松手。

senses.example_en: Due to budget cuts, the firm had to let go of twenty employees.
senses.example_zh: 由于预算削减，公司不得不解雇二十名员工。

senses.meaning: 摒弃，释怀（执念、过去或情绪）
senses.example_en: It is hard to move forward until you learn to let go of the past.
senses.example_zh: 只有学会放下过去，你才能真正向前看。

senses.meaning: 不打扰，由他去，听其自然
senses.example_en: He's very upset right now; it's best to just let him be.
senses.example_zh: 他现在情绪很糟，最好先别去打扰他，随他去吧。

senses.meaning: 放过，听之任之，不予追究
senses.example_en: His comment was quite rude, but I decided to let it pass.
senses.example_zh: 他的话相当无礼，但我决定不予计较，就这么算了。

senses.meaning: 听任其发展，暂且搁置不管
senses.example_en: There's no point arguing about the schedule now—let's just let it ride.
senses.example_zh: 现在争论时间表毫无意义——先随它去，暂且不管吧。

senses.meaning: 猛掷出，发射（武器、投掷物等）
senses.example_en: The archer drew his bow and let fly an arrow into the target.
senses.example_zh: 弓箭手拉满弓，向靶心射出了一支箭。

senses.example_en: Lost in anger, he let fly with a barrage of insults at his opponent.
senses.example_zh: 盛怒之下，他对着对手破口大骂了一通。

senses.example_en: Once he hit the empty highway, he stepped on the gas and let rip.
senses.example_zh: 一驶上空旷的高速公路，他就踩下油门全速狂飙。

senses.meaning: 尽情发泄，毫无顾忌地行动
senses.example_en: When asked for feedback, she didn't hold back and just let rip.
senses.example_zh: 当被征求意见时，她毫不保留，竹筒倒豆子般尽情吐露。

senses.meaning: 无意间说漏嘴，不经意透露
senses.example_en: During dinner, he let slip that the company was about to be sold.
senses.example_zh: 在晚宴期间，他不经意间说漏了公司即将被收购的事。

senses.example_en: The security guard refused to let anyone into the building without a badge.
senses.example_zh: 保安拒绝让任何没有佩戴证件的人进入大楼。

senses.example_en: She was finally let into the family secret after turning eighteen.
senses.example_zh: 满十八岁后，她终于被告知了那个家族秘密。

senses.meaning: 以……的名字命名，为纪念……而取名
senses.example_en: She was named after her grandmother, who had passed away the year before.
senses.example_zh: 她是用她祖母的名字命名的，祖母在前一年去世了。

senses.meaning: 以……命名（主要用于美式英语，同 name after）
senses.example_en: The national park was named for the legendary explorer who first mapped the region.
senses.example_zh: 这座国家公园是以首次绘制该地区地图的传奇探险家命名的。

senses.meaning: 因（某特征、功绩或原因）而得名
senses.example_en: The island was named for its abundant population of wild seals.
senses.example_zh: 该岛因栖息着大量野生海豹而得名。

senses.meaning: 任命……加入（委员会、内阁、代表队等）
senses.example_en: The young forward was unexpectedly named to the national Olympic squad.
senses.example_zh: 这名年轻前锋出人意料地入选了国家奥运代表队。

senses.meaning: 在（遗嘱、诉讼、报告等文件）中指名或提及
senses.example_en: He was surprised to discover that he had been named in his uncle's will.
senses.example_zh: 他惊讶地发现自己被列入了叔叔的遗嘱中。

senses.meaning: 逐一点出名字，大声念出姓名
senses.example_en: The teacher named out the prize winners one by one during the assembly.
senses.example_zh: 晨会上，老师逐一念出了获奖者的名字。

senses.example_en: Please name down all the volunteers who signed up for tomorrow's charity drive.
senses.example_zh: 请把所有报名参加明天慈善活动的志愿者名字登记下来。

senses.meaning: 凡是你能说得出的；应有尽有
senses.example_en: They had everything at the party: burgers, sushi, cocktails, you name it.
senses.example_zh: 聚会上应有尽有：汉堡、寿司、鸡尾酒，凡是你能想到的都有。

senses.meaning: 指名道姓；揭发涉案牵连人员的姓名
senses.example_en: The whistleblower refused to name names during the initial investigation.
senses.example_zh: 告密者在初步调查中拒绝指名道姓指认涉事者。

senses.meaning: 成名；崭露头角；赢得声誉
