senses.example_en: She worked relentlessly to make a name for herself in the competitive fashion industry.
senses.example_zh: 她在竞争激烈的时尚界拼搏努力，最终闯出了自己的名堂。

senses.meaning: 拉大旗作虎皮；随口提及名人显赫朋友以抬高自己
senses.example_en: He kept dropping names to impress the interview panel.
senses.example_zh: 他不断提及名人显贵，试图给面试官留下深刻印象。

senses.example_en: It took him nearly five years to finally clear his name in court.
senses.example_zh: 他花了近五年时间才最终在法庭上洗刷了罪名。

senses.meaning: 准确叫出……的名字；明确指认出某事物
senses.example_en: I recognized the melody immediately, but I couldn't put a name to it.
senses.example_zh: 我立刻认出了那段旋律，但一时叫不出它的名字。

senses.meaning: 确定结婚日期；定下吉日
senses.example_en: After five years of engagement, they have finally named the day.
senses.example_zh: 订婚五年后，他们终于定下了婚期。

senses.example_en: The seller asked us to name a price for the vintage painting.
senses.example_zh: 卖家让我们给这幅古董画开个价。

senses.example_en: We must name a date for the upcoming shareholder meeting.
senses.example_zh: 我们必须为即将召开的股东大会定下日期。

senses.meaning: 指定接班人；任命继任者
senses.example_en: The board met privately to name a successor to the retiring CEO.
senses.example_zh: 董事会秘密开会，指定了即将退休的首席执行官的继任者。

senses.example_en: The research wing was named in honour of the Nobel laureate.
senses.example_zh: 该研究中心侧楼是以这位诺贝尔奖得主的名字命名的，以示敬意。

senses.example_en: The striking workers invited management to sit down and name terms.
senses.example_zh: 罢工工人邀请管理层坐下来开出协商条件。

senses.meaning: 全称列出；完整拼写出某物名称
senses.example_en: Please avoid acronyms and name each institution in full on the application.
senses.example_zh: 在申请表上请避免使用首字母缩写，务必完整写出每个机构的名称。

senses.example_en: She was named as the company's new Chief Financial Officer yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 她昨天被任命为公司的新任首席财务官。

senses.example_en: Several local officials were named as key suspects in the bribery investigation.
senses.example_zh: 数名当地官员在受贿调查中被列为主要嫌疑人。

senses.meaning: 从……衍生命名，源自……的名字
senses.example_en: The disease is named from the Greek word meaning 'stiffness'.
senses.example_zh: 该疾病的名字源自一个意为“僵硬”的希腊词汇。

senses.example_en: I wrote a brief note to thank them for their warm hospitality during my stay.
senses.example_zh: 我写了一封简短的便条，感谢他们在逗留期间对我的热情款待。

senses.meaning: 受累于，怪罪于（反讽用法）
senses.example_en: You have only your own careless driving to thank for this hefty fine.
senses.example_zh: 这笔巨额罚款只能怪你自己开车太不小心了。

senses.example_en: We have our dedicated research team to thank for this medical breakthrough.
senses.example_zh: 这一医学突破要归功于我们专注投入的研发团队。

senses.meaning: 拜……所赐，把（坏的结果）归咎于
senses.example_en: We have the severe winter storm to thank for the widespread flight cancellations.
senses.example_zh: 大面积的航班取消全拜这场严重的冬季暴风雪所赐。

senses.meaning: 挨个向众人致谢，到处道谢
senses.example_en: After the concert, the conductor went backstage and thanked around the entire orchestra.
senses.example_zh: 音乐会结束后，指挥走到后台，向整个管弦乐团的成员逐一道谢。

senses.example_en: I’d like to thank ahead all the team members who will be working overtime this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我想预先感谢本周末将加班的所有团队成员。

senses.meaning: 回谢，对别人的道谢予以回应
senses.example_en: When she praised his assistance, he smiled and warmly thanked her back.
senses.example_zh: 当她夸赞他的帮助时，他微笑着热情地回谢了她。

senses.meaning: 客套道谢后打发走，礼貌谢绝送别
senses.example_en: The manager thanked the persistent salesperson off without committing to any purchase.
senses.example_zh: 经理客气地道谢打发走了那位推销员，没有做出任何购买承诺。

senses.meaning: 在致辞结束时）向台下或全场依次致谢
senses.example_en: The guest speaker finished his talk by thanking down the rows of the audience.
senses.example_zh: 特邀演讲嘉宾在演讲结束时依次向台下各排的听众致谢。

senses.meaning: 谢天谢地；庆幸自己的好运
senses.example_en: I thank my lucky stars every day that no one was injured in the accident.
senses.example_zh: 我每天都谢天谢地，庆幸在那场事故中没有人受伤。

idioms.phrase: I'll thank you to do sth

senses.meaning: 请你……（用于表示不满或警告，带有讽刺命令口吻）
senses.example_en: I'll thank you to mind your own business and stay out of my affairs.
senses.example_zh: 我希望你少管闲事，别插手我的私事。

senses.meaning: 谢天谢地；幸好（表示如释重负）
senses.example_en: Thank goodness the storm cleared up before the outdoor wedding began.
senses.example_zh: 谢天谢地，暴风雨在户外婚礼开始前就停了。

senses.example_en: If you fail the test after skipping classes, you have only yourself to thank.
senses.example_zh: 要是你逃课导致考试不及格，那只能怪你自己自食其果。

senses.meaning: 不用谢我；举手之劳何足挂齿
senses.example_en: "No need to thank me," she replied with a smile, "anyone would have done the same."
senses.example_zh: “不用谢我，”她微笑着回答，“换作任何人都会这么做的。”

senses.meaning: 多谢某人；非常感谢（稍带幽默或客套色彩）
senses.example_en: "I thank you kindly for the lift, sir," the old traveller said.
senses.example_zh: “先生，非常感谢您让我搭便车，”那位老旅人说道。

senses.meaning: 对某人感激不尽；感谢之情无以言表
senses.example_en: We cannot thank the rescue team enough for saving our family.
senses.example_zh: 我们对救援队挽救了我们一家人的性命感激不尽。

senses.meaning: 连声向某人道谢；再三由衷致谢
senses.example_en: The lost tourist thanked us profusely when we returned his passport.
senses.example_zh: 迷路的游客在我们归还他的护照时连声道谢。

senses.meaning: 预先感谢某人；提前向某人致意
senses.example_en: Thank you in advance for your cooperation with the building inspection.
senses.example_zh: 预先感谢您对大楼安全检查工作的配合。

senses.example_en: The patient made a special trip to the hospital to thank the surgeon personally.
senses.example_zh: 该患者特意去了一趟医院，当面向主刀医生致谢。

senses.meaning: 热情真挚地向某人道谢
senses.example_en: The host thanked the guest speaker warmly before concluding the seminar.
senses.example_zh: 主持人在研讨会结束前热情真挚地向主讲嘉宾致谢。

senses.meaning: 由衷地感谢某人；真诚地向某人道谢
senses.example_en: I want to thank you sincerely for standing by me through these difficult times.
senses.example_zh: 我想由衷地感谢你在这些艰难时刻始终陪伴在我身边。

senses.meaning: 通过客气道谢来婉拒退出
senses.example_en: He politely thanked himself out of the organizing committee due to his heavy workload.
senses.example_zh: 由于工作繁忙，他客客气气地道谢并退出了筹备委员会。

senses.meaning: 继续前进，离开并前往下一处
senses.example_en: After spending two days in Paris, we moved on to Lyon.
senses.example_zh: 在巴黎待了两天后，我们动身前往里昂。

senses.meaning: 转换话题，开始下一项活动
senses.example_en: Let's move on to the next item on the agenda.
senses.example_zh: 我们接着讨论议程上的下一项吧。

senses.meaning: 释怀，走出阴影展开新生活
senses.example_en: It took her months to move on after the breakup.
senses.example_zh: 分手之后，她花了数月时间才真正走出来并开始新生活。

senses.example_en: Our new neighbors are moving in this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们的新邻居这个周末就要搬进来了。

senses.meaning: 警察或军队等）逼近并采取行动，介入
senses.example_en: The police moved in to disperse the gathering crowd.
senses.example_zh: 警方迅速逼近并采取行动驱散聚集的人群。

senses.example_en: His landlord gave him thirty days to move out.
senses.example_zh: 房东限他三十天之内搬走。

senses.example_en: Many young people move away from small towns in search of jobs.
senses.example_zh: 许多年轻人为了找工作而离开小镇搬往外地。

senses.meaning: 背离，逐步脱离（传统、原则或模式）
senses.example_en: The company decided to move away from traditional marketing strategies.
senses.example_zh: 公司决定逐渐脱离传统的营销策略。

senses.example_en: The line moved forward slowly toward the ticket counter.
senses.example_zh: 队伍缓慢地向前移动，走向售票柜台。

senses.example_en: We need approval from management before we can move forward with this project.
senses.example_zh: 在推进这个项目之前，我们需要获得管理层的批准。

senses.example_en: She moved up quickly within the ranks of the firm.
senses.example_zh: 她在公司内部迅速得到了晋升。

senses.meaning: 挪动位置腾出空间，往前/往里坐
senses.example_en: Could you move up a bit to make room for another passenger?
senses.example_zh: 你能往前挪一挪，给另一位乘客腾点地方吗？

senses.meaning: 提高，上升（排名、物价或数值）
senses.example_en: Oil prices moved up again amid rising supply concerns.
senses.example_zh: 因对供应短缺的担忧加剧，油价再次出现上涨。

senses.example_en: The security guards told the crowd to move back.
senses.example_zh: 保安人员让围观人群往后退。

senses.example_en: After five years in London, she decided to move back to her hometown.
senses.example_zh: 在伦敦生活了五年后，她决定搬回老家。

senses.example_en: The meeting has been moved back from Tuesday to Thursday.
senses.example_zh: 会议已经从周二推迟到了周四。

senses.meaning: 挪开让位，挪动以腾出空位
senses.example_en: Move over on the bench so I can sit down.
senses.example_zh: 你在长椅上往旁边挪一挪，好让我坐下。

senses.meaning: 让出职位或权力（以便他人接任）
senses.example_en: It's time for senior executives to move over and let younger leaders take charge.
senses.example_zh: 是时候让资深高管退位让贤，让年轻领导人挑起大梁了。

senses.meaning: 车辆、队伍）启程，缓缓开走
senses.example_en: The bus moved off just as I reached the stop.
senses.example_zh: 我刚跑到公交站，车子就开走了。

senses.example_en: The discussion began to move off the main topic.
senses.example_zh: 讨论开始偏离了核心议题。

senses.example_en: Please move down the bus to allow others to board.
senses.example_zh: 请往车厢里面走走，方便其他人上车。

senses.example_en: The team moved down to third place after yesterday's defeat.
senses.example_zh: 昨天的失利让该队名次滑落到了第三位。

senses.example_en: Troops were reported to be moving in on the rebel stronghold.
senses.example_zh: 据报道，部队正逐步包围逼近叛军据点。

senses.meaning: 企图抢占，蚕食（市场、权力或资源）
senses.example_en: Foreign rivals are rapidly moving in on their domestic market.
senses.example_zh: 外国竞争对手正迅速蚕食他们的国内市场。

senses.meaning: 走开，勿滞留（常用于指令）
senses.example_en: The officer ordered the bystanders to move along.
senses.example_zh: 警察命令围观群众走开，不要滞留。

senses.meaning: 事情、工作）顺利进展，持续开展
senses.example_en: Renovations are moving along nicely and should finish next week.
senses.example_zh: 装修进展得很顺利，预计下周就能完工。

senses.example_en: Sitting for hours is bad for your back; get up and move around.
senses.example_zh: 久坐对腰不好，站起来四处走动一下吧。

senses.meaning: 频繁搬家，辗转各地生活
senses.example_en: Because of his father's diplomatic career, they moved around a lot.
senses.example_zh: 由于父亲从事外交工作，他们常常辗转各地频繁搬迁。

senses.meaning: 走在前面，取得领先地位
senses.example_en: With this new invention, the startup moved ahead of its competitors.
senses.example_zh: 凭借这项新发明，这家初创企业跑在了竞争对手前面。

senses.example_en: Despite initial objections, the board voted to move ahead with the plan.
senses.example_zh: 尽管最初有人反对，董事会还是投票决定继续推进该计划。

senses.meaning: 采取行动；动身离开；（向某人）示爱或展开追求
senses.example_en: If we want to secure this deal, we need to make a move now.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们想拿下这笔交易，现在就必须采取行动。

senses.example_en: He promised to move heaven and earth to get her tickets to the sold-out concert.
senses.example_zh: 他承诺会想尽一切办法为她搞到那场售罄演唱会的门票。

senses.meaning: 改变规则；在进行中提高标准或改变目标
senses.example_en: Every time we meet their requirements, they move the goalposts.
senses.example_zh: 每次我们达到他们的要求，他们又改变标准刁难我们。

senses.meaning: 与时俱进；顺应时代潮流
senses.example_en: Traditional retailers must move with the times and embrace e-commerce.
senses.example_zh: 传统零售商必须与时俱进，积极拥抱电子商务。

senses.meaning: 飞黄腾达；社会地位或经济状况显著提升
senses.example_en: Ever since his promotion, he has really been moving up in the world.
senses.example_zh: 自从升职后，他的社会地位确实水涨船高了。

senses.example_en: We'd better get a move on, or we'll miss our flight.
senses.example_zh: 我们最好动作快点，否则要赶不上飞机了。

senses.meaning: 朝正确的方向发展；有所好转
senses.example_en: Inflation figures suggest the economy is finally moving in the right direction.
senses.example_zh: 通胀数据表明经济终于在朝着好的方向发展。

senses.example_en: The audience was moved to tears by the pianist's emotional performance.
senses.example_zh: 观众被钢琴家深情动人的演奏感动得热泪盈眶。

senses.example_en: Neither side was willing to make the first move in the peace talks.
senses.example_zh: 在和平谈判中，双方都不愿意率先迈出第一步。

senses.example_en: Moving house is widely considered one of the most stressful life events.
senses.example_zh: 搬家被普遍认为是生活中最耗费心神的事情之一。

senses.meaning: 付诸行动；开始投入运作
senses.example_en: As soon as the alarm sounded, emergency crews moved into action.
senses.example_zh: 警报一响，应急救援人员立刻投入行动。

senses.meaning: 自由活动；畅通无阻地流动
senses.example_en: After weeks in a cast, she can finally move her fingers freely.
senses.example_zh: 打了数周石膏后，她的手指终于能够自如活动了。

senses.meaning: 在正式会议中）提出动议
senses.example_en: The chairman moved a motion to adjourn the meeting until tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 主席提议休会，会议推迟至次日早晨继续进行。

senses.meaning: 以某种速度移动或推进
senses.example_en: Technological advancements are moving at a breakneck pace.
senses.example_zh: 技术进步正以惊人的极快速度向前推进。

senses.meaning: 搬进，迁入新住处或办公地
senses.example_en: The company is moving into a newly built office building next month.
senses.example_zh: 该公司下个月将迁入一座新建的办公大楼。

senses.meaning: 涉足，打入（新业务领域或市场）
senses.example_en: The tech giant is moving into the electric vehicle industry.
senses.example_zh: 这家科技巨头正在涉足电动汽车行业。

senses.meaning: 指出，向某人提醒（事实、错误或信息）
senses.example_en: She pointed out several typos in my first draft.
senses.example_zh: 她指出了我初稿中的几处拼写错误。

senses.meaning: 使注意到，指引看某人某物
senses.example_en: He pointed out the historic landmark to the tourists.
senses.example_zh: 他向游客们指认了那处历史地标。

senses.meaning: 物理上）用手指或物体指向
senses.example_en: The compass needle pointed to the north.
senses.example_zh: 罗盘指针指向了北方。

senses.meaning: 表明，预示，显示出某种可能性
senses.example_en: All current indicators point to a strong economic recovery.
senses.example_zh: 目前的所有指标都预示着强劲的经济复苏。

senses.example_en: Critics point to the lack of funding as the primary cause of failure.
senses.example_zh: 批评人士将资金短缺列为失败的主要原因。

senses.meaning: 用手指、武器等直接）对准，指向
senses.example_en: It is considered rude to point at people in public.
senses.example_zh: 在公共场合用手指着别人被认为是不礼貌的。

senses.meaning: 突出显示，凸显（问题、弱点或重要性）
senses.example_en: The crisis pointed up the urgent need for structural reform.
senses.example_zh: 这场危机凸显了进行结构性改革的紧迫性。

senses.meaning: 追溯到，表明其根源在于
senses.example_en: All the evidence points back to an error made in the initial system setup.
senses.example_zh: 所有的证据都追溯到系统初始配置时犯下的一个错误。

senses.example_en: The arrow on the screen points down to indicate a drop in temperature.
senses.example_zh: 屏幕上的箭头朝下指，表示温度下降。

senses.example_en: Make sure the nozzle is pointed away from your face before spraying.
senses.example_zh: 喷洒前请确保喷嘴指向别处，不要对着自己的脸。

senses.meaning: 无关紧要的；离题的，不相干的
senses.example_en: Whether you like him or not is beside the point; he is qualified for the job.
senses.example_zh: 你喜不喜欢他无关紧要，关键是他能胜任这份工作。

senses.example_en: Her remarks were brief and straight to the point.
senses.example_zh: 她的发言简短有力且切中要害。

senses.meaning: 没抓住要领；理解错误，领会错核心意图
senses.example_en: You completely missed the point of what I was trying to explain.
senses.example_zh: 你完全没有领会我想表达的核心意思。

senses.meaning: 特别注意；务必做到；特意做（某事）
senses.example_en: He makes a point of thanking every team member individually after each project.
senses.example_zh: 每次项目结束后，他都会特意逐一致谢每位团队成员。

senses.meaning: 证明自己的观点正确；证明自己的能力以博取认同
senses.example_en: She ran the marathon not for the medal, but to prove a point to herself.
senses.example_zh: 她跑马拉松不是为了奖牌，而是为了向自己证明自己的能力。

senses.example_en: The manager agreed to stretch a point and accept the late application.
senses.example_zh: 经理同意破例一次，接受了逾期的申请。

senses.meaning: 痛处；伤心事；触及容易引人不悦的话题
senses.example_en: Don't ask about his exam results—it's a very sore point right now.
senses.example_zh: 别问他的考试成绩，那现在可是他的伤心事。

senses.meaning: 在那时；在那个当口/关头
senses.example_en: We were completely exhausted, and at that point we gave up searching.
senses.example_zh: 我们已经筋疲力尽，就在那个关头我们放弃了搜寻。

senses.meaning: 阐明观点；提出有说服力的意见
senses.example_en: You make a good point, but we still have to consider the cost implications.
senses.example_zh: 你说的很有道理，但我们仍须考虑成本方面的影响。

senses.example_en: I take your point, but I still believe my original plan is safer.
senses.example_zh: 我明白你的意思，但我仍然认为我最初的方案更稳妥。

senses.meaning: 出发点；起点；讨论的基点
senses.example_en: This draft can serve as a useful starting point for our negotiations.
senses.example_zh: 这份草案可以作为我们谈判的一个良好起点。

senses.example_en: Winning that scholarship proved to be a major turning point in her life.
senses.example_zh: 获得那笔奖学金被证明是她人生的一个重大转折点。

senses.example_en: The fireplace serves as the main focal point of the living room.
senses.example_zh: 壁炉是客厅整体视觉的核心焦点。

senses.example_en: Try to look at the situation from a customer's point of view.
senses.example_zh: 试着站在客户的立场来审视这一情况。

senses.example_en: At this point in time, we cannot confirm whether any data was leaked.
senses.example_zh: 在目前的这个时间节点，我们无法确认是否有数据遭到泄露。

senses.example_en: The road sign points towards the highway entrance.
senses.example_zh: 路标朝向高速公路入口方向。

senses.meaning: 显示出……的趋势，暗示未来走向
senses.example_en: Recent survey findings point towards a shift in consumer habits.
senses.example_zh: 近期的调查结果暗示了消费者习惯的转变趋势。

senses.example_en: Let me write down your phone number before I forget it.
senses.example_zh: 趁我还没忘，让我把你的电话号码记下来。

senses.example_en: The bank had to write down the value of its property portfolio by twenty percent.
senses.example_zh: 该银行不得不将其房地产投资组合的账面价值减记20%。

senses.meaning: 认定…毫无价值/失败，放弃
senses.example_en: Critics were quick to write off the new venture as a total disaster.
senses.example_zh: 评论家们迅速断定这项新创事业彻底失败了。

senses.example_en: The government agreed to write off millions of dollars in student loans.
senses.example_zh: 政府同意注销数百万美元的学生贷款债务。

senses.meaning: 把（车辆等）彻底撞毁致报废
senses.example_en: He survived the accident without a scratch, but his car was completely written off.
senses.example_zh: 他在事故中毫发无伤，但他的车彻底报废了。

senses.meaning: 开具，填写（支票、处方、单据等）
senses.example_en: The doctor wrote out a prescription for some painkillers.
senses.example_zh: 医生开了一张止痛药处方。

senses.example_en: Please write out your answers in full sentences rather than short bullet points.
senses.example_zh: 请用完整的句子把答案详细写出来，而不是只写简短的要点。

senses.meaning: 把…写成报道或详尽总结/报告
senses.example_en: I need a couple of quiet hours to write up the lab experiment results.
senses.example_zh: 我需要一两个小时安静的时间来整理并写完实验报告。

senses.meaning: 因违规或过失）书面记过，向上级呈报
senses.example_en: The manager threatened to write him up if he arrived late again.
senses.example_zh: 经理威胁说如果他再迟到就会对他进行书面违纪记录。

senses.meaning: 致信（电视台、电台、报刊等）
senses.example_en: Thousands of viewers wrote in to complain about the controversial broadcast.
senses.example_zh: 成千上万的观众写信投诉那期极具争议的广播节目。

senses.meaning: 在选票上附笔提名（未印在选票上的候选人）
senses.example_en: Disappointed by the party nominees, many voters decided to write in an independent candidate.
senses.example_zh: 对两党提名人感到失望的许多选民决定在选票上补写一位独立候选人的名字。

senses.example_en: I sent her a long email last week, but she hasn't written back yet.
senses.example_zh: 我上周给她发了一封长邮件，但她还没给我回信。

senses.meaning: 函购，写信索取（物品、资料等）
senses.example_en: As a kid, he would write away for free promotional stickers from magazines.
senses.example_zh: 小时候，他经常写信索取杂志上的免费宣传贴纸。

senses.meaning: 以居高临下/降尊迁就的通俗口吻迎合（读者或受众）
senses.example_en: Good children's authors never write down to their young readers.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的儿童文学作家从不会以居高临下、自降身段的口吻来迁就小读者。

senses.meaning: 向多家机构、个人等）群发信件征询信息
senses.example_en: The research team wrote around to several universities to gather data for the study.
senses.example_zh: 研究团队向数所大学发函征询，为课题收集数据。

senses.meaning: 平平常常，不值一提，没有什么特别出色的地方
senses.example_en: The food at the new restaurant was okay, but nothing to write home about.
senses.example_zh: 新餐馆的菜品尚可，但真没什么值得大书特书的。

senses.meaning: 情绪、内疚或秘密等）昭然若揭，全写在脸上
senses.example_en: Guilt was written all over his face when the manager walked in.
senses.example_zh: 当经理走进来时，他的内疚全写在脸上了。

senses.meaning: 开出自己的条件，自定待遇，随心所欲决定前途
senses.example_en: With her extraordinary credentials, she can pretty much write her own ticket in the tech sector.
senses.example_zh: 凭她过硬的资历，她在科技圈基本可以随意自开薪资待遇。

senses.meaning: 板上钉钉，不可变更，固定不可更改
senses.example_en: These schedule guidelines are flexible and not written in stone.
senses.example_zh: 这些时间表安排是具有弹性的，并非板上钉钉不可更改。

senses.meaning: 到此为止，全完了，事情彻底结束了
senses.example_en: The engine blew up on the final lap, and that was all she wrote.
senses.example_zh: 最后一圈时引擎爆炸了，这下彻底全完了。

senses.meaning: 开空头支票；给予无限授权/全权支配
senses.example_en: The government refused to write a blank check for the bailout.
senses.example_zh: 政府拒绝为这次救助计划提供无限制的资金授权。

senses.example_en: He pulled out his pen to write a check for the deposit.
senses.example_zh: 他掏出钢笔开了一张押金支票。

senses.example_en: Candidates are required to write the exam answers in blue or black ink.
senses.example_zh: 考生须用蓝色或黑色墨水书写考试答案。

senses.meaning: 撰写论文/报告/起草初稿
senses.example_en: She had to write a comprehensive report before the board meeting.
senses.example_zh: 她必须在董事会会议召开前撰写出一份详尽的报告。

senses.example_en: Please write legibly so that our staff can read your delivery address.
senses.example_zh: 请字迹工整清晰，以便工作人员辨认您的送货地址。

senses.meaning: 给某人写信/发书面函件
senses.example_en: I will write to the CEO directly regarding this unresolved dispute.
senses.example_zh: 我将就这起尚未解决的纠纷直接致信首席执行官。

senses.example_en: It is prudent to write a will while you are still in sound health.
senses.example_zh: 趁身体健康时立下一份遗嘱是明智之举。

senses.meaning: 通过编剧处理）把（角色）从剧情或剧本中剔除/写死
senses.example_en: After the actor decided to leave the show, the writers wrote his character out of the series.
senses.example_zh: 在这位演员决定离开该剧后，编剧们将他的角色从故事线中剔除了。

senses.meaning: 将某事草率归结为…；将…轻视为…
senses.example_en: She wrote the strange noises off as nothing more than the wind rattling the window.
senses.example_zh: 她把那些奇怪的声音草草归结为不过是风在吹打窗户而已。

senses.meaning: 将（条款、条件）明确写入（法律、合同或协议中）
senses.example_en: A confidentiality clause was explicitly written into their employment contract.
senses.example_zh: 一份保密条款被明确写入了他们的雇佣合同中。

senses.meaning: 齐心协力，组队协作，联手合作
senses.example_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
senses.example_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

senses.example_en: The local charity teamed up with a major supermarket to distribute free meals.
senses.example_zh: 这家地方慈善机构与一家大型超市联手分发免费餐食。

senses.meaning: 与…紧密配对/联合；（与服装搭配时）与…搭配
senses.example_en: She teamed a crisp white shirt with tailored trousers for the interview.
senses.example_zh: 她穿了一件挺括的白衬衫搭配修身西裤去参加面试。

senses.example_en: The experienced engineer was teamed with a junior developer on the new project.
senses.example_zh: 这位经验丰富的工程师与一名初级开发人员搭档负责这个新项目。

senses.meaning: 联手共同对抗/对付（对手、困难等）
senses.example_en: Several independent retailers teamed up against the aggressive expansion of the retail giant.
senses.example_zh: 几家独立零售商联手对抗这家零售巨头的激进扩张。

senses.meaning: 跨部门/跨界组建团队协作
senses.example_en: The organization encourages employees to team across departments to solve complex product issues.
senses.example_zh: 该机构鼓励员工跨部门组队协作，以解决复杂的产品问题。

senses.meaning: 为集体利益做出牺牲，顾全大局受委屈
senses.example_en: John agreed to work through the holiday, taking one for the team.
senses.example_zh: 约翰同意在假期全程值班，为了顾全团队大局做出了牺牲。

senses.meaning: 具有团队协作精神的人，善于与集体配合的人
senses.example_en: In modern corporate environments, being a team player is just as crucial as technical competence.
senses.example_zh: 在现代企业环境中，具备团队协作精神与专业技能同样至关重要。

senses.example_en: The firm assembled a dream team of top trial lawyers to handle the high-profile lawsuit.
senses.example_zh: 该事务所召集了一支由顶级诉讼律师组成的梦之队来应对这场引人注目的诉讼。

idioms.phrase: cheer for / play for the other team

senses.meaning: 站在对立阵营；特指同性恋倾向
senses.example_en: We realized early in the debate that he was covertly cheering for the other team.
senses.example_zh: 在辩论初期我们就意识到，他暗中站在了对方阵营一边。

senses.meaning: 车轮战搭档；轮流接替配合
senses.example_en: The detectives tag-teamed the suspect throughout the night during interrogation.
senses.example_zh: 整夜的审讯中，侦探们轮番上阵接替讯问嫌疑人。

senses.example_en: The company organized an outdoor retreat to facilitate team building and communication.
senses.example_zh: 公司组织了一次户外拓展，以促进团队建设与沟通。

senses.example_en: She proved that she has the leadership capabilities required to lead a team through a crisis.
senses.example_zh: 她证明了自己具备带领团队渡过危机所需的领导能力。

senses.example_en: Our marketing analysts team closely with the sales reps to identify consumer trends.
senses.example_zh: 我们的市场分析师与销售代表紧密协作，捕捉消费趋势。

senses.example_en: We are thrilled that a brilliant data scientist has decided to join our team.
senses.example_zh: 我们非常高兴有一位才华横溢的数据科学家决定加入我们的团队。

senses.meaning: 团队共同努力，集体协作
senses.example_en: Winning this prestigious contract was truly a combined team effort.
senses.example_zh: 赢得这份重要合同确实是全体成员共同努力的成果。

senses.example_en: The manager implemented flexible work hours to boost team morale.
senses.example_zh: 经理推行了弹性工作制以提振团队士气。

senses.example_en: If we all team together, we can finish painting the community center by evening.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们大家协同组队一起干，傍晚前就能粉刷完社区中心。

senses.example_en: Hurry up and put your coat on; it's freezing outside.
senses.example_zh: 快把外套穿上，外面冷极了。

senses.example_en: He put on a lot of weight over the winter holidays.
senses.example_zh: 他在寒假期间体重增加了不少。

senses.example_en: The local drama club is putting on a production of Hamlet.
senses.example_zh: 当地戏剧社正在排演《哈姆雷特》。

senses.meaning: 涂抹，施加（化妆品、护肤品等）
senses.example_en: She put on some sunscreen before heading out to the beach.
senses.example_zh: 她出门去海滩前涂了些防晒霜。

senses.example_en: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
senses.example_zh: 今日事今日毕，切莫拖延到明天。

senses.example_en: The bad smell of the restaurant completely put us off our food.
senses.example_zh: 那家餐馆难闻的气味让我们彻底没了食欲。

senses.example_en: Please don't talk while I'm driving; it really puts me off.
senses.example_zh: 我开车时请别跟我说话，这很容易让我分心。

senses.example_en: I can't put up with his constant complaining any longer.
senses.example_zh: 我再也无法容忍他没完没了的抱怨了。

senses.example_en: Firefighters worked through the night to put out the blaze.
senses.example_zh: 消防队员通宵奋战扑灭了大火。

senses.example_en: The police have put out a warning about counterfeit banknotes.
senses.example_zh: 警方已发布关于假钞的预警声明。

senses.example_en: I hope our staying here for the night won't put you out too much.
senses.example_zh: 希望我们在这里借宿一晚不会给你添太多麻烦。

senses.example_en: The factory puts out over five thousand units a day.
senses.example_zh: 这家工厂每天生产五千多件产品。

senses.example_en: They put up a notice on the bulletin board about the upcoming meeting.
senses.example_zh: 他们在公告栏上张贴了关于即将召开会议的通知。

senses.example_en: A new housing development is being put up near the station.
senses.example_zh: 车站附近正在兴建一个新的住宅区。

senses.example_en: Could you put me up for the night while I'm in town?
senses.example_zh: 我进城期间你能让我借宿一晚吗？

senses.example_en: Landlords have put up rents by ten percent this year.
senses.example_zh: 房东们今年把租金提高了百分之十。

senses.example_en: She put forward a compelling proposal at the board meeting.
senses.example_zh: 她在董事会上提出了一个令人信服的方案。

senses.example_en: Several colleagues put him forward as a candidate for the committee.
senses.example_zh: 几位同事推荐他作为委员会的候选人。

senses.example_en: Remember to put your clocks forward one hour for daylight saving time.
senses.example_zh: 记得在进入夏令时把时钟往前拨快一小时。

senses.example_en: Put that fragile vase down carefully on the table.
senses.example_zh: 小心点把那个易碎的花瓶放到桌上。

senses.example_en: Let me put down your phone number before I forget it.
senses.example_zh: 趁我还没忘，先让我把你的电话号码记下来。

senses.example_en: Government troops swiftly put down the armed rebellion.
senses.example_zh: 政府军迅速平息了这场武装叛乱。

senses.meaning: 使（受伤或患病的动物）安乐死
senses.example_en: The dog was in terrible pain, so the vet advised putting him down.
senses.example_zh: 那只狗痛苦不堪，兽医建议为它实施安乐死。

senses.example_en: The children were told to put away their toys before dinner.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们被告知晚饭前要把玩具收拾好。

senses.example_en: She puts away a small portion of her salary every month for retirement.
senses.example_zh: 她每月都会从薪水中存下一小笔钱用于养老。

senses.meaning: 把…关进监狱或送进精神病院
senses.example_en: The serial burglar was finally caught and put away for ten years.
senses.example_zh: 那个连环窃贼终于落网，被判入狱十年。

senses.example_en: Hold the line, please; I'll put you through to the sales department.
senses.example_zh: 请别挂断，我马上为您转接销售部。

senses.meaning: 使经历，使经受（考验、苦难）
senses.example_en: No parent should have to be put through such an ordeal.
senses.example_zh: 任何父母都不应该遭受如此痛苦的折磨。

senses.meaning: 使（法案、方案等）顺利通过
senses.example_en: The government managed to put the new healthcare legislation through.
senses.example_zh: 政府成功促使新的医疗改革法案获得通过。

senses.example_en: Please put the reference books back on the shelf after reading them.
senses.example_zh: 查阅完工具书后，请放回书架原处。

senses.example_en: The departure time has been put back by two hours due to fog.
senses.example_zh: 因大雾影响，起飞时间被推迟了两个小时。

senses.meaning: 把（钟表指针）往回拨，调慢
senses.example_en: In autumn, clocks are put back one hour across the country.
senses.example_zh: 秋季时，全国各地的时钟都要往回拨慢一小时。

senses.example_en: We try to put aside fifty dollars each week for our holiday fund.
senses.example_zh: 我们尽量每周省下五十美元存作度假基金。

senses.meaning: 把…置于一旁，暂时搁置不理
senses.example_en: They agreed to put aside their political differences and work together.
senses.example_zh: 他们同意暂时搁置政治分歧，携手合作。

senses.example_en: She put in over sixty hours at the office this week to finish the report.
senses.example_zh: 她本周在办公室加了六十多个小时的班来完成这份报告。

senses.meaning: 正式提出（申请、索赔、要求）
senses.example_en: He decided to put in a claim for compensation after the accident.
senses.example_zh: 事故发生后，他决定正式提出赔偿申请。

senses.example_en: We are having central heating put in before winter comes.
senses.example_zh: 我们在入冬前正在安装集中供暖系统。

senses.meaning: 把…表达清楚，使被理解或接受
senses.example_en: He used simple analogies to put across complex scientific concepts.
senses.example_zh: 他运用简单的打比方，将复杂的科学概念表达得清晰易懂。

senses.example_en: He always puts his colleagues down in front of the boss to make himself look good.
senses.example_zh: 他总是在老板面前贬低同事，以抬高自己。

senses.example_en: She has a tidy sum put by for a rainy day.
senses.example_zh: 她存了一笔可观的备用金以备不时之需。

senses.meaning: 散布，散播（谣言、虚假消息）
senses.example_en: Someone has been putting about rumors that the company is going bankrupt.
senses.example_zh: 有人到处散播公司即将破产的谣言。

senses.meaning: 向某人提出（问题、建议以征询意见或求证）
senses.example_en: The journalist put the allegations directly to the minister during the interview.
senses.example_zh: 记者在专访期间直接向部长就这些指控进行了求证。

senses.meaning: 根据现有事实推断出真相
senses.example_en: He hadn't told anyone they were dating, but we easily put two and two together.
senses.example_zh: 他没跟任何人提过他们在约会，但我们很容易就猜出真相了。

senses.meaning: 坚决反对，采取强硬立场
senses.example_en: When the kids demanded expensive phones, their father finally put his foot down.
senses.example_zh: 当孩子们索要昂贵的手机时，父亲终于态度坚决地表示反对。

senses.meaning: 准确指出症结所在，明确说出原因
senses.example_en: There was something strange about his story, but I couldn't put my finger on it.
senses.example_zh: 他的说法有些古怪，但我一时说不上来究竟不对在哪里。

idioms.phrase: put all one's eggs in one basket

senses.meaning: 孤注一掷，把所有希望寄托于一处
senses.example_en: Diversify your investments instead of putting all your eggs in one basket.
senses.example_zh: 分散你的投资，不要把所有鸡蛋放在同一个篮子里。

idioms.phrase: put the cart before the horse

senses.example_en: Designing the marketing campaign before finishing the product is putting the cart before the horse.
senses.example_zh: 产品还没完成就先设计营销活动，完全是本末倒置。

senses.meaning: 让某人认清自己的地位，挫其傲气
senses.example_en: His blunt response quickly put the arrogant newcomer in his place.
senses.example_zh: 他直截了当的回答迅速挫伤了那个傲慢新人的锐气。

idioms.phrase: put one's cards on the table

senses.meaning: 开诚布公，坦白交代自己的意图或底牌
senses.example_en: Let's put our cards on the table and negotiate a fair deal.
senses.example_zh: 我们打开天窗说亮话，谈一笔公平的交易吧。

senses.example_en: The ceasefire agreement finally put an end to years of armed conflict.
senses.example_zh: 停火协议终于结束了长达数年的武装冲突。

senses.example_en: It is much harder to put these principles into practice than to preach them.
senses.example_zh: 贯彻这些原则远比嘴上宣讲要困难得多。

senses.example_en: Campaigners are putting pressure on the government to act immediately.
senses.example_zh: 活动人士正向政府施压，要求其立即采取行动。

senses.example_en: Reckless driving puts innocent lives at risk.
senses.example_zh: 鲁莽驾驶把无辜的生命置于危险境地。

senses.example_en: She decided to put her multilingual skills to good use in diplomacy.
senses.example_zh: 她决定在外事外交工作中充分发挥自己的多语言优势。

senses.example_en: The new syllabus puts heavy emphasis on critical thinking skills.
senses.example_zh: 新教学大纲重点强调批判性思维能力。

senses.example_en: The emergency response system was put to the test during the storm.
senses.example_zh: 应急响应系统在暴风雨期间经受了实战检验。

senses.example_en: It took me nearly three hours to put the flat-pack wardrobe together.
senses.example_zh: 我花了近三个小时才把那个平板包装的衣柜组装好。

senses.meaning: 筹集，组织，制定（团队、方案、材料）
senses.example_en: The manager put together a team of top engineers for the project.
senses.example_zh: 经理为该项目组建了一支由顶尖工程师构成的团队。

senses.example_en: The teacher read out the names of the winning students to the class.
senses.example_zh: 老师向全班大声宣读了获奖学生的名单。

senses.meaning: 从头到尾仔细阅读，通读
senses.example_en: Make sure you read through the contract thoroughly before signing it.
senses.example_zh: 签字之前，务必把合同从头到尾仔细通读一遍。

senses.example_en: I'll read over your essay tonight and mark any grammatical mistakes.
senses.example_zh: 我今晚会把你的文章细看一遍，并把语法错误标出来。

senses.meaning: 经验、模式）横向对照，跨领域借鉴推广
senses.example_en: We need to ensure that the findings from this study can read across to other sectors.
senses.example_zh: 我们需要确保这项研究的成果能够推广借鉴到其他行业。

senses.meaning: 专项研读，查阅资料深入了解
senses.example_en: I need to read up on local labor laws before the negotiation begins.
senses.example_zh: 谈判开始前，我需要深入研读一下当地的劳动法规。

senses.meaning: 照着念，迅速朗读（清单、仪表数据等）
senses.example_en: The technician read off the pressure figures directly from the control monitor.
senses.example_zh: 技术员直接从控制显示屏上逐一念出压力数据。

senses.meaning: 复诵，将记录的信息读回以核对确认
senses.example_en: The operator asked me to read back the security code to make sure it was correct.
senses.example_zh: 接线员让我复诵一遍安全验证码，以确认无误。

senses.example_en: The script failed because the system could not read in the input file.
senses.example_zh: 脚本运行失败，因为系统无法读取输入文件。

senses.meaning: 向（某人）通报机密内情或背景信息
senses.example_en: The new intelligence officer was quickly read in on the covert operation.
senses.example_zh: 那位新任情报官很快听取了关于该秘密行动的背景通报。

senses.meaning: 体会言外之意，读出字里行间的深意
senses.example_en: Reading between the lines of her email, it was clear she was unhappy.
senses.example_zh: 从她邮件的字里行间可以看出，她显然很不高兴。

senses.meaning: 把某人的心思看得一清二楚，了如指掌
senses.example_en: You can't fool your mother; she can read you like a book.
senses.example_zh: 你骗不过你母亲的，她对你的心思了如指掌。

senses.example_en: He completely failed to read the room and cracked an insensitive joke during the solemn meeting.
senses.example_zh: 他完全不懂察言观色，在庄严肃穆的会议上讲了个不合时宜的笑话。

senses.meaning: 严厉警告，申斥，大加训斥
senses.example_en: The coach read the players the riot act after their lackluster performance.
senses.example_zh: 在球员们表现疲软之后，教练把他们狠狠训斥了一顿。

senses.meaning: 把…视为理所当然，想当然地认为无需讨论
senses.example_en: We can take it as read that everyone agrees with the core objective.
senses.example_zh: 我们可以想当然地认为大家都赞同这项核心目标。

senses.meaning: 引人入胜的读物，一本好书
senses.example_en: His latest historical thriller is an exceptionally compelling read.
senses.example_zh: 他最新的历史惊悚小说是一本极其扣人心弦的佳作。

senses.example_en: The teacher asked the student to read the poem aloud to the class.
senses.example_zh: 老师让该学生把这首诗大声朗读给全班同学听。

senses.example_en: As a child, she read voraciously about astronomy and space travel.
senses.example_zh: 孩提时代，她便如饥似渴地阅读有关天文学和太空旅行的书籍。

senses.example_en: Scholars are expected to read widely beyond their immediate field of study.
senses.example_zh: 学者们理应博览群书，涉猎超出自身直接研究领域的知识。

senses.example_en: I was just about to suggest coffee—you must have read my mind!
senses.example_zh: 我正想提议去喝咖啡呢——你准是猜透了我的心思！

collocations.phrase: read the fine print / small print

senses.meaning: 仔细阅读附加条款/细则
senses.example_en: Always read the fine print before agreeing to the loan conditions.
senses.example_zh: 在同意贷款条件之前，务必仔细阅读细则条款。

senses.meaning: 从头到尾完整读完（整本书）
senses.example_en: The biography was so gripping that I read it from cover to cover in one sitting.
senses.example_zh: 这本传记太引人入胜了，我一口气从头到尾读完了整本书。

senses.meaning: 过度解读，主观臆断深层含义
senses.example_en: Don't read too much into his silence; he's probably just tired.
senses.example_zh: 别对他的沉默过度解读，他可能只是累了。

senses.meaning: 继续，坚持（尤指不顾阻碍或反复进行）
senses.example_en: Despite the pouring rain, they kept on walking toward the campsite.
senses.example_zh: 尽管下着倾盆大雨，他们还是继续向营地走去。

senses.meaning: 反复唠叨，没完没了地说
senses.example_en: I wish you wouldn't keep on about my mistakes in front of everyone.
senses.example_zh: 我希望你不要当着大家的面老是对我的错误唠叨个没完。

senses.example_en: The company decided to keep on all temporary staff after the busy season.
senses.example_zh: 旺季过后，公司决定留用所有的临时员工。

senses.meaning: 保持，维持（高水平、良好状态或速度）
senses.example_en: You've been doing fantastic work—keep it up!
senses.example_zh: 你一直干得很出色——继续保持！

senses.meaning: 使……无法入睡，使保持清醒
senses.example_en: The loud music from next door kept me up all night.
senses.example_zh: 隔壁吵闹的音乐让我整夜没合眼。

senses.example_en: If the rain keeps up, we will have to cancel the outdoor concert.
senses.example_zh: 如果雨一直下个不停，我们就不得不取消室外音乐会了。

senses.meaning: 跟上（步伐、速度），不落后于
senses.example_en: He walked so fast that the children couldn't keep up with him.
senses.example_zh: 他走得太快，孩子们跟不上他的脚步。

senses.meaning: 跟上，了解（最新消息、潮流或技术发展）
senses.example_en: It's essential for software engineers to keep up with industry trends.
senses.example_zh: 对软件工程师而言，跟进行业最新动态至关重要。

senses.example_en: She still keeps up with several of her high school classmates.
senses.example_zh: 她仍和几位高中同学保持着联系。

senses.meaning: 遵守，遵循（规则、计划、协议或时间表）
senses.example_en: We need to keep to the schedule if we want to finish by Friday.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们想在周五前完成，就必须严格遵守时间表。

senses.meaning: 局限于，不偏离（主题、路线）
senses.example_en: Please keep to the main point and avoid irrelevant details.
senses.example_zh: 请切中要害，不要扯无关紧要的细节。

senses.example_en: You should keep away from the edge of the cliff.
senses.example_zh: 你应该离悬崖边缘远一点。

senses.example_en: Garlic is said to keep mosquitoes away during summer nights.
senses.example_zh: 据说夏天夜里大蒜能驱赶蚊子。

senses.example_en: He suspected that the witness was keeping something back.
senses.example_zh: 他怀疑证人隐瞒了某些事情。

senses.meaning: 阻挡，阻止上前（或退后不前）
senses.example_en: Police used barricades to keep back the surging crowd.
senses.example_zh: 警方设置路障以阻挡涌动的人群上前。

senses.example_en: She could hardly keep back her tears upon hearing the tragic news.
senses.example_zh: 听到这个噩耗时，她几乎无法忍住眼泪。

senses.example_en: Please keep your voice down; the baby is finally asleep.
senses.example_zh: 请放低声音，宝宝终于睡着了。

senses.meaning: 控制，抑制（成本、价格、通胀等）
senses.example_en: The management implemented new strategies to keep costs down.
senses.example_zh: 管理层实施了新策略以控制成本。

senses.meaning: 吃下或喝下而不吐出来（咽下食物）
senses.example_en: He was so sick that he couldn't even keep any water down.
senses.example_zh: 他病得很厉害，甚至连水都喝不下去，喝了就吐。

senses.example_en: The sign on the lawn clearly says, 'Keep off the grass.'
senses.example_zh: 草坪上的标牌明确写着：“请勿践踏草坪”。

senses.meaning: 避开（敏感或不快的话题）
senses.example_en: Let's keep off politics tonight to avoid unnecessary arguments.
senses.example_zh: 今晚我们避开政治话题吧，免得产生不必要的争执。

senses.meaning: 禁食，戒除（特定食物、烟酒等）
senses.example_en: The doctor advised him to keep off fatty foods until his tests improve.
senses.example_zh: 医生建议他在指标好转前不要吃油腻食物。

senses.example_en: Heavy curtains help keep out the chilly winter wind.
senses.example_zh: 厚窗帘有助于阻挡冬日的刺骨寒风。

senses.meaning: 留在外面，不进入（常见于警示牌）
senses.example_en: Danger! Construction site—keep out!
senses.example_zh: 危险！施工现场，严禁入内！

senses.meaning: 抑制，忍住（情感、怒火、笑声等）
senses.example_en: He was furious, but he tried hard to keep in his temper.
senses.example_zh: 他怒火中烧，但极力压抑着自己的脾气。

senses.example_en: Because of the blizzard, the school kept the children in all afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 由于暴风雪，学校整个下午都把孩子们留在室内。

senses.example_en: The teacher kept Mark in for half an hour for not submitting his homework.
senses.example_zh: 马克因为没交作业被老师罚留校半小时。

senses.example_en: Learning a new language is tough, but you'll succeed if you keep at it.
senses.example_zh: 学一门新语言很艰难，但只要坚持下去你就会成功的。

senses.meaning: 保留在身边，留在近处随时备用
senses.example_en: I always keep a flashlight around in case the power goes out.
senses.example_zh: 我总在手边备着一个手电筒，以防停电。

senses.meaning: 保持领先地位，保持竞争优势
senses.example_en: Continuous innovation is the only way for the company to keep ahead of rivals.
senses.example_zh: 持续创新是该公司在竞争对手面前保持领先地位的唯一途径。

senses.example_en: Could you please keep an eye on my luggage while I go to the restroom?
senses.example_zh: 我去洗手间时，你能帮我照看一下行李吗？

senses.meaning: 祈求好运，希望一切顺利
senses.example_en: I'm keeping my fingers crossed that the interview goes well tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 我祈祷明天的面试一切顺利。

senses.meaning: 绷着脸不笑，强忍住笑意
senses.example_en: It was impossible to keep a straight face after his hilarious blunder.
senses.example_zh: 在他闹出那个搞笑的大乌龙后，谁也憋不住笑了。

senses.meaning: 随时向某人通报最新进展/情况
senses.example_en: I'm waiting for the lab results, and I'll keep you posted as soon as they arrive.
senses.example_zh: 我正在等化验结果，一出来我就会随时向你通报。

senses.meaning: 使某人保持高度警惕，让人不敢松懈
senses.example_en: The unpredictable pop quizzes are designed to keep the students on their toes.
senses.example_zh: 难以预测的突击测验旨在让学生们时刻保持警觉不敢懈怠。

senses.meaning: 保持乐观，不气馁，振作精神
senses.example_en: Keep your chin up; things are bound to get better soon.
senses.example_zh: 振作起来，情况很快就会好转的。

senses.meaning: 密切监视，记录核查...的行踪或动向
senses.example_en: The manager uses modern software to keep tabs on project milestones.
senses.example_zh: 经理使用现代软件来密切跟进项目的各个里程碑。

senses.meaning: 铭记于心，牢记，考虑在内
senses.example_en: Keep in mind that prices are subject to change without prior notice.
senses.example_zh: 请牢记，价格如有更改，恕不另行通知。

senses.meaning: 记录，掌握...的线索/最新信息
senses.example_en: I use a budgeting app to keep track of my daily expenses.
senses.example_zh: 我使用记账软件来记录并掌握我每天的花销。

collocations.phrase: keep a promise / keep one's word

senses.example_en: He earned everyone's trust because he always keeps his word.
senses.example_zh: 他赢得了所有人的信任，因为他总是言出必行。

senses.example_en: Even after graduating, the roommates promised to keep in touch regularly.
senses.example_zh: 即使在毕业后，室友们也承诺会经常保持联系。

senses.meaning: 保持冷静，控制脾气不发火
senses.example_en: It was difficult to keep his temper when provoked so rudely.
senses.example_zh: 遭到如此粗鲁的挑衅，要抑制住怒火确实很难。

senses.example_en: Thank you for staying behind to keep me company while I finished the report.
senses.example_zh: 谢谢你留下来陪我完成这份报告。

senses.meaning: 置身事外，不卷入（纠纷、麻烦等）
senses.example_en: I suggest you keep out of their family disputes.
senses.example_zh: 我建议你别卷进他们的家庭纠纷中去。

senses.example_en: He is quite introverted and tends to keep to himself at social gatherings.
senses.example_zh: 他性格内向，在社交聚会上往往独来独往。

senses.meaning: 守口如瓶，对（消息或秘密）不声张
senses.example_en: I'll tell you about the promotion, but please keep it to yourself for now.
senses.example_zh: 我可以告诉你升职的事，但请你暂时保守秘密。

senses.meaning: 阻止，抑制（做某事；克制自己）
senses.example_en: She could not keep from laughing at his silly mistake.
senses.example_zh: 看到他犯了那么愚蠢的错误，她忍不住笑出声来。

senses.meaning: 隐瞒（消息、事实等不让某人知道）
senses.example_en: We decided to keep the bad news from her until after the exam.
senses.example_zh: 我们决定在考试结束前瞒着她这个坏消息。

senses.meaning: 最终到达，最后来到（某地）
senses.example_en: We took a wrong turn on the highway and ended up in an unfamiliar town.
senses.example_zh: 我们在高速上拐错了弯，最后来到了一座陌生的小镇。

senses.meaning: 最终处于，最终落得……结局（后接形容词、介词短语或动名词）
senses.example_en: If you keep spending recklessly, you will end up in debt.
senses.example_zh: 如果你继续挥霍无度，最终会负债累累。

senses.meaning: 以……告终，导致……结局（接 failure, disaster, a draw 等结果词）
senses.example_en: The negotiations ended in deadlock after hours of bitter argument.
senses.example_zh: 经过数小时的激烈争吵，谈判最终以僵局告终。

senses.meaning: 以……结束，以……收尾（指最后的组成部分、乐章或环节）
senses.example_en: The symphony ended with a thunderous crescendo of drums.
senses.example_zh: 交响乐在雷鸣般的鼓声高潮中落下帷幕。

senses.meaning: 彻底结束，画上句号；收尾
senses.example_en: Let's end off the meeting with a quick summary of next week's goals.
senses.example_zh: 让我们对下周的目标做个简要总结，以此结束今天的会议。

senses.meaning: 最终得到，最终落得拥有/面临（常指意外或不愿看到的结果）
senses.example_en: After hours of haggling, she ended up with a deal far worse than expected.
senses.example_zh: 讨价还价几个小时后，她最终达成的交易远比预期的要差。

senses.meaning: 量入为出，使收支平衡，维持生计
senses.example_en: Many families are working multiple jobs just to make ends meet in this economy.
senses.example_zh: 在当前的经济形势下，许多家庭身兼数职仅仅是为了勉强维持生计。

idioms.phrase: at the end of the day

senses.meaning: 归根结底，说到底，到头来
senses.example_en: At the end of the day, client satisfaction is the only metric that truly matters.
senses.example_zh: 说到底，客户满意度才是唯一真正重要的衡量指标。

senses.meaning: 智穷才尽，束手无策，走投无路
senses.example_en: I'm at my wit's end trying to figure out why this computer program keeps crashing.
senses.example_zh: 我实在想不通为什么这个电脑程序老是崩溃，已经束手无策了。

idioms.phrase: burn the candle at both ends

senses.meaning: 起早贪黑，过度透支精力，过度操劳
senses.example_en: You will ruin your health if you keep burning the candle at both ends.
senses.example_zh: 如果你继续这样起早贪黑过度透支，身体迟早会垮掉的。

idioms.phrase: light at the end of the tunnel

senses.meaning: 隧道尽头的亮光；（困境中）苦尽甘来的希望，曙光
senses.example_en: After months of painful medical treatments, she can finally see the light at the end of the tunnel.
senses.example_zh: 经过数月痛苦的治疗后，她终于看到了康复的曙光。

senses.example_en: With the rain pouring relentlessly, there was no end in sight to the delays.
senses.example_zh: 大雨倾盆而下，航班延误看起来遥遥无期。

senses.meaning: 尽到自己的职责，不甘示弱，独当一面
senses.example_en: In a team effort, every member is expected to hold their end up.
senses.example_zh: 在团队合作中，每位成员都应当恪尽职守、各司其职。

senses.example_en: The long era of rapid economic growth has finally come to an end.
senses.example_zh: 经济高速增长的漫长时代终于画上了句号。

senses.example_en: The government introduced strict laws to put an end to illegal poaching.
senses.example_zh: 政府出台了严厉的法律，以彻底杜绝非法偷猎行为。

senses.example_en: The signing of the peace treaty brought the decades-long war to an end.
senses.example_zh: 和平条约的签署使这场长达数十年的战争走向了终结。

senses.meaning: 结束一段感情关系/婚姻
senses.example_en: They mutually decided to end their marriage on amicable terms.
senses.example_zh: 他们和平商定，以友好的方式结束彼此的婚姻。

senses.meaning: 以灾难/失败收场，惨淡告终
senses.example_en: The ill-conceived military expedition ended in total disaster.
senses.example_zh: 这次谋划不周的军事远征最终以彻底的灾难惨淡收场。

senses.example_en: As the fiscal year drew near the end, departments rushed to balance their books.
senses.example_zh: 随着财政年度临近尾声，各部门纷纷抓紧结清账目。

senses.meaning: 最终以做某事收尾，最后做了某事
senses.example_en: He started out defending his decision, but ended by apologizing to everyone.
senses.example_zh: 他一开始还在为自己的决定辩解，但最后却向所有人道了歉。

senses.meaning: 最终成为，最终沦为（某种身份、角色或状态）
senses.example_en: The ambitious start-up ended up as just another failed project.
senses.example_zh: 那家雄心勃勃的初创公司最终沦为了又一个失败的项目。

senses.meaning: 终极目标，最关键/最核心的事物（常用于 the be-all and end-all）
senses.example_en: Making money is important, but it shouldn't be the end-all of your life.
senses.example_zh: 赚钱固然重要，但不应成为你人生的终极追求。

senses.meaning: 切换，转向（系统、方式或技术）
senses.example_en: The hospital is planning to change over to a fully digital records system next month.
senses.example_zh: 该医院计划下个月全面切换至数字化病历系统。

senses.example_en: The nurses usually change over at seven in the morning.
senses.example_zh: 护士们通常在早上七点进行交接班。

senses.meaning: 调换位置，重新摆放（家具或物品）
senses.example_en: We decided to change the living room furniture around to create more space.
senses.example_zh: 我们决定把客厅的家具重新摆放一下，以腾出更多空间。

senses.meaning: 改变顺序，重新调整安排
senses.example_en: The director changed around the running order of the show at the last minute.
senses.example_zh: 导演在最后一刻调整了节目的演出顺序。

senses.example_en: At midnight, the carriage changed back into a pumpkin.
senses.example_zh: 午夜时分，马车又变回了南瓜。

senses.meaning: 换回（原本的衣服、货币等）
senses.example_en: You can change your leftover foreign currency back into local money at the airport.
senses.example_zh: 你可以在机场把没用完的外币兑换回本国货币。

senses.meaning: 驾驶车辆时）换低速挡，减挡
senses.example_en: You should change down to second gear when going up a steep hill.
senses.example_zh: 上陡坡时，你应该减到二挡。

senses.meaning: 驾驶车辆时）换高速挡，加挡
senses.example_en: Once you reach sixty miles per hour, you can change up into fifth gear.
senses.example_zh: 时速达到六十英里后，你就可以换到五挡了。

senses.meaning: 做出改变，调整策略（以寻求突破）
senses.example_en: The team needs to change up its tactics if it wants to win the championship.
senses.example_zh: 该队如果想夺冠，就必须改变战术打法。

senses.meaning: 轮流，交替替换（分担某项工作）
senses.example_en: During the long drive across the desert, the two drivers changed off every two hours.
senses.example_zh: 在穿越沙漠的长途驾驶中，两位司机每隔两小时轮流开一次。

senses.example_en: She was planning to study law, but she changed her mind at the last moment.
senses.example_zh: 她本打算学法律，但在最后一刻改变了主意。

senses.example_en: The landlord had a change of heart and decided to extend our lease.
senses.example_zh: 房东回心转意，决定延长我们的租约。

senses.meaning: 因情势变化）彻底改变口风或态度
senses.example_en: He opposed the project until he saw the budget, and then he quickly changed his tune.
senses.example_zh: 他原本反对这个项目，但一看到预算就立刻改了口风。

senses.example_en: The historic manor has changed hands several times over the past century.
senses.example_zh: 过去一个世纪里，这座历史悠久的庄园已经多次易主。

senses.meaning: 换换节奏；调节一下生活/工作状态
senses.example_en: Working from home once a week provides a welcome change of pace.
senses.example_zh: 每周在家办公一天是调节工作节奏的不错方式。

senses.meaning: 换汤不换药；以不同方式变换花样
senses.example_en: You can ring the changes on this simple recipe by adding different herbs.
senses.example_zh: 你可以在这道简单食谱中加入不同的香草，变出新花样。

senses.meaning: 别老调重弹；换个话题（常用于表示厌烦）
senses.example_en: Stop complaining about the weather and change the record!
senses.example_zh: 别老抱怨天气了，换个话题吧！

senses.example_en: His health took a sudden change for the worse over the weekend.
senses.example_zh: 周末他的健康状况突然恶化。

senses.example_en: Whenever I ask about his finances, he immediately changes the subject.
senses.example_zh: 每当我问起他的财务状况，他就立刻岔开话题。

senses.meaning: 与某人调换位置；与某人易地而处
senses.example_en: Nobody in their right mind would want to change places with the prime minister right now.
senses.example_zh: 眼下头脑清醒的人谁都不想与首相换位处之。

senses.meaning: 做出改变；（以 It makes a change 开头）真难得/换个样真好
senses.example_en: It makes a pleasant change to see the sun after weeks of rain.
senses.example_zh: 连绵阴雨数周后终于见到太阳，真是让人心情舒畅。

senses.example_en: When direct criticism failed, the manager decided to change tack and offer encouragement.
senses.example_zh: 当直接批评无济于事时，经理决定改变策略，转而给予鼓励。

senses.meaning: 转变方向；转变人生/事业轨迹
senses.example_en: After twenty years in banking, she changed direction and opened a bakery.
senses.example_zh: 在银行业工作二十年后，她转变了职业方向，开了一家面包店。

senses.example_en: As soon as he got home, he changed out of his wet suit.
senses.example_zh: 他一到家就换掉了身上湿透的西装。

senses.example_en: I need to quickly change into something more comfortable before the guests arrive.
senses.example_zh: 客人来之前，我得赶紧换上一身舒服点的衣服。

senses.example_en: With a wave of the wand, the pumpkin changed into a golden carriage.
senses.example_zh: 魔杖一挥，南瓜就变成了一辆金色的马车。

senses.example_en: Prolonged stress can lead to a variety of serious health issues.
senses.example_zh: 长期的压力会导致各种严重的健康问题。

senses.example_en: This narrow stone path leads directly to the mountain summit.
senses.example_zh: 这条狭窄的石阶小路直通山顶。

senses.meaning: 时间上）作为…的先导，在…之前发生
senses.example_en: Security was significantly heightened in the weeks leading up to the election.
senses.example_zh: 在选举前的几周里，安保级别显著提升。

senses.meaning: 逐渐引出（某个话题或请求）
senses.example_en: He made small talk for ten minutes, leading up to asking for a loan.
senses.example_zh: 他闲聊了十分钟，借此巧妙地引出想借钱的话题。

senses.meaning: 误导，哄骗（使人抱有虚假希望）
senses.example_en: She had no intention of marrying him; she was just leading him on.
senses.example_zh: 她根本无意嫁给他，只是在吊着他玩弄感情。

senses.meaning: 领路前行，带头走在前面
senses.example_en: You know the trail best, so you lead on and we will follow.
senses.example_zh: 你对这条路线最熟，你带头往前走，我们在后面跟着。

senses.example_en: The keynote speaker led off with an amusing anecdote about his early career.
senses.example_zh: 主讲人以一段关于他早年职业生涯的趣闻轶事作为开场。

senses.meaning: 棒球等）率先击球，打头阵
senses.example_en: He led off the bottom of the ninth inning with a solo home run.
senses.example_zh: 他在第九局下半场首棒登场，轰出了一记单人本垒打。

senses.meaning: 押走，带走（拘留或远离现场）
senses.example_en: The handcuffed suspect was led away by two armed police officers.
senses.example_zh: 戴着手铐的嫌疑人被两名持枪警官押解离开。

senses.example_en: The mother bird feigned an injury to lead predators away from her nest.
senses.example_zh: 母鸟假装受伤，以把捕食者从鸟巢旁引开。

senses.meaning: 带头离场，领出（人员、队伍等）
senses.example_en: The captain led out the team onto the pitch amidst roaring cheers.
senses.example_zh: 队长在雷鸣般的欢呼声中带领球队步入球场。

senses.meaning: 自行车等竞速中）为冲刺队员领骑
senses.example_en: His teammate worked tirelessly to lead him out for the final bunch sprint.
senses.example_zh: 他的队友不知疲倦地为他领骑，以便助他在最后的大团冲刺中夺冠。

senses.example_en: All the evidence uncovered by the investigation leads back to the same offshore account.
senses.example_zh: 调查发现的所有线索最终都指向了同一个离岸账户。

senses.example_en: If we follow this winding creek downstream, it will lead us back to the campsite.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们顺着这条蜿蜒的小溪顺流而下，它会把我们带回营地。

senses.meaning: 牵着某人的鼻子走；彻底操纵某人
senses.example_en: He is so gullible that his business partner leads him by the nose in every deal.
senses.example_zh: 他太轻信他人了，以至于生意合伙人在每笔交易中都牵着他的鼻子走。

senses.meaning: 引路；走在前面；树立榜样/处于领跑地位
senses.example_en: The company has led the way in developing renewable energy solutions.
senses.example_zh: 该公司在开发可再生能源解决方案方面始终处于领跑地位。

idioms.phrase: lead sb up the garden path

senses.example_en: Consumers were led up the garden path by false claims in the advertisement.
senses.example_zh: 消费者被广告中的虚假宣传彻底误导了。

senses.example_en: It turned out that the mild-mannered accountant was leading a double life as a master thief.
senses.example_zh: 事实证明，这位举止温和的会计师竟然过着大盗的暗地双重生活。

senses.meaning: 身先士卒；以身作则树立榜样
senses.example_en: A good manager should lead from the front during challenging crises.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的管理者在面临危机挑战时应当身先士卒。

senses.meaning: 处于领头羊地位；在竞争中拔得头筹
senses.example_en: With its innovative camera technology, the smartphone brand continues to lead the pack.
senses.example_zh: 凭借创新的摄像技术，该智能手机品牌继续在行业中领跑。

senses.meaning: 过着牛马不如的生活；日子困苦悲惨
senses.example_en: Under the tyranny of the cruel boss, the factory workers led a dog's life.
senses.example_zh: 在那位残酷老板的暴政下，工厂工人们过着牛马不如的生活。

senses.example_en: Great leaders inspire others by leading by example rather than just giving orders.
senses.example_zh: 伟大的领导者通过以身作则而非仅仅发号施令来激励他人。

senses.example_en: Even in her eighties, my grandmother continues to lead an active life.
senses.example_zh: 即使到了八十多岁，我祖母依然过着活力充沛的生活。

senses.example_en: A senior detective was appointed to lead the murder investigation.
senses.example_zh: 一名资深侦探被指派主持这起谋杀案的调查工作。

senses.example_en: Our team took the lead in the second quarter and held it until the final whistle.
senses.example_zh: 我们队在第二节取得领先，并将优势一直保持到终场哨声吹响。

senses.meaning: 把某人引上歧途；误导某人
senses.example_en: The teenager was led astray by older kids who were involved in petty theft.
senses.example_zh: 这名青少年被涉嫌小偷小摸的大龄孩子引上了歧途。

senses.example_en: She managed to hold the lead throughout the entire marathon.
senses.example_zh: 她在整场马拉松比赛中都成功保持了领先地位。

senses.meaning: 过渡到，平滑引入（下一部分或话题）
senses.example_en: The acoustic guitar solo nicely leads into the energetic chorus.
senses.example_zh: 这段原声吉他独奏非常自然地过渡到了充满力量的高潮副歌。

senses.meaning: 通入，连接到（另一个空间）
senses.example_en: The main hallway leads into a spacious open-plan kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 主走廊直接通向一个宽敞的开放式厨房。

senses.example_en: We've run out of coffee, so I'll grab some on my way home.
senses.example_zh: 我们的咖啡喝完了，我下班回家路上顺便买点。

senses.meaning: 合同、协议、签证等）到期，失效
senses.example_en: My passport runs out next month, so I need to renew it.
senses.example_zh: 我的护照下个月就要到期了，我得去换发一本新护照。

senses.meaning: 偶然碰见（某人）或发现（某物）
senses.example_en: I ran across some old family letters while cleaning out the attic.
senses.example_zh: 我在清理阁楼时偶然发现了一些旧的家信。

senses.example_en: The teenager ran away from home after a heated argument with his parents.
senses.example_zh: 那个少年和父母激烈争吵后离家出走了。

senses.meaning: 逃避，回避（问题、责任或现实）
senses.example_en: You can't keep running away from your responsibilities forever.
senses.example_zh: 你不能永远这样逃避自己的责任。

senses.example_en: She ran after the bus, waving frantically to catch the driver's attention.
senses.example_zh: 她拼命追赶公共汽车，疯狂挥手想引起司机的注意。

senses.example_en: He spent the entire semester running after Sarah, but she wasn't interested.
senses.example_zh: 他整个学期都在追求萨拉，但她毫无兴趣。

senses.example_en: He braked hard, terrified that he had run over a stray dog.
senses.example_zh: 他紧急刹车，生怕自己撞到了一只流浪狗。

senses.example_en: The morning meeting ran over by twenty minutes, delaying the presentation.
senses.example_zh: 早会超时了二十分钟，耽误了后面的展示汇报。

senses.example_en: Turn off the tap before the bathwater runs over onto the floor.
senses.example_zh: 在浴缸的水溢到地板上之前快把水龙头关掉。

senses.example_en: Let's run over the key points once more before the client arrives.
senses.example_zh: 在客户到达之前，我们再快速过一遍核心要点吧。

senses.meaning: 排练，快速过一遍（流程、台词等）
senses.example_en: The cast ran through the opening scene one last time before the curtain went up.
senses.example_zh: 开演前，演员们最后把开场戏排练了一遍。

senses.example_en: A subtle sense of nostalgia runs through all of his novels.
senses.example_zh: 淡淡的怀旧情愫贯穿于他的所有小说之中。

senses.example_en: He ran through his entire inheritance in less than two years.
senses.example_zh: 他在不到两年的时间里就挥霍光了所有遗产。

senses.meaning: 电池、钟表等）电量耗尽，停止运转
senses.example_en: My phone's battery has run down completely; do you have a charger?
senses.example_zh: 我手机电量彻底耗尽了，你有充电器吗？

senses.example_en: Stop running yourself down—you did a fantastic job on the project.
senses.example_zh: 别再妄自菲薄贬低自己了——你在这个项目上做得非常出色。

senses.example_en: The cyclist was run down by a speeding taxi at the intersection.
senses.example_zh: 这名骑车人在十字路口被一辆超速的出租车撞倒了。

senses.meaning: 逐步减少，缩减（业务规模或库存）
senses.example_en: The company decided to run down its coal operations over the next decade.
senses.example_zh: 该公司决定在未来十年内逐步削减其煤炭业务。

senses.meaning: 积欠，累积（大额账单、债务）
senses.example_en: She ran up huge credit card debts while shopping in Paris.
senses.example_zh: 她在巴黎购物时欠下了巨额信用卡债务。

senses.example_en: The crew ran up the national flag as the ship entered the port.
senses.example_zh: 当轮船驶入港口时，船员们迅速升起了国旗。

senses.meaning: 匆忙缝制，快速赶制（衣物等）
senses.example_en: My grandmother ran up a lovely dress for the party in just one afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 我奶奶仅用一个下午就赶制出了一件漂亮的聚会礼服。

senses.meaning: 遭遇，面临（困难、阻力、强硬对手）
senses.example_en: The proposed tax reforms ran up against fierce opposition in parliament.
senses.example_zh: 拟议中的税制改革在议会遭遇了强烈的反对。

senses.example_en: This new hybrid vehicle can run on either petrol or electricity.
senses.example_zh: 这款新型混合动力汽车既能用汽油也能用电驱动运转。

senses.example_en: The debate ran on well past midnight with no sign of a consensus.
senses.example_zh: 辩论一直持续到深夜，丝毫没有达成共识的迹象。

senses.meaning: 滔滔不绝，喋喋不休地说
senses.example_en: Once Uncle Joe starts talking about politics, he just runs on and on.
senses.example_zh: 乔叔叔一旦聊起政治，就会喋喋不休地说个没完。

senses.example_en: The shoplifter ran off as soon as the security guard turned his back.
senses.example_zh: 保安一转身，那个小偷就拔腿逃跑了。

senses.example_en: Could you please run off fifty copies of this agenda for the conference?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我把这份会议议程印制五十份吗？

senses.meaning: 与……私奔，抛下原有生活出走 (run off with)
senses.example_en: Rumor has it that he ran off with his former secretary.
senses.example_zh: 有传言说他和之前的前秘书私奔了。

senses.example_en: Heavy rain quickly ran off the steep roof into the gutters.
senses.example_zh: 大雨迅速从陡峭的屋顶顺势流进了排水沟。

senses.example_en: Avoid driving at high speeds while you are running in the new car engine.
senses.example_zh: 在磨合新车引擎期间，请尽量避免高速行驶。

senses.example_en: The police ran him in for disorderly conduct outside the bar.
senses.example_zh: 警方因他在酒吧外扰乱公共秩序而将他拘捕带回局里。

senses.example_en: I'll run in on Mrs. Gable on my way to the pharmacy to see if she needs anything.
senses.example_zh: 我去药房顺路拐过去看看盖博太太，问问她是否需要什么。

senses.meaning: 遗弃，抛弃（家庭、伴侣或需要帮助的人）
senses.example_en: He ran out on his wife and two young children without leaving a penny.
senses.example_zh: 他抛弃了妻子和两个年幼的孩子，甚至一分钱都没留下。

senses.meaning: 走开，离开（常用于温和、客气地吩咐儿童离开）
senses.example_en: Run along now, kids; the adults need to discuss some serious matters.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们快自己去玩吧，大人们要商量些正经事了。

senses.meaning: 把……向某人讲一遍以征求意见 (run sth by sb)
senses.example_en: I have a few new marketing ideas I'd love to run by you before the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 我有些新的营销想法，想在开会前先跟您念叨念叨征求一下意见。

senses.example_en: I've been running around all day trying to sort out my visa paperwork.
senses.example_zh: 我今天一整天都在四处奔波，忙着办理我的签证材料。

senses.example_en: The children were running around in the backyard until sunset.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们在后院到处嬉戏打闹，一直玩到日落。

senses.example_en: Could you run that tape back? I couldn't hear what he said at the end.
senses.example_zh: 你能把那段录音倒回去重放一下吗？我最后那句没听清。

senses.example_en: Don't bother calling a cab; I'll run you back to your hotel.
senses.example_zh: 别叫出租车了，我顺道开车送你回酒店。

senses.meaning: 精疲力竭，失去势头或动力
senses.example_en: After five consecutive hours of intense negotiations, both parties seemed to run out of steam.
senses.example_zh: 在连续进行了五个小时的紧张谈判后，双方似乎都筋疲力尽、没了后劲。

senses.meaning: 特征、才华或疾病）世代相传，家族遗传
senses.example_en: Musical talent runs in their family; every single child plays at least one instrument well.
senses.example_zh: 音乐天赋是他们家族世代相传的；每个孩子都至少精通一种乐器。

senses.example_en: The new headmistress runs a tight ship, ensuring every teacher adheres to the strict schedule.
senses.example_zh: 新任女校长治校极严，确保每位老师都严格遵守时间表。

senses.example_en: Investing in high-quality equipment may seem expensive now, but it will save money in the long run.
senses.example_zh: 现在投资高品质设备看似昂贵，但从长远来看能够节省资金。

senses.example_en: If you skip the testing phase, you run the risk of releasing a defective software update.
senses.example_zh: 如果你跳过测试环节，就会冒着发布有缺陷软件更新的风险。

senses.meaning: 普通的，平淡无奇的，乏善可陈的
senses.example_en: It wasn't an extraordinary movie, just a run-of-the-mill romantic comedy.
senses.example_zh: 那并不是一部特别出彩的电影，只是一部平淡无奇的浪漫喜剧。

senses.meaning: 远胜于某人，把某人耍得团团转
senses.example_en: In debates, she easily runs circles around her opponents thanks to her sharp legal mind.
senses.example_zh: 在辩论中，凭借敏锐的法律思维，她可以轻而易举地把对手驳得毫无还手之力。

senses.example_en: Running a small business requires not only capital but also relentless dedication.
senses.example_zh: 经营一家小企业不仅需要资金，还需要不懈的投入与专注。

senses.example_en: The lab technicians will run several diagnostic tests on the blood samples today.
senses.example_zh: 实验室技术人员今天将对这些血液样本进行几项诊断测试。

senses.example_en: The child woke up crying in the middle of the night and was running a high fever.
senses.example_zh: 孩子半夜哭着醒来，发着高烧。

senses.example_en: I'm terribly sorry for running late; my commuter train was delayed by signal failures.
senses.example_zh: 非常抱歉我迟到了，我坐的通勤火车因为信号故障延误了。

senses.example_en: I have to spend my Saturday afternoon running errands like grocery shopping and picking up dry cleaning.
senses.example_zh: 我周六下午得用来跑腿办杂务，比如买菜和取干洗的衣服。

senses.meaning: 情感、信念、传统等）根深蒂固，刻骨铭心
senses.example_en: Rivalry between the two neighboring cities runs deep and dates back several centuries.
senses.example_zh: 这两座相邻城市之间的对抗根深蒂固，可以追溯到几个世纪之前。

senses.example_en: I ran into an old college friend at the supermarket yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 我昨天在超市偶遇了一位大学老同学。

senses.example_en: The delivery truck lost control and ran into a lamppost.
senses.example_zh: 那辆送货卡车失控撞上了路灯杆。

senses.meaning: 遭遇，陷入（困难、麻烦或债务）
senses.example_en: The startup ran into severe financial difficulties within its first year.
senses.example_zh: 这家初创公司在第一年就遭遇了严重的财务困难。

senses.meaning: 争取过来，赢得……的好感与支持
senses.example_en: His witty presentation helped win over even the most skeptical investors.
senses.example_zh: 他机智风趣的演说赢得了哪怕是最持怀疑态度的投资者的支持。

senses.meaning: 赢回，夺回，重获（信任、市场份额、失地）
senses.example_en: The brand is launching a loyalty program to win back lost customers.
senses.example_zh: 该品牌正在推出会员忠诚计划，以赢回流失的客户。

senses.meaning: 最终战胜，占上风，克服困难后获胜
senses.example_en: Despite all the political interference, common sense eventually won out.
senses.example_zh: 尽管受到重重政治干扰，常识和理性最终还是占了上风。

senses.meaning: 渡过难关，历经艰险最终成功
senses.example_en: It was a grueling year of cancer treatment, but she won through in the end.
senses.example_zh: 那是一整年艰难的癌症治疗过程，但她最终挺了过来战胜了病魔。

senses.meaning: 说服，使转变观念，赢得赞同
senses.example_en: Her parents were initially against the move, but she managed to win them round.
senses.example_zh: 她父母起初反对这次搬迁，但她最终成功说服了他们。

senses.example_en: He bragged about the fifty dollars he had won off his brother at poker.
senses.example_zh: 他吹嘘自己在打扑克时从他哥哥那里赢了五十美元。

senses.meaning: 将（客户、拥护者等）从竞争对手处争取或抢夺过来
senses.example_en: The innovative platform succeeded in winning users away from established rivals.
senses.example_zh: 这个创新平台成功地从老牌竞争对手手中争夺到了大量用户。

senses.meaning: 战胜，压倒（对手、阻力或消极情绪）
senses.example_en: In the end, his passion for filmmaking won out over his fears of financial instability.
senses.example_zh: 最终，他对电影制作的热忱战胜了对经济不稳定的恐惧。

senses.meaning: 轻而易举地获胜，毫无悬念地赢得
senses.example_en: Given her remarkable experience, she won the mayoral election hands down.
senses.example_zh: 鉴于她卓越的资历与经验，她轻而易举地赢得了市长选举。

senses.meaning: 获得最终胜利，取得成功
senses.example_en: It was their team's superior endurance and disciplined defense that ultimately won the day.
senses.example_zh: 正是该团队出色的耐力和纪律严明的防守最终锁定了胜局。

senses.meaning: 赢得某人的芳心，博得某人的喜爱
senses.example_en: With his warm sense of humor and attentiveness, he quickly won her heart.
senses.example_zh: 凭借温暖的幽默感和体贴入微，他迅速赢得了她的芳心。

senses.meaning: 人生不可能事事如意，胜败乃家常便饭（安慰他人）
senses.example_en: Don't be too disheartened by losing this single contract; you can't win them all.
senses.example_zh: 不要因为失去这一份合同就太沮丧；胜败乃兵家常事，不可能事事顺心。

senses.meaning: 立功立业，崭露头角，确立自己的地位与声誉
senses.example_en: He won his spurs as a fearless foreign correspondent covering conflicts across the Middle East.
senses.example_zh: 他作为一名无畏的战地记者报道中东冲突，从而确立了自己的行业声誉。

senses.example_en: Win or lose, we should be proud of having given everything we had on the pitch.
senses.example_zh: 不论输赢，我们都应该为自己在球场上拼尽全力而感到自豪。

senses.example_en: Her debut novel won several prestigious literary awards within months of release.
senses.example_zh: 她的处女作小说在出版数月内便赢得了数个极具声望的文学奖项。

senses.example_en: The incumbent governor won the election by an unexpectedly wide margin.
senses.example_zh: 现任州长以出人意料的巨大优势赢得了大选。

senses.example_en: The infrastructure proposal must win parliamentary approval before funds can be released.
senses.example_zh: 这项基础设施方案必须在获得议会批准后才能拨付资金。

senses.example_en: The engineering consortium successfully won the multimillion-dollar railway construction contract.
senses.example_zh: 该工程财团成功赢得了这项价值数百万美元的铁路建设合同。

senses.example_en: Over three decades, the hospital has won an international reputation for cardiac surgery.
senses.example_zh: 三十多年来，该医院在心脏外科手术领域赢得了国际声誉。

senses.example_en: The newly appointed CEO worked tirelessly to win the confidence of skeptical shareholders.
senses.example_zh: 新任命的首席执行官不知疲倦地工作，以赢得多疑股东们的信任。

senses.meaning: 符合，达到（期望、标准、诺言）
senses.example_en: The concert didn't quite live up to our high expectations.
senses.example_zh: 这场音乐会并没能完全达到我们很高的期望。

senses.meaning: 靠（特定金钱或食物）生活
senses.example_en: They had to live on bread and water during the harsh winter.
senses.example_zh: 在严冬里，他们不得不靠面包和水勉强维生。

senses.meaning: 名声、记忆、精神等）继续存在，流传
senses.example_en: Her legacy will live on through the charity she founded.
senses.example_zh: 她的精神将通过她创办的慈善机构永远流传下去。

senses.meaning: 忍受，接受（不可改变的不快局面）
senses.example_en: The damage is done, and now we just have to live with the consequences.
senses.example_zh: 损失已经造成，现在我们只能承受后果。

senses.example_en: She moved to London to live with her boyfriend.
senses.example_zh: 她搬到伦敦和男朋友住在一起。

senses.meaning: 度过，经历（艰难时期、灾难等考验）
senses.example_en: He lived through two world wars and several major crises.
senses.example_zh: 他经历了两次世界大战和几场重大危机。

senses.meaning: 让人忘掉，洗刷（过去的过失或耻辱）
senses.example_en: If you make such a silly mistake on stage, you'll never live it down.
senses.example_zh: 如果你在舞台上犯了这么愚蠢的错误，这辈子都别想让人忘记了。

senses.meaning: 依靠（积蓄、养老金或他人）过活，啃老
senses.example_en: He's nearly thirty and still living off his parents.
senses.example_zh: 他快三十岁了，还在靠父母养活。

senses.example_en: The stray dog lived off scraps from the local restaurant.
senses.example_zh: 那只流浪狗靠当地餐馆倒掉的剩菜剩饭为生。

senses.example_en: She was finally able to live out her dream of traveling the world.
senses.example_zh: 她终于实现了环游世界的梦想。

senses.example_en: The retired couple moved to the coast to live out their days in peace.
senses.example_zh: 这对退休夫妇搬到了海边，安享晚年。

senses.meaning: 佣人、学生等）住在工作或学习场所以外
senses.example_en: Most domestic staff at the estate live out.
senses.example_zh: 庄园里的大多数家政人员都不住在这里。

senses.meaning: 遵循，信奉（某种原则或信条）
senses.example_en: Honesty is the golden rule he chose to live by.
senses.example_zh: 诚实是他选择恪守的处世金科玉律。

senses.example_en: The villagers lived by fishing and trading goods.
senses.example_zh: 村民们靠捕鱼和以物易物维生。

senses.meaning: 为……而活；视……为生命中最重要的事情
senses.example_en: He lives for football and spends every weekend on the pitch.
senses.example_zh: 他简直为足球而生，每个周末都在球场上度过。

senses.meaning: 住在工作场所（如保姆、管家、住院医生等）
senses.example_en: They are looking for a reliable live-in nanny for their twins.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在为双胞胎物色一位可靠的住家保姆。

senses.meaning: 重新经历；重温（过去的体验或记忆）
senses.example_en: In his mind, he lived over the moments of their first meeting.
senses.example_zh: 在他脑海里，他一遍遍重温着初次相遇的场景。

senses.example_en: After winning the lottery, they went to Las Vegas to live it up.
senses.example_zh: 中彩票之后，他们去拉斯维加斯尽情享乐了一番。

senses.meaning: 待人宽容，各行其是（包容他人的不同生活方式）
senses.example_en: I don't agree with their lifestyle, but I believe in live and let live.
senses.example_zh: 我并不认同他们的生活方式，但我主张宽以待人、互不干涉。

senses.meaning: 过着勉强度日、朝不保夕的生活
senses.example_en: Without a steady income, the family was forced to live hand to mouth.
senses.example_zh: 没有稳定的收入，这一家人不得不勉强糊口度日。

senses.meaning: 活一天算一天；时日无多；大难不死而苟活
senses.example_en: Since surviving the plane crash, he felt he was living on borrowed time.
senses.example_zh: 自从空难幸存以来，他觉得自己多活的每一天都是赚来的。

senses.meaning: 过着自欺欺人、掩盖真相的虚伪生活
senses.example_en: She could no longer bear to live a lie and finally told her family the truth.
senses.example_zh: 她再也无法忍受这种自欺欺人的生活，终于向家人坦白了真相。

senses.meaning: 形影不离；过于密切以致缺乏个人空间
senses.example_en: Sharing a tiny studio made them feel like they were living in each other's pockets.
senses.example_zh: 挤在一间狭小的单身公寓里，让他们觉得彼此毫无隐私和个人空间。

senses.example_en: Financial advisors urge young workers to live within their means.
senses.example_zh: 理财顾问敦促年轻工薪族要量入为出。

senses.example_en: Relying on multiple credit cards led him to live beyond his means.
senses.example_zh: 依靠多张信用卡透支导致他陷入了入不敷出的生活。

senses.example_en: Civilians in the conflict zone have to live in fear every day.
senses.example_zh: 冲突地区的平民每天都不得不生活在恐惧之中。

senses.example_en: The secret agent lived a double life as a quiet bookstore owner.
senses.example_zh: 这名特工过着双重生活，表面上是一家书店的沉静店主。

senses.meaning: 死里逃生，幸存下来讲述经历
senses.example_en: The storm was devastating, but luckily all the crew lived to tell the tale.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雨极具毁灭性，但幸运的是所有船员都大难不死。

senses.meaning: 和平与和睦地共处生活
senses.example_en: The treaty allowed both communities to live in peace and harmony.
senses.example_zh: 该条约使两个族群得以和平与睦邻共处。

senses.example_en: They decided to live together before getting married.
senses.example_zh: 他们决定在结婚前先住在一起。

senses.meaning: 把……建立在……基础之上；以……为根据
senses.example_en: Their democratic system is founded on the core premise that all citizens possess equal rights.
senses.example_zh: 他们的民主制度建立在所有公民享有平等权利这一核心前提之上。

senses.meaning: 有充分事实依据的；有正当理由的
senses.example_en: Subsequent safety inspections confirmed that the public's anxiety was entirely well-founded.
senses.example_zh: 随后的安全检查证实，公众的担忧完全是有充分依据的。

senses.meaning: 缺乏根据的；捕风捉影的
senses.example_en: The rumors regarding the bank's insolvency were dismissed as completely ill-founded.
senses.example_zh: 关于该银行破产的谣言被斥为纯属毫无根据的捕风捉影。

senses.example_en: I left my briefcase on the commuter train and retrieved it from the lost and found.
senses.example_zh: 我把公文包落在了通勤列车上，后来在失物招领处取了回来。

senses.example_en: The two engineers pooled their savings to found a company focused on solar technology.
senses.example_zh: 这两位工程师凑齐积蓄创办了一家专注于太阳能技术的公司。

senses.meaning: 设立机构；创办学术或科研机构
senses.example_en: A generous bequest from an alumnus was used to found an institution dedicated to public health.
senses.example_zh: 一位校友的慷慨遗产被用于创办一所致力于公共卫生研究的机构。

senses.example_en: Their commercial partnership is firmly founded on mutual trust and transparent communication.
senses.example_zh: 他们的商业伙伴关系牢固地建立在相互信任和透明沟通的基础之上。

senses.example_en: She served as a founding member of the regional conservation initiative and drafted its charter.
senses.example_zh: 她是该区域自然保护倡议的创始成员之一，并亲自起草了倡议章程。

senses.meaning: 基于；以……为根基（较为正式）
senses.example_en: Contract law is founded upon the principle of free and informed consent between parties.
senses.example_zh: 合同法是以双方自由且知情的自愿同意原则为根基的。

senses.meaning: 毫无好感；互相厌恶；视同水火
senses.example_en: There was no love lost between the two political rivals during the debate.
senses.example_zh: 辩论期间，这两位政界对手之间毫无好感、针锋相对。

senses.meaning: 心甘情愿做的工作；情愿付出劳力的事情
senses.example_en: Restoring the vintage sports car took three years, but it was a true labor of love.
senses.example_zh: 修复这辆老式跑车花了三年时间，但这完全是出于热爱的自愿付出。

senses.meaning: 神魂颠倒；彻底坠入爱河
senses.example_en: Mark was head over heels in love with Sarah from the first date.
senses.example_zh: 从第一次约会起，马克就彻底为萨拉神魂颠倒了。

senses.meaning: 严厉的爱；用严厉手段迫使其自立的爱
senses.example_en: Sometimes parents need to practice tough love to help their children overcome addiction.
senses.example_zh: 有时父母需要采取严厉的爱，以帮助孩子克服成瘾问题。

senses.meaning: 看在上帝的份上；求求你（用于表达愤怒、绝望或恳求）
senses.example_en: For the love of God, please turn down that loud music!
senses.example_zh: 看在老天爷的份上，求你把那吵闹的音乐关小一点吧！

senses.meaning: 情人眼里出西施；爱情让人盲目
senses.example_en: She ignored all his obvious flaws because love is truly blind.
senses.example_zh: 她忽视了他所有明显的缺点，因为爱情确实是盲目的。

senses.example_en: Please send my love to your parents when you call them tonight.
senses.example_zh: 今晚给你父母打电话时，请代我向他们问好。

senses.example_en: They fell madly in love while backpacking across Europe.
senses.example_zh: 他们在欧洲背包旅行时疯狂地相爱了。

senses.example_en: He gathered his courage and finally declared his love to her.
senses.example_zh: 他鼓起勇气，终于向她表白了爱意。

senses.meaning: 单相思；单恋；未得回报的爱
senses.example_en: The novel portrays the painful bitterness of unrequited love.
senses.example_zh: 这部小说刻画了单相思带来的痛苦与心酸。

senses.example_en: Children thrive when parents regularly show love and affection.
senses.example_zh: 当父母经常表达爱意和温情时，孩子们会茁壮成长。

senses.example_en: After years of failed relationships, she finally found true love.
senses.example_zh: 在经历了多年的感情波折后，她终于寻得了真爱。

senses.meaning: 表达关爱；疼爱；宠爱（常用于美式非正式英语）
senses.example_en: Grandma spent the whole afternoon loving on her new grandbaby.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶整个下午都在宠溺地疼爱着刚出生的小孙子。

senses.example_en: The puppy ran straight into my lap, waiting to be loved up.
senses.example_zh: 小狗直接跳进我怀里，等着被抱抱和抚摸。

senses.example_en: They fell in love while studying abroad together in Florence.
senses.example_zh: 他们在佛罗伦萨一起留学时坠入了爱河。

senses.example_en: The moment she arrived in the coastal town, she fell in love with its quiet charm.
senses.example_zh: 一到达那个海滨小镇，她就深深迷上了它宁静的魅力。

senses.example_en: They have been in love for over a decade and are still inseparable.
senses.example_zh: 他们相爱了十多年，如今依然形影不离。

senses.example_en: They stayed up all night, talking softly and making love until dawn.
senses.example_zh: 他们整夜未眠，轻声细语，相拥缠绵直至黎明。

senses.meaning: 逐渐喜欢上；慢慢适应并爱上
senses.example_en: I hated classical music at first, but I eventually learned to love it.
senses.example_zh: 我起初讨厌古典音乐，但后来渐渐喜欢上了它。

senses.meaning: 因某特质或某事而深爱某人
senses.example_en: I love him for his honesty and dry sense of humor.
senses.example_zh: 我爱他是因为他的真诚和冷幽默。

senses.example_en: She loves her rescue cat to death and buys him all kinds of toys.
senses.example_zh: 她疼极了那只救助来的猫，给它买了各种各样的玩具。

senses.example_en: The outdoor concert was called off due to a severe thunderstorm.
senses.example_zh: 由于严重雷暴，户外音乐会被取消了。

senses.meaning: 命令（人或动物）停止攻击或追踪；叫走
senses.example_en: The guard called off the attack dog once the intruder surrendered.
senses.example_zh: 入侵者投降后，警卫叫住了攻击犬。

senses.example_en: This promotion definitely calls for a celebration tonight.
senses.example_zh: 这次升职今晚绝对值得好好庆祝一番。

senses.example_en: Activists are calling for an immediate investigation into the incident.
senses.example_zh: 活动人士正公开呼吁立即对该事件展开调查。

senses.example_en: I'll call for you at seven so we can head to the theatre together.
senses.example_zh: 我七点钟去接你，这样我们可以一起去剧院。

senses.example_en: I'm in a meeting right now; can I call you back in half an hour?
senses.example_zh: 我正在开会，半小时后给你回电话好吗？

senses.meaning: 召回（有缺陷的产品）；叫回（人员）
senses.example_en: The automaker called back thousands of sedans over a faulty brake system.
senses.example_zh: 该汽车制造商因刹车系统故障召回了数千辆轿车。

senses.meaning: 通知（应聘者或演员）参加复试/二轮面试
senses.example_en: Out of sixty auditionees, only three were called back for a second reading.
senses.example_zh: 在六十位试镜者中，只有三个人获得了复试机会。

senses.meaning: 请来，召集（专业人员来协助或修理）
senses.example_en: The company had to call in a crisis management expert to handle the leak.
senses.example_zh: 公司不得不请来一位危机公关专家来处理这次泄密事件。

senses.example_en: David woke up with a high fever and called in sick this morning.
senses.example_zh: 戴维今天早上发高烧，所以打电话请了病假。

senses.example_en: I'll call in on my way home from work to see how you're feeling.
senses.example_zh: 我下班回家的路上会顺道来看看你感觉怎么样。

senses.meaning: 收回（流通纸币）；要求偿还（贷款）
senses.example_en: The bank reserved the right to call in the loan should repayments lapse.
senses.example_zh: 银行保留在还款违约时提前收回贷款的权利。

senses.meaning: 大声呼喊；喊出（某人名字）
senses.example_en: The teacher called out the names from the attendance register.
senses.example_zh: 老师照着考勤表大声点名。

senses.meaning: 公开指责；批评指出（不当行为）
senses.example_en: She was widely praised for calling out the sexist remarks made by her colleague.
senses.example_zh: 她因公开指责同事的不当性别歧视言论而受到广泛赞誉。

senses.meaning: 调动，派出（军队、救援队应对紧急状况）
senses.example_en: The National Guard was called out to assist flood-stricken communities.
senses.example_zh: 国民警卫队被调派前往援助受洪水侵袭的社区。

senses.example_en: The union leaders threatened to call out all transport workers if talks failed.
senses.example_zh: 工会领导人威胁称，如果谈判破裂，将号召所有交通工人举行罢工。

senses.example_en: The Prime Minister called on citizens to remain calm during the crisis.
senses.example_zh: 首相呼吁民众在危机期间保持冷静。

senses.meaning: 课堂上等）点名让某人回答问题
senses.example_en: The professor called on Emma to explain the second theorem.
senses.example_zh: 教授点名让艾玛来解释第二个定理。

senses.example_en: We plan to call on our former neighbours when we visit town next weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们打算下周末去城里时拜访一下我们以前的邻居。

senses.example_en: Call me up as soon as you touch down at the airport.
senses.example_zh: 你一在机场落地就给我打电话。

senses.meaning: 征召入伍；征调（入国家队）
senses.example_en: The young winger was called up to the national football squad for the first time.
senses.example_zh: 这位年轻的边锋首次入选国家足球队。

senses.example_en: The scent of lavender called up vivid memories of her childhood in Provence.
senses.example_zh: 薰衣草的香气勾起了她在普罗旺斯度过的童年记忆。

senses.meaning: 在屏幕上）调出（数据、档案
senses.example_en: The doctor called up the patient's medical records on her monitor.
senses.example_zh: 医生在电脑屏幕上调出了病人的病历档案。

senses.meaning: 四处打电话打听（询价或收集信息）
senses.example_en: I had to call around several repair shops before finding a decent quote.
senses.example_zh: 我四处给好几家修理厂打了电话，才问到一个合理的价格。

senses.meaning: 顺道走访；去某人家拜访（常作 call round，英式）
senses.example_en: Why don't you call round for coffee this Sunday afternoon?
senses.example_zh: 这周日下午你顺道来我家喝杯咖啡怎么样？

senses.meaning: 因公或急事叫走；使离开
senses.example_en: The surgeon was called away from dinner to deal with an emergency in the OR.
senses.example_zh: 这位外科医生在晚饭时被紧急叫走，前往手术室处理急症。

senses.example_en: The government's new tax policy called forth fierce public opposition.
senses.example_zh: 政府的新税收政策引发了公众的强烈反对。

senses.meaning: 展现出，使激发出（勇气、力量等）
senses.example_en: Sailing through the gale called forth all his navigational skill.
senses.example_zh: 在狂风大作的海面上航行激发出了他所有的航海技巧。

senses.meaning: 顺便拜访；路过时顺道探望
senses.example_en: I'll call by after work to drop off those books you wanted.
senses.example_zh: 我下班后会顺道过去一趟，把你想要的那些书带给你。

senses.meaning: 船只、列车）停靠于（港口、车站
senses.example_en: The overnight express calls at York and Newcastle before terminating in Edinburgh.
senses.example_zh: 这趟夜间特快列车在终到爱丁堡之前会停靠约克和纽卡斯尔。

senses.meaning: 以……命名（英式，美式通常用 name after）
senses.example_en: She was called Charlotte after her paternal grandmother.
senses.example_zh: 她以祖母的名字被命名为夏洛特。

senses.example_en: The supervisor called him down in front of the entire team for missing the deadline.
senses.example_zh: 主管当着整个团队的面因他耽误截止期限而严厉斥责了他。

senses.meaning: 祈求降下（诅咒、神怒或灾难）
senses.example_en: In the play, the prophet calls down curses upon the corrupt rulers.
senses.example_zh: 在戏剧中，先知祈求上天降下诅咒惩罚腐败的统治者。

senses.example_en: The customer called over the waiter to ask for the bill.
senses.example_zh: 顾客把服务员叫过来结账。

senses.example_en: The captain called over the roll before the regiment embarked.
senses.example_zh: 团部队登船前，上尉逐一点名宣读花名册。

senses.example_en: We called in on Sarah on our way back from the countryside.
senses.example_zh: 我们从乡下回来的路上顺道探望了萨拉。

senses.meaning: 今天就到此为止；收工；停止工作
