senses.example_en: We've made substantial progress on the project, so let's call it a day.
senses.example_zh: 我们的项目取得了实质性进展，今天就收工吧。

senses.example_en: In this department, it is the director who calls the shots.
senses.example_zh: 在这个部门里，发号施令做主的人是主任。

senses.example_en: She always calls a spade a spade, even when the truth is uncomfortable.
senses.example_zh: 即便真相令人不快，她也总是直言不讳、直截了当。

senses.meaning: 决定放弃；就此作罢；协议分手
senses.example_en: After years of constant arguing, they mutually agreed to call it quits.
senses.example_zh: 经过多年的不断争吵，他们一致同意就此分手。

senses.meaning: 侥幸脱险；千钧一发；险情
senses.example_en: That speeding truck almost hit our car—it was a very close call.
senses.example_zh: 那辆超速的卡车差点撞上我们的车——真是千钧一发。

senses.example_en: The biggest investor naturally gets to call the tune in the boardroom.
senses.example_zh: 最大的投资者自然能在董事会里掌握主导权。

senses.example_en: Surgeons are frequently on call throughout weekends in case of emergencies.
senses.example_zh: 遇到紧急情况时，外科医生在周末通常需要随叫随到待命。

senses.example_en: The recent scientific discoveries call into question earlier theories about planetary formation.
senses.example_zh: 最近的科学发现使先前关于行星形成的理论受到了质疑。

senses.meaning: 唤起对……的注意；提醒关注
senses.example_en: The report calls attention to the growing problem of youth unemployment.
senses.example_zh: 该报告提醒人们关注日益严重的青年失业问题。

senses.meaning: 宣布举行大选；召集会议
senses.example_en: The prime minister decided to call an early election to consolidate power.
senses.example_zh: 首相决定提前举行大选以巩固权力。

senses.example_en: The municipal government called a halt to construction until environmental safety was ensured.
senses.example_zh: 市政府叫停了施工，直到环境安全得到保障为止。

senses.example_en: Solving this complex engineering problem will call into play all your technical skills.
senses.example_zh: 解决这个复杂的工程问题将需要调动你所有的专业技能。

senses.example_en: The railway union voted overwhelmingly to call a nationwide strike.
senses.example_zh: 铁路工会以压倒性多数投票决定举行全国性罢工。

senses.example_en: We were expecting thirty people, but only twenty showed up.
senses.example_zh: 我们原本预计有三十人，但只来了二十人。

senses.example_en: The scratch on the car door didn't show up in the photo.
senses.example_zh: 车门上的划痕在照片里看不出来。

senses.meaning: 使某人难堪，让某人出丑
senses.example_en: Stop arguing with me in public; you're just showing us both up.
senses.example_zh: 别在大庭广众之下跟我争了，你这样只会让我们俩都下不来台。

senses.meaning: 比某人表现更优而使其相形见绌
senses.example_en: The young intern's impressive presentation really showed up the senior staff.
senses.example_zh: 那名年轻实习生精彩的陈述让资深员工们相形见绌。

senses.example_en: He's always showing off how much money he makes.
senses.example_zh: 他总是到处炫耀自己赚了多少钱。

senses.example_en: The simple black dress showed off her diamond necklace perfectly.
senses.example_zh: 那件朴素的黑裙子完美地衬托出了她的钻石项链。

senses.meaning: 带某人参观，领某人四处走走
senses.example_en: Welcome to the company! Let me show you around the office.
senses.example_zh: 欢迎加入公司！我带你在办公室各处转转吧。

senses.example_en: The receptionist showed the client in as soon as the manager was ready.
senses.example_zh: 经理一准备好，前台就把客户领了进去。

senses.example_en: Thank you for coming; my assistant will show you out.
senses.example_zh: 感谢您的光临，我的助理会送您出去。

senses.example_en: The white paint was so thin that the dark surface below showed through.
senses.example_zh: 白漆太薄了，以至于底层的暗色都透了出来。

senses.example_en: Despite his calm exterior, his anxiety clearly showed through in his trembling voice.
senses.example_zh: 尽管他表面平静，但他颤抖的声音暴露了他内心的焦虑。

senses.meaning: 引导某人到（特定位置或房间）
senses.example_en: The waiter smiled politely and showed us to our table by the window.
senses.example_zh: 服务员礼貌地微笑，引我们入座靠窗的餐位。

senses.meaning: 带领某人参观（建筑物、房产等）并详细讲解
senses.example_en: The real estate agent showed prospective buyers over the historic house.
senses.example_zh: 房产经纪人带领意向买家参观了这栋历史悠久的老宅。

senses.meaning: 展现，显扬（力量、品质或荣耀）
senses.example_en: The poet sought to show forth the beauty and fragility of human life.
senses.example_zh: 诗人试图展现人类生命的美丽与脆弱。

senses.example_en: At the final round of betting, both poker players had to show down.
senses.example_zh: 在最后一轮下注时，两位扑克玩家都必须亮牌决胜负。

senses.meaning: 在某人面前故意卖弄/显摆
senses.example_en: The boy performed dangerous skateboard tricks just to show off to his classmates.
senses.example_zh: 那个男孩做出危险的滑板特技，纯粹是为了在同学面前显摆。

senses.meaning: 抢尽风头，成为全场瞩目的焦点
senses.example_en: The child actor completely stole the show with his heartfelt monologue.
senses.example_zh: 那位小演员凭借发自肺腑的独白彻底抢尽了风头。

senses.meaning: 露出真面目，显露本来嘴脸
senses.example_en: Under intense financial pressure, he finally showed his true colors.
senses.example_zh: 在巨大的经济压力下，他终于露出了真面目。

senses.meaning: 向某人传授诀窍，指导新手熟悉门道
senses.example_en: A senior engineer was assigned to show the new recruit the ropes.
senses.example_zh: 一位资深工程师被指派指导这名新员工熟悉业务门道。

senses.meaning: 逐客，将某人扫地出门；解雇某人
senses.example_en: When he refused to follow safety protocols, the manager showed him the door.
senses.example_zh: 当他拒绝遵守安全规程时，经理直接将他扫地出门。

senses.example_en: The motion was passed easily by an overwhelming show of hands.
senses.example_zh: 通过压倒性的举手表决，该提案顺利通过。

senses.example_en: Although his father founded the company, Mark now runs the show.
senses.example_zh: 虽然是他父亲创办了这家公司，但如今由马克全面掌管大局。

senses.example_en: The global economy is beginning to show tentative signs of recovery.
senses.example_zh: 全球经济开始呈现出试探性的复苏迹象。

senses.example_en: You should show respect for traditional customs when visiting abroad.
senses.example_zh: 到国外旅游时，你应该尊重当地的传统习俗。

senses.example_en: Several prominent venture capitalists have shown interest in our startup.
senses.example_zh: 已有数家知名风投机构对我们的初创企业表现出兴趣。

senses.example_en: She sent a personalized card to show gratitude to all her supporters.
senses.example_zh: 她寄出了一张手写贺卡，向所有支持者表达感激之情。

senses.meaning: 毫无悔意；毫不仁慈/心狠手辣
senses.example_en: The judge noted that the defendant showed no remorse for his actions.
senses.example_zh: 法官指出，被告对自己的行为毫无悔意。

senses.example_en: The patient's condition has shown steady improvement over the weekend.
senses.example_zh: 整个周末患者的病情都有了持续稳定的好转。

senses.example_en: He was too ashamed of his mistake to show himself at the gathering.
senses.example_zh: 他因犯错而感到羞愧，不敢在聚会上露面。

senses.meaning: 在记录或屏幕上显示为…，呈现为…
senses.example_en: The mystery fee showed up as an unauthorized charge on my monthly bill.
senses.example_zh: 那笔莫名其妙的费用在我的月度账单上显示为一笔未经授权的扣款。

senses.meaning: 把某人领进（特定房间或办公室）
senses.example_en: She was showed into the conference room to wait for the interview to begin.
senses.example_zh: 她被领进了会议室，等待面试开始。

senses.meaning: 感觉有精力/能力应付（某事）
senses.example_en: I'm still recovering from the flu and don't feel up to a long workout.
senses.example_zh: 我流感刚见好，还觉得自己没体力进行高强度锻炼。

senses.example_en: I really feel for anyone who had their home damaged by the storm.
senses.example_zh: 我十分同情那些房屋在暴风雨中受损的人。

senses.example_en: She felt for her keys at the bottom of her handbag.
senses.example_zh: 她在手提包底部摸索着找钥匙。

senses.meaning: 试探，摸底（某人的想法、意向）
senses.example_en: We should feel out the board members before submitting the proposal.
senses.example_zh: 在提交提案之前，我们应该先探探董事会成员的口风。

senses.meaning: 摸索，四处摸探（以寻找某物）
senses.example_en: When the lights went out, he felt around for a flashlight in the drawer.
senses.example_zh: 灯熄灭后，他在抽屉里摸索着找手电筒。

senses.meaning: 非礼性地）抚摸某人身体，摸索
senses.example_en: She slapped the stranger who tried to feel her up on the crowded subway.
senses.example_zh: 在拥挤的地铁上，有人企图对她动手动脚，她直接给了那陌生人一巴掌。

senses.example_en: Whenever I feel down, taking a walk in the park helps clear my mind.
senses.example_zh: 每当我心情沮丧时，去公园散散步总能帮我理清思绪。

senses.example_en: It takes time to feel through your grief instead of just bottling it up.
senses.example_zh: 充分体会并消化内心的悲伤需要时间，而不是一味压抑它。

senses.meaning: 感到无拘无束，感觉像在自己家一样舒适自在
senses.example_en: The hosts were so warm and hospitable that we felt at home immediately.
senses.example_zh: 主人非常热情好客，让我们立刻感到宾至如归。

senses.meaning: 身体略感不适，有点小病小痛
senses.example_en: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I think I'll skip the gym.
senses.example_zh: 我今天感觉身体有点不舒服，所以打算不去健身房了。

senses.meaning: 因经济困难）手头拮据，感受到财政压力
senses.example_en: With surging inflation, working families everywhere are feeling the pinch.
senses.example_zh: 随着通货膨胀飙升，各地的工薪家庭都感受到了手头拮据的压力。

senses.meaning: 打心底直觉到，对…有强烈的预感
senses.example_en: I can feel it in my bones that something extraordinary is about to happen.
senses.example_zh: 我有一种强烈的直觉，非比寻常的大事即将发生。

idioms.phrase: feel on top of the world

senses.meaning: 感到极度幸福，春风得意，飘飘欲仙
senses.example_en: After receiving the scholarship, she felt on top of the world.
senses.example_zh: 拿到奖学金后，她感觉幸福得如同登上世界之巅。

senses.meaning: 怨恨，心怀芥蒂（常用在 no hard feelings 中表示“别往心里去”）
senses.example_en: We had a fierce debate, but there are no hard feelings between us.
senses.example_zh: 我们辩论得很激烈，但彼此之间绝没有心存芥蒂。

senses.meaning: 感到一种…感（如归属感、成就感等）
senses.example_en: Volunteering gave him a renewed sense of purpose and fulfillment.
senses.example_zh: 志愿服务让他重新获得了一种人生目标感与充实感。

senses.meaning: 觉得有义务/不得不去做某事
senses.example_en: I felt obliged to clarify the misunderstanding before rumors spread.
senses.example_zh: 我觉得有责任在谣言扩散前把误会解释清楚。

senses.meaning: 对…感触极深，非常关切/在乎
senses.example_en: She feels deeply about animal rights and devotes weekends to shelter work.
senses.example_zh: 她对动物权益深感关切，并将周末时间都奉献给了收容所工作。

senses.example_en: Small retail shops are feeling the direct impact of online commerce.
senses.example_zh: 小型零售店正切身承受着电子商务带来的直接冲击。

senses.meaning: 感到一阵剧烈的（内疚、嫉妒、悲伤等）痛楚
senses.example_en: He felt a sharp pang of guilt for forgetting his mother's birthday.
senses.example_zh: 因为忘记了母亲的生日，他心头掠过一阵强烈的内疚。

senses.example_en: His gentle voice and calm demeanor made the nervous patient feel at ease.
senses.example_zh: 他温和的语调和平静的举止让紧张的患者渐渐放松下来。

senses.example_en: I don't feel like cooking tonight, so why don't we order takeout?
senses.example_zh: 我今晚不想做饭，我们叫外卖怎么样？

senses.example_en: The air was heavy and humid; it felt like rain was coming.
senses.example_zh: 空气沉闷潮湿，感觉像是要下雨了。

senses.meaning: 随意，尽管去做某事（不必拘束）
senses.example_en: Feel free to grab a drink from the fridge whenever you want.
senses.example_zh: 想喝什么随时从冰箱里拿，别客气。

senses.example_en: How do you feel towards the management's new remote-work policy?
senses.example_zh: 你对管理层出台的远程办公新政策持什么态度？

senses.example_en: The teacher told him off for chatting during the exam.
senses.example_zh: 老师因为他在考试中聊天而严厉训斥了他。

senses.example_en: If you don't let me play, I'm going to tell on you to Mom.
senses.example_zh: 如果你不让我玩，我就去向妈妈告你的状。

senses.meaning: 对…产生明显不良影响，使显出疲态
senses.example_en: The prolonged stress and lack of sleep were beginning to tell on his health.
senses.example_zh: 长期的压力和睡眠不足已经开始对他的身体健康产生明显不良影响。

senses.example_en: The twins look so similar that even their teachers can hardly tell them apart.
senses.example_zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，连他们的老师都很难分清。

senses.example_en: To tell the truth, I was completely surprised by their sudden decision to merge.
senses.example_zh: 说实话，他们突然决定合并让我感到非常意外。

senses.meaning: 时间会证明一切，日后见分晓
senses.example_en: Only time will tell whether this massive investment will yield the expected profits.
senses.example_zh: 只有时间才能证明这笔巨额投资能否带来预期的利润。

senses.meaning: 表示完全感同身受或无奈赞同）可不是嘛，那还用你说
senses.example_en: "Finding an affordable apartment in this city is impossible." "Tell me about it!"
senses.example_zh: “在这个城市找一套租得起的公寓简直不可能。”“可不是嘛！”

idioms.phrase: you never can tell / there's no telling

senses.example_en: There's no telling how the market will react to the new regulations tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 谁也说不准明天市场会对新规作出何种反应。

senses.meaning: 搬弄是非，泄露内部秘密
senses.example_en: I don't mean to tell tales out of school, but the project manager is planning to resign.
senses.example_zh: 我不想搬弄是非泄露内幕，但项目经理确实打算辞职了。

idioms.phrase: tell sb a thing or two

senses.meaning: 狠狠教训某人一顿；给某人点颜色瞧瞧
senses.example_en: If he speaks to me so rudely again, I'm going to tell him a thing or two.
senses.example_zh: 如果他再对我这么无礼，我一定要好好教训他一顿。

senses.example_en: Can you tell the difference between authentic leather and synthetic materials?
senses.example_zh: 你能辨别真皮与合成皮革之间的区别吗？

senses.example_en: He promised never to tell a lie to his parents again.
senses.example_zh: 他保证再也不对父母撒谎了。

senses.example_en: Children usually learn how to tell the time when they enter primary school.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们通常在进入小学时学习看钟表认时间。

senses.example_en: The old woman by the temple claimed she could tell fortunes using tarot cards.
senses.example_zh: 庙旁的老妇人声称自己能用塔罗牌为人算命。

senses.example_en: Truth be told, we simply didn't have enough budget to execute the original campaign.
senses.example_zh: 坦白讲，我们根本没有足够的预算来执行最初的营销方案。

senses.meaning: 讲述故事；说明问题，反映情况
senses.example_en: The financial figures tell a very different story from what the executives claim.
senses.example_zh: 财务数据所反映的情况与高管们宣称的大相径庭。

senses.example_en: The novel tells of a young sailor's perilous journey across the ocean.
senses.example_zh: 这部小说讲述了一位年轻水手横渡大洋的险恶旅程。

senses.example_en: The dark circles under her eyes told of many sleepless nights.
senses.example_zh: 她眼眶下的黑眼圈表明她度过了许多不眠之夜。

senses.example_en: It is often hard to tell genuine leather from high-quality synthetic alternatives.
senses.example_zh: 通常很难区分真皮与高品质的合成革替代品。

senses.meaning: 对…不利，成为对…不利的证据或因素
senses.example_en: His lack of relevant industry experience ultimately told against him in the final interview.
senses.example_zh: 缺乏相关行业经验最终在终面中成了对他的不利因素。

senses.meaning: 推演，情境模拟（深入推演不同行动方案的可能后果或结局）
senses.example_en: The strategic planning committee met to game out worst-case scenarios before entering the new market.
senses.example_zh: 战略规划委员会在进军新市场前碰头，推演了各种最坏情况。

senses.meaning: 最关键的要素；实质所在
senses.example_en: In the fast-moving tech sector, relentless innovation is the name of the game.
senses.example_zh: 在快节奏的科技行业中，持续不断的创新才是根本所在。

senses.meaning: 处于领先地位；占得先机
senses.example_en: By adopting automated processes early, the firm stayed ahead of the game.
senses.example_zh: 通过及早采用自动化流程，该企业保持了领先地位。

senses.example_en: He tried to keep the surprise party a secret, but a slip of the tongue gave the game away.
senses.example_zh: 他本想对惊喜派对保密，但一时说漏了嘴让事情穿了帮。

senses.meaning: 阴谋败露；把戏被戳穿；大势已去
senses.example_en: When the auditors uncovered the second ledger, the fraudster knew the game was up.
senses.example_zh: 当审计人员查出第二套账本时，骗子明白自己的把戏彻底败露了。

senses.meaning: 人人皆可攻击/批评的对象；合法猎物
senses.example_en: Once an official steps into the public spotlight, their past decisions become fair game for the press.
senses.example_zh: 官员一旦进入公众视野，其过去的决策就成了媒体合理审视和批判的靶子。

senses.meaning: 钻空子；利用系统规则漏洞谋利
senses.example_en: Several traders were penalized for exploiting regulatory loopholes to game the system.
senses.example_zh: 数名交易员因利用监管漏洞钻空子谋利而受到处罚。

senses.meaning: 颠覆格局的事物；规则改变者
senses.example_en: The introduction of generative AI is widely considered a monumental game changer across industries.
senses.example_zh: 生成式人工智能的推出被普遍视为颠覆各行各业格局的重大变革。

senses.example_en: We need to revise our marketing game plan before the holiday shopping season kicks off.
senses.example_zh: 在假日购物季开启前，我们需要修订营销策略方案。

senses.meaning: 零和博弈（一方所得即为另一方所失的竞争格局）
senses.example_en: Trade negotiations should aim for mutual benefit rather than descending into a zero-sum game.
senses.example_zh: 贸易谈判应以互利共赢为目标，而不是沦为零和博弈。

senses.meaning: 采取观望策略；伺机而动
senses.example_en: Instead of investing immediately, the venture capitalists decided to play a waiting game.
senses.example_zh: 风险投资者决定采取观望策略伺机而动，而不是立即注资。

senses.example_en: She longed for the peaceful days she had spent in the countryside.
senses.example_zh: 她十分渴望能重温曾经在乡村度过的宁静岁月。

senses.meaning: 苦苦思念；切望（书面或文学表达）
senses.example_en: Even years after his departure, she still longed after the life they could have shared.
senses.example_zh: 即使在他离开多年后，她仍然苦苦思念着他们本可以共同拥有的生活。

senses.example_en: Investing in energy-efficient equipment will save you money in the long run.
senses.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资节能设备会为你节省资金。

senses.example_en: You can borrow the vehicle as long as you return it with a full tank.
senses.example_zh: 只要你保证加满油归还，就可以把车借走。

senses.example_en: Keep practicing every day and before long you will be speaking with confidence.
senses.example_zh: 坚持每天练习，不久你就能自信地开口表达了。

idioms.phrase: the long and the short of it

senses.example_en: The long and the short of it is that our division simply cannot take on any more projects.
senses.example_zh: 总而言之，我们部门实在无法再承担更多项目了。

senses.example_en: After hours in the crowded hall, he longed to breathe some fresh outdoor air.
senses.example_zh: 在拥挤的大厅里待了数小时后，他极度渴望呼吸一下室外的新鲜空气。

senses.example_en: Trapped in the flooded building, the survivors longed desperately for rescue teams to arrive.
senses.example_zh: 被困在被淹大楼里的幸存者们极其渴望救援队的到来。

senses.meaning: 姗姗来迟的；早就该进行的
senses.example_en: A thorough overhaul of the outdated software system is long overdue.
senses.example_zh: 对这一陈旧软件系统进行全面彻底的检修早就该进行了。

senses.meaning: 希望渺茫的尝试；不大可能成功的举动
senses.example_en: Securing a grant on such short notice is a long shot, but it is worth a try.
senses.example_zh: 在这么紧迫的时间内争取到拨款希望渺茫，但值得一试。

senses.example_en: We should start off early tomorrow morning to beat the rush hour traffic.
senses.example_zh: 我们明天得一大早动身，以避开早高峰的拥堵。

senses.example_en: The speaker started off by sharing an amusing personal anecdote with the audience.
senses.example_zh: 演讲者以向听众分享一段有趣的个人轶事作为开场。

senses.meaning: 动身，启程（尤指一段漫长的旅程）
senses.example_en: They packed their hiking gear and started out at dawn.
senses.example_zh: 他们收拾好徒步装备，在黎明时分启程出发。

senses.meaning: 起初打算，本意要做（通常后接不定式）
senses.example_en: I started out to write a short article, but it eventually turned into a full-length book.
senses.example_zh: 我起初打算写一篇短文，但最终却写成了一整本书。

senses.meaning: 职业生涯或人生）最初从业，起初以某种身份从业
senses.example_en: Many acclaimed film directors started out as low-paid production assistants.
senses.example_zh: 许多著名电影导演最初都是从低薪的剧组助理做起的。

senses.meaning: 启动，发动（机器、汽车或设备）
senses.example_en: The old car made a strange rattling noise when the engine started up.
senses.example_zh: 发动机启动时，这辆老旧汽车发出了奇怪的咔嗒声。

senses.meaning: 创办，开办（公司、业务或项目）
senses.example_en: She decided to leave her corporate job to start up her own tech consultancy.
senses.example_zh: 她决定辞去大公司的工作，创办自己的科技咨询公司。

senses.meaning: 突然站起；（争端、风雨等）突然爆发
senses.example_en: He started up from his armchair the moment the smoke alarm went off.
senses.example_zh: 烟雾警报器一响，他猛地从扶手椅上弹了起来。

senses.example_en: As soon as dinner was cleared away, she started on her chemistry assignment.
senses.example_zh: 晚饭一收拾完，她就着手做化学作业了。

senses.meaning: 开始数落，挑剔或指责某人
senses.example_en: Please don't start on me about the mess—I've had an exhausting day.
senses.example_zh: 请别又拿屋子乱来数落我了——我今天累坏了。

senses.example_en: When the unsaved document closed unexpectedly, the designer had no choice but to start over.
senses.example_zh: 未保存的文档意外关闭后，设计师别无选择，只能从头再来。

senses.meaning: 开始动手干，着手干（常接 on 或 doing）
senses.example_en: Grab a shovel and start in—we have a lot of snow to clear before noon.
senses.example_zh: 拿把铁锹开始干吧——中午前我们得清理掉大量的积雪。

senses.meaning: 开始责难、抱怨或攻击某人（常接 on sb）
senses.example_en: She started in on her brother the minute he walked through the front door.
senses.example_zh: 弟弟刚一迈进大门，她就开始没完没了地数落他。

senses.example_en: Let's start with a quick review of the vocabulary we learned yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 我们先从快速复习昨天学过的词汇开始吧。

senses.meaning: 首先，起初（常用于 to start with 表首要原因）
senses.example_en: We can't buy the apartment; to start with, it's far beyond our budget.
senses.example_zh: 我们买不起这套公寓；首先，它远远超出了我们的预算。

senses.example_en: The storm clouds look threatening, so we had better start back to camp right now.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雨的乌云看起来很凶猛，我们最好现在就动身返回营地。

senses.meaning: 因吃惊或恐惧而猛然退缩
senses.example_en: He started back in terror when he saw a snake coiled on the pathway.
senses.example_zh: 当看到小路上盘着一条蛇时，他惊恐地猛然向后退去。

senses.meaning: 帮助或指导某人入门/开始
senses.example_en: The mentor started the intern off on a few straightforward bug-fixing tasks.
senses.example_zh: 导师安排实习生先做几个简单的漏洞修复任务，以此带其入门。

senses.meaning: 引发某人开始大笑、痛哭或滔滔不绝
senses.example_en: Don't mention politics around Uncle Bob, or you'll start him off on an endless rant.
senses.example_zh: 别在鲍勃叔叔面前提政治，否则会引得他滔滔不绝地大发牢骚。

senses.meaning: 因惊吓而猛地跳起或缩身退避
senses.example_en: The deer started away into the thick bushes when a dry twig snapped.
senses.example_zh: 一根枯树枝被踩断时，那只鹿受惊猛然跳起，窜进了灌木丛深处。

senses.example_en: Upon hearing the urgent call, the physician started away without finishing his lunch.
senses.example_zh: 一接到紧急传呼，那位内科医生午饭都没吃完就急匆匆动身离开了。

senses.meaning: 从零开始，白手起家，从一无所有开始
senses.example_en: After the fire destroyed their workshop, the founders had to start from scratch.
senses.example_zh: 大火摧毁作坊后，创始团队不得不从零开始重新创业。

senses.meaning: 率先行动，带头开展，抛砖引玉拉开序幕
senses.example_en: To start the ball rolling, the chairman pledged a personal donation of ten thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 为带头推动活动开展，主席率先认捐了一万美元。

senses.meaning: 首先，作为开头第一点（常用于列举理由或批评）
senses.example_en: We can't afford the vacation; for a start, the airfares are outrageous.
senses.example_zh: 我们承担不起这次度假；首先，机票价格就贵得离谱。

idioms.phrase: get off to a flying start

senses.meaning: 旗开得胜，取得开门红，开局势如破竹
senses.example_en: The new product got off to a flying start, selling out within twenty-four hours.
senses.example_zh: 新产品取得了开门红，在二十四小时内便销售一空。

senses.meaning: 别提了，别惹我打开话匣子（表示一旦展开讲就会抱怨个没完）
senses.example_en: Don't get me started on the public transport here; trains are perpetually delayed.
senses.example_zh: 别跟我提这儿的公共交通了，火车永远在晚点。

senses.meaning: 既往不咎，不计前嫌，重新开始
senses.example_en: Both managers agreed to put past rivalries behind them and start with a clean slate.
senses.example_zh: 两位经理一致同意放下过去的恩怨，重新建立合作关系。

senses.example_en: The merger was off to a bad start when key executives resigned on day one.
senses.example_zh: 核心高管在第一天就集体辞职，使得这次合并出师不利。

senses.example_en: She took a leap of faith and left her secure job to start a business.
senses.example_zh: 她毅然辞去了稳定的工作，勇敢迈出一步去开办自己的企业。

senses.example_en: They bought a house in the suburbs and decided it was the right time to start a family.
senses.example_zh: 他们在郊区买了房，并觉得是时候生儿育女、组建家庭了。

senses.meaning: 打破沉默，挑起话头，开启对话
senses.example_en: He made a witty remark about the weather to start a conversation with the woman beside him.
senses.example_zh: 他就天气说了句俏皮话，与身旁的女士攀谈起来。

senses.example_en: Dry leaves and high winds made it terrifyingly easy to start a catastrophic forest fire.
senses.example_zh: 干燥的落叶和狂风使得引发灾难性森林大火变得极易发生。

senses.example_en: He turned the ignition key, but the old battery failed to start the engine.
senses.example_zh: 他转动点火钥匙，但老化的电瓶没能将发动机发动起来。

senses.meaning: 从零打基础，从基层逐步做起
senses.example_en: The software architecture had to be redesigned and started from the ground up.
senses.example_zh: 该软件架构必须彻底重新设计，从零开始搭建基础。

senses.example_en: Construction crews are scheduled to start work on the new highway extension next Monday.
senses.example_zh: 施工队预定于下周一正式着手新高速公路延伸段的建设。

senses.meaning: 翻开新的一页，重新再来，洗心革面
senses.example_en: Moving to a new city gave him the perfect opportunity to leave his past behind and start afresh.
senses.example_zh: 搬到一座新城市给了他绝佳的机会，让他能够告别过去，重新再来。

senses.meaning: 常与……交往，同……混在一起（常带贬义或过时用法）
senses.example_en: His parents worried that he was keeping company with a bad crowd.
senses.example_zh: 父母担心他正和一群不良少年混在一起。

senses.meaning: 有同行者（因而无需尴尬/自责）；大有人在
senses.example_en: If you failed the exam, you're in good company—half the class did too.
senses.example_zh: 要是你考试不及格，也别难过，全班有一半人都没过呢。

senses.meaning: 两人成伴，三人不欢；二人世界容不下第三者
senses.example_en: I won't join you two at dinner—two's company, three's a crowd.
senses.example_zh: 我就不掺和你们俩吃晚餐了——二人世界，三人多余。

senses.meaning: 倒霉有人作伴心稍宽；同病相怜
senses.example_en: He was glad others also got wet in the rain, proving misery loves company.
senses.example_zh: 看到其他人也被雨淋了，他竟感到一丝宽慰，真是倒霉有人陪心稍宽。

senses.meaning: 在座各位除外；不包括在场的人
senses.example_en: Politicians can never be trusted, present company excepted, of course.
senses.example_zh: 政客从来都不可信，当然，在座的各位除外。

idioms.phrase: a man is known by the company he keeps

senses.meaning: 观其友而知其人；物以类聚，人以群分
senses.example_en: Remember that a man is known by the company he keeps, so choose your friends wisely.
senses.example_zh: 记住，观其友而知其人，所以交朋友务必慎重。

senses.meaning: 为了作伴；为了不感到孤单
senses.example_en: Living alone in the countryside, she adopted a stray cat for company.
senses.example_zh: 独自在乡村生活，她收养了一只流浪猫来作伴。

senses.example_en: She has been running the tech company successfully for over a decade.
senses.example_zh: 她成功经营这家科技公司已经十多年了。

collocations.phrase: start / set up / found a company

senses.example_en: The two college friends decided to set up a software company together.
senses.example_zh: 那两位大学好友决定联手创办一家软件公司。

senses.example_en: The local airline is a subsidiary of a major European parent company.
senses.example_zh: 这家本土航空公司是一家大型欧洲母公司的子公司。

senses.example_en: Transparency is strictly required for any publicly listed company.
senses.example_zh: 对于任何一家上市公司而言，信息公开透明都是硬性要求。

senses.meaning: 公司文化 / 公司规章制度
senses.example_en: Encouraging open feedback is a central pillar of our company culture.
senses.example_zh: 鼓励公开反馈是我们公司文化的核心支柱。

senses.meaning: 与他人在一起；身处社交场合
senses.example_en: He behaves very differently when he is in company compared to when he is alone.
senses.example_zh: 他身处众人之中与独处时的表现大不相同。

senses.example_en: I'll stay here and keep you company while you wait for the bus.
senses.example_zh: 你在等公交车的时候，我留在这里陪你吧。

senses.meaning: 与……分道扬镳，因分歧而散伙或断绝往来
senses.example_en: The band parted company with their manager over creative differences.
senses.example_zh: 由于创作上的分歧，乐队与他们的经纪人分道扬镳了。

senses.meaning: 行走时）与……分手，各走各的路
senses.example_en: We walked together as far as the station, where we parted company.
senses.example_zh: 我们一起走到车站，然后在那里各奔东西。

senses.meaning: 陪伴某人，陪同某人（较正式）
senses.example_en: Would you bear me company on my walk to the library?
senses.example_zh: 你能陪我一起走到图书馆吗？

senses.meaning: 喜欢和某人待在一起，享受某人的陪伴
senses.example_en: I really enjoy her company because she has a great sense of humor.
senses.example_zh: 我非常喜欢和她待在一起，因为她很有幽默感。

senses.meaning: 喜欢独处，享受一人清静
senses.example_en: He is rather introverted and has always preferred his own company.
senses.example_zh: 他性格相当内向，向来更喜欢一个人独处。

senses.meaning: 主动寻找某人作伴，想和某人待在一起
senses.example_en: Whenever he felt anxious, he sought his brother's company.
senses.example_zh: 每当感到焦虑时，他都会主动去找哥哥作伴。

senses.meaning: 交友不慎，结交坏朋友，误入歧途
senses.example_en: After moving to the new city, the teenager fell into bad company and started skipping school.
senses.example_zh: 搬到新城市后，那个少年结交了坏朋友，开始旷课。

senses.meaning: 以居高临下的口吻对……说话，傲慢地对待
senses.example_en: Don't talk down to me as if I know nothing about this project.
senses.example_zh: 别用那种居高临下的口气跟我说话，好像我对这个项目一无所知似的。

senses.meaning: 劝降，劝解（企图轻生或情绪激动者）放弃危险举动
senses.example_en: A trained negotiator spent hours talking the man down from the bridge ledge.
senses.example_zh: 一名训练有素的谈判专家花了好几个小时，才劝说那名男子从桥梁边缘退回来。

senses.meaning: 大声压制对方的发言，把人说得哑口无言
senses.example_en: Whenever I tried to raise an objection, he shouted and talked me down.
senses.example_zh: 每当我想提出异议时，他就大声嚷嚷把我压制下去。

senses.meaning: 说服降价，讨价还价成功
senses.example_en: The seller wanted $500, but I managed to talk him down to $400.
senses.example_zh: 卖家开价500美元，但我成功把价格压到了400美元。

senses.meaning: 无线电指引（遇险飞机）安全降落
senses.example_en: Air traffic controllers managed to talk the inexperienced pilot down safely.
senses.example_zh: 空中交通管制员设法通过无线电指引，让那位缺乏经验的飞行员安全降落。

senses.example_en: Children shouldn't talk back to their teachers when they are corrected.
senses.example_zh: 孩子在被批评时不应该对老师顶嘴。

senses.example_en: We need to sit down and talk over the details before signing the contract.
senses.example_zh: 在签署合同之前，我们需要坐下来详细商讨各个细节。

senses.meaning: 向某人步步讲解，逐步指导操作
senses.example_en: The technician talked me through the software installation step by step.
senses.example_zh: 技术人员一步步指导我完成了软件的安装。

senses.meaning: 透彻交谈以疏导（某人的情绪、困惑或问题）
senses.example_en: The counselor helped talk her through her panic attack.
senses.example_zh: 心理咨询师耐心地引导交流，帮她平复了恐慌发作。

senses.meaning: 说服某人改变主意或立场
senses.example_en: He was firmly against the plan at first, but we finally talked him around.
senses.example_zh: 起初他坚决反对这项计划，但我们最终说服他改变了主意。

senses.meaning: 拐弯抹角，回避核心话题而不直奔主题
senses.example_en: Stop talking around the problem and tell us honestly what went wrong.
senses.example_zh: 别再拐弯抹角了，老老实实告诉我们究竟出了什么问题。

senses.meaning: 大肆吹捧，极力夸赞……的价值或前景
senses.example_en: The company talked up the new phone, but users found it quite ordinary.
senses.example_zh: 公司对那款新手机大加吹捧，但用户发现它其实平平无奇。

senses.meaning: 通过坦诚交谈解决（分歧或矛盾）
senses.example_en: Instead of staying angry, they sat down together to talk out their differences.
senses.example_zh: 他们没有继续生闷气，而是坐下来通过坦诚交谈化解了分歧。

senses.meaning: 自顾自地对某人说教，单向唠叨不容对方插话
senses.example_en: I felt exhausted because he spent the entire lunch just talking at me rather than listening.
senses.example_zh: 我感到精疲力竭，因为整顿午饭他都在自顾自地对我滔滔不绝，根本不听我说话。

senses.meaning: 全面细致地探讨，透彻梳理（方案、问题等）
senses.example_en: Let's talk through all the possible risks before making a final decision.
senses.example_zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们先把所有潜在风险彻底梳理讨论一遍。

senses.meaning: 不停地闲扯，滔滔不绝地说个没完
senses.example_en: The two old friends sat in the corner, talking away for hours.
senses.example_zh: 那两位老朋友坐在角落里，滔滔不绝地聊了好几个小时。

senses.example_en: We talked away the long evening over cups of hot tea.
senses.example_zh: 我们喝着热茶聊天，打发了漫长的夜晚。

senses.meaning: 通过解释消弭，借言语化解（疑虑、问题等）
senses.example_en: He tried to talk away his mistakes, but the evidence was undeniable.
senses.example_zh: 他试图通过巧舌如簧掩盖自己的错误，但证据确凿不容辩驳。

senses.example_en: I need to talk to you about the upcoming presentation.
senses.example_zh: 关于接下来的汇报演示，我需要和你谈谈。

senses.example_en: If he keeps coming in late, the manager will have to talk to him.
senses.example_zh: 如果他继续迟到，经理就得找他严肃谈话了。

senses.meaning: 三句话不离本行；在社交场合大谈工作业务
senses.example_en: We promised not to talk shop at the dinner party, but we couldn't resist.
senses.example_zh: 我们答应过晚宴上不聊工作，但最后还是忍不住三句话不离本行。

senses.meaning: 说得头头是道；说得天花乱坠（通常与 walk the walk 连用）
senses.example_en: He can certainly talk the talk, but let's see if he can deliver results.
senses.example_zh: 他确实能说会道、讲得头头是道，但且看他能不能拿出实际成果。

senses.meaning: 吹大牛；说大话；夸夸其谈
senses.example_en: He talks big about his wealth, but he actually rents that luxury car.
senses.example_zh: 他大吹特吹自己多么富有，其实那辆豪车是他租来的。

senses.meaning: 信口雌黄；胡说八道；不懂装懂
senses.example_en: Ignore his opinion on economics—he's just talking through his hat.
senses.example_zh: 别理他对经济学的见解——他纯粹是在不懂装懂、胡说八道。

senses.meaning: 把某人的耳朵都说出茧来；喋喋不休地说个没完
senses.example_en: My neighbor caught me in the hallway and nearly talked my ear off.
senses.example_zh: 邻居在楼道里撞见我，没完没了地讲个不停，差点把我耳朵说出茧来。

senses.meaning: 这才像话；这才对嘛；正合我意
senses.example_en: A weekend trip to the beach? Now you're talking!
senses.example_zh: 周末去海滩度假？这才对嘛，正合我意！

senses.meaning: 金钱万能；钱能通神；有钱能使鬼推磨
senses.example_en: In professional sports negotiations, money talks louder than sentiment.
senses.example_zh: 在职业体育的商业谈判中，金钱往往比情怀更有话语权。

senses.meaning: 说话在理 / 胡说八道
senses.example_en: It's refreshing to hear someone talk sense in this heated debate.
senses.example_zh: 在这次激烈的争辩中，听到有人说了几句明白在理的话，真令人耳目一新。

senses.meaning: 言归正传谈正事；洽谈生意业务
senses.example_en: After enjoying our coffee, let's get down to work and talk business.
senses.example_zh: 喝完咖啡后，我们言归正传谈正事吧。

senses.example_en: The team was encouraged to talk openly about any bottlenecks they encountered.
senses.example_zh: 团队成员被鼓励畅所欲言，提出自己遇到的任何瓶颈。

senses.example_en: The coach needs to have a serious talk with the captain before the final match.
senses.example_zh: 教练在决赛前需要和队长认真谈一谈。

senses.example_en: She was invited to give a talk on renewable energy at the annual summit.
senses.example_zh: 她受邀在年度峰会上就可再生能源作专题报告。

senses.example_en: He tried to use sweet talk to persuade her into lending him the car.
senses.example_zh: 他试图用甜言蜜语哄骗她说服她借车给自己。

senses.meaning: 劝阻某人做某事，说服某人放弃
senses.example_en: I tried to talk her out of quitting university, but she had already made up her mind.
senses.example_zh: 我试图劝她不要退学，但她已经下定了决心。

senses.example_en: The villagers were talking of the strange lights seen in the mountains.
senses.example_zh: 村民们都在谈论山里出现的奇异光芒。

senses.example_en: There is already talk of early elections following the scandal.
senses.example_zh: 丑闻发生后，已有关于提前举行大选的传闻传出。

senses.meaning: 劝服某人做某事，说服某人参与
senses.example_en: She managed to talk him into applying for the new job.
senses.example_zh: 她设法说服了他去申请那份新工作。

senses.example_en: It took them twenty years to pay off the mortgage on their house.
senses.example_zh: 他们花了二十年时间才还清房贷。

senses.example_en: All her hard work finally paid off when she received the promotion.
senses.example_zh: 当她获得晋升时，她所有的辛勤努力终于得到了回报。

senses.example_en: The criminals tried to pay off the security guards to look the other way.
senses.example_zh: 罪犯试图收买保安，让他们装作没看见。

senses.example_en: The shipyard paid off hundreds of workers as orders dried up.
senses.example_zh: 随着订单枯竭，造船厂结清工资解雇了数百名工人。

senses.example_en: I can lend you fifty dollars, but you have to pay me back by Friday.
senses.example_zh: 我可以借给你五十美元，但你必须在周五前还我。

senses.example_en: He swore he would pay them back for the humiliation they caused him.
senses.example_zh: 他发誓一定要为他们带给他的羞辱进行报复。

senses.example_en: I can never pay you back for all the support you gave me during difficult times.
senses.example_zh: 你在艰难时期给予我的全力支持，我感激不尽、无以为报。

senses.example_en: Put your wallet away; I'm going to pay for dinner tonight.
senses.example_zh: 把钱包收起来吧，今晚的晚饭我来买单。

senses.example_en: He ignored the warning signs and paid for his carelessness with an injury.
senses.example_zh: 他忽视了警告标志，因粗心大意而付出了受伤的代价。

senses.example_en: The insurance company had to pay out millions after the flood.
senses.example_zh: 洪水过后，保险公司不得不赔付数百万美元。

senses.example_en: The sailors paid out the cable slowly into the deep water.
senses.example_zh: 水手们将缆绳慢慢放入深水中。

senses.meaning: 付清全部欠款；（尤指勉强或被迫）交款
senses.example_en: After several legal warnings, the tenant finally paid up the overdue rent.
senses.example_zh: 经过几次法律警告后，租客终于结清了拖欠的房租。

senses.example_en: She went to the local branch to pay in a check she received yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 她去当地银行网点把昨天收到的一张支票存入账户。

senses.meaning: 分期偿还，逐步减少（债务总额）
senses.example_en: The company used its excess cash to pay down its long-term debt.
senses.example_zh: 该公司利用富余资金来逐步削减其长期债务。

senses.example_en: They paid down ten thousand dollars on the new apartment.
senses.example_zh: 他们为这套新公寓当场付了一万美元的首付款。

senses.meaning: 把（收到的款项）立即转付给他人
senses.example_en: Nearly half of the profits were paid away in taxes and commissions.
senses.example_zh: 近一半的利润立即被用于缴纳税款和支付佣金。

senses.example_en: Pay away more anchor rope so the ship won't drag.
senses.example_zh: 再放一些锚绳，以免船只走锚。

senses.meaning: 把（款项）正式转交/移交给官方或指定受益人
senses.example_en: The trustee was required to pay over the remaining funds to the heirs.
senses.example_zh: 受托人被要求将剩余资金正式移交给继承人。

senses.meaning: 花大价钱，被敲竹杠，付出过高的代价
senses.example_en: They had to pay through the nose for last-minute flight tickets during peak season.
senses.example_zh: 在旺季，他们不得不花大价钱购买临近起飞的机票。

senses.meaning: 自食其果，承担（享乐或鲁莽行为的）后果
senses.example_en: If you live beyond your means for years, you will eventually have to pay the piper.
senses.example_zh: 如果你多年来一直入不敷出，最终必然要自食其果。

senses.meaning: 口惠而实不至，做表面文章，虚应故事
senses.example_en: The management paid lip service to workplace safety but cut the protective gear budget.
senses.example_zh: 管理层口头上承诺重视职场安全，却削减了防护用具的预算。

senses.meaning: 吃苦熬出头，历经磨砺获得认可或资格
senses.example_en: She spent a decade working night shifts at local clinics, paying her dues before becoming chief surgeon.
senses.example_zh: 她在地方诊所上了十年的夜班，历尽艰辛熬出头，才成为主任医师。

idioms.phrase: pay sb back in their own coin

senses.meaning: 以其人之道还治其人之身
senses.example_en: When he refused to share information, the rival team paid him back in his own coin.
senses.example_zh: 当他拒绝共享信息时，对手团队以其人之道还治其人之身。

senses.meaning: 作恶无好下场，违法犯罪终遭惩罚
senses.example_en: The convicted fraudster learned the hard way that crime doesn't pay.
senses.example_zh: 被定罪的诈骗犯尝到了苦头，明白了多行不义必自毙的道理。

senses.example_en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions demonstrated by the crew.
senses.example_zh: 请仔细留意机组人员演示的安全须知。

collocations.phrase: pay a visit / pay a call

senses.example_en: We decided to pay a visit to our former teacher while staying in town.
senses.example_zh: 在城里停留期间，我们决定去探望一下当年的老师。

senses.example_en: Thousands gathered at the square to pay tribute to the fallen heroes.
senses.example_zh: 成千上万的人聚集在广场上，向牺牲的英雄们致敬。

senses.meaning: 自食其力，自掏腰包（不欠人情/不依赖他人）
senses.example_en: He worked part-time throughout college to pay his own way.
senses.example_zh: 他在大学期间一直做兼职，自食其力完成学业。

senses.meaning: 产生丰厚收益，带来长期回报
senses.example_en: Investing in employee training always pays dividends in the long run.
senses.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资员工培训总会带来丰厚的回报。

senses.meaning: 支付溢价，支付额外费用
senses.example_en: Consumers are willing to pay a premium for organic produce.
senses.example_zh: 消费者愿意为有机农产品支付溢价。

senses.meaning: 自掏腰包支付；从（某笔专款/预算）中支出
senses.example_en: Employees will have to pay for parking out of their own pockets.
senses.example_zh: 员工必须自掏腰包支付停车费。

senses.meaning: 向（基金、养老金或特定账户）定期存入/缴纳款项
senses.example_en: He pays ten percent of his monthly salary into a private pension scheme.
senses.example_zh: 他每月将工资的百分之十存入个人养老金计划中。

senses.meaning: 为……承担一部分费用，贴补
senses.example_en: Her parents agreed to pay towards the cost of her college textbooks.
senses.example_zh: 她的父母同意帮她分担一部分大学课本的费用。

senses.example_en: He walked into the office and asked for a glass of water.
senses.example_zh: 他走进办公室要了一杯水。

senses.example_en: Driving at such high speed on an icy road is just asking for trouble.
senses.example_zh: 在结冰的路面上开这么快纯粹是自找麻烦。

senses.example_en: He finally gathered the courage to ask her out for a movie.
senses.example_zh: 他终于鼓起勇气约她出去看电影。

senses.meaning: 四处打听，向周围人询问
senses.example_en: I'm looking for a good mechanic, so I'll ask around at work tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 我在找一个靠谱的汽修工，明天去上班时我四处打听打听。

senses.meaning: 问候，询问（某人的近况或身体状况）
senses.example_en: I bumped into your former teacher today, and she asked after you.
senses.example_zh: 我今天碰到了你以前的老师，她问起你的近况。

senses.example_en: Don't leave our guests standing on the porch—ask them in!
senses.example_zh: 别让客人站在门廊外，快请他们进屋！

senses.meaning: 邀请（某人）到自己家里做客
senses.example_en: We should ask the new neighbors over for dinner this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们这周末应该请新邻居来家里吃顿晚饭。

senses.meaning: 邀请（求职者）参加第二轮面试
senses.example_en: She was thrilled when the company asked her back for a second interview.
senses.example_zh: 得知公司通知她参加第二轮面试，她兴奋不已。

senses.example_en: They invited us to their party last month, so we must ask them back.
senses.example_zh: 他们上个月邀请我们参加了派对，所以我们一定要回请他们。

senses.example_en: Several potential buyers called to ask about the price of the house.
senses.example_zh: 几位潜在买家打电话来询问房子的售价。

senses.meaning: 邀请（某人）到乡间或楼下
senses.example_en: My uncle asked us down to his cottage in Devon for the holidays.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔邀请我们假期去他在德文郡的乡间小屋度假。

senses.meaning: 依我看，在我看来（用于表达个人观点）
senses.example_en: If you ask me, the whole marketing campaign is a waste of money.
senses.example_zh: 依我看，整场营销活动纯粹是浪费钱。

senses.meaning: 只要开口就能得到，唾手可得
senses.example_en: There are plenty of grants available for young entrepreneurs, just for the asking.
senses.example_zh: 有大量面向青年创业者的补助资金，只要提出申请就能拿到。

senses.meaning: 别提了！一言难尽！（表示情况很糟糕或尴尬）
senses.example_en: 'How was your journey back?' 'Don't ask! The flight was canceled twice.'
senses.example_zh: “你返程顺利吗？”“别提了！航班取消了两次。”

senses.meaning: 自讨苦吃，自作自受，活该
senses.example_en: Walking down unlit alleys late at night holding expensive gadgets is just asking for it.
senses.example_zh: 大半夜拿着贵重数码产品在黑黢黢的巷子里晃荡，简直是自讨苦吃。

senses.meaning: 异想天开，提出过高或不可能的要求
senses.example_en: Expecting a zero-error rate in such a complex prototype is asking for the moon.
senses.example_zh: 指望如此复杂的样机达到零差错率，简直是异想天开。

idioms.phrase: ask no questions and hear no lies

senses.meaning: 少打听就少听假话（劝人莫管闲事）
senses.example_en: Where did I find the cash? Ask no questions and you'll hear no lies.
senses.example_zh: 这钱我是从哪儿弄来的？少问少听假话，别多管闲事。

senses.example_en: I hate to impose, but could I ask a favor of you regarding tomorrow's shift?
senses.example_zh: 我真不想麻烦你，但能不能请你帮个忙替一下明天的班？

senses.example_en: You must ask permission from the property owner before filming on site.
senses.example_zh: 在此地拍摄前，你必须先征求业主的许可。

senses.example_en: She consulted her mentor to ask advice on career transitions.
senses.example_zh: 她向导师请教关于职业转型的建议。

senses.example_en: The seller is refusing to budge below the original asking price of $400,000.
senses.example_zh: 卖家拒绝在原先40万美元的挂牌要价上做出任何让步。

senses.example_en: The junior officer asked leave to visit his ailing father.
senses.example_zh: 这位初级军官请假去探望生病的父亲。

senses.example_en: Journalists gathered outside the hall to ask tough questions about the subsidy cuts.
senses.example_zh: 记者们聚集在大厅外，就削减补贴一事提出了尖锐的质问。

senses.meaning: 成为第二本能；变得习以为常
senses.example_en: After years of practice, checking his blind spots had become second nature to him.
senses.example_zh: 经过多年的练习，变道前查看盲区对他来说已成了第二本能。

senses.meaning: 成为常态；成为不可或缺的固定一员
senses.example_en: The coffee cart outside the subway station has become a permanent fixture of our morning commute.
senses.example_zh: 地铁站外的那辆咖啡推车已成为我们早晨通勤中不可或缺的固定景象。

senses.meaning: 融为一体；（男女）结为夫妇
senses.example_en: The two rival organizations agreed to merge and become one unified entity.
senses.example_zh: 两家竞争对手机构同意合并，融为一个统一的实体。

senses.meaning: 成为历史；不复存在；被淘汰
senses.example_en: Without major reforms, traditional postal services could soon become history.
senses.example_zh: 若不进行重大改革，传统的邮政服务可能很快就会成为历史。

senses.example_en: It soon became apparent that the initial budget estimates were far too low.
senses.example_zh: 很快大家就看清楚了，最初的预算估算实在太低了。

senses.example_en: Doctors are urging the public to become more aware of early diabetes symptoms.
senses.example_zh: 医生们呼吁公众提高对早期糖尿病症状的警惕和认识。

senses.example_en: Tickets will become available online starting next Monday at 9 a.m.
senses.example_zh: 门票将于下周一上午9点起在网上公开发售。

senses.example_en: Rapid technological advances cause many electronic gadgets to become obsolete in a few years.
senses.example_zh: 技术的飞速进步使得许多电子设备在短短几年内便遭淘汰。

senses.meaning: 常与 what 连用）某人/某事遭遇如何，下落如何；结局怎样
senses.example_en: Whatever became of that talented violinist after she graduated from the conservatory?
senses.example_zh: 那位从音乐学院毕业的天才小提琴手后来到底怎么样了？

senses.meaning: 总数达到；以（成百上千等数量级）计
senses.example_en: The crowd gathered in the main square numbered in the tens of thousands.
senses.example_zh: 聚集在主广场上的人群数以万计。

senses.example_en: The drill sergeant ordered the squad to fall in and number off from right to left.
senses.example_zh: 训练军士命令全班集合，并从右至左依次报数。

senses.example_en: The archivist spent the morning numbering up all the newly cataloged manuscripts.
senses.example_zh: 档案管理员花了一上午的时间给所有新编目的手稿依次编号。

senses.example_en: Literary critics frequently number her debut novel with the finest works of the decade.
senses.example_zh: 文学评论家们经常将她的处女作与近十年最优秀的作品并列相提。

senses.meaning: 按编号逐一核对；依序清点
senses.example_en: The warehouse staff numbered down the crates on the manifest before signing the delivery form.
senses.example_zh: 仓库人员在货运单上按编号逐一核对了板条箱，随后才签署了交货确认书。

senses.example_en: The teacher numbered out the examination booklets carefully before distributing them to the class.
senses.example_zh: 老师在将考卷分发给全班之前，仔细地按份数清点核准。

senses.meaning: 屈指可数；时日无多；气数已尽
senses.example_en: With profits plummeting, the CEO's days at the company are numbered.
senses.example_zh: 随着利润暴跌，这位首席执行官在该公司的日子屈指可数了。

senses.meaning: 狠狠伤害/打击某人；严重损坏某物；欺骗愚弄
senses.example_en: That flu really did a number on me; I was in bed for a whole week.
senses.example_zh: 那场流感可把我折腾惨了，我整整卧床了一周。

senses.meaning: 看穿某人的底细；摸透某人的把戏
senses.example_en: He tried to charm his way out of trouble, but the boss already had his number.
senses.example_zh: 他试图靠献殷勤脱困，但老板早就看穿了他的底细。

senses.meaning: 机械死板地；照章办事；按步就班地
senses.example_en: The film follows the genre conventions strictly by the numbers without any surprises.
senses.example_zh: 这部电影完全是按部就班地套用类型片套路，没有任何惊喜。

senses.meaning: 某人气数已尽；死期已到；大祸临头
senses.example_en: When the engine caught fire at 30,000 feet, the pilot thought his number was up.
senses.example_zh: 当引擎在三万英尺高空起火时，飞行员以为自己的死期到了。

senses.example_en: Hikers are advised to travel in groups because there is safety in numbers.
senses.example_zh: 建议徒步旅行者结伴同行，因为人多更安全。

senses.meaning: 数字游戏（只注重冷冰冰的统计量而忽略质量或实质）
senses.example_en: Modern recruitment has become a ruthless numbers game dominated by algorithms.
senses.example_zh: 现代招聘已沦为一场由算法主导的残酷数字游戏。

senses.example_en: There could be any number of reasons why she didn't reply to your email.
senses.example_zh: 她没回复你的邮件可能会有许多种原因。

senses.example_en: Casualties from the earthquake are feared to number in the thousands.
senses.example_zh: 据恐，地震中的伤亡人数已达数千人。

senses.example_en: She has faced hardships without number throughout her career.
senses.example_zh: 在她的职业生涯中，她经历了无数的艰难困苦。

senses.example_en: The endangered birds are steadily dwindling in number due to habitat loss.
senses.example_zh: 由于栖息地丧失，这种濒危鸟类的数量正不断缩减。

senses.example_en: The exhibits must be numbered consecutively for the auction catalog.
senses.example_zh: 拍卖图录中的展品必须按顺序连续编号。

senses.example_en: Subscribers to the online platform continue to grow in number each month.
senses.example_zh: 该在线平台的用户订阅数量每月都在持续增长。

senses.example_en: A vast number of complaints were lodged after the train service collapsed.
senses.example_zh: 列车服务瘫痪后，收到了大量的投诉。

senses.meaning: 把……归入；将……算作（成员或一类）
senses.example_en: He numbers several prominent artists among his closest personal friends.
senses.example_zh: 他把几位杰出的艺术家算作自己最亲密的私交好友。

senses.example_en: She is proud to be numbered among the pioneers of modern renewable energy research.
senses.example_zh: 她为能够跻身现代可再生能源研究的先驱之列而深感自豪。

senses.example_en: The client was thoroughly pleased with the final design submitted by the architect.
senses.example_zh: 客户对建筑师提交的最终设计方案感到非常满意。

senses.meaning: 很乐意做某事；荣幸地做某事
senses.example_en: The committee is pleased to welcome all international delegates to the conference.
senses.example_zh: 组委会非常荣幸地欢迎各位国际代表出席本次会议。

senses.meaning: 非常高兴；心满意足；得意扬扬
senses.example_en: When she heard she won the scholarship, she was as pleased as Punch.
senses.example_zh: 当听说自己赢得了奖学金时，她高兴得合不拢嘴。

senses.meaning: 随你的便；极其/非常（如 calm as you please）
senses.example_en: He walked right past the security guards, cool as you please.
senses.example_zh: 他从保安身边大摇大摆地走了过去，显得极其淡定。

senses.example_en: The food critic is notoriously hard to please, but she loved the soup.
senses.example_zh: 这位美食评论家出了名的难以取悦，但她却非常喜欢这道汤。

senses.meaning: 请问；请听我说；竟然（用于表示惊讶、愤慨或嘲讽）
senses.example_en: They charged us fifty dollars for parking, if you please!
senses.example_zh: 他们竟然收了我们五十美元的停车费，真不可思议！

senses.example_en: Please God, may the surgery go smoothly and the biopsy come back clear.
senses.example_zh: 老天保佑，但愿手术一切顺利且活检结果正常。

senses.example_en: The minimalist interior design is functional and pleases the eye.
senses.example_zh: 极简主义的室内设计兼具实用性与赏心悦目的美感。

senses.example_en: Grandpa is very easy to please; a cup of tea and a good book make his day.
senses.example_zh: 爷爷非常容易满足，一杯茶和一本好书就能让他开心一整天。

senses.meaning: 急于讨好；渴望令人满意
senses.example_en: As a newcomer to the firm, he was overly anxious to please his superiors.
senses.example_zh: 作为公司的新人，他过分急于讨好自己的上司。

senses.meaning: 随心所欲；想做什么就做什么
senses.example_en: Now that she is retired, she can travel the world and do as she pleases.
senses.example_zh: 现在她退休了，可以环游世界，随心所欲地生活。

senses.meaning: 使某人极其高兴；深得某人欢心
senses.example_en: The glowing reviews pleased the author immensely after months of anxiety.
senses.example_zh: 经历数月的焦虑后，这些热烈的好评让作者感到无比欣慰。

senses.meaning: 试图讨好每个人；面面俱到
senses.example_en: You cannot lead effectively if you spend all your time trying to please everyone.
senses.example_zh: 如果你把所有时间都花在试图讨好每个人上，你就无法进行有效的领导。

senses.example_en: Working under an impossible to please supervisor burned out the entire marketing team.
senses.example_zh: 在一名称得上无法讨好的主管手下工作，让整个营销团队心力交瘁。

senses.example_en: Golden retrievers are famous for being friendly and eager to please.
senses.example_zh: 金毛寻回犬以性格友善、乐于讨人欢心而闻名。

senses.meaning: 自作主张；随自己的便；自行其是
senses.example_en: You don't have to follow our travel plan; you can just please yourself this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 你不需要跟着我们的旅行计划走，这个周末你完全可以随自己的便。

senses.example_en: She was deeply pleased by the overwhelmingly positive reception her speech received.
senses.example_zh: 她的演讲获得了极其热烈的反响，这让她感到格外欣喜。

senses.meaning: 致力于让客户满意；尽力讨人喜欢
senses.example_en: The staff at this boutique hotel clearly aim to please every single guest.
senses.example_zh: 这家精品酒店的员工显然致力于让每一位入住的客人都感到称心如意。

senses.example_en: As a new intern, he strove to please his supervisors by working late into the evening.
senses.example_zh: 作为新来的实习生，他每晚加班到很晚，竭力取悦主管们。

senses.example_en: Despite its enormous budget, the film sequel completely failed to please both critics and fans.
senses.example_zh: 尽管耗资巨大，这部电影续集却未能让影评人和粉丝满意。

senses.example_en: Politicians who constantly seek to please everyone often end up satisfying no one.
senses.example_zh: 那些总想面面讨好各方利益的政客，往往最终谁也满足不了。

senses.meaning: 为……配备（设施、设备或人员）
senses.example_en: The newly built conference center is serviced with high-speed fiber-optic internet and modern audiovisual gear.
senses.example_zh: 新建的会议中心配备了高速光纤网络和现代化的视听设备。

senses.meaning: 用……向（某地或机构）提供补给或服务
senses.example_en: The military outpost is serviced with essential supplies by weekly helicopter flights.
senses.example_zh: 该军事哨所由每周一班的直升机提供必需物资补给。

senses.meaning: 将（设备维护或技术服务）外包给第三方
senses.example_en: To reduce operational overhead, the company decided to service out its printer fleet to a local vendor.
senses.example_zh: 为了削减运营开销，该公司决定将打印机机群的维护外包给一家本地供应商。

senses.meaning: 由（交通线路、公共网络或市政机构）覆盖并提供服务
senses.example_en: This residential neighborhood is well serviced by several bus routes and a light rail station.
senses.example_zh: 这个居民区有多条公交线路和轻轨站覆盖，交通非常便利。

senses.meaning: 由（指定机构或技术人员）进行检修与保养
senses.example_en: All company-owned vehicles must be serviced by certified mechanics every six months.
senses.example_zh: 所有公司车辆必须每半年由持证机械师检修一次。

senses.meaning: 为……送修或进行保养检修
senses.example_en: I need to take my car in to the dealership for its annual service.
senses.example_zh: 我需要把车开到经销店做年度保养。

senses.meaning: 为（债务、贷款）支付利息或偿付本息
senses.example_en: The firm generates sufficient operating cash flow to service its existing loans comfortably.
senses.example_zh: 该公司的经营性现金流充足，能够轻松偿还现有贷款的本息。

senses.meaning: 调入（人员或设备）投入服务或检修作业
senses.example_en: Additional engineers were serviced in from headquarters to help resolve the critical pipeline failure.
senses.example_zh: 总部紧急调派了多名工程师入场，协助解决严重的管道故障。

senses.meaning: 停机检修；逐级关闭设备进行全面维护
senses.example_en: The refinery operators had to service down the entire processing unit for emergency repairs.
senses.example_zh: 炼油厂操作员不得不停机检修整个加工装置以进行紧急抢修。

senses.meaning: 对……口惠而实不至；空口说白话；敷衍应付
senses.example_en: The management paid lip service to environmental protection while continuing to dump waste.
senses.example_zh: 管理层口口声声说支持环保，实际上却在继续倾倒废物。

senses.meaning: 临时征用；把……派上临时用场
senses.example_en: When the bus broke down, local minivans were pressed into service to transport the passengers.
senses.example_zh: 大巴抛锚后，当地的小型面包车被临时征用来转运乘客。

senses.meaning: 对某人有用；能为某人效劳/提供帮助
senses.example_en: Please let me know if I can be of any service to you during your stay.
senses.example_zh: 在您逗留期间，如果我能为您提供任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

senses.meaning: 随时听候某人吩咐；乐意为某人效劳
senses.example_en: "I am entirely at your service, sir," the concierge replied with a courteous bow.
senses.example_zh: “先生，我随时听候您的吩咐，”门房礼貌地鞠躬回答道。

senses.meaning: 为某人提供服务；帮某人一个忙；效劳
senses.example_en: He rendered a valuable service to the company by negotiating a critical truce with suppliers.
senses.example_zh: 他通过与供应商达成关键和解，为公司立下了一大功劳。

senses.meaning: 机器、车辆或工具）经久耐用、服役多年；参军服役
senses.example_en: This old tractor has seen service on the farm for over four decades and still runs smoothly.
senses.example_zh: 这台老拖拉机在农场服役了四十多年，运转依然顺畅。

senses.meaning: 偿还债务/贷款的利息（或本息）
senses.example_en: The developing nation is struggling to service its enormous foreign debt.
senses.example_zh: 这个发展中国家正苦于偿还其巨额的外债利息。

senses.meaning: 检修/保养汽车、车辆或引擎
senses.example_en: You ought to have your car serviced regularly to prevent costly breakdowns.
senses.example_zh: 你应当定期保养汽车，以防出现花费高昂的故障。

senses.meaning: 服务/维护客户或业务账户
senses.example_en: Our senior account executives are assigned to service high-net-worth clients.
senses.example_zh: 我们的资深客户经理被指派专门维护高净值客户。

senses.meaning: 向某个区域或市场提供营运路线、基础设施或商业服务
senses.example_en: The low-cost airline plans to service several emerging secondary cities next year.
senses.example_zh: 这家廉价航空公司计划明年开通多条飞往新兴二线城市的航线。

senses.meaning: 满足……的需求；为……的需要服务
senses.example_en: The revised curriculum is tailored to service the needs of an increasingly digital workforce.
senses.example_zh: 修订后的课程专为满足日益数字化劳动力队伍的需求而设计。

senses.meaning: 全面检修；定期维护保养
senses.example_en: The elevator was fully serviced last month, so the sudden breakdown surprised everyone.
senses.example_zh: 电梯上个月才做过全面检修，因此突然故障让大家十分惊讶。

senses.meaning: 陪伴并支持某人度过（困境、危机、疾病等）
senses.example_en: Her family rallied around her to support her through the arduous cancer treatments.
senses.example_zh: 家人团结在她身边，支持她度过了艰难的癌症治疗期。

senses.meaning: 在（某项行动、决策或职业追求）中支持某人
senses.example_en: His parents fully supported him in his decision to leave law and pursue culinary school.
senses.example_zh: 父母全力支持他放弃法律专业去读厨艺学校的决定。

senses.meaning: 用（资金、技术或物资等资源）资助或扶持
senses.example_en: The municipal government agreed to support the local startup with a substantial research grant.
senses.example_zh: 市政府同意向这家本地初创公司提供大额研发补助资金予以支持。

senses.meaning: 用（证据、数据或事实）佐证或支撑（观点）
senses.example_en: You need to support your central thesis with concrete empirical data.
senses.example_zh: 你需要用具体的实证数据来佐证你的核心论点。

senses.meaning: 用支架或木桩等）撑起，支护使之不倒
senses.example_en: The gardeners used bamboo stakes to support up the heavily laden tomato plants.
senses.example_zh: 园丁们用竹竿将结满果实的西红柿植株撑了起来。

senses.meaning: 在精神或体力上支撑（某人）不致崩溃
senses.example_en: Her deep religious faith helped support her up during months of intense grief.
senses.example_zh: 深厚坚定的信仰支撑着她度过了数月极度悲痛的日子。

senses.example_en: The massive glass dome is supported by eight curved steel pillars.
senses.example_zh: 巨大的玻璃穹顶由八根弯曲的钢柱支撑。

senses.meaning: 由……资助、赞助或维持生计
senses.example_en: The international cultural festival is largely supported by corporate sponsorships.
senses.example_zh: 该国际文化节主要由企业赞助维持。

senses.meaning: 由（证据、事实或权威意见）证实或支持
senses.example_en: The team's revolutionary theory is well supported by findings from subsequent clinical trials.
senses.example_zh: 该团队的革命性理论得到了后续临床试验结果的有力支持。

senses.meaning: IT/运维）维持外部兼容支持；延伸技术兜底服务
senses.example_en: The software vendor agreed to support out the legacy API integration until all clients migrate to the new platform.
senses.example_zh: 该软件供应商同意继续维护旧版API集成，直到所有客户迁移至新平台。

senses.meaning: 作为支持……的理由；为了声援/支援……
senses.example_en: Thousands of demonstrators marched through the capital in support of electoral reform.
senses.example_zh: 数以千计的示威者在首都游行，以声援选举制度改革。

senses.meaning: 支持……；为（理论、观点）提供依据；增添可信度
senses.example_en: Recent archaeological findings lend strong support to the theory of early human migration.
senses.example_zh: 最新的考古发现为早期人类迁徙理论提供了强有力的支持。

senses.meaning: 公开表态支持/拥护（某人或观点）
senses.example_en: Several prominent economists have come out in support of the proposed tax cuts.
senses.example_zh: 几位著名经济学家已公开表态支持这项减税提案。

senses.meaning: 争取/赢得……的支持与协助
senses.example_en: The charity aims to enlist the support of local businesses to build the community shelter.
senses.example_zh: 该慈善机构旨在争取当地企业的支持来建立社区收容所。

senses.meaning: 团结聚集起来声援/支持
senses.example_en: Voters across the country rallied in support of the embattled prime minister.
senses.example_zh: 全国选民团结一致，声援深陷政治困境的首相。

senses.meaning: 承受……的重量；（引申）担负起……的沉重负担
senses.example_en: The old stone bridge can no longer support the weight of heavy commercial trucks.
senses.example_zh: 这座古老的石桥已无法再承受重型商业货车的重量。

senses.example_en: He worked two jobs simultaneously to support his growing family.
senses.example_zh: 他同时打两份工来抚养他人口日增的家庭。

senses.meaning: 证实/支持假说、理论或主张
senses.example_en: There is currently insufficient clinical data to support this controversial claim.
senses.example_zh: 目前尚无充分的临床数据能够证实这一有争议的主张。

senses.meaning: 支持/拥护（某个运动队、俱乐部）
senses.example_en: He has supported Liverpool Football Club ever since he was a little boy.
senses.example_zh: 从孩提时代起，他就一直是利物浦足球俱乐部的忠实球迷。

senses.meaning: 支持/赞成提案、动议或政策
senses.example_en: The majority of lawmakers voted to support the climate transition bill.
senses.example_zh: 多数立法议员投票支持这项气候转型法案。

senses.meaning: 极力/全力/全心全意支持
senses.example_en: We wholeheartedly support the peace initiatives undertaken by the United Nations.
senses.example_zh: 我们全心全意支持联合国采取的和平倡议。

senses.meaning: 在经济上资助/在资金与精神上给予支持
senses.example_en: The endowment fund was established to financially support underprivileged college students.
senses.example_zh: 该留本基金的设立旨在资助家庭贫困的大学生。

senses.meaning: 引起一连串麻烦；触碰棘手复杂的难题
senses.example_en: Investigating that corruption rumor will open a huge can of worms for the board.
senses.example_zh: 调查那起腐败传闻会给董事会惹来一大堆极难处理的麻烦。

senses.meaning: 使某人大开眼界；使某人看清事实真相
senses.example_en: Working in rural clinics really opened her eyes to the severe healthcare inequalities.
senses.example_zh: 在乡村诊所工作的经历真正让她看清了医疗资源匮乏与不平等的现实。

senses.meaning: 大开方便之门；引发无法遏制的连锁反应/泛滥之势
senses.example_en: Approving this single exception could open the floodgates to hundreds of similar requests.
senses.example_zh: 批准这一个特例可能会打开闸门，引来成百上千个类似的申请。

senses.meaning: 保持开放的心态；不带成见
senses.example_en: We should keep an open mind until we have examined all the available evidence.
senses.example_zh: 在审查完所有现有证据之前，我们应该保持客观开放的态度。

senses.example_en: Earning a degree from a prestigious university often opens doors in the financial sector.
senses.example_zh: 从名牌大学获得学位通常能在金融行业为个人开启大量机遇之门。

senses.meaning: 揭开旧伤疤；重提令人痛苦的往事
senses.example_en: I didn't mean to open an old wound by bringing up her previous marriage.
senses.example_zh: 我提起她上一段婚姻并不是存心想揭她的旧伤疤。

senses.example_en: You need two forms of identification to open a bank account.
senses.example_zh: 你需要两种身份证明文件才能开立银行账户。

senses.example_en: The soldiers were ordered not to open fire unless directly threatened.
senses.example_zh: 士兵们接到命令，除非受到直接威胁，否则不得开火。

senses.example_en: Both nations agreed to open a constructive dialogue to de-escalate border tensions.
senses.example_zh: 两国同意展开建设性对话，以缓解边境紧张局势。

senses.example_en: The senator will open the debate on the proposed climate bill tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 参议员将于明早带头就拟议的气候法案展开辩论。

senses.example_en: The auctioneer opened the bidding at five thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 拍卖师以五千美元作为起拍价拉开了竞价序幕。

senses.example_en: The dentist asked the patient to open wide so she could inspect the molar.
senses.example_zh: 牙医让患者把嘴张大，以便检查臼齿。

senses.example_en: It took months of therapy before he finally began to open up about his childhood.
senses.example_zh: 经过几个月的心理治疗，他终于开始敞开心扉谈论自己的童年。

senses.example_en: Learning a new language can open up completely new career opportunities.
senses.example_zh: 学习一门新语言能带来崭新的职业机遇。

senses.example_en: The bakery opens up at six in the morning every day.
senses.example_zh: 这家面包店每天清晨六点开门营业。

senses.example_en: Once he hit the straight highway, he opened up and reached top speed.
senses.example_zh: 一驶上笔直的高速公路，他就开足马力飙到了极速。

senses.example_en: She opened out the map on the table to plan their route.
senses.example_zh: 她在桌上铺开地图来规划他们的路线。

senses.example_en: As we rounded the bend, the valley opened out before us.
senses.example_zh: 当我们绕过弯道时，山谷在眼前豁然开朗。

senses.meaning: 性格）变得开朗，活跃起来
senses.example_en: He was shy at first, but after a few drinks he began to open out.
senses.example_zh: 他起初很拘谨，但喝了几杯酒后就活跃健谈起来了。

senses.example_en: French doors open onto a terrace with stunning sea views.
senses.example_zh: 法式双开门通向一个拥有绝美海景的露台。

senses.meaning: 连通到，直接进入（另一空间）
senses.example_en: The narrow hallway opens into a spacious, light-filled living room.
senses.example_zh: 狭窄的过道连通着一间宽敞明亮的起居室。

senses.example_en: The keynote speaker opened with an amusing anecdote about his early failures.
senses.example_zh: 主讲人以一段关于自己早期失败经历的趣事开场。

senses.example_en: Several small bedrooms opened off the main corridor.
senses.example_zh: 主走廊两侧连通着几间小卧室。

senses.meaning: 向…猛烈开火；对…发起激烈抨击
senses.example_en: The media opened up on the politician following the leaked documents.
senses.example_zh: 文件泄露后，各大媒体对这位政客发起了猛烈抨击。

senses.example_en: The folding partitions open back completely to create one huge hall.
senses.example_zh: 折叠隔板可以完全向后收折，从而形成一个宽敞的大厅。

senses.example_en: She decided to set up her own consulting firm after years in the corporate world.
senses.example_zh: 在企业界打拼多年后，她决定创立自己的咨询公司。

senses.example_en: I'll ask my assistant to set up a conference call for tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 我会让助手安排明天上午的电话会议。

senses.example_en: We arrived at the campsite before sunset and set up the tent.
senses.example_zh: 我们在日落前赶到了露营地并搭建好了帐篷。

senses.example_en: He claimed he was completely innocent and that someone had set him up.
senses.example_zh: 他坚称自己完全是无辜的，是有人设局陷害了他。

senses.example_en: They packed their bags and set off on an epic road trip across the country.
senses.example_zh: 他们收拾好行囊，踏上了横穿全国的壮丽公路之旅。

senses.example_en: Smoke from the burnt toast was enough to set off the fire alarm.
senses.example_zh: 烤糊吐司冒出的烟雾足以触发火灾警报。

senses.example_en: His controversial remark set off a heated debate among the delegates.
senses.example_zh: 他引发争议的言论在代表们中间激起了一场激烈的辩论。

senses.example_en: The dark velvet dress set off her porcelain skin beautifully.
senses.example_zh: 那身深色天鹅绒连衣裙把她如瓷般的肌肤衬托得格外动人。

senses.example_en: The explorers set out for the South Pole at the break of dawn.
senses.example_zh: 探险队员在破晓时分启程前往南极。

senses.meaning: 着手，打算（实现特定目标）
senses.example_en: She never set out to become famous; she just loved painting.
senses.example_zh: 她从未打算成名，她只是纯粹热爱画画。

senses.example_en: The contract clearly sets out the obligations of both parties.
senses.example_zh: 合同中清楚阐明了双方各自的义务。

senses.example_en: He set out all the tools neatly on the workbench before starting repairs.
senses.example_zh: 他在开始维修前把所有工具整齐地陈列在工作台上。

senses.example_en: As soon as she finished unpacking, she set about cleaning the kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 她一拆完行李，就立刻着手清理厨房。

senses.example_en: A gang of thugs set about him as he was walking home through the alley.
senses.example_zh: 他在穿过小巷回家时，遭到了一帮暴徒的殴打。

senses.meaning: 恶劣天气、疾病或消极状态）到来并持续，开始蔓延
senses.example_en: Winter has firmly set in, bringing weeks of freezing temperatures.
senses.example_zh: 寒冬已经真正降临，带来了持续数周的刺骨低温。

senses.example_en: The unexpected supply chain shortage set back production by three months.
senses.example_zh: 意料之外的供应链短缺使生产进度推迟了三个月。

senses.example_en: That luxury watch must have set him back thousands of dollars.
senses.example_zh: 那块名牌手表肯定花了他好几千美元。

senses.example_en: The villa is set back from the main road behind a thick line of trees.
senses.example_zh: 别墅坐落在远离主干道的一排浓密树林之后。

senses.example_en: Try to set aside twenty minutes every day for light exercise.
senses.example_zh: 尽量每天留出二十分钟来进行适度锻炼。

senses.meaning: 把…置于一旁，搁置（分歧、情绪等）
senses.example_en: They agreed to set aside their political differences to solve the crisis.
senses.example_zh: 他们同意暂时搁置政治分歧，携手化解这场危机。

senses.example_en: The appellate court set aside the original verdict due to new evidence.
senses.example_zh: 上诉法院鉴于新的证据撤销了原判。

senses.example_en: She sat at her desk to set down her thoughts in a personal journal.
senses.example_zh: 她坐在书桌前，在个人日记中写下自己的想法。

senses.example_en: Strict safety guidelines have been set down by the regulatory authority.
senses.example_zh: 监管部门已经制定了严格的安全准则。

senses.example_en: The bus driver kindly set the elderly passenger down near her door.
senses.example_zh: 公交司机好心地在那位年长乘客家门附近让她下了车。

senses.example_en: The document sets forth a clear strategy for renewable energy adoption.
senses.example_zh: 该文件阐明了一项采用可再生能源的明确战略。

senses.example_en: The fleet set forth on its voyage across the uncharted ocean.
senses.example_zh: 舰队启程远航，驶向未知的大洋深处。

senses.meaning: 使与众不同，使脱颖而出
senses.example_en: Her meticulous attention to detail sets her apart from other designers.
senses.example_zh: 她对细节的一丝不苟使她在众多设计师中脱颖而出。

senses.example_en: Two rooms were set apart for use as a makeshift clinic.
senses.example_zh: 腾出了两间屋子专门用作临时诊所。

senses.meaning: 袭击，攻击；唆使（狗等）扑向
senses.example_en: The guard threatened to set his dogs on anyone who trespassed.
senses.example_zh: 保安威胁说要放狗扑向任何非法闯入的人。

senses.meaning: 全力以赴干起来，大干起来
senses.example_en: With so much work left, the whole team set to without wasting any time.
senses.example_zh: 剩下这么多工作，整个团队分秒必争地大干了起来。

senses.example_en: After exchanging harsh words, the two drivers set to in the middle of the street.
senses.example_zh: 在互飙难听话后，两名司机在马路中间大打出手。

senses.example_en: He sets by a small portion of his salary every month for a rainy day.
senses.example_zh: 他每个月都会从薪水中存下一小笔钱以备不时之需。

senses.example_en: Don't forget to set your clocks forward one hour for daylight saving time.
senses.example_zh: 别忘了为了夏令时将时钟拨快一小时。

senses.example_en: The minister set forward several proposals to reform the tax system.
senses.example_zh: 部长提出了几项改革税收制度的建议。

senses.example_en: A new project manager was set over the construction division.
senses.example_zh: 一名新项目经理被委任主管施工部门。

senses.example_en: The spokesperson called a press briefing to set the record straight regarding the allegations.
senses.example_zh: 发言人召开了新闻发布会，以澄清针对这些指控的事实真相。

senses.meaning: 把目光投向；立志追求/争取
senses.example_en: Having dominated the national tournament, the swimmer has set her sights on Olympic gold.
senses.example_zh: 在横扫全国锦标赛后，这位游泳选手已将目光锁定在奥运金牌上。

senses.meaning: 板上钉钉；一成不变/不可更改
senses.example_en: These schedule proposals are preliminary, so none of the dates are set in stone yet.
senses.example_zh: 这些日程安排只是初步方案，因此日期都还没板上钉钉。

senses.example_en: The CEO's opening remarks set an optimistic tone for the entire annual summit.
senses.example_zh: 首席执行官的开幕致辞为整场年度峰会定下了乐观积极的基调。

senses.example_en: He had set his heart on studying architecture in Paris ever since childhood.
senses.example_zh: 他从小就一心渴望去巴黎攻读建筑学。

senses.example_en: The interviewer's friendly smile instantly set the nervous candidate at ease.
senses.example_zh: 面试官友善的微笑让紧张的应聘者立刻放松了下来。

senses.meaning: 取得惊人成就；引起轰动（常用于否定句）
senses.example_en: His debut novel won praise, but it hardly set the world on fire commercially.
senses.example_zh: 他的处女作小说获得了好评，但在商业上并未引起太大轰动。

senses.example_en: Senior managers are expected to set an example of punctuality and accountability.
senses.example_zh: 高级管理人员应当在守时和负责方面树立榜样。

senses.example_en: The Supreme Court ruling is likely to set a legal precedent for future privacy cases.
senses.example_zh: 最高法院的裁决很可能会为未来的隐私权案件开创司法先例。

senses.example_en: The committee set a strict deadline of Friday at noon for submitting project bids.
senses.example_zh: 委员会设定了严格的截止日期：周五中午前必须提交项目投标书。

senses.example_en: Protesters set fire to piles of trash outside the embassy during the demonstration.
senses.example_zh: 抗议者在游行示威期间点燃了使馆外的垃圾堆。

senses.example_en: The athlete set a new world record in the 400-meter hurdles yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 这位运动员昨天在400米栏比赛中创下了新的世界纪录。

senses.example_en: New evidence presented by the defense persuaded the judge to set the prisoner free.
senses.example_zh: 辩方出示的新证据促使法官当庭释放了该名囚犯。

senses.example_en: Detectives set an elaborate trap to catch the counterfeiters red-handed.
senses.example_zh: 便衣警探设下周密的圈套，企图将造假分子当场人赃并获。

senses.example_en: The disputed inheritance set brother against brother.
senses.example_zh: 有争议的遗产使得亲兄弟反目成仇。

senses.example_en: The potential gains must be set against the high operational risks.
senses.example_zh: 必须将潜在收益与高昂的运营风险进行权衡。

senses.example_en: I really fucked up on that presentation yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 我昨天的演讲彻底搞砸了。

senses.example_en: He fell off his bike and completely fucked up his shoulder.
senses.example_zh: 他从自行车上摔下来，把肩膀伤得不轻。

senses.meaning: 使精神崩溃，在心理上造成严重伤害
senses.example_en: Growing up in that toxic household really fucked him up.
senses.example_zh: 在那个充满戾气的家庭中长大，给他的心灵造成了极大的创伤。

senses.meaning: 滚开，走开（极不礼貌的驱赶）
senses.example_en: Just fuck off and leave me alone!
senses.example_zh: 赶紧滚开，别来烦我！

senses.meaning: 游手好闲，消磨时间，翘班
senses.example_en: We spent the whole afternoon just fucking off in the park.
senses.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在公园里闲逛打发时间。

senses.example_en: Stop fucking around and finish your homework.
senses.example_zh: 别胡闹了，赶紧去把作业写完。

senses.example_en: She divorced him after she found out he was fucking around.
senses.example_zh: 发现他在外面鬼混乱搞后，她跟他离了婚。

senses.meaning: 瞎摆弄，乱动（机械或物品）
senses.example_en: Don't fuck around with the thermostat; it's set properly.
senses.example_zh: 别乱动恒温器，已经调好了。

senses.example_en: Don't fuck with him; he has a notoriously bad temper.
senses.example_zh: 别去招惹他，他的臭脾气是出了名的。

senses.example_en: Are you being serious, or are you just fucking with me?
senses.example_zh: 你是认真的，还是在故意耍我？

senses.example_en: Who told you to fuck with my computer settings?
senses.example_zh: 谁让你乱动我的电脑设置的？

senses.example_en: His business partner stole the funds and completely fucked him over.
senses.example_zh: 他的商业合伙人卷走了资金，狠狠地坑了他一把。

senses.meaning: 故意耍弄某人，出尔反尔，浪费某人时间
senses.example_en: Stop fucking me around and give me a straight answer.
senses.example_zh: 别再忽悠我了，给我个明确的答复。

senses.example_en: He fucked away his entire inheritance in less than two years.
senses.example_zh: 他不到两年就挥霍光了整笔遗产。

senses.meaning: 仓促且马虎地做完某事；胡乱混过去
senses.example_en: He didn't study at all and just tried to fuck through the exam.
senses.example_zh: 他根本没复习，就想着在考试里胡乱混过去。

senses.meaning: 在乎，介意（常用于否定句或疑问句）
senses.example_en: I honestly don't give a fuck what they think of me.
senses.example_zh: 我真的一点都不在乎他们怎么看我。

senses.meaning: 到底怎么回事；搞什么鬼（表达极度震惊或愤怒）
senses.example_en: What the fuck is going on out there?
senses.example_zh: 外头到底搞什么鬼？

senses.meaning: 一无所有，屁都没有；毫无作用
senses.example_en: I worked all day and got fuck all to show for it.
senses.example_zh: 我辛苦干了一整天，结果什么都没拿到。

senses.example_en: Shut the fuck up and listen to what I'm saying.
senses.example_zh: 闭上你的臭嘴，听我把话说完。

senses.meaning: 去他的，算了（表示放弃、厌烦或听天由命）
senses.example_en: Fuck it, let's just go home and forget about the party.
senses.example_zh: 去他的，咱们直接回家吧，别管那个派对了。

senses.meaning: 极其，非常（口语强化副词短语）
senses.example_en: It's cold as fuck outside, so put on a warm coat.
senses.example_zh: 外面冷得要命，穿件暖和的大衣吧。

collocations.phrase: scare the fuck out of sb

senses.example_en: That sudden loud noise scared the fuck out of me.
senses.example_zh: 那声巨响把我的魂都快吓飞了。

collocations.phrase: beat the fuck out of sb

senses.example_en: They threatened to beat the fuck out of him if he talked.
senses.example_zh: 他们威胁说如果他敢走漏风声，就打断他的腿。

collocations.phrase: annoy / bother the fuck out of sb

senses.meaning: 把某人烦死；极度惹恼某人
senses.example_en: His constant complaining annoys the fuck out of everyone.
senses.example_zh: 他没完没了的抱怨快把所有人都烦死了。

senses.example_en: A single mistake could fuck up the whole operation completely.
senses.example_zh: 一个细小的疏忽就可能把整项行动彻底毁掉。

senses.example_en: We were freezing the fuck out waiting for the delayed bus.
senses.example_zh: 等那趟晚点的公交车时，我们快被冻成冰棍了。

senses.example_en: The teacher told the students to group up in pairs for the assignment.
senses.example_zh: 老师让学生们两人一组组队完成这项作业。

senses.example_en: The children grouped around the storyteller, eager to hear the tale.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们围在讲故事的人身旁，急切地想听故事。

senses.example_en: In the catalog, all of these items are grouped under 'Office Supplies'.
senses.example_zh: 在商品目录中，所有这些物品都被归在“办公用品”一类。

senses.example_en: You can group the search results by date or relevance.
senses.example_zh: 你可以按照日期或相关度对搜索结果进行分组。

senses.meaning: 分批分开，分成若干小队分别行动
senses.example_en: The volunteers grouped off to search different sections of the forest.
senses.example_zh: 志愿者们分成几个小组，前往森林的不同区域进行搜寻。

senses.meaning: 与……归为一组；把……与……归并在一起
senses.example_en: In this demographic study, teenagers are grouped with young adults.
senses.example_zh: 在这项人口学研究中，青少年与青年人被归并为同一组。

senses.meaning: 集体努力；团队合作成果
senses.example_en: Winning this championship was truly a group effort.
senses.example_zh: 赢得这次锦标赛确实是整个团队共同努力的结果。

senses.meaning: 群体动力学；团队人际互动关系
senses.example_en: The manager needs to understand the group dynamics before assigning roles.
senses.example_zh: 经理在分派角色之前需要先摸清团队的人际互动情况。

senses.meaning: 群体盲思（因屈从团队共识而缺乏独立判断）
senses.example_en: The board's disastrous decision was a classic case of groupthink.
senses.example_zh: 董事会灾难性的决定是典型的群体盲思产物。

senses.example_en: It took several months for the newcomer to really feel part of the group.
senses.example_zh: 新来的人花了几个月的时间才真正感觉自己融入了这个集体。

senses.example_en: This educational program is tailored specifically for the 6-to-12 age group.
senses.example_zh: 这个教育项目是专门为6至12岁年龄段儿童量身打造的。

senses.example_en: The teacher asked the class to break into small groups for discussion.
senses.example_zh: 老师让全班分成若干小组进行讨论。

senses.example_en: Local residents formed a support group to help flood victims.
senses.example_zh: 当地居民成立了一个互助小组来帮助洪灾灾民。

senses.meaning: 按类别对某物进行归类
senses.example_en: The librarian grouped the new books by subject category.
senses.example_zh: 图书管理员按主题门类对新书进行了归类。

senses.example_en: Adolescents are heavily influenced by the opinions of their peer group.
senses.example_zh: 青少年深受其同辈群体观点的影响。

senses.example_en: We conducted a focus group to gather customer feedback on the new prototype.
senses.example_zh: 我们组织了一次焦点小组访谈，以收集客户对新原型的反馈。

senses.example_en: Young urban professionals are the primary target group for this product.
senses.example_zh: 年轻的都市白领是该产品的主要目标受众。

senses.example_en: The cold wind made the hikers group together for warmth.
senses.example_zh: 寒风让徒步旅行者们聚拢在一起取暖。

senses.example_en: We can group these smaller expenses together under travel costs.
senses.example_zh: 我们可以把这些零碎开支统统归并到差旅费项下。

senses.example_en: The participants were grouped into three different age brackets.
senses.example_zh: 参与者被分成了三个不同的年龄段。

senses.meaning: 常用于被动语态）借调到，临时调派至（另一部门、机构或地点
senses.example_en: The senior engineer was seconded to the regional office to oversee the construction project.
senses.example_zh: 这位资深工程师被借调到区域办事处，负责统筹该建筑工程。

senses.meaning: 会议中）正式附议某动议；（日常口语中）强烈赞同提议
senses.example_en: "I move that we take a short lunch break." — "I'll second the motion!"
senses.example_zh: “我提议我们休息片刻去吃午饭。”——“我举双手赞成！”

senses.meaning: 附议；完全同意前面所说的话
senses.example_en: "That was the best presentation of the conference." — "I definitely second that."
senses.example_zh: “那是整个会议上最精彩的演示。”——“我绝对赞同。”

senses.meaning: 事后诸葛亮般）妄加揣测；事后批评质疑
senses.example_en: It is easy for critics to second-guess the manager's tactical decisions after the match.
senses.example_zh: 赛后批评人士轻而易举就能对主教练的战术布置指手画脚、评头论足。

senses.example_en: A committee member must second the motion before a formal vote can take place.
senses.example_zh: 在进行正式表决之前，必须有一名委员会成员附议该动议。

senses.example_en: She stood up to second the nomination of her colleague for the board seat.
senses.example_zh: 她站起身来，附议支持其同事担任董事会席位的提名。

senses.example_en: Several delegates rose immediately to second the environmental proposal.
senses.example_zh: 数名代表立即起立附议该环保提案。

senses.example_en: He was seconded abroad to lead the humanitarian mission in Geneva for six months.
senses.example_zh: 他被临时借调到海外，在日内瓦主管人道主义行动达六个月。

senses.meaning: 用牵索或钢丝绳拉紧固定（桅杆、帐篷、构架等）
senses.example_en: The maintenance crew had to guy up the radio tower before high winds arrived.
senses.example_zh: 大风来临前，维护人员必须用拉线把无线电塔固定牢固。

senses.meaning: 英，旧/口）打扮得古怪滑稽；嘲弄装扮
senses.example_en: The children guyed themselves up in ridiculous hats and old coats for the parade.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们戴着滑稽的帽子、穿着旧大衣，把自己扮成怪模样去参加游行。

senses.meaning: 用牵拉索向外侧撑开或拉紧固定
senses.example_en: Make sure you guy out the main tent poles securely into the soft ground.
senses.example_zh: 务必用防风绳将帐篷的主支柱牢牢地向外拉紧并固定在松软的地面上。

senses.example_en: The junior manager realized he was being set up as the fall guy for the firm's accounting fraud.
senses.example_zh: 那位初级经理意识到自己正被推出去当公司财务造假的替罪羊。

senses.meaning: 自作聪明的人；狂妄自大者
senses.example_en: Don't get smart with me, wise guy.
senses.example_zh: 别跟我耍聪明，自作聪明的家伙。

senses.meaning: 平易近人的普通人；厚道实在的人
senses.example_en: Despite his immense fortune, the billionaire behaves like a regular guy.
senses.example_zh: 尽管拥有巨额财富，这位亿万富翁待人接物却像个普通的实在人。

senses.meaning: 正直靠得住的人；讲义气的人
senses.example_en: You can always count on Mark in a crisis; he is a real stand-up guy.
senses.example_zh: 危急时刻你永远可以信任马克，他是个非常正直靠得住的人。

senses.example_en: He likes to play the tough guy, but deep down he has a gentle heart.
senses.example_zh: 他总喜欢扮硬汉，但内心深处其实很温柔。

senses.example_en: He is a genuinely nice guy who never hesitates to lend a hand.
senses.example_zh: 他是个真正的大好人，从不吝啬施以援手。

senses.example_en: The actor became famous after playing the bad guy in several action thrillers.
senses.example_zh: 在几部动作惊悚片中出演反派后，这位演员一举成名。

senses.example_en: The shop is run by a local guy who knows everyone in the neighborhood.
senses.example_zh: 这家店由一个熟悉街坊邻居每一个人的本地小伙经营。

senses.example_en: Let's meet up for coffee sometime next week.
senses.example_zh: 下周找个时间我们碰头喝杯咖啡吧。

senses.meaning: 遭遇，遭到，蒙受（反对、批评、挫折等）
senses.example_en: The proposal met with fierce opposition from local residents.
senses.example_zh: 这项提议遭到了当地居民的强烈反对。

senses.example_en: The foreign minister will meet with his counterpart tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 外交部长将于明天与对方同行举行正式会晤。

senses.example_en: I'm going to meet up with some old classmates after work.
senses.example_zh: 下班后我要和几个老同学碰个头。

senses.example_en: On my travels, I met up with a group of backpackers from Japan.
senses.example_zh: 在旅行途中，我偶遇了一群来自日本的背包客。

senses.meaning: 到车站、机场等）接（下车/下飞机的）人
senses.example_en: Could you meet me off the train at five o'clock?
senses.example_zh: 你能在五点钟去火车站接我下车吗？

senses.meaning: 返回原处碰头，重新集合
senses.example_en: Everyone explore on your own, and let's meet back here at noon.
senses.example_zh: 大家各自自由活动，中午再回到这里集合。

senses.example_en: With rising living costs, many young families struggle to make ends meet.
senses.example_zh: 随着生活成本攀升，许多年轻家庭难以维持收支平衡。

senses.meaning: 迁就某人；各让半步；达成妥协
senses.example_en: If you are willing to lower the price slightly, we can meet you halfway on the delivery date.
senses.example_zh: 如果你方愿意稍作降价，我们可以在交货日期上做出让步。

idioms.phrase: more (to sth) than meets the eye

senses.meaning: 别有内情；表面之下另有玄机；并不像看上去那么简单
senses.example_en: Don't dismiss his strange behavior; there is definitely more to this than meets the eye.
senses.example_zh: 别对他的反常举动不以为意，这事情肯定远没有表面那么简单。

senses.example_en: The reigning champion finally met his match in yesterday's intense final.
senses.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在昨天的激烈决赛中终于遇到了旗鼓相当的劲敌。

senses.meaning: 惨遭覆灭；遭到毁灭性打击
senses.example_en: The tech startup met its Waterloo when a major competitor launched a free alternative.
senses.example_zh: 当一家巨头竞争对手推出同类免费产品时，这家科技初创公司遭遇了滑铁卢。

senses.example_en: The old sailor felt his time had come to meet his maker.
senses.example_zh: 老水手感到自己大限已到，该去见上帝了。

senses.meaning: 赶上截止日期；按期完成
senses.example_en: The team worked around the clock to meet the strict project deadline.
senses.example_zh: 团队日夜连轴转以赶上项目紧迫的截止日期。

senses.example_en: Applicants must meet all the academic criteria before being considered for an interview.
senses.example_zh: 申请者必须先符合所有学术标准，才会进入面试考量。

senses.meaning: 达到某人的期望；满足预期
senses.example_en: The final cut of the film failed to meet the critics' high expectations.
senses.example_zh: 这部电影的最终公映版未能达到影评人们的高期望。

senses.example_en: The healthcare system has shown remarkable resilience in meeting the challenge.
senses.example_zh: 该医疗体系在应对这一挑战时展现出了非凡的韧性。

senses.meaning: 直视某人的双眼；与某人目光相接
senses.example_en: She was too ashamed to meet her father's eyes after confessing the truth.
senses.example_zh: 坦白真相之后，她羞愧得不敢直视父亲的双眼。

senses.example_en: The scholarship is designed to help gifted students meet the cost of tuition.
senses.example_zh: 该奖学金旨在帮助有天赋的学生承担学费开支。

senses.example_en: The committee members meet together once a month to review progress.
senses.example_zh: 委员会成员每月聚拢一次，审议工作进展。

senses.meaning: 逐步建立，创立（事业、财富等）
senses.example_en: She spent twenty years building up a successful cosmetics business.
senses.example_zh: 她花了二十年时间白手起家建立起一家成功的化妆品企业。

senses.meaning: 增强，加强（体质、信心、声誉等）
senses.example_en: Regular exercise will help build up your immune system.
senses.example_zh: 规律锻炼有助于增强你的免疫系统。

senses.meaning: 逐渐聚集，积聚（压力、交通、情绪等）
senses.example_en: Traffic begins to build up on the highway around 5 PM.
senses.example_zh: 下午五点左右，高速公路上的车流开始积聚拥堵。

senses.example_en: The movie was built up so much by the media that it ended up disappointing audiences.
senses.example_zh: 这部电影被媒体吹得神乎其神，结果反而让观众大失所望。

senses.meaning: 以……为基础，在……基础上进一步发展
