senses.example_zh: 这项研究帮助科学家深入了解了该病毒是如何变异的。

senses.meaning: 按规则、义务或约定）应当，理应
senses.example_en: You are supposed to submit your completed assignment by Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 你应当在周五下午之前提交写完的作业。

senses.example_en: This historic castle is supposed to be haunted by an ancient knight.
senses.example_zh: 据说这座历史悠久的城堡里经常有一名古代骑士的鬼魂出没。

senses.meaning: 本打算，原定（多用于过去时或否定句，表未能按计划实现）
senses.example_en: It was supposed to be a surprise party, but somebody leaked the secret.
senses.example_zh: 这本该是个惊喜派对，但有人泄露了秘密。

senses.meaning: 我想是吧（表示不情愿、不确定或勉强的赞同）
senses.example_en: 'Can we leave the cleanup until tomorrow?' 'I suppose so, if you're too exhausted.'
senses.example_zh: “我们能把打扫留到明天吗？”“我想也行吧，如果你实在太累的话。”

idioms.phrase: what is that supposed to mean?

senses.meaning: 那到底是什么意思？（用于表达被冒犯、质疑或不满情绪）
senses.example_en: What is that supposed to mean? Are you insinuating that I took the money?
senses.example_zh: 那到底是什么意思？你是在影射我拿了那笔钱吗？

senses.meaning: 被普遍认为；被广泛假定
senses.example_en: It is widely supposed that the CEO will announce her retirement at the annual meeting.
senses.example_zh: 外界普遍推测首席执行官将在年会上宣布退休。

senses.meaning: 合乎情理地推断 / 假定
senses.example_en: One can reasonably suppose that higher prices will eventually curb consumer demand.
senses.example_zh: 人们完全可以合理地推测，价格上涨终将抑制消费需求。

senses.example_en: Detectives have good reason to suppose that the suspect has fled abroad.
senses.example_zh: 刑警有充分理由相信嫌疑人已经逃往国外。

senses.example_en: Suppose for a moment that their projections are wrong; what is our backup plan?
senses.example_zh: 设想一下如果他们的预测全错了，我们的备用方案是什么？

senses.example_en: The launch date has been pushed back to November.
senses.example_zh: 发布日期已被推迟到十一月。

senses.example_en: Employees pushed back against the new overtime policy.
senses.example_zh: 员工们对新的加班政策表示了抵制。

senses.example_en: Environmental groups are pushing for stricter carbon regulations.
senses.example_zh: 环保组织正在极力争取更严格的碳排放法规。

senses.meaning: 强行促成，匆忙通过（法律、议案或方案）
senses.example_en: The government managed to push through the controversial reform bill.
senses.example_zh: 政府设法强行通过了这项有争议的改革法案。

senses.example_en: Despite the budget cuts, the team decided to push forward with the research.
senses.example_zh: 尽管预算遭到削减，团队仍决定继续推进该项研究。

senses.example_en: Don't let them push you around; you have rights as a tenant.
senses.example_zh: 别让他们摆布你；作为租客你也是有权利的。

senses.example_en: It was getting dark, but we pushed on to reach the shelter before nightfall.
senses.example_zh: 天色渐暗，但我们继续赶路，以便在入夜前到达避难所。

senses.example_en: The founder was gradually pushed out of the company by the board.
senses.example_zh: 创始人逐渐被董事会排挤出了公司。

senses.example_en: You've done well so far, but don't push your luck by demanding a huge bonus.
senses.example_zh: 你目前表现不错，但别得寸进尺要求巨额奖金。

senses.meaning: 挑战极限，突破界限，开拓创新
senses.example_en: Their latest aircraft design really pushes the envelope of fuel efficiency.
senses.example_zh: 他们最新的飞机设计真正突破了燃油效率的极限。

senses.meaning: 在紧要关头，到了摊牌的关键时刻
senses.example_en: When push comes to shove, family members should always support one another.
senses.example_zh: 在紧要关头，家人之间应该始终相互支持。

senses.meaning: 投其所好，应对得当，切中要害
senses.example_en: The candidate pushed all the right buttons during the town hall debate.
senses.example_zh: 那位候选人在市民辩论会上切中要害，深得人心。

senses.example_en: The artist continuously pushes the boundaries of traditional sculpture.
senses.example_zh: 这位艺术家不断打破传统雕塑的界限。

senses.example_en: There is a slight market dip, but there's no reason to push the panic button.
senses.example_zh: 市场出现微小下跌，但完全没必要惊慌失措。

senses.example_en: The grueling training schedule pushed every athlete to the limit.
senses.example_zh: 高强度的训练日程把每位运动员都逼到了极限。

senses.example_en: The union is pushing hard for a four-day workweek.
senses.example_zh: 工会正在大力争取四天工作制。

senses.example_en: They had to paint over the graffiti on the brick wall.
senses.example_zh: 他们只得用涂料把砖墙上的涂鸦覆盖掉。

senses.meaning: 用油漆涂抹掉（字迹或污迹）
senses.example_en: The company name on the van had been crudely painted out.
senses.example_zh: 货车上的公司名称被粗糙地用油漆涂抹掉了。

senses.example_en: The artist later decided to paint in a small boat in the background.
senses.example_zh: 画家后来决定在背景中添画上一只小船。

senses.example_en: After submitting their final exams, the students went out to paint the town red.
senses.example_zh: 交完期末考卷后，学生们外出狂欢痛饮了一番。

senses.meaning: 一概而论，粗枝大叶地概括
senses.example_en: It is unfair to paint the entire generation with such a broad brush.
senses.example_zh: 对整整一代人进行如此一概而论的概括是不公平的。

idioms.phrase: paint someone in a bad light

senses.meaning: 把某人描绘得很糟，抹黑某人
senses.example_en: The interview was heavily edited to paint the senator in a bad light.
senses.example_zh: 采访录像经过大量剪辑，把参议员描绘得十分不堪。

idioms.phrase: not as black as it is painted

senses.meaning: 没有传闻描绘的那么糟
senses.example_en: The economic situation is challenging, but it is not as black as it is painted.
senses.example_zh: 经济形势确实严峻，但绝没有传说的那么可怕。

senses.example_en: Her detailed memoir paints a vivid picture of wartime London.
senses.example_zh: 她详实的回忆录生动再现了战时伦敦的景象。

senses.meaning: 粉饰太平，描绘美好乐观的前景
senses.example_en: The executive tried to paint a rosy picture of the company's financial health.
senses.example_zh: 那位高管试图将公司的财务状况描绘得一片大好。

senses.example_en: The United Nations report paints a grim picture of escalating food insecurity.
senses.example_zh: 联合国报告对日益加剧的粮食危机描绘了一幅令人堪忧的图景。

senses.example_en: We decided to paint a fresh coat of white on the kitchen cabinets.
senses.example_zh: 我们决定给厨房橱柜重新刷上一层白漆。

senses.meaning: 增加员工，扩充人员编制
senses.example_en: The customer service department is staffing up ahead of the holiday shopping rush.
senses.example_zh: 客服部门在假日购物高峰来临前正在增加人手。

senses.meaning: 从上到下全员配置（彻底配备）
senses.example_en: The new facility must be staffed from top to bottom before the opening inspection.
senses.example_zh: 在开业检查之前，新设施必须从上到下全员配备到位。

senses.meaning: 全员配备齐全，人员齐备
senses.example_en: The intensive care unit is currently fully staffed with certified specialists.
senses.example_zh: 重症监护室目前配齐了持证专科医护人员。

senses.example_en: Volunteers took turns to staff the promotional booth at the fair.
senses.example_zh: 志愿者们轮流在博览会的宣传展位值守。

senses.meaning: 负责值守接听电话（热线）
senses.example_en: Extra operators were called in to staff the phones during the emergency.
senses.example_zh: 紧急事件发生期间，额外召集了话务员负责接听热线。

senses.example_en: Management promised that the night shift would remain adequately staffed.
senses.example_zh: 管理层承诺夜班会保持充足的人员配置。

senses.example_en: We need experienced data engineers to staff this critical initiative.
senses.example_zh: 我们需要经验丰富的数据工程师来为这个关键项目配备人手。

senses.example_en: We need to arrange a meeting to sort out these budget discrepancies.
senses.example_zh: 我们需要安排一次会议来解决这些预算不一致的问题。

senses.meaning: 整理，收拾（混乱的地方或物品）
senses.example_en: I spent the entire weekend sorting out the garage.
senses.example_zh: 我花了一整个周末整理车库。

senses.meaning: 惩治，教训（不守规矩的人）（英式非正式）
senses.example_en: If he carries on causing trouble, somebody is going to sort him out.
senses.example_zh: 如果他继续惹麻烦，迟早会有人来收拾他。

senses.meaning: 翻查，翻找（在大量物品中寻找所需之物）
senses.example_en: She spent hours sorting through boxes of old family photographs.
senses.example_zh: 她花了数小时翻检那几箱老家庭照片。

senses.meaning: 从……中挑选出来/区分开来
senses.example_en: The machine sorts out the recyclable plastics from regular waste.
senses.example_zh: 这台机器从常规垃圾中分拣出可回收塑料。

senses.meaning: 有几分；有点儿；在某种程度上
senses.example_en: I sort of thought you might say that.
senses.example_zh: 我隐约料到你可能会那么说。

senses.meaning: 勉强称得上的；某种劣质或不怎么样的
senses.example_en: They offered us a bed of sorts, which was actually just a foam mattress on the floor.
senses.example_zh: 他们给我们提供了一张勉强算作床的东西，其实只是铺在地板上的泡沫床垫。

idioms.phrase: sort your life out / get sorted

senses.meaning: 把生活理顺；振作起来，恢复正常生活状态
senses.example_en: He really needs to stop partying every night and sort his life out.
senses.example_zh: 他真得停止夜夜笙歌，把自己的生活好好理顺了。

senses.example_en: The files are sorted alphabetically by author surname.
senses.example_zh: 文件按作者姓氏的首字母顺序排列。

senses.meaning: 垃圾分类；分拣可回收物
senses.example_en: Residents are strictly required to sort their household waste.
senses.example_zh: 居民被严格要求对生活垃圾进行分类。

senses.example_en: Click the header to sort the columns in descending order.
senses.example_zh: 点击表头可将各列按降序排列。

senses.meaning: 把……分类放入；归类整理成
senses.example_en: The donations were sorted into piles of clothes, toys, and books.
senses.example_zh: 捐赠物品被分成了衣物、玩具和书籍几大堆。

senses.meaning: 分离出；提炼出；把……单独分流出来
senses.example_en: The centrifuge separates out the red blood cells from the plasma.
senses.example_zh: 离心机将红细胞从血浆中分离出来。

senses.meaning: 区分出，剖析出（复杂事物中的某一部分）
senses.example_en: It is difficult to separate out the effects of diet from genetics.
senses.example_zh: 很难把饮食习惯的影响与遗传因素单独剥离开来。

senses.meaning: 把……隔开；划分出独立区域
senses.example_en: A tall glass partition separates off the dining area from the kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 一扇高大的玻璃隔断将就餐区与厨房分隔开来。

idioms.phrase: separate the wheat from the chaff

senses.meaning: 去粗取精；辨别优劣；挑出真正有价值之物
senses.example_en: The rigorous audition process helped separate the wheat from the chaff.
senses.example_zh: 严格的试镜流程有助于去粗取精、选拔出真正的人才。

idioms.phrase: separate the men from the boys

senses.meaning: 考验真正实力；见真章（区分坚强者与平庸者）
senses.example_en: A high-stakes pitch under immense pressure will soon separate the men from the boys.
senses.example_zh: 在巨大压力下的关键提案竞争很快就能看出谁才是真正的强者。

senses.meaning: 分道扬镳；各奔前程；（夫妻或搭档）散伙
senses.example_en: After years of artistic differences, the band members decided to go their separate ways.
senses.example_zh: 经过多年的艺术分歧后，乐队成员决定分道扬镳。

senses.example_en: A good journalist must learn to separate fact from fiction.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的记者必须学会区分事实与虚构。

senses.example_en: Bake the cake until the edges separate cleanly from the pan.
senses.example_zh: 把蛋糕烤到边缘能与烤盘干净利落地剥离为止。

senses.example_en: The referee stepped in to separate the two fighters forcibly.
senses.example_zh: 裁判介入强行将两名拳手分开。

senses.meaning: 拉开很大差距；相隔甚远
senses.example_en: The two candidates are separated by only a handful of votes.
senses.example_zh: 两位候选人之间仅相差寥寥数票。

senses.meaning: 与……分开；脱离（整体或某人）
senses.example_en: During the tour, a child separated from the group and got lost.
senses.example_zh: 在旅行途中，一个孩子与大部队走散并迷了路。

senses.meaning: 分成，分割为（若干组或部分）
senses.example_en: The teacher separated the students into four discussion groups.
senses.example_zh: 老师把学生们分成了四个讨论小组。

senses.meaning: 常带讽刺）讲人尽皆知的事情；自以为发现了新大陆
senses.example_en: He announced that regular exercise improves health, as if he had just discovered America.
senses.example_zh: 他宣称经常锻炼有益健康，搞得像自己刚发现了新大陆一样。

senses.meaning: 重新发明轮子；做无谓的重复劳动
senses.example_en: Instead of rediscovering the wheel, let's use an established open-source framework.
senses.example_zh: 我们别再去重复造轮子了，直接用成熟的开源框架吧。

senses.example_en: Researchers are working tirelessly to discover a cure for Alzheimer's disease.
senses.example_zh: 研究人员正不知疲倦地工作，以期发现治疗阿尔茨海默病的方法。

senses.example_en: She was horrified when she eventually discovered the truth behind the accident.
senses.example_zh: 当她最终发现事故背后的真相时，感到非常震惊。

senses.example_en: The indie film festival has a long history of discovering fresh talent.
senses.example_zh: 该独立电影节在发掘新锐人才方面历史悠久。

senses.example_en: Penicillin was accidentally discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928.
senses.example_zh: 青霉素是亚历山大·弗莱明于1928年偶然发现的。

senses.example_en: The missing hikers were miraculously discovered unharmed in a secluded cave.
senses.example_zh: 失踪的徒步旅行者在一个隐蔽的山洞里被奇迹般地发现，安然无恙。

senses.example_en: I could tell you the rules, but it is better if you discover them for yourself.
senses.example_zh: 我可以把规则告诉你，但如果是你自己去发现领悟会更好。

senses.meaning: 加速，加快步伐/行驶速度
senses.example_en: The train began to speed up once it cleared the city limits.
senses.example_zh: 列车一驶出城市边界便开始加速。

senses.example_en: New automation software helped to speed up the manufacturing process.
senses.example_zh: 新的自动化软件有助于加快制造流程。

senses.meaning: 驾车等）疾驰而去，飞速驶离
senses.example_en: The getaway car sped off down a narrow alley before police could arrive.
senses.example_zh: 逃逸车辆在警方赶到之前便顺着一条狭窄的小巷疾驰而去。

senses.meaning: 快速完成，匆匆通过（程序、任务、法案等）
senses.example_en: The committee decided to speed through the agenda to finish before noon.
senses.example_zh: 委员会决定迅速过一遍议程，以便在中午前结束。

senses.example_en: The express train sped through the small station without stopping.
senses.example_zh: 特快列车呼啸穿过小站，没有停留。

senses.meaning: 迅速逃离，疾驰离开现场
senses.example_en: Witnesses saw two suspects jump on a motorbike and speed away.
senses.example_zh: 目击者看到两名嫌疑人跳上一辆摩托车后飞速逃离。

senses.meaning: 迅速推进，高速平稳行进
senses.example_en: The boat sped along the smooth surface of the lake.
senses.example_zh: 小船在平静的湖面上飞速疾驰。

senses.meaning: 了解最新情况；达到标准运转水平
senses.example_en: It took the new manager a couple of weeks to get fully up to speed on the project.
senses.example_zh: 新经理花了两周时间才完全熟悉该项目的最新进展。

senses.meaning: 以惊人的速度，极其危险地飞速
senses.example_en: Technology has been developing at breakneck speed over the past decade.
senses.example_zh: 在过去的十年里，技术一直以惊人的速度迅猛发展。

senses.example_en: Don't rush through your proofreading—more haste, less speed.
senses.example_zh: 别匆匆忙忙地校对——欲速则不达。

senses.example_en: The factory is operating at full speed to meet the holiday rush.
senses.example_zh: 工厂正在全速运转以应对假期的订单高峰。

senses.example_en: He received a heavy fine for driving 30 miles over the legal speed limit.
senses.example_zh: 他因超速30英里驾车而被处以重罚。

senses.example_en: The bicycle gathered speed as it coasted down the steep incline.
senses.example_zh: 自行车顺着陡坡滑下时速度越来越快。

senses.example_en: The paramedics worked at top speed to stabilize the injured passenger.
senses.example_zh: 急救人员以最快的速度抢救，以稳定受伤乘客的伤情。

senses.example_en: Drivers were advised to reduce speed significantly in foggy conditions.
senses.example_zh: 建议司机在有雾的情况下大幅减速行驶。

senses.meaning: 物色；特意寻找并找到（某人或某物）
senses.example_en: She always seeks out talented young writers and helps them get published.
senses.example_zh: 她总是特意物色有才华的年轻作家，并帮助他们发表作品。

senses.example_en: You need to seek out new opportunities rather than waiting for them to come to you.
senses.example_zh: 你必须主动去寻找新机会，而不是坐等机会上门。

senses.meaning: 追求；孜孜以求（名利、真理等，常用于被动或书面语）
senses.example_en: He spent his entire youth seeking after wealth and social status.
senses.example_zh: 他把整个青春都耗费在追求财富与社会地位上。

senses.meaning: 闯荡天下以求发迹；外出谋生
senses.example_en: Like many young men of his generation, he left home to seek his fortune in the capital.
senses.example_zh: 像同辈的许多年轻人一样，他离开家乡前往首都闯荡谋生。

senses.meaning: 寻找就寻见；皇天不负有心人（源自《圣经》）
senses.example_en: Don't give up on finding the truth—remember, seek and ye shall find.
senses.example_zh: 别放弃探寻真相——记住，皇天不负有心人。

senses.example_en: You should definitely seek legal advice before signing any contract.
senses.example_zh: 在签署任何合同之前，你务必要寻求法律建议。

senses.example_en: Filming inside the museum requires you to seek permission well in advance.
senses.example_zh: 在博物馆内拍摄需要提前征得许可。

senses.example_en: Thousands of refugees crossed the border to seek asylum from the war.
senses.example_zh: 数以千计的难民越过边境，寻求躲避战火的庇护。

senses.example_en: Both nations agreed to set aside their differences and seek common ground.
senses.example_zh: 两国同意搁置分歧，寻求共同利益点。

senses.meaning: 向……逼近；挺进（常具威胁性或军事行动）
senses.example_en: The rebel troops were advancing on the capital from two different directions.
senses.example_zh: 叛军正从两个不同方向向首都逼近。

senses.meaning: 晋级到（下一轮）；晋升至（更高阶段或职位）
senses.example_en: With yesterday's decisive victory, the national team advanced to the finals.
senses.example_zh: 凭借昨天的决定性胜利，国家队顺利晋级决赛。

senses.example_en: Tickets for the concert must be purchased in advance.
senses.example_zh: 音乐会门票必须提前购买。

senses.meaning: 年事已高；渐入暮年（较委婉说法）
senses.example_en: As my grandfather advanced in years, he began spending more time in the garden.
senses.example_zh: 随着祖父年事渐高，他开始把更多时间花在打理花园上。

senses.example_en: Her dedicated research did much to advance the cause of environmental protection.
senses.example_zh: 她专注的研究极大地推进了环境保护事业的发展。

senses.example_en: The professor advanced a novel theory to explain the cosmic phenomenon.
senses.example_zh: 这位教授提出了一种新颖的理论来解释这一宇宙现象。

senses.meaning: 促进个人职业生涯发展
senses.example_en: Learning new technical skills is the most reliable way to advance your career.
senses.example_zh: 掌握新技术是促进职业发展最稳妥的途径。

senses.meaning: 显著取得进展/大幅向前发展
senses.example_en: Medical technology has advanced significantly over the past two decades.
senses.example_zh: 在过去的二十年里，医疗技术取得了显著的发展。

senses.example_en: The publishing company agreed to advance him five thousand dollars on royalties.
senses.example_zh: 出版公司同意向他预付五千美元的版税。

senses.meaning: 用……替换/替代原有事物或人
senses.example_en: The IT department decided to replace the outdated desktop computers with high-end laptops.
senses.example_zh: 信息技术部决定用高端笔记本电脑全面替换过时的台式机。

senses.meaning: 被……取代/换掉（常用于被动语态）
senses.example_en: Manual labor in the factory is gradually being replaced by automated assembly robots.
senses.example_zh: 工厂里的人工作业正逐渐被自动化装配机器人所取代。

senses.meaning: ……是无可替代的；任何人或物都无法弥补……
senses.example_en: While the firm hired a new CEO, there is no replacing his visionary leadership.
senses.example_zh: 虽然公司聘请了新CEO，但他那富有远见的领导力是无可替代的。

senses.meaning: 难以取代；地位举足轻重
senses.example_en: Her deep institutional memory and technical expertise make her extremely hard to replace.
senses.example_zh: 她对机构运作的深刻了解和精湛的专业技能使她极难被取代。

senses.example_en: If the remote control stops responding, you just need to replace the battery.
senses.example_zh: 如果遥控器没有反应，你只需要更换电池即可。

senses.meaning: 接替某人担任（职务或角色）
senses.example_en: She was chosen to replace David as head of the marketing department.
senses.example_zh: 她被选定接替戴维出任市场部负责人。

senses.example_en: The mechanic had to replace several damaged parts before the car was safe to drive.
senses.example_zh: 技工不得不更换几个损坏的零部件，车子才能够安全上路。

senses.example_en: Renewable energy sources are expected to gradually replace fossil fuels over the coming decades.
senses.example_zh: 预计在未来几十年内，可再生能源将逐步取代化石燃料。

senses.meaning: 极度缺乏，急需（尤指资金、时间、资源）
senses.example_en: With the sudden loss of tourism revenue, local businesses are hurting for cash.
senses.example_zh: 由于旅游收入的锐减，当地企业极度缺乏现金。

idioms.phrase: it wouldn't hurt (someone) to do something

senses.meaning: 做某事也无妨，不妨做某事（常用于提出委婉或带不满的建议）
senses.example_en: It wouldn't hurt you to say thank you once in a while.
senses.example_zh: 你偶尔说声谢谢又不会掉块肉。

senses.example_en: I sprained my ankle during the run, and it hurts like hell.
senses.example_zh: 我跑步时扭伤了脚踝，疼得要命。

senses.meaning: 巨大的麻烦，深重的困境
senses.example_en: If we miss this critical project deadline, our department will be in a world of hurt.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们错过了这个关键的项目截止期，我们部门将会面临巨大的麻烦。

idioms.phrase: what you don't know can't hurt you

senses.meaning: 不知者不受其害，眼不见心不烦
senses.example_en: I decided not to tell him about the minor mistake; what he doesn't know can't hurt him.
senses.example_zh: 我决定不把那个小错误告诉他；不知者不伤神。

senses.example_en: Several passengers were badly hurt in the highway collision.
senses.example_zh: 几名乘客在公路相撞事故中受了重伤。

senses.meaning: 伤某人的感情，伤害某人的自尊心
senses.example_en: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings; I was just offering honest feedback.
senses.example_zh: 我不是故意要伤你的感情，我只是想给你真实的反馈。

senses.meaning: 损害某人的胜算或机会
senses.example_en: Arriving late to the final interview significantly hurt his chances of getting the job.
senses.example_zh: 终面迟到大大降低了他获得这份工作的几率。

senses.meaning: 在经济上蒙受损失或承受困难
senses.example_en: Independent contractors were hurt financially during the prolonged lockdown.
senses.example_zh: 自由职业者在漫长的封控期间经济上受到了很大打击。

senses.example_en: Hydrogen combines with oxygen under the right conditions to form water.
senses.example_zh: 在适当条件下，氢气与氧气化合形成水。

senses.meaning: 多种因素）兼具，交织在一起
senses.example_en: Her deep technical knowledge combines with exceptional leadership skills.
senses.example_zh: 她深厚的技术专长与卓越的领导才能融为一体。

senses.meaning: 公私兼顾，寓工作于娱乐
senses.example_en: Since the conference is held in Hawaii, I decided to combine business with pleasure and stay the weekend.
senses.example_zh: 既然会议在夏威夷举行，我决定公私兼顾，顺便在那里度个周末。

senses.example_en: The two universities decided to combine forces to develop the new vaccine.
senses.example_zh: 这两所大学决定联合力量共同研发这种新疫苗。

senses.example_en: The training curriculum is designed to combine theory with hands-on practice.
senses.example_zh: 该培训课程旨在将理论知识与动手实践相结合。

senses.example_en: Only by combining our efforts can we resolve this international crisis.
senses.example_zh: 唯有群策群力，我们才能化解这场国际危机。

senses.example_en: The app seamlessly combines navigation with social networking features.
senses.example_zh: 这款应用将导航功能与社交网络功能无缝融合在一起。

senses.example_en: His musical style combines elements of traditional folk and modern jazz.
senses.example_zh: 他的音乐风格融合了传统民谣与现代爵士的元素。

senses.meaning: 联合起来反对或对抗（某人、某势力）
senses.example_en: Several smaller rival companies combined against the industry giant.
senses.example_zh: 几家规模较小的竞争对手联合起来对抗这家行业巨头。

senses.example_en: The three administrative divisions were combined into a single regional office.
senses.example_zh: 这三个行政部门被合并成了一个区域办事处。

senses.meaning: 园艺/农耕）培土，壅土（将土堆在植物根部周围
senses.example_en: Gardeners usually earth up potato plants to protect the growing tubers from sunlight.
senses.example_zh: 园丁通常会给土豆植株培土，以保护生长中的块茎免受阳光直射。

senses.meaning: 电气）接地引流，短路至大地
senses.example_en: The exposed wire touched the metal casing and earthed out, tripping the circuit breaker.
senses.example_zh: 裸露的电线触碰到了金属外壳发生接地短路，导致断路器跳闸。

senses.meaning: 经长期追踪搜寻到（某人或某物）；查根问底
senses.example_en: After months of meticulous investigative work, detectives finally ran the suspect to earth.
senses.example_zh: 经过数月缜密的侦查工作，警探们终于追踪并查获了该嫌疑人。

idioms.phrase: bring somebody back down to earth

senses.meaning: 使某人面对现实，让某人清醒过来
senses.example_en: The harsh quarterly financial figures brought the overly optimistic board back down to earth.
senses.example_zh: 严峻的季度财务数据让过度乐观的董事会认清了现实。

senses.meaning: 竭尽全力，想方设法排除万难
senses.example_en: She moved heaven and earth to ensure her daughter got into the specialized medical program.
senses.example_zh: 她竭尽全力，想方设法确保女儿被那个专业医学项目录取。

senses.example_en: For safety reasons, you must earth the washing machine properly before use.
senses.example_zh: 出于安全考虑，使用洗衣机前必须妥善接地。

senses.meaning: 规范接地的，良好接地的
senses.example_en: Ensure all outdoor electrical installations are properly earthed to prevent shocks.
senses.example_zh: 确保所有室外电气设施均规范接地，以防发生触电事故。

senses.example_en: The electrician firmly connected the green-and-yellow earth cable to the terminal.
senses.example_zh: 电工将黄绿相间的地线牢固地连接到了接线端子上。

senses.meaning: 凭空想象消除；假想（问题或困难）不存在而予以回避
senses.example_en: You cannot simply imagine away deep-seated economic disparities without real policy reform.
senses.example_zh: 没有真正的政策改革，你不可能仅凭假想就让根深蒂固的经济差距凭空消失。

senses.meaning: 胡思乱想，疑神疑鬼，产生幻觉
senses.example_en: Don't worry, there's nobody outside the window—you're just imagining things.
senses.example_zh: 别担心，窗外没有人——你只是在疑神疑鬼罢了。

senses.meaning: 根本料想不到，做梦也没想到
senses.example_en: Little did he imagine that this small investment would turn him into a billionaire.
senses.example_zh: 他做梦也没想到，这笔小小的投资会让他成为亿万富翁。

senses.meaning: 难以想象，无法理解（常用于强调程度之深或情况之极端）
senses.example_en: I cannot imagine how difficult it must have been for her to raise three children alone.
senses.example_zh: 我无法想象她独自抚养三个孩子该有多么艰难。

senses.meaning: 清晰地设想，历历在目地想象
senses.example_en: She could vividly imagine the look of disappointment on her parents' faces.
senses.example_zh: 她能清晰地想象出父母脸上失望的神情。

senses.example_en: We can hardly imagine what life was like before the advent of electricity.
senses.example_zh: 我们几乎无法想象在电出现之前的生活是什么样的。

senses.example_en: It is easy to imagine the chaos that would ensue if the power grid failed.
senses.example_zh: 不难想象，如果电网瘫痪将会导致怎样的混乱局面。

senses.example_en: Most teenagers today cannot imagine life without smartphones and social media.
senses.example_zh: 当今年轻人大多数都无法设想没有智能手机和社交媒体的生活。

senses.meaning: 要求归还，索回（款项、财物或权利）
senses.example_en: Angry customers marched to the store to demand their money back.
senses.example_zh: 愤怒的顾客们涌向商店，要求退钱。

senses.meaning: 讨要说法，要求作出合理解释
senses.example_en: The board demanded an explanation after the sudden departure of the chief executive.
senses.example_zh: 在首席执行官突然离职后，董事会要求其作出合理解释。

senses.meaning: 要求严惩某人，勒令撤换/严惩当事人
senses.example_en: Following the data breach scandal, the press was practically demanding the minister's head.
senses.example_zh: 数据泄露丑闻发生后，媒体几乎是一致要求严惩那位部长并令其下台。

senses.meaning: 引起关注，需要被密切注意
senses.example_en: The climate crisis is an urgent global problem that demands immediate attention.
senses.example_zh: 气候危机是一个亟待引起高度重视的紧迫全球性问题。

senses.meaning: 赢得尊敬，令人肃然起敬
senses.example_en: His deep integrity and tireless dedication naturally demand respect from his peers.
senses.example_zh: 他高尚的品格与不懈的奉献自然赢得了同行们的由衷尊敬。

senses.example_en: Humanitarian organizations urgently demanded an immediate ceasefire.
senses.example_zh: 人道主义组织迫切敦促立即停火。

senses.meaning: 理直气壮地要求，合法索取
senses.example_en: Freelancers should rightfully demand timely payment for completed contracts.
senses.example_zh: 自由职业者有权理直气壮地要求按时拿到合同酬金。

senses.meaning: 对……提出苛求；要求某人付出（精力、时间等）
senses.example_en: The coach demands an immense amount of discipline of his athletes.
senses.example_zh: 教练对他的运动员们提出了极高的纪律要求。

senses.meaning: 向……强行索取；向某人索要（赔偿、解释等）
senses.example_en: The kidnappers demanded five million dollars from the victim's family.
senses.example_zh: 绑匪向受害者家属勒索五百万美元。

senses.meaning: 加倍下注；固执己见，变本加厉地坚持原立场或策略
senses.example_en: Instead of apologizing for the controversial remark, the politician doubled down on it.
senses.example_zh: 这位政客非但没有为自己的争议言论道歉，反而在原立场上更加强硬。

senses.meaning: 原路折回，掉头往回走以避开追踪或寻找失物
senses.example_en: Realizing he had lost his wallet, he doubled back along the trail to search for it.
senses.example_zh: 意识到钱包丢了后，他沿小径原路折返去寻找。

senses.meaning: 路线、山路等）迂回弯折，呈急转弯
senses.example_en: The hiking path doubles back on itself as it ascends the steep cliff face.
senses.example_zh: 徒步小径在盘旋攀登陡峭悬崖时呈现之字形来回折返。

senses.meaning: 因剧痛、大笑或精疲力竭）弯下腰，蜷缩起身体
senses.example_en: The boxer doubled over in agony after taking a sharp blow to the abdomen.
senses.example_zh: 腹部遭受重击后，拳击手痛苦地弓下了身子。

senses.meaning: 两人合住，合用一个房间或设施
senses.example_en: Because the hotel was fully booked, the delegates had to double up.
senses.example_zh: 由于酒店客满，代表们不得不两人合住一间房。

senses.meaning: 因疼痛或大笑）弯腰蜷缩（同 double over
senses.example_en: The stand-up comedian had the entire audience doubling up with laughter.
senses.example_zh: 单口喜剧演员逗得全场观众笑弯了腰。

senses.meaning: 孤注一掷；输赢翻倍（要么赢回双倍，要么前功尽弃）
senses.example_en: Having lost the first poker round, he bet everything on double or nothing.
senses.example_zh: 输掉第一轮扑克后，他孤注一掷，押上了全部筹码来一场输赢翻倍赌局。

senses.meaning: 弯腰驼背，弓着身子（因衰老、负重或疼痛）
senses.example_en: The elderly porter walked slowly, bent double under the heavy sack of grain.
senses.example_zh: 老搬运工在沉重的粮袋重压下弯着腰，步履蹒跚。

senses.meaning: 加倍努力，付出双倍汗水
senses.example_en: With the deadline looming, the engineering team had to double their efforts to finish testing.
senses.example_zh: 随着截止日期临近，工程团队不得不加倍努力以完成测试。

senses.meaning: 规模扩大一倍，体积翻番
senses.example_en: The tech startup has doubled in size over the last eighteen months.
senses.example_zh: 这家科技初创公司在过去的18个月里人员规模翻了一番。

senses.example_en: Always double check your calculations before submitting the tax returns.
senses.example_zh: 在提交纳税申报表之前，一定要反复核对你的计算结果。

senses.meaning: 两位数（常与 double growth 连用，表示两位数的高速增长）
senses.example_en: The retail firm posted double-digit growth in quarterly revenue despite a sluggish economy.
senses.example_zh: 尽管经济低迷，这家零售企业季度营收仍实现了两位数的增长。

senses.meaning: 兼作，兼当（具备第二种用途或功能）
senses.example_en: In a compact apartment, the dining table can double as a desk during work hours.
senses.example_zh: 在小户型公寓里，餐桌在工作时段可以兼作书桌使用。

senses.meaning: 打算供……使用；针对；预定给（多用于被动语态 be intended for）
senses.example_en: This educational toolkit is specifically intended for children with special needs.
senses.example_zh: 这套教学用具是专门针对有特殊需求的儿童设计的。

senses.meaning: 预定……从事（某职业）或成为（某种人）
senses.example_en: Her parents had always intended her for a career in law, but she chose music instead.
senses.example_zh: 父母一直打算让她从政或学法，但她最终选择了音乐。

senses.meaning: 并非故意说俏皮话；无意双关（指出前面用了可能引起谐音歧义的词）
senses.example_en: I found the physics lecture very illuminating—no pun intended.
senses.example_zh: 我觉得这场物理讲座非常发人深省——绝非有意借‘照亮’说双关。

senses.example_en: He may come across as harsh, but he really intends well and wants to help you improve.
senses.example_zh: 他态度可能有些生硬，但他真的是出于好意，希望你能进步。

senses.meaning: 完全打算做某事；一心想要做某事
senses.example_en: I fully intend to honor our contract, provided all conditions are met.
senses.example_zh: 只要满足所有条件，我完全打算履行我们的合同。

senses.example_en: We originally intended to spend a week in Paris, but our plans changed.
senses.example_zh: 我们最初打算在巴黎待一周，但计划后来变了。

senses.meaning: 绝无冒犯之意 / 并无恶意
senses.example_en: I intend no offense, but I strongly disagree with your assessment.
senses.example_zh: 我绝无冒犯之意，但我强烈反对你的评估意见。

senses.example_en: The proposed tax reforms clearly intend to encourage green investment.
senses.example_zh: 拟议中的税收改革显然旨在鼓励绿色投资。

senses.meaning: 独立闯荡；自立门户；另辟蹊径
senses.example_en: After five years at the firm, she decided to strike out on her own and open an agency.
senses.example_zh: 在事务所工作五年后，她决定自立门户开一家中介公司。

senses.example_en: The judge ordered the controversial remark to be struck out of the official transcript.
senses.example_zh: 法官下令将那句争议言论从官方庭审记录中划掉。

senses.meaning: 棒球）被三振出局；未能命中
senses.example_en: The star batter struck out in the bottom of the ninth inning.
senses.example_zh: 那位明星击球手在第九局下半场被三振出局。

senses.meaning: 开始（与某人交谈、建立友谊等）
senses.example_en: It is remarkably easy to strike up a conversation with locals in this friendly town.
senses.example_zh: 在这个友好的小镇上，与当地人攀谈起来异常容易。

senses.meaning: 乐手或乐队）开始演奏音乐
senses.example_en: As soon as the guests took their seats, the orchestra struck up a lively waltz.
senses.example_zh: 宾客们一落座，管弦乐队便奏起了一曲轻快的华尔兹。

senses.meaning: 法庭等）废除；宣布（法律或裁决）无效
senses.example_en: The Supreme Court voted to strike down the controversial state regulation.
senses.example_zh: 最高法院投票决定废除那项备受争议的州规。

senses.meaning: 疾病）使病倒；夺去（某人）生命
senses.example_en: Tragically, he was struck down by pneumonia at the height of his career.
senses.example_zh: 不幸的是，他在职业生涯的巅峰期因感染肺炎而英年早逝。

senses.example_en: The company struck back at its competitors by slashing prices across the board.
senses.example_zh: 该企业通过全线大幅降价对竞争对手发起了回击。

senses.meaning: 突然想到；偶然发现（主意、解决办法）
senses.example_en: After hours of brainstorming, we struck on a simple yet brilliant design.
senses.example_zh: 头脑风暴数小时后，我们突然想到一个简洁而绝妙的设计。

senses.example_en: The corrupt surgeon was struck off the medical register following the investigation.
senses.example_zh: 经过调查，这名腐败的外科医生被从医疗名册中除名并吊销执照。

senses.example_en: We can strike that issue off our agenda since it has already been resolved.
senses.example_zh: 我们已经解决那个问题了，可以从议程中划掉了。

senses.meaning: 冲击；动摇（根本、基础或核心价值观）
senses.example_en: Corruption strikes at the very heart of democratic governance.
senses.example_zh: 腐败冲击着民主治理的最核心根基。

idioms.phrase: strike while the iron is hot

senses.example_en: Investors are showing strong interest, so we should strike while the iron is hot.
senses.example_zh: 投资者反响热烈，我们应该趁热打铁推进项目。

senses.example_en: His documentary struck a chord with millions of young job seekers worldwide.
senses.example_zh: 他的纪录片在全球数百万年轻求职者中引起了强烈共鸣。

senses.example_en: Many early tech founders struck it rich after taking their startups public.
senses.example_zh: 许多早期的科技创业者在公司上市后一夜暴富。

senses.meaning: 取得巨大成功；发现极有价值的东西
senses.example_en: The research laboratory struck gold with their latest breakthrough in battery chemistry.
senses.example_zh: 该研究实验室凭借其在电池化学领域的最新突破取得了辉煌成果。

senses.example_en: Parents must strike a balance between offering guidance and encouraging autonomy.
senses.example_zh: 父母必须在给予指导与鼓励独立之间找到平衡点。

senses.example_en: The two publishing houses struck a deal to co-distribute the translated novels.
senses.example_zh: 两家出版社达成协议，共同发行这些翻译小说。

senses.meaning: 使……心惊胆战；让……感到恐惧
senses.example_en: The mere rumor of an audit struck fear into the hearts of corrupt managers.
senses.example_zh: 哪怕只是审计的传言，也让那些腐败的经理们胆战心惊。

senses.example_en: She paused near the fountain and struck a dramatic pose for the camera.
senses.example_zh: 她在喷泉旁停下脚步，对着镜头摆出了一个夸张的姿势。

senses.meaning: 决定；下定决心（采取某行动）
senses.example_en: The board has determined upon a radical restructuring of the overseas divisions.
senses.example_zh: 董事会已决定对海外部门进行大刀阔斧的重组。

senses.meaning: 一劳永逸地确定；彻底弄清查明
senses.example_en: We need conclusive DNA testing to determine the animal's true lineage once and for all.
senses.example_zh: 我们需要决定性的DNA检测来一劳永逸地查明这只动物的真正血统。

senses.example_en: The upcoming shareholder vote will ultimately determine the CEO's fate.
senses.example_zh: 即将举行的股东投票将最终决定这位首席执行官的去留命运。

senses.example_en: Voter turnout in swing states will likely determine the outcome of the presidential election.
senses.example_zh: 摇摆州的选民投票率很可能会决定总统大选的结果。

senses.example_en: Socioeconomic conditions largely determine a child's access to quality education.
senses.example_zh: 社会经济条件在很大程度上决定了孩子能否获得优质教育。

senses.example_en: Inspectors will run diagnostic tests to determine whether the structure remains safe.
senses.example_zh: 质检员将进行诊断性测试，以查明该建筑结构是否仍然安全。

senses.meaning: 测定/查明……的程度或范围
senses.example_en: Engineers conducted aerial surveys to determine the extent of the earthquake damage.
senses.example_zh: 工程师们进行了航空勘测，以确定地震受灾的范围与严重程度。

senses.example_en: Her coat was weighted down with snow and freezing rain.
senses.example_zh: 她的大衣被积雪和冻雨压得沉甸甸的。

senses.meaning: 使沮丧；使焦虑或不堪重负
senses.example_en: He felt weighted down by the burden of running the family business.
senses.example_zh: 他感到被经营家族企业的沉重负担压得喘不过气来。

senses.meaning: 弄虚作假使偏向某方；预先安排以确保胜算
senses.example_en: The sudden regulatory change seemed designed to weight the dice against foreign competitors.
senses.example_zh: 监管规则的突然变更似乎旨在暗中打压外国竞争对手。

senses.meaning: 操纵天平；对某方产生决定性的偏向影响
senses.example_en: His extensive political connections weighted the scales when the contract was awarded.
senses.example_zh: 在合同招标时，他广泛的政治人脉起到了关键的倾斜作用。

senses.meaning: 占很大比重的；极度偏向的
senses.example_en: The composite index is heavily weighted toward tech stocks.
senses.example_zh: 该综合指数高度偏重于科技股。

senses.example_en: The final grade weights coursework and exams equally.
senses.example_zh: 期末总成绩对平时作业与期末考试赋予同等比重。

senses.example_en: The survey results were weighted by population to ensure regional accuracy.
senses.example_zh: 调查结果按人口比例进行了加权处理，以确保区域准确性。

senses.example_en: The interview scoring system is weighted in favour of practical experience.
senses.example_zh: 面试评分机制偏重于考察实际工作经验。

senses.meaning: 使处于不利地位；偏袒以对…不利
senses.example_en: The electoral rules are heavily weighted against third-party candidates.
senses.example_zh: 选举规则被制定得极大地不利于第三方候选人。

senses.meaning: 因过度工作而）耗尽体力；筋疲力尽
senses.example_en: If you keep working eighty hours a week, you'll burn out within a year.
senses.example_zh: 如果你继续每周工作八十个小时，一年之内你就会筋疲力尽、彻底垮掉。

senses.example_en: The fire was left to burn out overnight.
senses.example_zh: 火堆被留在那里自行燃尽熄灭了一整夜。

senses.meaning: 电器元器件、电机）烧坏；熔断
senses.example_en: The motor burned out because of a power surge.
senses.example_zh: 电机因电压骤增而烧坏了。

senses.meaning: 建筑物等）被完全烧毁；焚毁
senses.example_en: The historic hotel burned down in the middle of the night.
senses.example_zh: 那家历史悠久的旅馆在半夜被彻底烧毁了。

senses.example_en: We sat talking in silence as the flames burned down to glowing embers.
senses.example_zh: 当火焰渐渐微弱、化为泛光的余烬时，我们默默围坐交谈。

senses.example_en: Meteors usually burn up upon entering the Earth's atmosphere.
senses.example_zh: 流星进入地球大气层时通常会被完全烧尽。

senses.example_en: High-intensity interval training helps you burn up calories quickly.
senses.example_zh: 高强度间歇训练有助于你迅速消耗卡路里。

senses.example_en: It burns me up to see people take advantage of his kindness.
senses.example_zh: 看到有人利用他的善良，我真是火冒三丈。

senses.meaning: 通过运动消耗掉（脂肪、能量）
senses.example_en: He went for a long run to burn off the dessert he had after dinner.
senses.example_zh: 他去长跑以消耗掉晚饭后吃的甜点热量。

senses.meaning: 薄雾、水汽）在阳光下消散
senses.example_en: The morning mist quickly burned off as the sun rose.
senses.example_zh: 太阳升起后，晨雾很快就散去了。

senses.meaning: 迅速挥霍光；大量消耗（资金、资源）
senses.example_en: The startup burned through five million dollars of venture capital in six months.
senses.example_zh: 该初创公司在六个月内就烧光了五百万美元的风险投资。

senses.example_en: Acid had burned away part of the metal surface.
senses.example_zh: 酸液腐蚀烧掉了部分金属表面。

senses.example_en: She had to burn the midnight oil to prepare for her medical board exams.
senses.example_zh: 为了准备医师执业资格考试，她不得不挑灯夜战。

senses.example_en: Never burn your bridges when leaving a job, as you may need references later.
senses.example_zh: 离职时切莫做绝把路堵死，因为你日后可能还需要推荐信。

idioms.phrase: burn the candle at both ends

senses.meaning: 过分透支精力；蜡烛两头烧
senses.example_en: Studying full-time while working nights is burning the candle at both ends.
senses.example_zh: 白天全日制上学、晚上又值夜班，无异于过度透支身体。

idioms.phrase: burn a hole in one's pocket

senses.example_en: As soon as he gets his paycheck, the money burns a hole in his pocket.
senses.example_zh: 他一拿到薪水，手里的钱就急着要花出去。

senses.example_en: The stars seemed to burn brightly in the clear desert sky.
senses.example_zh: 在晴朗的沙漠夜空下，星星似乎燃烧得格外耀眼。

senses.example_en: She burned with anger when she discovered the deliberate betrayal.
senses.example_zh: 当她发现这起蓄意的背叛时，心中怒火中烧。

senses.example_en: Countries must reduce their reliance on burning fossil fuels to combat climate change.
senses.example_zh: 各国必须减少对燃烧化石燃料的依赖以应对气候变化。

senses.example_en: Swimming is an efficient way to burn calories without straining joints.
senses.example_zh: 游泳是一种在不增加关节负担的情况下消耗卡路里的有效方式。

senses.meaning: 界定条件；确立规则与范围
senses.example_en: Before entering negotiations, both parties met to define the terms of the dialogue.
senses.example_zh: 在展开谈判前，双方举行会面以确立对话的具体规则与范围。

senses.meaning: 由…所决定；体现…的本质特征
senses.example_en: A person should be defined by their character, not their material wealth.
senses.example_zh: 一个人的本质应当由其品格来界定，而非其物质财富。

senses.example_en: The contract needs to clearly define each partner's responsibilities.
senses.example_zh: 合同需要清晰界定各合伙人的具体职责。

senses.meaning: 划定范围；界定适用范围
senses.example_en: The committee met to define the scope of the upcoming audit.
senses.example_zh: 委员会开会界定了即将展开的审计范围。

senses.example_en: Parents must define boundaries early to guide children's behavior.
senses.example_zh: 父母必须尽早划定行为界限以引导孩子的品行。

senses.example_en: The statute uses broadly defined terms that allow judicial discretion.
senses.example_zh: 该法令使用了宽泛界定的法律术语，为司法裁量留出了空间。

senses.example_en: The report defines poverty as living on less than two dollars a day.
senses.example_zh: 该报告将贫困定义为每天生活费不足两美元。

idioms.phrase: an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure

senses.meaning: 预防胜于治疗；防患于未然
senses.example_en: You should get your car serviced regularly; remember, an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
senses.example_zh: 你应该定期给车做保养；记住，防患于未然比事后补救强得多。

senses.example_en: Frequent handwashing is essential to prevent the spread of infectious diseases.
senses.example_zh: 经常洗手对于防止传染病扩散至关重要。

senses.example_en: The government must take immediate measures to prevent further economic collapse.
senses.example_zh: 政府必须立即采取措施防止经济进一步崩溃。

senses.example_en: Community policing plays a vital role in helping to prevent crime.
senses.example_zh: 社区警务在协助预防犯罪方面起着至关重要的作用。

senses.example_en: Security guards stepped in to actively prevent protesters from entering the venue.
senses.example_zh: 安保人员介入以主动阻止抗议者进入会场。

senses.meaning: 阻止/妨碍某人或某事做某事（使之无法进行）
senses.example_en: Bad weather prevented the rescue team from reaching the survivors in time.
senses.example_zh: 恶劣的天气阻碍了救援队及时赶到幸存者身边。

senses.meaning: 搜索并消灭；彻底清剿（原指军事战术，后引申为彻底清除某物）
senses.example_en: The immune system deploys white blood cells on a seek and destroy mission against pathogens.
senses.example_zh: 免疫系统部署白细胞对病原体执行搜寻并歼灭的任务。

senses.meaning: 打破神话；破除错误迷思
senses.example_en: The scientific report finally destroyed the myth that fat-free diets are always healthy.
senses.example_zh: 这份科学报告最终打破了无脂饮食总是健康的迷思。

senses.example_en: The historic cathedral was completely destroyed by an accidental fire overnight.
senses.example_zh: 这座历史悠久的大教堂在一夜之间被一场意外火灾彻底摧毁。

senses.example_en: The suspect attempted to destroy evidence by shredding all financial records.
senses.example_zh: 嫌疑人企图通过粉碎所有财务记录来销毁证据。

senses.meaning: 打击/摧毁某人的自信心
senses.example_en: A barrage of harsh criticism completely destroyed the young athlete's confidence.
senses.example_zh: 接二连三的严厉批评彻底摧毁了这位年轻运动员的自信心。

senses.example_en: Deceiving your partners will quickly destroy trust that took years to build.
senses.example_zh: 欺骗合作伙伴会迅速瓦解耗时数年建立起来的信任。

senses.meaning: 创造奇迹；实现看似不可能的事情
senses.example_en: Against overwhelming odds, the underdog team managed to achieve the impossible and win the tournament.
senses.example_zh: 在胜算极其渺茫的情况下，这支不被看好的队伍创造了奇迹并夺得了锦标赛冠军。

senses.meaning: 成就卓越；登上伟大顶峰
senses.example_en: Her sheer discipline and relentless curiosity allowed her to achieve greatness in theoretical physics.
senses.example_zh: 她严谨的自律和不懈的好奇心使她在理论物理领域取得了卓越的成就。

collocations.phrase: achieve a goal / achieve an objective

senses.example_en: The company has achieved all its quarterly sales objectives ahead of schedule.
senses.example_zh: 该公司提前达成了所有季度销售目标。

senses.example_en: Talent alone is rarely enough to achieve long-term success in the arts.
senses.example_zh: 仅凭天赋在艺术界往往很难取得长期的成功。

senses.example_en: Medical researchers have achieved a major breakthrough in developing targeted cancer therapies.
senses.example_zh: 医学研究人员在开发靶向癌症疗法方面取得了重大突破。

senses.example_en: It is difficult for working parents to achieve a healthy balance between career and family.
senses.example_zh: 在职父母很难在事业与家庭之间取得良性平衡。

senses.meaning: 发表微不足道的拙见；插话发表个人看法
senses.example_en: I'd like to contribute my two cents before we make a final decision.
senses.example_zh: 在我们做出最终决定之前，我想谈谈我个人的浅见。

senses.meaning: 尽绵薄之力；贡献自己微薄的一份力量
senses.example_en: Even volunteers with limited time can contribute their mite to the campaign.
senses.example_zh: 即使时间有限的志愿者也可以为该活动贡献自己的绵薄之力。

senses.meaning: 做出显著贡献；产生重大影响
senses.example_en: Renewable energy will contribute significantly to cutting carbon emissions.
senses.example_zh: 可再生能源将对减少碳排放做出显著贡献。

senses.example_en: Alumni contributed generously to the university's new scholarship programme.
senses.example_zh: 校友们为大学设立的新奖学金项目慷慨解囊。

senses.example_en: The sudden tariff increase contributed directly to the company's loss.
senses.example_zh: 关税的突然上调直接导致了该公司的亏损。

senses.example_en: He contributes regularly to a weekly column on financial technology.
senses.example_zh: 他定期为一个金融科技周专栏供稿。

senses.meaning: 促成，导致（某种结果或局面）
senses.example_en: Poor diet and lack of exercise significantly contribute to heart disease.
senses.example_zh: 不良饮食和缺乏运动是导致心脏病的重要诱因。

senses.example_en: Local businesses were asked to contribute to the disaster relief fund.
senses.example_zh: 当地企业被号召向救灾基金捐款。

senses.meaning: 为（报刊、书籍等）撰稿或提供内容
senses.example_en: She has been invited to contribute to several prestigious academic journals.
senses.example_zh: 她受邀为数家著名学术期刊撰稿。

senses.meaning: 共同出资分担，贴补（某项花销）
senses.example_en: The government grant will contribute towards the cost of roof repairs.
senses.example_zh: 政府拨款将用于分担屋顶修缮的部分费用。

senses.meaning: 对……起到推动或助力作用
senses.example_en: Every small habit contributes towards a more sustainable environment.
senses.example_zh: 每一个微小的习惯都有助于构建更具可持续性的环境。

senses.meaning: 欣然迎接（新年、新纪元或新宾客）的到来
senses.example_en: Thousands gathered in the town square to welcome in the New Year.
senses.example_zh: 成千上万人聚集在小镇广场上迎接新年的到来。

senses.meaning: 主动接纳，欢迎（新观念、新成员等）进入
senses.example_en: The community has welcomed in refugees from war-torn areas.
senses.example_zh: 该社区热情接纳了来自饱受战乱地区的难民。

senses.meaning: 欢迎（某人）回归、归队或归来
senses.example_en: The team held a dinner to welcome back their captain after months of injury.
senses.example_zh: 车队举行晚宴，欢迎因伤休战数月后的队长归队。

senses.meaning: 乐见（某种做法、传统等）重新恢复
senses.example_en: Commuters welcomed back the late-night train service after the strike.
senses.example_zh: 罢工结束后，通勤者对深夜列车服务的恢复表示欢迎。

senses.meaning: 张开双臂热烈欢迎某人
senses.example_en: When I arrived in the village, the locals welcomed me with open arms.
senses.example_zh: 当我抵达村庄时，当地居民张开双臂热情地欢迎我。

senses.meaning: 做客过久惹人嫌；不受欢迎仍赖着不走
senses.example_en: They decided to stay in a hotel rather than wear out their welcome at their friends' flat.
senses.example_zh: 他们决定住酒店，以免在朋友的公寓住得太久惹人嫌。

senses.meaning: 彼此彼此；欢迎加入同病相怜者的行列（多带幽默或讽刺）
senses.example_en: "I haven't slept properly in weeks." "Welcome to the club."
senses.example_zh: “我已经好几个星期没睡好觉了。”“彼此彼此，我也一样。”

senses.example_en: The delegation was warmly welcomed by senior government officials.
senses.example_zh: 代表团受到了政府高级官员的热烈欢迎。

senses.meaning: 欣然把握机会；十分欢迎这个契机
senses.example_en: I welcome the opportunity to work alongside such experienced researchers.
senses.example_zh: 我非常珍惜并乐于把握与如此经验丰富的研究人员共事的机会。

senses.example_en: Environmental groups welcomed the court's decision to halt the pipeline.
senses.example_zh: 环保组织对法院叫停该输油管道项目的裁决表示欢迎。

senses.meaning: 虚心听取意见；欢迎提供反馈
senses.example_en: We actively welcome input from staff at all levels of the organisation.
senses.example_zh: 我们积极欢迎机构各级员工提出宝贵意见。

senses.meaning: 因……而发笑；觉得……滑稽有趣
senses.example_en: The audience couldn't stop laughing at his absurd imitations.
senses.example_zh: 观众被他荒诞滑稽的模仿逗得大笑不止。

senses.example_en: She was deeply hurt when her classmates laughed at her accent.
senses.example_zh: 当同班同学嘲笑她的口音时，她受到了极大的伤害。

senses.meaning: 对（危险、警告、困难等）付之一笑；轻视不屑
senses.example_en: The seasoned mountaineers laughed at the stormy weather warnings.
senses.example_zh: 那些经验丰富的登山者对暴风雨预警付之一笑、不以为意。

senses.meaning: 对……一笑了之；用笑掩饰（尴尬、指责或伤痛）
senses.example_en: He tried to laugh off the criticism, but it clearly bothered him.
senses.example_zh: 他试图对批评一笑了之，但显然心里很介意。

senses.meaning: 以笑谈驱散（担忧、恐惧或紧张）
senses.example_en: The coach laughed away our pre-match anxieties with a funny story.
senses.example_zh: 教练讲了个幽默故事，在谈笑间驱散了我们赛前的焦虑。

senses.meaning: 笑得前仰后合；捧腹狂笑
senses.example_en: The children were laughing their heads off during the cartoon show.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们看动画片时笑得前仰后合。

idioms.phrase: laugh all the way to the bank

senses.meaning: 轻轻松松发大财；乐不可支地赚得盆满钵满
senses.example_en: The critics panned the movie, but the producers laughed all the way to the bank.
senses.example_zh: 影评人把这部电影批得一无是处，但制片方却赚得盆满钵满。

senses.meaning: 笑到最后；最终反败为胜
senses.example_en: They doubted his invention at first, but he had the last laugh when it became a hit.
senses.example_zh: 起初大家都怀疑他的发明，但当这项发明大火时，他笑到了最后。

idioms.phrase: laugh on the other side of one's face

senses.meaning: 很快就笑不出来；由喜转悲，乐极生悲
senses.example_en: He thinks he got away with cheating, but he'll laugh on the other side of his face tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 他以为自己作弊蒙混过关了，但明天他肯定就笑不出来了。

senses.meaning: 对某人的提议或言论嗤之以鼻；断然驳回某人的主张
senses.example_en: His bizarre conspiracy theory was laughed out of court by genuine historians.
senses.example_zh: 他那古怪荒谬的阴谋论遭到正统历史学家的嗤之以鼻。

senses.meaning: 开怀大笑；畅快淋漓地笑
senses.example_en: The old friends sat by the fireplace, drinking wine and laughing heartily.
senses.example_zh: 老朋友们围坐在壁炉旁，一边饮酒一边开怀大笑。

senses.meaning: 紧张地干笑；局促不安地笑
senses.example_en: Caught off guard by the question, the candidate laughed nervously before replying.
senses.example_zh: 被这个问题问得措手不及，候选人紧张地干笑了一下才作答。

senses.meaning: 突然噗嗤大笑；放声大笑起来
senses.example_en: The classroom was dead silent until someone burst out laughing.
senses.example_zh: 教室里本来一片死寂，直到有人突然放声大笑起来。

senses.meaning: 忍不住笑出来；忍俊不禁
senses.example_en: Seeing the kitten chase its own tail, I couldn't help laughing.
senses.example_zh: 看着小猫追逐自己的尾巴，我忍不住笑出声来。

senses.meaning: 履行承诺/践行诺言/执行合同
senses.example_en: The company promised to honor its warranty commitment without any hidden fees.
senses.example_zh: 该公司承诺履行保修承诺，不收取任何隐形费用。

senses.example_en: A charity was established to honor the memory of the fallen soldier.
senses.example_zh: 一个慈善机构成立了，旨在缅怀这位阵亡士兵。

senses.meaning: 接受/满足请求；承兑支票
senses.example_en: The bank refused to honor the forged check.
senses.example_zh: 银行拒绝兑付那张伪造的支票。

senses.example_en: He completely flew off the handle when he discovered the mistake.
senses.example_zh: 当他发现那个错误时，当场暴跳如雷。

senses.meaning: 小心翼翼地对待；极圆通地处理
senses.example_en: The delicate political negotiations must be handled with kid gloves.
senses.example_zh: 这起微妙的政治谈判必须极其谨慎地对待。

senses.example_en: She proved her ability to handle a crisis under intense pressure.
senses.example_zh: 她证明了自己在巨大压力下应对危机的能力。

senses.example_en: Candidates should demonstrate how they handle stress in fast-paced environments.
senses.example_zh: 应聘者应展示在快节奏环境中如何应对压力。

senses.example_en: Our support team is trained to handle customer complaints professionally.
senses.example_zh: 我们的客服团队接受过专业处理客户投诉的培训。

senses.meaning: 穿上盛装，盛装打扮；乔装，打扮成
senses.example_en: You don't need to dress up; casual clothes are fine for the party.
senses.example_zh: 你不需要盛装打扮，去参加聚会穿便装就行。

senses.meaning: 穿便装（比平时随意）；斥责，训诫
senses.example_en: On Fridays, staff are allowed to dress down.
senses.example_zh: 每周五，员工可以穿便服上班。

senses.meaning: 着装极度吸引人，打扮得艳惊四座
senses.example_en: She arrived at the gala dressed to kill in a red silk gown.
senses.example_zh: 她身穿一袭红色丝绸礼服出现在晚会上，艳惊四座。

senses.example_en: Everyone was dressed to the nines for the award ceremony.
senses.example_zh: 每个人都为了颁奖典礼盛装出席，打扮得极其考究。

senses.example_en: The guards were dressed in formal dark suits.
senses.example_zh: 保安人员身着深色正式西装。

senses.example_en: Please ensure you dress appropriately for the corporate interview.
senses.example_zh: 参加企业面试时请务必穿着得体。

senses.example_en: I always mix up the twins because they look and sound identical.
senses.example_zh: 我总是分不清这对双胞胎，因为他们长相和声音都一模一样。

senses.meaning: 彻底弄乱，打乱（次序或状态）
senses.example_en: Someone mixed up the order of the confidential files on my desk.
senses.example_zh: 有人把我办公桌上的机密文件顺序给弄乱了。

senses.meaning: 使卷入，使牵扯进（不良事件，常用于被动语态）
senses.example_en: He got mixed up in an illegal street racing ring last summer.
senses.example_zh: 他去年夏天被卷入了一场非法街头飙车团伙。

senses.meaning: 在烹饪等过程中）掺入，混入
senses.example_en: Gently fold the egg whites and mix in the melted chocolate.
senses.example_zh: 轻轻翻拌蛋白霜，然后拌入融化好的巧克力。

senses.meaning: 在社交场合）融入群体，合群相处
senses.example_en: She was naturally shy, but she managed to mix in well with her new classmates.
senses.example_zh: 她天性害羞，但还是设法与新同学们打成了一片。

senses.example_en: His job requires him to mix with high-profile diplomats and politicians.
senses.example_zh: 他的工作要求他经常与知名外交官和政治家打交道。

senses.example_en: This chemical solvent does not readily mix with cold water.
senses.example_zh: 这种化学溶剂不容易与冷水相溶。

senses.meaning: 公私混杂；将工作与娱乐混在一起
senses.example_en: I try never to mix business with pleasure when going out with coworkers.
senses.example_zh: 和同事外出聚会时，我尽量不把工作与娱乐混为一谈。

senses.meaning: 混搭；组合不同的元素以求协调
senses.example_en: You can mix and match various tops and skirts to create different looks.
senses.example_zh: 你可以把不同的上衣和裙子混搭，打造出多样的造型。

senses.meaning: 水火不容；性格或事物截然不同而无法合得来
senses.example_en: Don't force them to work together—they are like oil and water.
senses.example_zh: 别强求他们共事了——他们俩水火不容。

senses.example_en: Mix thoroughly until the powder completely dissolves in the liquid.
senses.example_zh: 彻底搅拌均匀，直至粉末完全溶解在液体中。

senses.meaning: 充分调和；（社交上）相处融洽
senses.example_en: The two base colors mix well to create a subtle green tone.
senses.example_zh: 这两种底色调和得很好，调出了一种柔和的绿色调。

senses.example_en: Add all dry ingredients into a large bowl and mix them together.
senses.example_zh: 把所有干性配料放入大碗中混合在一起。

senses.example_en: Dolphins use clicks and whistles to communicate with one another underwater.
senses.example_zh: 海豚在水下通过发出咔哒声和哨鸣声互相交流。

senses.meaning: 房间、通道等）与……相通，连通
senses.example_en: The master bedroom communicates directly with a private balcony through French doors.
senses.example_zh: 主卧通过落地门与私人阳台直接相通。

senses.meaning: 产生共鸣；想法完全一致；心有灵犀
senses.example_en: From our first meeting, we seemed to communicate on the same wavelength.
senses.example_zh: 从第一次见面起，我们俩似乎就完全能想到一块儿去。

senses.meaning: 沟通脱节；表达失当；无法达成共识
senses.example_en: The project stalled simply because both departments completely failed to communicate.
senses.example_zh: 项目停滞不前纯粹是因为两个部门之间完全缺乏有效沟通。

senses.example_en: The training is designed to help managers communicate effectively with their teams.
senses.example_zh: 该培训旨在帮助管理人员与团队进行有效沟通。

senses.example_en: Healthy relationships require both partners to communicate openly about their expectations.
senses.example_zh: 健康的恋爱关系需要双方坦诚地交流各自的期望。

senses.meaning: 通过非语言方式交流（如肢体语言、眼神）
senses.example_en: Actors learn how to communicate non-verbally through subtle body language.
senses.example_zh: 演员们学习如何通过细微的肢体语言进行非语言交流。

senses.example_en: The clients prefer to communicate by email rather than over the phone.
senses.example_zh: 客户更倾向于通过电子邮件而非电话进行沟通。

senses.example_en: "Are you coming to the party tonight?" "It depends—I have a lot of chores to finish."
senses.example_zh: “你今晚来参加聚会吗？”“看情况吧，我还有好多家务要处理。”

senses.meaning: 包管没错；尽可放心；那是必然的
senses.example_en: Interest rates will rise again before the end of the year, you can depend on it.
senses.example_zh: 年底前利率肯定还会上调，这一点大可放心。

senses.example_en: The island's local economy depends heavily on seasonal tourism.
senses.example_zh: 该岛的当地经济严重依赖季节性旅游业。

senses.example_en: The final decision depends entirely on the board's formal approval.
senses.example_zh: 最终决定完全取决于董事会的正式批准。

senses.example_en: The success of the treatment will depend largely on early detection.
senses.example_zh: 治疗的成功在很大程度上取决于早期发现。

senses.example_en: Whether the event will be held outdoors depends on the weather tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 活动是否在室外举行取决于明天的天气。

senses.meaning: 依靠，依赖（获取经济资助或生存支持）
senses.example_en: Many elderly residents depend on food banks to make ends meet.
senses.example_zh: 许多老年居民依赖食物银行来维持生计。

senses.meaning: 指望，信赖（在需要时给予帮助）
senses.example_en: You can always depend on Sarah to deliver high-quality work on tight deadlines.
senses.example_zh: 在时间紧迫的情况下，你完全可以信赖莎拉交付高质量的工作成果。

senses.example_en: The future of the company depends upon our ability to innovate rapidly.
senses.example_zh: 公司的未来取决于我们快速创新的能力。

senses.meaning: 为（某职位或机会）参加面试
senses.example_en: She flew to Chicago to interview for the marketing director position.
senses.example_zh: 她飞往芝加哥参加市场总监职位的面试。

senses.meaning: 与（某人或机构）进行面试或面谈
senses.example_en: He has scheduled to interview with several tech firms next week.
senses.example_zh: 他已安排好下周接受几家科技公司的面试。

senses.meaning: 在面试中表现出色；擅长面试
senses.example_en: His resume looked modest, but he interviews remarkably well.
senses.example_zh: 他的简历看起来普普通通，但面试时的表现却极其出色。

senses.meaning: 接受采访；同意接见并接受访问
senses.example_en: The reclusive author rarely grants interviews to the press.
senses.example_zh: 这位深居简出的作家极少接受媒体采访。

senses.example_en: The panel conducted a rigorous forty-minute interview with each finalist.
senses.example_zh: 评审团对每位最终入围者进行了长达四十分钟的严格面试。

senses.meaning: 依法对嫌疑人进行警诫讯问
senses.example_en: The suspect was taken to the local police station and interviewed under caution.
senses.example_zh: 嫌疑人被带到当地警察局，并在依法告知权利后接受了讯问。

senses.example_en: We will begin interviewing candidates for the managerial role tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 我们明天将开始对该管理职位的候选人进行面试。

senses.example_en: The researcher carried out in-depth interviews with thirty frontline nurses.
senses.example_zh: 研究人员对三十名一线护士开展了深度访谈。

senses.meaning: 依靠（极少量的钱、食物等）勉强维生
senses.example_en: During college, he survived on instant noodles and part-time wages.
senses.example_zh: 上大学期间，他仅靠泡面和兼职收入勉强糊口。

senses.meaning: 熬过，挺过（艰难时期、严酷环境等）
senses.example_en: The small family-owned business managed to survive through the economic downturn.
senses.example_zh: 这家家族小企业设法挺过了经济低迷期。

idioms.phrase: survive by the skin of one's teeth

senses.meaning: 九死一生；侥幸脱险生还
senses.example_en: Trapped in the blizzard, the hikers survived by the skin of their teeth.
senses.example_zh: 困在暴风雪中的徒步旅行者们死里逃生，侥幸活了下来。

senses.meaning: 经受住时间的考验；历久弥新
senses.example_en: Great literature must survive the test of time across multiple generations.
senses.example_zh: 伟大的文学作品必须能够经受住几代人的时间考验。

senses.example_en: The driver barely survived the catastrophic highway collision.
senses.example_zh: 司机在那场惨烈的高速公路碰撞中险些丧命。

senses.example_en: Amazingly, the medieval bridge survived the earthquake intact.
senses.example_zh: 令人称奇的是，那座中世纪桥梁在地震后依然完好无损。

senses.example_en: Many endangered wildlife species are struggling to survive habitat loss.
senses.example_zh: 许多濒危野生动物在栖息地丧失的困境中苦苦求生。

senses.meaning: 在撞击/坠机事故中生还
senses.example_en: Only four passengers survived the tragic plane crash.
senses.example_zh: 只有四名乘客在那场悲惨的空难中幸存。

senses.meaning: 平淡无奇；没什么大惊小怪的；不值得激动
senses.example_en: The new phone model is functional, but there is really nothing to get excited about.
senses.example_zh: 这款新手机功能完备，但实在没有什么令人眼前一亮的地方。

senses.meaning: 几乎无法引起某人的兴趣；乏善可陈
senses.example_en: The itinerary offered little to excite the seasoned travelers.
senses.example_zh: 这段行程几乎无法引起那些经验丰富的旅行者的兴趣。

senses.example_en: The mysterious sealed letter excited curiosity among all family members.
senses.example_zh: 那封神秘的火漆密封信激起了所有家庭成员的好奇心。

senses.example_en: His unexpected resignation excited widespread speculation about the company's financial health.
senses.example_zh: 他的意外辞职引发了人们对公司财务状况的广泛猜测。

senses.example_en: Walking around the bank vault after hours is bound to excite suspicion.
senses.example_zh: 下班后在银行金库周围徘徊必然会引起怀疑。

senses.example_en: Her tragic tale of survival never failed to excite sympathy in the listeners.
senses.example_zh: 她幸存下来的悲惨故事总能激起听众的同情。

senses.meaning: 刺激、唆使或驱使（某人）做出某种行动
senses.example_en: The speaker's aggressive words excited the crowd into a violent protest.
senses.example_zh: 演讲者激进的言辞唆使人群发起了暴力抗议。

senses.meaning: 给（汽车等交通工具）加满油
senses.example_en: We should stop at the next station to gas up before hitting the highway.
senses.example_zh: 上高速前，我们应该在下一个加油站停下来把油加满。

senses.meaning: ）过分吹捧某人使其自我膨胀
senses.example_en: Stop gassing him up; his ego is already big enough.
senses.example_zh: 别再捧他了，他的尾巴已经翘得够高了。

senses.meaning: 体育运动/格斗等中）耗尽体力，精疲力竭
senses.example_en: The fighter pushed too hard in the opening round and completely gassed out in the third.
senses.example_zh: 该拳手在第一回合冲得太猛，导致在第三回合彻底体力不支。

senses.meaning: 用有害毒气将某人熏昏或逼出
senses.example_en: The riot police used tear gas to gas the protesters out of the building.
senses.example_zh: 防暴警察使用催泪瓦斯将抗议者从大楼中熏了出来。

senses.meaning: 滔滔不绝地空谈；唠叨不休
senses.example_en: He gassed on for nearly an hour about his glory days in college.
senses.example_zh: 关于自己大学时的辉煌岁月，他滔滔不绝地吹了近一个小时。

senses.meaning: 材料、化学品等）释放气体，挥发逸气
senses.example_en: New memory foam mattresses often gas off for a few days after unboxing.
senses.example_zh: 新的记忆棉床垫在开箱后的几天内往往会散发化学气体。

senses.meaning: 踩油门加速；加紧努力，加快节奏
senses.example_en: We are behind schedule, so we really need to step on the gas.
senses.example_zh: 我们进度落后了，真得加快脚步了。

senses.meaning: 油料用尽；（比喻）精疲力竭，失去动力或后劲
senses.example_en: Toward the end of the marathon, my legs ran out of gas completely.
senses.example_zh: 在马拉松接近终点时，我的双腿彻底没有了力气。

senses.meaning: 进展极其迅速且顺利；干得出色，走上正轨
senses.example_en: Now that the computer system is upgraded, we are really cooking with gas.
senses.example_zh: 既然计算机系统已经升级完毕，我们的工作进展得飞快且顺畅。

senses.example_en: Thousands of innocent victims were gassed to death in the extermination camps.
senses.example_zh: 成千上万无辜的受害者在灭绝营中被毒气毒死。

senses.example_en: The malfunctioning furnace began to gas heavily, setting off the alarms.
senses.example_zh: 发生故障的火炉开始猛烈释放废气，触发了警报。

senses.example_en: Don't forget to gas the car before you bring it back to the rental company.
senses.example_zh: 在把车还给租车公司之前，别忘了把油加满。

senses.example_en: The price of fresh produce varies with the seasons.
senses.example_zh: 新鲜农产品的价格随着季节的变化而变动。

senses.meaning: 在（大小、颜色、种类等）某方面各不相同
senses.example_en: These handmade ceramic bowls vary in size and color.
senses.example_zh: 这些手工制作的陶瓷碗在尺寸和颜色上各不相同。

senses.meaning: 见仁见智；人言人殊，众说纷纭
senses.example_en: Opinions vary as to whether the economic stimulus plan actually worked.
senses.example_zh: 关于这项经济刺激计划是否真正奏效，各方意见不一。

senses.meaning: 萝卜青菜，各有所爱；各人喜好不同
senses.example_en: Tastes vary, but almost everyone agrees that this restaurant serves top-tier wine.
senses.example_zh: 尽管各人口味不同，但几乎所有人都承认这家餐厅的葡萄酒是一流的。

senses.meaning: 日新月异；一天一个样，不稳定
senses.example_en: His mood varies from day to day, making it difficult to work with him.
senses.example_zh: 他的脾气一天一个样，让人很难与他共事。

senses.example_en: Estimates of the total repair costs vary widely depending on the contractor.
senses.example_zh: 根据承包商的不同，总维修费用的估算差异十分悬殊。

senses.meaning: 有相当大的变化；显著不同
senses.example_en: The quality of the wine can vary considerably from one vintage to another.
senses.example_zh: 不同年份出产的葡萄酒，品质可能有相当大的差异。

senses.example_en: Tuition fees vary according to the student's country of origin.
senses.example_zh: 学费根据学生来自的国家而有所不同。

senses.example_en: In physics, pressure and volume vary inversely under constant temperature.
senses.example_zh: 在物理学中，恒温状态下压力与体积成反比变化。

senses.example_en: The local dialect varies considerably from standard speech.
senses.example_zh: 当地的方言与标准语言有相当大的差异。

senses.meaning: 在……之间变动（常与 to 搭配：vary from A to B）
senses.example_en: Hotel room rates vary from fifty to two hundred dollars a night.
senses.example_zh: 酒店房价每晚在五十到两百美元不等。

senses.example_en: The patient's temperature varied between 38 and 40 degrees Celsius.
senses.example_zh: 病人的体温在摄氏38度至40度之间波动。

senses.meaning: 定居；成家立业过安定的生活
senses.example_en: They toured the world for years before finally deciding to settle down in a quiet coastal town.
senses.example_zh: 他们周游世界多年，最终决定在一个宁静的海滨小镇定居下来。

senses.example_en: The teacher waited for the energetic pupils to settle down before starting the lesson.
senses.example_zh: 老师等精力充沛的学生们安静下来之后才开始上课。

senses.meaning: 静下心来专心做某事（+ to）
senses.example_en: After making coffee, she settled down to review the financial reports.
senses.example_zh: 冲完咖啡后，她静下心来仔细审查财务报告。

senses.meaning: 适应（新环境、新工作、新居等）；安顿下来
senses.example_en: It took the children a couple of weeks to settle in at their new school.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们花了两周时间才适应新学校的环境。

senses.meaning: 勉强接受；将就；对……感到满足
senses.example_en: Never settle for mediocrity when you know you have the potential to excel.
senses.example_zh: 当你明知自己有潜力做到卓越时，绝不要安于平庸。

senses.example_en: If you pay for the groceries now, we can settle up when we get home.
senses.example_zh: 要是你现在先付食材的钱，我们到家后再结清。

senses.example_en: After hours of heated debate, the committee finally settled on a compromise.
senses.example_zh: 经过数小时的激烈争论，委员会最终敲定了一个折中方案。

senses.meaning: 舒适地向后靠坐（以放松身心）
senses.example_en: He settled back into the armchair and closed his eyes for a quick nap.
senses.example_zh: 他舒服地靠在扶手椅上，闭上双眼打了个盹。

idioms.phrase: settle a score / settle old scores

senses.example_en: He entered the match determined to settle an old score with his archrival.
senses.example_zh: 他带着与宿敌清算旧账的决心走上了赛场。

senses.meaning: 等尘埃落定；局势明朗之后
senses.example_en: We will evaluate the true impact of the merger once the dust settles.
senses.example_zh: 等尘埃落定之后，我们将评估此次合并带来的真实影响。

senses.example_en: The two co-founders agreed to settle their differences for the sake of the company.
senses.example_zh: 为了公司的利益，两位联合创始人同意消除彼此的分歧。

senses.example_en: Both parties preferred to settle out of court to avoid exorbitant legal expenses.
senses.example_zh: 双方都倾向于庭外和解，以避免高昂的诉讼费用。

senses.example_en: An independent mediator was appointed to help settle the border dispute.
senses.example_zh: 一名独立调解员被任命协助化解边界争端。

senses.example_en: Please settle your hotel bill at reception before checking out.
senses.example_zh: 退房前请前往前台结清您的酒店账单。

senses.example_en: The cat settled comfortably on the soft rug beside the fireplace.
senses.example_zh: 猫咪舒舒服服地趴在壁炉旁柔软的地毯上。

senses.meaning: 向（某人）通报……的最新情况/进展
senses.example_en: The project manager will update the board on the quarterly milestones tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 项目经理明天将向董事会汇报季度里程碑的最新进展。

senses.meaning: 让某人随时掌握最新动态；持续向某人通报进展
senses.example_en: Please keep me updated as soon as you receive any news from the client.
senses.example_zh: 一旦收到客户的消息，请务必随时通知我最新动态。

senses.example_en: Cybersecurity experts strongly advise users to regularly update their passwords.
senses.example_zh: 网络安全专家强烈建议用户定期更新密码。

senses.example_en: The operating system is configured to automatically update in the background.
senses.example_zh: 该操作系统已配置为在后台自动更新。

senses.example_en: The administrative staff spent the afternoon updating patient records.
senses.example_zh: 行政人员花了一下午的时间来更新患者档案。

senses.meaning: 更新状态（如社交媒体或工作进度）
senses.example_en: She updated her profile status to reflect her recent job promotion.
senses.example_zh: 她更新了个人资料状态以体现她最近的晋升。

senses.meaning: 被（嫉妒、愤怒、内疚等强烈情绪）吞噬；充满某种情感
senses.example_en: He was consumed by guilt after realizing the unintended harm his words had caused.
senses.example_zh: 在意识到自己的话造成了无意的伤害后，他内心充满了自责。

senses.meaning: 被（大火等）彻底吞噬、烧毁
senses.example_en: The historic wooden library was completely consumed by the raging fire.
senses.example_zh: 那座历史悠久的木结构图书馆被熊熊大火彻底吞噬了。

senses.example_en: The pending medical diagnosis continued to consume her thoughts all week.
senses.example_zh: 未出的医疗诊断结果整整一周都占据着她的心绪。

senses.example_en: Training large artificial intelligence models can consume vast amounts of energy.
senses.example_zh: 训练大型人工智能模型可能会消耗极其庞大的能源。

senses.meaning: 摄入食物/饮酒（正式表达）
senses.example_en: Patrons are strictly forbidden to consume alcohol outside the designated patio area.
senses.example_zh: 顾客被严禁在指定的露台区域之外饮酒。

senses.example_en: The dry summer grass rapidly consumed the dropped spark, igniting a bushfire.
senses.example_zh: 干燥的夏草迅速助长了掉落的火星，引发了一场灌木丛火灾。

senses.example_en: Resolving customer disputes can consume significant time and organizational resources.
senses.example_zh: 化解客户纠纷会耗费大量的时间和组织资源。

senses.meaning: 回购（股票、资产、特许权等）
senses.example_en: The corporation allocated surplus capital to purchase back shares from existing investors.
senses.example_zh: 该公司拨出盈余资金，从现有投资者手中回购股份。

senses.meaning: 出资买断（合伙人或小股东的股权/权益）
senses.example_en: The founding partners agreed to purchase out the early investor after the firm became profitable.
senses.example_zh: 公司实现盈利后，创始合伙人同意出资买断该早期投资者的股权。

senses.example_en: The spokesperson gave vague answers during the press briefing purely to purchase time for the negotiators.
senses.example_zh: 发言人在新闻发布会上含糊其辞，纯粹是为了给谈判代表争取时间。

senses.meaning: 用金钱封口，花钱买封口
senses.example_en: The corrupt official attempted to purchase the whistleblower's silence with a lucrative offshore contract.
senses.example_zh: 这名贪官企图通过一份利润丰厚的离岸合同来买通举报人闭嘴。

senses.example_en: Taking out comprehensive travel insurance is a small price to pay to purchase peace of mind.
senses.example_zh: 购买一份全面的旅行保险花钱不多，却能让人买个安心。

senses.example_en: Supermarkets often purchase goods in bulk to negotiate deeper discounts from suppliers.
senses.example_zh: 超市通常大批量采购商品，以便向供应商争取更大的折扣。

senses.meaning: 赊购，通过信用贷款购买
senses.example_en: Many small enterprises purchase essential machinery on credit to maintain liquid cash reserves.
senses.example_zh: 许多小企业通过赊购方式引进关键机器，以维持充足的流动现金储备。

senses.example_en: Consumers increasingly prefer to purchase organic produce directly from local farmers.
senses.example_zh: 消费者越来越倾向于直接从当地农户手中购买有机农产品。

senses.example_en: The private collector purchased the rare manuscript at a prestigious London auction.
senses.example_zh: 这位私人收藏家在伦敦一场知名的拍卖会上拍下了这件珍贵的手稿。

senses.meaning: 使自己平静下来，平复情绪
senses.example_en: She took several deep breaths in the hallway to compose herself before addressing the board.
senses.example_zh: 她在走廊里深吸了几口气平复情绪，然后才进去向董事会做报告。

senses.example_en: Give me a moment to compose my thoughts before I deliver my verdict on the matter.
senses.example_zh: 在对这件事发表裁决之前，先给我片刻时间整理一下思路。

senses.meaning: 收敛表情，换上严肃/平静的面容
senses.example_en: The diplomat quickly composed his features so that neither side could read his shock.
senses.example_zh: 外交官迅速收敛了神色，以免任何一方察觉出他内心的震惊。

senses.example_en: Beethoven composed his Ninth Symphony even after losing almost all of his hearing.
senses.example_zh: 贝多芬在几乎完全丧失听力后依然谱写出了《第九交响曲》。

senses.example_en: The legal department spent two days composing a formal reply to the regulatory body.
senses.example_zh: 法务部门花了整整两天时间才拟定好给监管机构的正式公函。

senses.example_en: The director instructed the cinematographer to compose the shot using natural shadow and light.
senses.example_zh: 导演指示摄影师利用自然光影对镜头进行画面构图。

senses.example_en: He composed a poignant poem celebrating the natural beauty of the Scottish Highlands.
senses.example_zh: 他创作了一首深情的诗篇，赞美苏格兰高地的自然风光。

senses.example_en: Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
senses.example_zh: 水是由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成的。

senses.meaning: 委员会、群体等）由……人员组成
senses.example_en: The ethics panel is composed of leading scientists, legal experts, and philosophers.
senses.example_zh: 该伦理审查小组由顶尖科学家、法律专家和哲学家组成。

senses.example_en: The referee indicated to the bench that extra time would be limited to three minutes.
senses.example_zh: 裁判向替补席示意伤停补时仅有三分钟。

senses.meaning: 表明情况并非如此，给出相反的迹象
senses.example_en: He insisted that the project was on track, but mounting delays indicate otherwise.
senses.example_zh: 他坚称项目进展顺利，但越来越多的拖延表明事实并非如此。

idioms.phrase: indicate the direction of the wind

senses.meaning: 预示风向，反映舆论或政策的发展动向
senses.example_en: The recent voting patterns in the local council indicate the direction of the political wind.
senses.example_zh: 地方议会近期的投票格局预示了整体政治风向的变动。

senses.example_en: As indicated above, all warranty claims require the presentation of an original receipt.
senses.example_zh: 如上文所述，所有保修申请均须出示原始发票收据。

senses.example_en: The archaeological findings indicate clearly that human trade existed in the region millennia ago.
senses.example_zh: 考古发掘结果明确表明，数千年前该地区就已经存在人类贸易。

senses.example_en: Clinical evidence indicates that regular aerobic exercise significantly lowers cardiovascular risks.
senses.example_zh: 临床证据表明，经常进行有氧运动能显著降低心血管疾病风险。

senses.example_en: Survey results indicate a strong public preference for renewable energy initiatives.
senses.example_zh: 民调结果显示，公众对可再生能源项目表现出强烈的偏好。

senses.example_en: Quarterly sales figures indicate a steady upward trend in online retail spending.
senses.example_zh: 季度销售数据表明，线上零售支出呈现稳步上升的趋势。

senses.example_en: The chairman indicated by a nod that the delegate was permitted to take the floor.
senses.example_zh: 主席点头示意，允许该代表上台发言。

senses.meaning: 唯恐避之不及；避而远之
senses.example_en: Ever since their huge argument, she has been avoiding him like the plague.
senses.example_zh: 自从他们大吵一架之后，她就对他避之唯恐不及。

senses.meaning: 回避目光接触；不敢正视
senses.example_en: The nervous witness avoided eye contact with the defense attorney during questioning.
senses.example_zh: 那名紧张的证人在接受质询时一直回避与辩方律师的目光接触。

senses.meaning: 避免做某事（后接动名词）
senses.example_en: You should avoid eating sugary snacks late at night.
senses.example_zh: 你应该避免深夜吃含糖零食。

senses.example_en: The driver swerved sharply and narrowly avoided a head-on collision.
senses.example_zh: 司机猛打方向盘，勉强避开了一场迎头相撞的事故。

senses.example_en: Diplomats are working around the clock to avoid military conflict in the region.
senses.example_zh: 外交官们正夜以继日地工作，以避免该地区爆发军事冲突。

senses.example_en: The hacker used multiple proxy servers to avoid detection by security analysts.
senses.example_zh: 黑客使用了多重代理服务器，以避开安全分析人员的侦测。

senses.meaning: 认为…理所当然；对…不予珍惜
senses.example_en: Never take your health for granted; it can deteriorate very quickly.
senses.example_zh: 永远不要把健康视为理所当然，它可能在转瞬间恶化。

senses.meaning: 我承认；就算你说得对（口语中用于让步）
senses.example_en: It's an expensive car, I grant you, but it's remarkably reliable.
senses.example_zh: 我承认这辆车确实贵，但它性能非常可靠。

senses.example_en: God grant that peace may soon be restored to this troubled region.
senses.example_zh: 但愿和平能早日回到这片多灾多难的土地上。

senses.example_en: The city council refused to grant permission for the music festival.
senses.example_zh: 市议会拒绝批准举办该音乐节的许可。

senses.example_en: The administrator will grant you access to the confidential database tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 管理员明天会授予你访问该机密数据库的权限。

senses.example_en: The judge decided to grant the defendant's request for an extension.
senses.example_zh: 法官决定批准被告延期审理的请求。

senses.example_en: The magistrate agreed to grant bail under strict conditions.
senses.example_zh: 地方法官同意在严格条件下予以保释。

senses.example_en: The government granted political asylum to several prominent dissidents.
senses.example_zh: 该国政府向几名知名异见人士提供了政治庇护。

senses.meaning: 引领某人穿过（物理空间/复杂地形）
senses.example_en: An experienced Sherpa guided the climbers through the treacherous icefall.
senses.example_zh: 一位经验丰富的夏尔巴向导带领登山者穿过了危险的冰瀑区。

senses.meaning: 耐心地指导某人完成/熟悉（复杂程序或学习过程）
senses.example_en: The interactive tutorial will guide you through the initial setup process.
senses.example_zh: 互动式教程将引导您一步步完成初始设置流程。

senses.example_en: A local historian kindly offered to guide us around the ancient ruins.
senses.example_zh: 一位当地的历史学家热心地提出带我们参观这处古代遗址。

senses.meaning: 指路明灯；精神导师；启发性力量
senses.example_en: Her grandmother was the guiding light who inspired her to pursue medicine.
senses.example_zh: 她的祖母是一盏指路明灯，激励着她投身医学事业。

senses.example_en: Integrity must remain the guiding principle behind every corporate decision.
senses.example_zh: 诚信必须始终作为每项企业决策背后的指导原则。

senses.example_en: Our clinical recommendations are firmly guided by the latest scientific evidence.
senses.example_zh: 我们的临床建议严格以最新的科学证据为指导依据。

senses.example_en: The teacher gently guided the shy boy back toward his classmates.
senses.example_zh: 老师温和地引导着那个害羞的男孩回到了同学们身边。

senses.meaning: 熟练地引导；专业地指引
senses.example_en: She expertly guided the committee toward a mutually beneficial compromise.
senses.example_zh: 她熟练地引导委员会达成了一项互惠互利的妥协方案。

senses.meaning: 指导政策制定；引领方针
senses.example_en: Sound economic data is essential to guide fiscal policy effectively.
senses.example_zh: 可靠的经济数据对于有效指导财政政策至关重要。

senses.meaning: 引导/导入（特定位置或状态）
senses.example_en: Ground crew used light wands to guide the aircraft into the gate.
senses.example_zh: 地勤人员挥动指挥棒，引导飞机滑入停机位。

senses.example_en: Critics reacted favorably to the director's bold new cinematic approach.
senses.example_zh: 评论界对这位导演大胆的新电影手法给出了积极评价。

senses.example_en: Investors were cautioned not to overreact to short-term market fluctuations.
senses.example_zh: 投资者被警告不要对短期市场波动反应过度。

senses.meaning: 对…作出反应；对…起过敏反应
senses.example_en: Markets reacted nervously to the central bank's unexpected interest rate hike.
senses.example_zh: 市场对央行出人意料的加息举措反应紧张。

senses.meaning: 反对；起而抗拒（传统、权威等）
senses.example_en: A new generation of artists began to react against the prevailing modernist doctrines.
senses.example_zh: 新一代艺术家开始反抗盛行的现代主义教条。

senses.example_en: The high-speed rail network transports millions of passengers every day.
senses.example_zh: 该高铁网络每天运送数以百万计的旅客。

senses.meaning: 仿佛被带回（过去的岁月或场景）
senses.example_en: Hearing the nostalgic melody, she was instantly transported back to her childhood.
senses.example_zh: 听到这首怀旧的旋律，她仿佛瞬间被带回到了童年时代。

senses.meaning: 生产/制造产品或零部件
senses.example_en: The facility is specially designed to manufacture precision optical components.
senses.example_zh: 该工厂专为制造精密光学元件而设计。

senses.example_en: Investigators discovered that the suspect had manufactured an elaborate alibi.
senses.example_zh: 调查人员发现嫌疑人伪造了一套天衣无缝的不在场证明。

senses.meaning: 装备；配备（技术、工具或技能）
senses.example_en: The research laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art spectrometers.
senses.example_zh: 该研究实验室配备了最先进的光谱仪。

senses.example_en: Higher education should aim to equip students for the challenges of an evolving workforce.
senses.example_zh: 高等教育应当致力于使学生具备应对不断演变的劳动力市场挑战的能力。

senses.meaning: 完全有能力/准备充分去做某事
senses.example_en: With extensive field experience, she is well equipped to handle complex overseas negotiations.
senses.example_zh: 凭借丰富的实地经验，她完全有能力处理复杂的海外谈判。

senses.meaning: 固定（利率、价格）；将…关在里面
senses.example_en: Borrowers rushed to lock in low mortgage rates before the announced hike.
senses.example_zh: 借款人赶在宣布加息前抢先锁定较低的抵押贷款利率。

senses.meaning: 对…实施全面封锁；锁定掌控
senses.example_en: Authorities took immediate steps to lock down the perimeter following the security breach.
senses.example_zh: 在发生安全漏洞后，当局立即采取措施封锁了周边区域。

senses.meaning: 把…关在门外；排斥；（资方）对（工人）实施闭厂停工
senses.example_en: He accidentally left his keys inside and locked himself out of the apartment.
senses.example_zh: 他不小心把钥匙落在了屋里，把自己反锁在了公寓门外。

senses.meaning: 与某人）发生激烈争执；角力
senses.example_en: The mayor locked horns with the city council over funding for public transit.
senses.example_zh: 市长在公共交通拨款问题上与市议会展开了激烈角力。

senses.meaning: 陷入旷日持久的争端/激战之中
senses.example_en: The two tech giants have been locked in a patent dispute for over three years.
senses.example_zh: 这两家科技巨头陷入专利纠纷已超过三年。

senses.example_en: The CEO's transparent communication during the crisis inspired widespread confidence.
senses.example_zh: 首席执行官在危机期间透明公开的沟通赢得了各方的广泛信任。

senses.meaning: 激励/鼓舞某人去做某事
senses.example_en: Her groundbreaking research inspired a whole generation of women to pursue science.
senses.example_zh: 她的开创性研究激励了整整一代女性投身于科学事业。

senses.meaning: 认同；理解并同情（某人的遭遇或感受）
senses.example_en: Many young readers closely identify with the vulnerable protagonist in the novel.
senses.example_zh: 许多年轻读者对小说中那位脆弱的主人公产生了强烈的心理共鸣。

senses.meaning: 将……与……等同起来；把……联系在一起
senses.example_en: Consumers often identify the brand name with premium quality and reliable service.
senses.example_zh: 消费者往往将该品牌名称与卓越品质和可靠服务紧密联系在一起。

idioms.phrase: identify the elephant in the room

senses.meaning: 直言指出众人回避的核心重大问题/点出房间里的大象
senses.example_en: The new auditor was the only one brave enough to identify the elephant in the room regarding the budget deficit.
senses.example_zh: 新来的审计员是唯一一个敢于直言不讳指出预算赤字这一显而易见大问题的人。

senses.meaning: 确凿指认；明确辨认出（嫌疑人或证物）
senses.example_en: The eyewitness was able to positively identify the suspect from the police lineup.
senses.example_zh: 目击证人能够从警方的列队辨认中确凿指认出犯罪嫌疑人。

senses.example_en: The engineering team worked overnight to identify the root cause of the system failure.
senses.example_zh: 工程团队彻夜工作，以查明系统故障的根本原因。

collocations.phrase: identify a gap in the market

senses.meaning: 发现市场空白/发掘商机
senses.example_en: The entrepreneurs succeeded because they identified a clear gap in the eco-friendly packaging market.
senses.example_zh: 这些创业者之所以成功，是因为他们在环保包装市场中敏锐地捕捉到了市场空白。

senses.example_en: The summit aims to help regional leaders identify key priorities for environmental protection.
senses.example_zh: 峰会旨在帮助地区领导人明确环境保护的核心优先工作。

senses.meaning: 自我认同为；认同自己的身份是（特定性别、群体、身份等）
senses.example_en: A growing percentage of respondents in the survey identified as independent voters.
senses.example_zh: 调查中越来越多的受访者将自己的政治身份认同为独立选民。

senses.meaning: 应某人之邀；按照某人的要求
senses.example_en: The meeting was scheduled at the client's request.
senses.example_zh: 这次会议是应客户要求安排的。

senses.example_en: Further details of the study are available on request.
senses.example_zh: 该研究的更多详细资料可备索。

senses.meaning: 应广大群众的强烈要求
senses.example_en: The band played an extra concert by popular request.
senses.example_zh: 应广大歌迷的强烈要求，该乐队加演了一场音乐会。

senses.example_en: The journalist requested permission to record the interview.
senses.example_zh: 记者请求录音采访许可。

senses.example_en: The ambassador formally requested an emergency session of the council.
senses.example_zh: 大使正式要求召开理事会紧急会议。

senses.example_en: Dissatisfied customers have the right to request a full refund within 30 days.
senses.example_zh: 不满意的顾客有权在30天内申请全额退款。

senses.example_en: He requested an extension on the project deadline due to unforeseen delays.
senses.example_zh: 由于不可预见的延误，他申请将项目截止日期延期。

senses.meaning: 向（某人）请求，向（某人）索求
senses.example_en: There is one small favor I would like to request of you before you leave.
senses.example_zh: 在你离开之前，我想向你请求帮一个小忙。

senses.meaning: 用打印机打印出（纸质文件）
senses.example_en: Could you please print out a copy of the contract for me to sign?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我打印一份合同让我签字吗？

senses.meaning: 快速从电脑中）打印出（数份文件
senses.example_en: I'll print off a few copies of the agenda before the meeting starts.
senses.example_zh: 开会前我会把议程打印几份出来。

senses.meaning: 大量印制，印刷（宣传册、海报、传单等）
senses.example_en: They printed up thousands of flyers to advertise the festival.
senses.example_zh: 他们印制了成千上万份传单来宣传这次节日活动。

senses.meaning: 书籍）仍在印行，仍在销售；见诸报刊
senses.example_en: The classic novel has remained in print for more than fifty years.
senses.example_zh: 这部经典小说五十多年来一直在印行发售。

senses.meaning: 书籍）已绝版，不再印刷发行
senses.example_en: This dictionary is unfortunately out of print and hard to find second-hand.
senses.example_zh: 可惜这本词典已经绝版，二手书也很难买到。

senses.meaning: 合同等文件中的）小号字补充条款，附属细则（常隐含不利条件
senses.example_en: Always read the fine print before signing any insurance agreement.
senses.example_zh: 签署任何保险协议之前，务必仔细阅读细则条款。

senses.example_en: Key terms and definitions are printed in bold throughout the textbook.
senses.example_zh: 全书的关键术语和定义均以粗体印制。

senses.meaning: 刊登撤回声明，登报更正
senses.example_en: The newspaper was forced to print a retraction after publishing false allegations.
