senses.meaning: 袖手旁观；一点忙都不帮
senses.example_en: He just sat on the couch and didn't lift a finger while we cleaned the house.
senses.example_zh: 我们打扫屋子时，他光坐在沙发上，一点忙都不帮。

senses.example_en: The government announced plans to lift travel restrictions by next month.
senses.example_zh: 政府宣布计划在下个月前解除旅行限制。

senses.meaning: 振奋某人的精神；使心情好转
senses.example_en: A walk in the fresh morning air always helps lift my spirits.
senses.example_zh: 在清晨清新的空气中散步总能让我精神一振。

senses.example_en: He spent the entire meeting kissing up to the new manager to secure a promotion.
senses.example_zh: 他整个会议都在拍新经理的马屁，以谋求晋升。

senses.meaning: 与…永别；做好彻底失去某物的心理准备
senses.example_en: If you miss the filing deadline, you can kiss your tax refund goodbye.
senses.example_zh: 如果你错过了申报截止日期，你的退税款就泡汤了。

senses.meaning: 轻吻某人道别/轻吻道晚安
senses.example_en: She kissed her daughter goodnight and turned off the bedroom light.
senses.example_zh: 她吻了吻女儿道了声晚安，随后关掉了卧室的灯。

senses.example_en: He greeted her with a warm smile and kissed her lightly on the cheek.
senses.example_zh: 他带着温暖的微笑迎向她，并在她的脸颊上轻轻吻了一下。

senses.example_en: People often confuse being busy with being productive.
senses.example_zh: 人们常常把瞎忙和高效混为一谈。

senses.meaning: 混淆视听；使问题复杂化
senses.example_en: Introducing irrelevant statistics will only confuse the issue further.
senses.example_zh: 引入无关的统计数据只会让问题更加扑朔迷离。

senses.example_en: The twin sisters look so similar that they easily confuse their teachers.
senses.example_zh: 这对双胞胎姐妹长得太像了，经常让老师分不清。

senses.meaning: 屈服于；顺从；接受（审查或裁决）
senses.example_en: The suspects agreed to submit to questioning without a lawyer present.
senses.example_zh: 嫌疑人同意在没有律师在场的情况下接受讯问。

senses.example_en: All candidates must submit an application before the end of the month.
senses.example_zh: 所有候选人必须在月底前提交申请。

senses.example_en: Students are required to submit their final thesis by Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 学生被要求在周五下午前提交最终论文。

idioms.phrase: defeat the purpose / defeat the object

senses.meaning: 违背初衷；失去原本意义；适得其反
senses.example_en: Eating fast food right after working out defeats the purpose of exercising.
senses.example_zh: 刚健身完就吃快餐完全违背了锻炼的初衷。

senses.example_en: The champion narrowly defeated his opponent in the final round.
senses.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在最后一轮险胜对手。

senses.example_en: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to defeat the proposed bill.
senses.example_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票否决了该拟议法案。

senses.example_en: The national team was soundly defeated in the semi-finals.
senses.example_zh: 国家队在半决赛中惨遭痛击淘汰出局。

senses.meaning: 轰然倒塌；（梦想、体系等）瞬间破灭
senses.example_en: When the scandal broke, his carefully built career crashed down.
senses.example_zh: 丑闻曝光后，他苦心经营的事业轰然瓦解。

senses.meaning: 精疲力竭倒头大睡；在比赛中被淘汰出局
senses.example_en: After working a 14-hour shift, he crashed out on the sofa.
senses.example_zh: 连续工作14个小时后，他倒在沙发上便昏睡过去。

senses.example_en: Despite massive funding, the new tech startup crashed and burned within a year.
senses.example_zh: 尽管资金雄厚，这家新科技初创公司仍在一年内惨淡收场。

senses.meaning: 不请自来地混入聚会；蹭派对
senses.example_en: A few college students managed to crash the celebrity after-party.
senses.example_zh: 几个大学生想方设法蹭进了名流举办的庆功派对。

senses.example_en: Save your work frequently in case the software crashes unexpectedly.
senses.example_zh: 经常保存工作内容，以防软件意外崩溃。

senses.example_en: The driver lost control on the icy road and crashed into a tree.
senses.example_zh: 司机在结冰的路面上失去控制，撞上了一棵树。

senses.meaning: 冲走；冲垮；洗刷掉（痕迹、罪恶等）
senses.example_en: Heavy flooding washed away several temporary bridges overnight.
senses.example_zh: 暴雨引发的洪水一夜之间冲垮了数座临时桥梁。

senses.meaning: 水流把物体）冲上海滩/岸边；洗碗；彻底过气/毫无前途（be washed up
senses.example_en: Plastic debris continues to wash up on the island's pristine shores.
senses.example_zh: 塑料垃圾不断被海浪冲上这座小岛原本洁净的海滩。

senses.meaning: 彻底冲洗（表面）；用饮料送服/就着液体咽下（食物、药物）
senses.example_en: He washed down the spicy tacos with a cold glass of lemonade.
senses.example_zh: 他喝了一大口冰柠檬水，咽下了辛辣的墨西哥卷饼。

senses.meaning: 洗掉（污渍）；因下雨取消/中断（be washed out）
senses.example_en: The outdoor music festival was completely washed out by the downpour.
senses.example_zh: 室外音乐节因倾盆大雨而被迫彻底取消。

senses.meaning: 洗手不干；撒手不管；与……断绝/撇清干系
senses.example_en: After repeatedly offering help to no avail, she washed her hands of the whole project.
senses.example_zh: 在屡次提供帮助未果后，她彻底对这个项目撒手不管了。

senses.meaning: 那一套行不通；没人会信；站不住脚
senses.example_en: Making up excuses like traffic delays just won't wash with our strict boss.
senses.example_zh: 编造堵车之类的借口在我们严厉的老板那儿根本行不通。

senses.example_en: A rare deep-sea fish washed ashore after the hurricane.
senses.example_zh: 飓风过后，一条罕见的深海鱼被冲上了岸。

senses.meaning: 耐心培育；悉心扶持促其发展
senses.example_en: He carefully nursed the fragile startup along until it became profitable.
senses.example_zh: 他悉心扶持这家脆弱的初创公司，直至其实现盈利。

senses.example_en: Life is too short to nurse a grudge over such a trivial matter.
senses.example_zh: 人生苦短，没必要为了这么点小事耿耿于怀。

senses.example_en: The striker will sit out this weekend's match to nurse a hamstring injury.
senses.example_zh: 这位前锋本周末将缺席比赛，以调养腿筋拉伤。

senses.meaning: 慢慢抿饮一杯酒/饮料（喝得很慢）
senses.example_en: He sat alone at the corner table, quietly nursing a beer for over an hour.
senses.example_zh: 他独自坐在角落的桌旁，一杯啤酒慢慢喝了一个多小时。

senses.meaning: 心怀抱负；抱有长久的野心
senses.example_en: She had long nursed an ambition to run for public office.
senses.example_zh: 她长久以来一直怀揣着竞选公职的抱负。

senses.meaning: 悉心照料某人直至康复
senses.example_en: She stayed by his bedside for weeks to nurse him back to health.
senses.example_zh: 她在他的床前守候了数周，悉心照料直到他恢复健康。

senses.example_en: Patients who exhibit mild symptoms are advised to isolate at home.
senses.example_zh: 建议出现轻微症状的患者居家隔离。

senses.example_en: Children under severe stress often exhibit aggressive behavior.
senses.example_zh: 承受巨大压力的儿童往往会表现出攻击性行为。

senses.example_en: The gallery is proud to exhibit paintings by local contemporary artists.
senses.example_zh: 该画廊很荣幸展出当地当代艺术家的绘画作品。

senses.example_en: The teacher told the excited children to gather round for the story.
senses.example_zh: 老师让兴奋的孩子们围拢过来听故事。

senses.meaning: 收拾起；搜集齐（物品或思绪）
senses.example_en: She gathered up her scattered papers and stuffed them into her briefcase.
senses.example_zh: 她收拾好散落的文件，塞进了公文包。

senses.meaning: 理清思绪；镇定下来组织语言
senses.example_en: He paused at the podium for a moment to gather his thoughts before speaking.
senses.example_zh: 他在讲台前稍作停顿以理清思绪，随后开始发言。

senses.meaning: 加快步伐；势头越来越猛
senses.example_en: The transition toward renewable energy has gathered pace in recent years.
senses.example_zh: 近年来，向可再生能源的转型步伐显著加快。

senses.example_en: Investigators worked around the clock to gather forensic evidence from the crime scene.
senses.example_zh: 调查人员夜以继日地从犯罪现场搜集法医物证。

senses.example_en: His expensive exercise bike has just been gathering dust in the garage.
senses.example_zh: 他那台昂贵的健身车一直闲置在车库里吃灰。

senses.example_en: The board of directors must consult with external auditors before finalizing the report.
senses.example_zh: 董事会必须先与外部审计师磋商，才能最终定稿报告。

senses.example_en: If the symptoms persist for more than three days, consult a doctor immediately.
senses.example_zh: 如果症状持续超过三天，请立即就医。

senses.example_en: The general practitioner recommended that he consult a heart specialist.
senses.example_zh: 全科医生建议他去看心脏专科医生。

senses.example_en: Students are encouraged to consult a dictionary when encountering unfamiliar words.
senses.example_zh: 建议学生在遇到生词时查阅词典。

senses.example_en: The paramedic carefully bound up the deep wound to stem the bleeding.
senses.example_zh: 医护人员小心地包扎好深伤口以止血。

senses.meaning: 法院）责令（某人）守行/交付保释金
senses.example_en: The magistrate bound him over to keep the peace for twelve months.
senses.example_zh: 治安法官责令他遵守治安一年以保释。

senses.example_en: Once signed, both parties are legally bound by the terms of the contract.
senses.example_zh: 一旦签署，双方均须受合同条款的法律约束。

senses.meaning: 将……紧密维系/团结在一起；黏合
senses.example_en: Shared traditions and values bind the diverse community together.
senses.example_zh: 共同的传统和价值观将这个多元化的社区紧密维系在一起。

senses.meaning: 数量、账单、开支等）逐渐累积，迅速增加
senses.example_en: Medical expenses can mount up quickly without comprehensive insurance.
senses.example_zh: 如果没有全面的医疗保险，医疗费用很快就会越积越多。

senses.meaning: 发起运动；提出有力挑战
senses.example_en: Environmental groups have mounted a legal challenge against the pipeline project.
senses.example_zh: 环保团体已针对该输油管道项目提起了法律诉讼与挑战。

senses.meaning: 压力剧增；紧张局势加剧
senses.example_en: Pressure is mounting on the prime minister to step down amid the scandal.
senses.example_zh: 丑闻之下，要求首相辞职的压力日益剧增。

senses.example_en: The police officer mounted his horse and patrolled the crowded avenue.
senses.example_zh: 警官骑上马，在拥挤的大道上巡逻。

collocations.phrase: can ill afford to do sth

senses.meaning: 承担不起做某事的后果；绝不能冒险做某事
senses.example_en: At this critical stage of development, the company can ill afford to lose key personnel.
senses.example_zh: 在当前关键的发展阶段，公司绝承担不起骨干人才流失的代价。

senses.meaning: 提供机会；给予庇护/保护
senses.example_en: The summit affords world leaders a rare opportunity to engage in direct dialogue.
senses.example_zh: 该峰会为各国领导人提供了直接对话的难得契机。

senses.example_en: Few young families in the city can afford the exorbitant cost of childcare.
senses.example_zh: 该市几乎没有年轻家庭能够负担得起高昂的托儿费用。

idioms.phrase: what possessed someone to do sth

senses.meaning: 表示难以置信或恼怒）什么鬼迷了心窍让某人做出某事
senses.example_en: What on earth possessed you to tell the boss our secret plans?
senses.example_zh: 你究竟着了什么魔，竟然把我们的机密计划全抖给老板了？

senses.example_en: She possesses exceptional leadership skills and remains calm under pressure.
senses.example_zh: 她具备出众的领导才能，并在高压下始终沉着冷静。

senses.meaning: 被（强烈情绪、恐惧或执念）所支配或缠绕
senses.example_en: He was possessed by an overpowering desire to discover the truth.
senses.example_zh: 他被一种极度强烈的揭开真相的渴望所驱使。

senses.meaning: 限制进入/使用（区域、数据或资源）
senses.example_en: Strict protocols are in place to restrict access to the server room.
senses.example_zh: 现场已实施严格的安全条例，以限制进出服务器机房。

senses.meaning: 严加限制；极大程度约束
senses.example_en: The trade embargo has severely restricted the country's economic growth.
senses.example_zh: 贸易禁运严重遏制了该国的经济增长。

senses.meaning: 自律于；仅限于（做某事或食用某物）
senses.example_en: To maintain his weight, he restricted himself to one glass of wine a week.
senses.example_zh: 为了保持体重，他克制自己每周只喝一杯葡萄酒。

senses.meaning: 把…吓跑；吓退（潜在买家、入侵者等）
senses.example_en: Rising housing prices may scare away younger first-time buyers.
senses.example_zh: 不断上涨的房价可能会吓退较年轻的首次购房群体。

senses.meaning: 勉强设法弄到（急需的资金、食物或人手）
senses.example_en: We managed to scare up a few volunteers to help set up the stage.
senses.example_zh: 我们好不容易临时拉到了几个志愿者来帮忙搭建舞台。

idioms.phrase: scare the life out of someone

senses.meaning: 把某人吓得魂飞魄散；把某人吓个半死
senses.example_en: Don't jump out behind doors like that! You scared the life out of me.
senses.example_zh: 别那样冷不丁从门后蹦出来！你真把我吓了个半死。

senses.meaning: 把某人吓呆；吓得浑身发僵
senses.example_en: Turbulence during the flight scared the passengers stiff.
senses.example_zh: 飞行途中的颠簸把机上乘客吓得魂不附体。

senses.example_en: The scammers tried to scare elderly victims into transferring their savings.
senses.example_zh: 诈骗分子试图恐吓老年受害者，迫使其转出个人积蓄。

idioms.phrase: err on the side of caution

senses.meaning: 宁可过于谨慎；以防万一，力求稳妥
senses.example_en: When checking these complex balance sheets, it is always wise to err on the side of caution.
senses.example_zh: 在核对这些复杂的资产负债表时，力求谨慎稳妥向来是明智之举。

senses.meaning: 在某方面犯错/发生判断失误
senses.example_en: The local council erred in approving the construction project without public consultation.
senses.example_zh: 市议会在未进行公众咨询的情况下就批准了该建设项目，这显然是个失误。

senses.example_en: He hated being labeled as a troublemaker just because he voiced his concerns.
senses.example_zh: 他讨厌仅仅因为表达了自己的担忧就被贴上“惹事者”的标签。

senses.example_en: All chemical containers must be clearly labeled with hazard warnings.
senses.example_zh: 所有化学品容器都必须清晰标明危险警告。

senses.example_en: The company decided to initiate legal proceedings against its former partner.
senses.example_zh: 该公司决定对前合伙人提起法律诉讼。

senses.example_en: Both nations agreed to initiate a dialogue to defuse border tensions.
senses.example_zh: 两国同意开启对话以缓和边境紧张局势。

senses.meaning: 使某人初涉；接纳某人入会
senses.example_en: She was initiated into the secret society in a midnight ceremony.
senses.example_zh: 她在午夜的仪式中被接纳成为该秘密会社的成员。

senses.example_en: The police suspected him of leaking classified information to the press.
senses.example_zh: 警方怀疑他向媒体泄露了机密信息。

senses.example_en: Doctors have reason to suspect that the outbreak was caused by contaminated water.
senses.example_zh: 医生们有理由怀疑疫情是由受污染的水源引起的。

senses.example_en: I strongly suspect that they are hiding the true extent of the damage.
senses.example_zh: 我极其怀疑他们隐瞒了受损的真实程度。

senses.example_en: He was accused of aiding and abetting the fugitive in evading arrest.
senses.example_zh: 他被控协助并教唆该逃犯逃避抓捕。

senses.example_en: Regular exercise aids in reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease.
senses.example_zh: 规律运动有助于降低心血管疾病的风险。

senses.example_en: Drinking plenty of fluids will aid your recovery from the flu.
senses.example_zh: 多喝水将有助于你从流感中康复。

senses.meaning: 急忙抓住；仓促抓住（机会等）
senses.example_en: He grabbed at the handrail as the train lurched forward.
senses.example_zh: 列车猛然前冲时，他一把抓住了扶手。

senses.meaning: 人人可争取的；待竞争的
senses.example_en: With the incumbent retiring, the senate seat is suddenly up for grabs.
senses.example_zh: 随着现任者退休，该参议院席位突然变得人人皆可竞逐。

senses.example_en: Let's grab a bite before the movie starts.
senses.example_zh: 电影开始前我们去随便吃点东西吧。

senses.meaning: 吸引注意力；成为头条新闻
senses.example_en: The scandal quickly grabbed the headlines across the country.
senses.example_zh: 该丑闻迅速登上了全国各大媒体的头条。

senses.example_en: Two experienced investigators were assigned to the case.
senses.example_zh: 两名经验丰富的调查员被指派负责此案。

senses.example_en: The committee was formed not to assign blame, but to prevent future errors.
senses.example_zh: 成立该委员会的目的不是为了追究责任，而是为了防止未来再度出错。

senses.example_en: The administration assigns high priority to renewable energy development.
senses.example_zh: 该届政府高度重视可再生能源的发展。

senses.example_en: She managed to convince the investors of the project's long-term profitability.
senses.example_zh: 她成功让投资者确信该项目具有长期盈利能力。

senses.example_en: We finally convinced him to see a doctor about his chronic back pain.
senses.example_zh: 我们终于说服他去医院看他那慢性的背痛。

senses.example_en: Skeptical board members were difficult to convince without solid data.
senses.example_zh: 没有确凿的数据，持怀疑态度的董事会成员很难被说服。

senses.example_en: The board decided to proceed with the merger despite market uncertainty.
senses.example_zh: 尽管市场前景不明朗，董事会仍决定继续推进这项合并案。

senses.example_en: She finished her presentation and proceeded to answer questions from the audience.
senses.example_zh: 她做完陈述后，接着回答了现场听众的提问。

senses.example_en: Investors are advised to proceed with caution in this volatile market.
senses.example_zh: 建议投资者在这个动荡的市场中谨慎行事。

senses.example_en: The construction work is proceeding as planned.
senses.example_zh: 施工正在按计划顺利推进。

senses.example_en: Most of the current problems proceed from poor communication between departments.
senses.example_zh: 目前的大多数问题都源于各部门之间沟通不畅。

senses.example_en: Doctors are closely monitoring the patient's recovery after surgery.
senses.example_zh: 医生们正在密切监测该患者术后的恢复情况。

senses.example_en: The manager set up weekly checkpoints to monitor progress on the project.
senses.example_zh: 经理设立了每周审查节点，以跟踪项目的进展情况。

senses.example_en: Independent inspectors visit regularly to monitor compliance with safety regulations.
senses.example_zh: 独立质检员会定期走访，监督安全法规的执行合规情况。

senses.example_en: The police announced a new campaign to crack down on reckless driving.
senses.example_zh: 警方宣布开展一项新行动，严厉打击危险驾驶行为。

senses.example_en: Her impression of the boss made everyone in the room crack up.
senses.example_zh: 她模仿老板的样子让屋里的所有人都笑得前仰后合。

senses.example_en: We haven't got much time left, so let's crack on with the preparations.
senses.example_zh: 我们时间不多了，赶紧加紧准备吧。

senses.meaning: 破译密码；找到窍门/破解难题
senses.example_en: Marketers have spent years trying to crack the code of teenage spending habits.
senses.example_zh: 营销人员花费了数年时间试图摸透青少年的消费习惯秘诀。

senses.example_en: He cracked a joke to lighten the tense atmosphere in the meeting room.
senses.example_zh: 他开了个玩笑来缓解会议室里的紧张气氛。

senses.example_en: A true professional never cracks under pressure.
senses.example_zh: 真正的专业人士绝不会在重压之下乱了阵脚。

senses.example_en: Let's crack open a bottle of champagne to celebrate your promotion.
senses.example_zh: 我们开一瓶香槟庆祝你升职吧。

senses.example_en: His casual remarks deeply offended several members of the committee.
senses.example_zh: 他漫不经心的言论深深得罪了委员会的几位成员。

senses.example_en: I apologize if I unintentionally offended anyone with my comment.
senses.example_zh: 如果我的言论无意中冒犯了任何人，我深表歉意。

senses.meaning: 触犯，违背（法律、道德或原则）
senses.example_en: Actions that offend against basic human rights should not be tolerated.
senses.example_zh: 违背基本人权的行为绝不应该被容忍。

senses.example_en: They decided to rent out their spare room on weekends for extra income.
senses.example_zh: 他们决定在周末把空置的房间租出去以赚取额外收入。

senses.example_en: Finding a reasonably priced apartment to rent in the city center is almost impossible.
senses.example_zh: 在市中心想租到价格合理的公寓几乎是不可能的。

senses.example_en: The holiday cottage is usually rented by the week during the summer season.
senses.example_zh: 这座度假小屋在夏季通常按周出租。

senses.example_en: She decided to dye her hair bright red for the summer.
senses.example_zh: 她决定夏天把头发染成鲜红色。

senses.example_en: The fabric was dyed dark blue using traditional natural pigments.
senses.example_zh: 这块布料是用传统天然颜料染成深蓝色的。

senses.meaning: 摆脱，甩掉（疾病、不良情绪或追踪者）
senses.example_en: I've been trying to shake off this cold all week.
senses.example_zh: 这一整周我都在试着摆脱这场感冒。

senses.meaning: 重组，彻底整顿；使震惊，使动摇
senses.example_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
senses.example_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

senses.meaning: 抖开；（行业或市场）优胜劣汰，出现分晓
senses.example_en: Let's wait and see how the market shakes out before investing.
senses.example_zh: 我们先静观市场洗牌后的局面，然后再做投资。

senses.meaning: 握手；握手言和；握手成交
senses.example_en: After hours of negotiation, they finally shook hands on the deal.
senses.example_zh: 经过数小时的谈判，他们最终握手达成了交易。

senses.example_en: Come on, shake a leg, or we're going to miss our flight!
senses.example_zh: 快点，动作麻利点，不然我们要赶不上航班了！

senses.meaning: 摇头（表示反对、无奈或否定）
senses.example_en: He shook his head in disbelief when he heard the shocking news.
senses.example_zh: 听到这个震惊的消息时，他难以置信地摇了摇头。

senses.example_en: Her voice shook with anger as she confronted the dishonest employee.
senses.example_zh: 当面对质那名不诚实的员工时，她的声音因愤怒而颤抖。

senses.example_en: The authorities cannot guarantee the safety of travelers in that region.
senses.example_zh: 当局无法保障前往该地区旅客的安全。

senses.meaning: 必定会做某事；肯定会引发某种结果
senses.example_en: His witty remarks are always guaranteed to make people laugh.
senses.example_zh: 他那些诙谐的话语总是一定能逗人发笑。

senses.example_en: Her parents agreed to guarantee the mortgage for her first apartment.
senses.example_zh: 她的父母同意为她首套公寓的房贷提供担保。

senses.meaning: 使某人厌烦至极，无聊得要命
senses.example_en: The lecture on tax codes bored the entire audience to tears.
senses.example_zh: 那场关于税法的讲座让全场听众无聊得要命。

senses.example_en: The carpenter used an electric drill to bore a hole through the plank.
senses.example_zh: 木工用电钻在木板上钻出了一个洞。

senses.meaning: 目光）紧盯着，逼视；钻入，穿透
senses.example_en: I could feel his sharp eyes boring into me as I spoke.
senses.example_zh: 我说话时能感觉到他敏锐的目光紧紧盯着我。

senses.example_en: The prosecutor accused the suspect of tampering with evidence.
senses.example_zh: 检察官指控嫌疑人篡改证据。

senses.example_en: He claimed that he had been falsely accused by his political rivals.
senses.example_zh: 他声称自己遭到了政敌的诬告。

senses.example_en: Technological advancements have radically transformed the way we work.
senses.example_zh: 技术的进步从根本上改变了我们的工作方式。

senses.example_en: Access to clean water will transform the lives of millions of villagers.
senses.example_zh: 获得清洁饮用水将改变数百万村民的生活。

senses.example_en: The old industrial warehouse was transformed into a modern art gallery.
senses.example_zh: 那座旧工业仓库被改造为一座现代艺术馆。

senses.example_en: Economists failed to accurately predict the scale of the financial crisis.
senses.example_zh: 经济学家们未能准确预测这场金融危机的规模。

senses.example_en: It is nearly impossible to predict the outcome of this tight election.
senses.example_zh: 要预测这场势均力敌的选举结果几乎是不可能的。

senses.example_en: The long-term effects of global warming are extremely difficult to predict.
senses.example_zh: 全球变暖的长期影响极其难以预测。

senses.example_en: The final episode of the popular drama bitterly disappointed long-time fans.
senses.example_zh: 该热播剧的最终集让长久以来的剧迷们深感失望。

senses.example_en: The new product failed in the market and disappointed investors' expectations.
senses.example_zh: 这款新产品在市场上受挫，辜负了投资者的期望。

senses.meaning: 很遗憾要让你扫兴/失望了（常用于口语委婉反驳）
senses.example_en: I hate to disappoint you, but the tickets are already completely sold out.
senses.example_zh: 很遗憾要让你扫兴了，但门票已经彻底售罄了。

senses.example_en: Many manufacturers now prefer to retail directly to consumers online.
senses.example_zh: 许多制造商现在更喜欢通过线上直接向消费者销售。

senses.example_en: The new wireless earbuds retail at $149.
senses.example_zh: 这款新型无线耳机的零售价为149美元。

senses.meaning: 断然拒绝；不假思索地回绝
senses.example_en: The board rejected the takeover bid out of hand.
senses.example_zh: 董事会断然拒绝了这项收购要约。

senses.example_en: She reluctantly rejected the job offer due to the long commute.
senses.example_zh: 由于通勤路途遥远，她勉强拒绝了那份工作邀请。

senses.example_en: The high court rejected his appeal against the sentence.
senses.example_zh: 高等法院驳回了他对判决的上诉。

senses.meaning: 使某人面临/接触到（风险、光照等）
senses.example_en: Working late hours exposed him to significant workplace stress.
senses.example_zh: 长时间加班让他承受了巨大的工作压力。

senses.example_en: Investigative journalists exposed high-level corruption within the ministry.
senses.example_zh: 调查记者揭露了该部门内部的高层腐败。

senses.example_en: The stress test exposed severe flaws in the bank's risk model.
senses.example_zh: 压力测试暴露了该银行风险模型中的严重缺陷。

senses.example_en: The company decided to concentrate its efforts on emerging markets.
senses.example_zh: 公司决定将精力集中在开拓新兴市场上。

senses.example_en: The tech industry is heavily concentrated in coastal metropolitan areas.
senses.example_zh: 科技产业高度集中于沿海大都市圈。

senses.example_en: I need a quiet room so I can concentrate on my revision.
senses.example_zh: 我需要一个安静的房间，以便专心复习。

senses.meaning: 详细解释；明确说明；逐字拼出
senses.example_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
senses.example_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

senses.meaning: 招致灾难/惹来麻烦；意味着不妙的后果
senses.example_en: The proposed tax hike could spell disaster for small local businesses.
senses.example_zh: 拟议中的增税政策可能会给当地小企业带来灭顶之灾。

senses.example_en: Make sure your name is spelt correctly on the certificate.
senses.example_zh: 请确保证书上你的名字拼写正确无误。

senses.meaning: 齐心协力；出资或出力支援
senses.example_en: If we all pitch in, we can finish clearing the yard in an hour.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们大家齐心协力，一个小时就能把院子清理干净。

senses.example_en: He pitched up on our doorstep late last night without calling first.
senses.example_zh: 他昨晚深夜没打招呼就突然出现在我家门前。

senses.example_en: The city is making a pitch for hosting the next Olympic Games.
senses.example_zh: 该市正在全力争取下一届奥运会的主办权。

senses.meaning: 推介构想/项目（争取支持或投资）
senses.example_en: The startup pitched their product to several venture capitalists.
senses.example_zh: 这家初创公司向几位风险投资家推介了他们的产品。

senses.example_en: We pitched our tent near the river before it got dark.
senses.example_zh: 天黑前我们在河边搭起了帐篷。

senses.meaning: 自生自灭；全凭个人造化
senses.example_en: In a competitive market like this, new companies must sink or swim.
senses.example_zh: 在如此激烈的市场竞争中，新公司只能靠自己去拼搏存亡。

senses.example_en: There was so much financial data that my head began to swim.
senses.example_zh: 财务数据太多，看得我头晕目眩。

senses.meaning: 游几个来回（按圈游泳锻炼）
senses.example_en: She swims laps every morning before going to work.
senses.example_zh: 她每天上班前都会去泳池游几个来回。

senses.example_en: By rejecting the popular trend, the author chose to swim against the tide.
senses.example_zh: 通过拒绝大众潮流，这位作家选择了逆流而上。

senses.meaning: 连接到；伴随（责任、重要性或特征）
senses.example_en: Great prestige attaches to this academic fellowship.
senses.example_zh: 这项学术研究员职位享有崇高的声望。

senses.example_en: They offered a grant of $10,000 with no strings attached.
senses.example_zh: 他们提供了一笔一万美元的无附加条件资助金。

senses.meaning: 高度重视；认为……重要/有价值
senses.example_en: The university attaches great importance to undergraduate research.
senses.example_zh: 这所大学非常重视本科生科研。

senses.example_en: Please attach a copy of your resume to the application email.
senses.example_zh: 请在求职邮件中附上您的简历副本。

senses.example_en: Artificial intelligence technologies are rapidly evolving.
senses.example_zh: 人工智能技术正在迅猛发展。

senses.example_en: Language inevitably evolves over time as society changes.
senses.example_zh: 随着社会的变迁，语言不可避免地随时间发生演变。

senses.example_en: Modern birds are believed to have evolved from theropod dinosaurs.
senses.example_zh: 人们认为现代鸟类是由兽脚亚目恐龙演化而来的。

senses.example_en: What started as a hobby quickly evolved into a multi-million-dollar business.
senses.example_zh: 最初只是一项业余爱好，很快就演变成了一门价值数百万美元的生意。

senses.meaning: 致力于；奉献于；将（作品）题献给
senses.example_en: He dedicated his first novel to his late grandmother.
senses.example_zh: 他将自己的第一部小说献给了已故的祖母。

senses.meaning: 将毕生精力/时间奉献给……
senses.example_en: Dr. Chen dedicated her entire career to finding a cure for malaria.
senses.example_zh: 陈医生将她整个职业生涯都奉献给了寻找疟疾治疗方案的事业。

senses.example_en: The company decided to dedicate more resources to renewable energy research.
senses.example_zh: 该公司决定投入更多资源用于可再生能源研究。

senses.meaning: 使）分裂；分手，断绝关系；把……分配/分成小份
senses.example_en: After years of growing apart, the couple decided to split up peacefully.
senses.example_zh: 在经历了多年的隔阂后，这对夫妇决定和平分手。

senses.meaning: 分离；分裂出去；脱离母体独立
senses.example_en: A small faction split off from the main party to form a new coalition.
senses.example_zh: 一个小派系从主要政党中脱离出来，成立了一个新的联盟。

senses.meaning: 吹毛求疵；纠缠于微不足道的细节
senses.example_en: Whether it costs five dollars or six is just splitting hairs at this stage.
senses.example_zh: 在这个阶段争论是花五美元还是六美元纯粹是小题大做。

senses.example_en: He wanted $100 and I offered $80, so we agreed to split the difference at $90.
senses.example_zh: 他要价100美元，我出价80美元，最后我们各让一步定在90美元。

senses.example_en: Shall we split the bill, or do you want me to cover it this time?
senses.example_zh: 我们平摊账单，还是这次由我来买单？

senses.example_en: Running two independent candidates will only split the vote and hand victory to the opposition.
senses.example_zh: 推出两位独立候选人只会分散选票，把胜利拱手让给对手。

senses.meaning: 被……不断骚扰；受……折磨或困扰
senses.example_en: The minister was harried by reporters as he stepped out of the conference hall.
senses.example_zh: 部长一走出会议大厅就遭到记者们的围追堵截。

senses.meaning: 体育比赛中）持续压迫/骚扰防线
senses.example_en: The forward used his pace to harry the opposition defence throughout the match.
senses.example_zh: 该前锋在整场比赛中利用速度不断对敌方防线施压。

senses.example_en: The home crowd urged the marathon runners on as they neared the finish line.
senses.example_zh: 当马拉松选手接近终点线时，主场观众为他们加油鼓劲。

senses.example_en: Health authorities strongly urge everyone eligible to receive their booster shot.
senses.example_zh: 卫生部门强烈敦促所有符合条件的人接种加强针。

senses.meaning: 呼吁保持谨慎；敦促克制
senses.example_en: Financial analysts urge caution amid increasing volatility in the stock market.
senses.example_zh: 面对股市日益加剧的波动，金融分析师呼吁保持谨慎。

senses.example_en: Organizations that fail to adapt to rapid market changes rarely survive.
senses.example_zh: 无法适应快速市场变化的机构很难生存下去。

senses.example_en: The best-selling fantasy novel was skillfully adapted for the big screen.
senses.example_zh: 这部畅销奇幻小说被巧妙地改编成了大银幕电影。

senses.example_en: Children usually adapt quickly to a new school environment.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们通常能很快适应新的学校环境。

senses.example_en: The board decided to delay a final decision until more data becomes available.
senses.example_zh: 董事会决定推迟做出最终决定，直到获得更多数据。

senses.example_en: Dense fog delayed the flight's departure by more than three hours.
senses.example_zh: 浓雾导致该航班的起飞延误了三个多小时。

senses.meaning: 不必要地延误；过度拖延
senses.example_en: Procedural red tape should not unduly delay the approval of life-saving drugs.
senses.example_zh: 繁琐的行政审批程序不应过度延误救命药物的获批。

senses.meaning: 威胁采取法律手段；扬言起诉
senses.example_en: The company threatened legal action against former employees who breached the non-disclosure agreement.
senses.example_zh: 该公司威胁要对违反保密协议的前员工采取法律行动。

senses.example_en: The finance director threatened to resign unless the board approved the proposed budget.
senses.example_zh: 财务总监扬言，除非董事会批准拟定预算，否则他将辞职。

senses.example_en: Officials warned that cyberattacks on critical infrastructure threaten national security.
senses.example_zh: 官员警告称，针对关键基础设施的网络攻击危及国家安全。

senses.meaning: 击倒；撞倒；拆除（建筑物）；大幅削减（价格）
senses.example_en: The old factory was knocked down to make way for a modern shopping center.
senses.example_zh: 旧工厂被拆除，为一座现代化的购物中心腾出了空间。

senses.meaning: 收工，下班；停止（做某事）；降价；仿冒
senses.example_en: Let's knock off for the day and grab some dinner together.
senses.example_zh: 我们今天就收工吧，一起去吃顿晚餐。

senses.meaning: 击晕，击倒；淘汰；使筋疲力尽
senses.example_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
senses.example_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

senses.meaning: 敲木头（祈求好运，防止说漏嘴带来霉运）
senses.example_en: I haven't had a single cold all winter, knock on wood.
senses.example_zh: 我整个冬天一次感冒都没得过，但愿好运常在。

senses.meaning: 令人叹为观止；彻底征服某人
senses.example_en: Her breathtaking performance at the audition knocked everyone's socks off.
senses.example_zh: 她在试镜中惊艳的表演让所有人赞叹不已。

senses.example_en: She waited patiently after knocking on the front door.
senses.example_zh: 敲响前门后，她耐心地等待着。

senses.example_en: The cat jumped onto the desk and knocked over the coffee cup.
senses.example_zh: 猫跳上书桌，打翻了咖啡杯。

senses.meaning: 嗅出；察觉出，发觉（秘密或阴谋）
senses.example_en: The trained dogs were deployed to smell out hidden drugs.
senses.example_zh: 受训过的警犬被派去搜寻藏匿的毒品。

senses.meaning: 感到事有蹊跷，怀疑有诈
senses.example_en: When he suddenly offered to sell the car so cheaply, I began to smell a rat.
senses.example_zh: 当他突然提出以这么便宜的价格卖车时，我开始觉得事有蹊跷。

senses.meaning: 觉察到对手虚弱而乘胜追击
senses.example_en: The opposition party smelled blood as the scandal engulfed the minister.
senses.example_zh: 丑闻缠住该部长后，反对党觉察到了胜机并乘胜追击。

senses.meaning: 察觉到麻烦/危险的苗头
senses.example_en: The veteran officer could smell trouble the moment he walked into the bar.
senses.example_zh: 老警官一走进酒吧就察觉到了不对劲。

senses.example_en: Freshly baked bread always smells delicious.
senses.example_zh: 新鲜出炉的面包总是闻起来特别香。

senses.meaning: 散发出……的气味；有……的迹象
senses.example_en: His jacket smelled strongly of cigarette smoke.
senses.example_zh: 他的夹克衫散发着一股浓烈的香烟味。

senses.example_en: The firm is advertizing for an experienced software architect.
senses.example_zh: 这家公司正在登广告招聘一位经验丰富的软件架构师。

senses.example_en: Companies spend millions of dollars advertizing their products during major sports events.
senses.example_zh: 各大公司在重大体育赛事期间斥资数百万美元宣传其产品。

senses.meaning: 大做广告；进行大规模广告宣传
senses.example_en: The new streaming platform was advertized heavily across all social media.
senses.example_zh: 这个新流媒体平台在所有社交媒体上都进行了大规模广告宣传。

senses.example_en: The university plans to advertize the teaching post nationally next month.
senses.example_zh: 该大学计划下个月在全国范围内登广告招聘这个教学岗位。

senses.meaning: 仓促通过（法案等）；匆忙搞定
senses.example_en: The government was criticized for rushing the controversial bill through parliament.
senses.example_zh: 政府因匆忙让该争议性法案在议会通过而受到批评。

senses.example_en: Paramedics rushed the injured driver to hospital following the highway collision.
senses.example_zh: 高速公路相撞事故发生后，医护人员火速将受伤的司机送往医院。

senses.example_en: We have plenty of time, so there is no need to rush a decision.
senses.example_zh: 我们有充裕的时间，因此没有必要仓促作出决定。

senses.meaning: 一头栽进；轻率鲁莽地盲目行动
senses.example_en: He tended to rush headlong into business ventures without adequate market research.
senses.example_zh: 他往往在没有做足市场调研的情况下就盲目涉足商业投资。

senses.example_en: Don't rush into a long-term commitment without considering all the consequences.
senses.example_zh: 在未考虑所有后果之前，不要仓促做出长期承诺。

senses.example_en: She politely declined the job offer because it required relocating overseas.
senses.example_zh: 她礼貌地谢绝了这份工作邀约，因为该岗位需要移居海外。

senses.example_en: House prices have declined sharply over the past two quarters.
senses.example_zh: 房价在过去两个季度中急剧下跌。

senses.example_en: The spokesperson declined to comment on the ongoing investigation.
senses.example_zh: 发言人拒绝就正在进行的调查发表评论。

senses.example_en: The extra revenue from new sales was canceled out by rising operational costs.
senses.example_zh: 新销售带来的额外收益被不断上升的运营成本抵消了。

senses.example_en: I need to call the clinic to cancel my dental appointment for tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 我需要给诊所打电话取消明天的看牙预约。

senses.example_en: Bad weather forced the airline to cancel several international flights.
senses.example_zh: 恶劣天气迫使该航空公司取消了数个国际航班。

senses.example_en: You can cancel your monthly subscription at any time without penalty.
senses.example_zh: 您可以随时取消按月订阅，无需支付违约金。

senses.example_en: The cyclist sustained serious injuries after being hit by a car.
senses.example_zh: 那名骑行者被汽车撞击后身受重伤。

senses.example_en: Policies are needed to sustain steady growth amid global inflation.
senses.example_zh: 在全球通胀背景下，需要出台政策以维持稳定的经济增长。

senses.example_en: Mars lacks sufficient oxygen and liquid water to sustain life.
senses.example_zh: 火星缺乏维持生命所需的充足氧气和液态水。

senses.example_en: The lake usually freezes over by late December.
senses.example_zh: 这个湖通常在十二月下旬完全封冻。

senses.meaning: 排挤某人；冷落某人使其出局
senses.example_en: He felt he was being frozen out of key executive decisions.
senses.example_zh: 他觉得自己被排挤在核心管理层决策之外。

senses.meaning: 系统或屏幕）死机，卡死；（人因紧张或惊吓）呆住说不出话
senses.example_en: Whenever she stepped onto the stage, her mind completely froze up.
senses.example_zh: 每当她走上舞台，她的大脑就一片空白、彻底卡壳。

senses.meaning: 因惊恐或吃惊而）突然僵在原地
senses.example_en: He froze in his tracks when he heard a bear growling nearby.
senses.example_zh: 听到附近传来熊的低吼声，他吓得僵在原地不敢动弹。

senses.example_en: The court ordered the bank to freeze all assets belonging to the suspect.
senses.example_zh: 法院责令银行冻结嫌疑人名下的所有资产。

senses.example_en: The government decided to freeze energy prices for the upcoming winter.
senses.example_zh: 政府决定在即将到来的冬季冻结能源价格。

senses.example_en: The new scholarship enabled her to study abroad without financial strain.
senses.example_zh: 这项新奖学金使她能够出国留学而没有经济压力。

senses.example_en: Cloud computing enables rapid innovation across modern enterprises.
senses.example_zh: 云计算赋能现代企业实现快速创新。

senses.meaning: 追逐，追赶；追求（爱情、名利等）
senses.example_en: He ran down the street chasing after the departing bus.
senses.example_zh: 他沿着街道狂奔，追赶那辆正开走的公交车。

senses.meaning: 追捕到；追查并找到（信息或人）
senses.example_en: The reporter spent months chasing down leads for the corruption story.
senses.example_zh: 记者花了数月时间追查这条贪腐报道的线索。

senses.example_en: I need to chase up the finance team regarding the overdue invoice.
senses.example_zh: 我得催一下财务团队处理那笔逾期未付的发票。

senses.meaning: 瞎忙；原地打转，徒劳无功
senses.example_en: Without a clear strategic plan, we are just chasing our tail.
senses.example_zh: 如果没有明确的战略规划，我们只是在原地打转瞎忙活。

senses.example_en: Stop chasing rainbows and focus on a career that offers stability.
senses.example_zh: 别再追逐白日梦了，专注在一份能给你带来稳定保障的事业上吧。

senses.example_en: She moved to New York to chase her dream of becoming a dancer.
senses.example_zh: 她搬到了纽约，去追逐成为一名舞者的梦想。

senses.example_en: The tech tycoon donated millions of dollars to cancer research.
senses.example_zh: 这位科技大亨向癌症研究机构捐赠了数百万美元。

senses.example_en: Volunteers queued at the clinic to donate blood after the earthquake.
senses.example_zh: 地震发生后，志愿者们在诊所排队献血。

senses.example_en: It took him several months to adjust to the intense work pace.
senses.example_zh: 他花了好几个月才适应这种快节奏的工作。

senses.example_en: The central bank may adjust interest rates to counter inflation.
senses.example_zh: 央行可能会调整利率以对抗通货膨胀。

senses.meaning: 自我调整；调整坐姿或衣物
senses.example_en: He paused and adjusted his tie before opening the boardroom door.
senses.example_zh: 在推开董事会会议室大门前，他停顿了一下并整理好领带。

senses.meaning: 英语口语）心肠真好；哎呀真是的（兼含怜爱或温和调侃
senses.example_en: You shoveled my driveway? Bless your heart, that was so thoughtful!
senses.example_zh: 你帮我把车道上的雪铲了？你人太好了，真体贴！

senses.meaning: 有幸享有……；得天独厚地拥有（才能、健康等）
senses.example_en: The island is blessed with abundant sunshine and fertile soil.
senses.example_zh: 该岛得天独厚，享有充沛的阳光与肥沃的土地。

senses.example_en: The priest stepped forward to bless the couple's marriage.
senses.example_zh: 神父走上前去祝福这对新人的婚姻。

senses.example_en: The police department is responsible for enforcing the law impartially.
senses.example_zh: 警局有责任公正执法。

senses.example_en: The school strictly enforces a zero-tolerance policy on bullying.
senses.example_zh: 学校对欺凌行为严格执行零容忍政策。

senses.meaning: 强制合规；强行督促遵守
senses.example_en: Regulators have the authority to enforce compliance with safety standards.
senses.example_zh: 监管机构有权强制要求遵守安全标准。

senses.meaning: 使恢复到（某种状态、职务或地位）
senses.example_en: After months of therapy, his mobility was restored to normal.
senses.example_zh: 经过数月的治疗，他的活动能力恢复到了正常水平。

senses.example_en: Troops were deployed to the streets to restore order.
senses.example_zh: 军队被部署到街头以恢复秩序。

senses.example_en: The central bank's intervention helped restore market confidence.
senses.example_zh: 央行的干预有助于重塑市场信心。

senses.example_en: A massive renovation project aims to restore the historic palace to its former glory.
senses.example_zh: 一项浩大的翻修工程旨在让这座历史悠久的宫殿重现昔日辉煌。

senses.example_en: The customs officer closely inspected the contents of the cargo.
senses.example_zh: 海关官员仔细检查了货物的内部物品。

senses.example_en: Fire safety equipment must be regularly inspected by certified professionals.
senses.example_zh: 消防安全设备必须由持证专业人员定期检查。

senses.meaning: 视察现场；检查房屋物业
senses.example_en: Health inspectors arrived unannounced to inspect the premises of the restaurant.
senses.example_zh: 卫生稽查员突击造访，对这家餐厅的场地进行了现场检查。

senses.example_en: His account of the event approximates closely to what the witnesses saw.
senses.example_zh: 他对事件的描述与目击者的所见非常接近。

senses.example_en: The simulated test environment closely approximates real-world driving conditions.
senses.example_zh: 模拟测试环境高度接近真实的驾驶路况。

senses.example_en: There is no need to scream at me; I can hear you perfectly well.
senses.example_zh: 你没必要冲我大喊大叫，我听得很清楚。

senses.example_en: She screamed out in terror when the lights suddenly went out.
senses.example_zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她惊恐地尖叫出声。

senses.meaning: 拼命尖叫；扯着嗓子大喊大叫
senses.example_en: The baby was screaming his head off because of the loud thunder.
senses.example_zh: 宝宝被巨响的雷声吓得拼命大哭尖叫。

senses.meaning: 大吵大闹；发出极其刺耳激烈的抗议
senses.example_en: The toddler screamed blue murder when his mother took away the iPad.
senses.example_zh: 妈妈把平板电脑拿走时，那小孩放声大吵大闹。

senses.example_en: The injured player screamed in agony as he clutched his knee.
senses.example_zh: 受伤的球员捂着膝盖痛苦地尖叫。

senses.example_en: My grandmother swears by a cup of hot lemon water for any cold.
senses.example_zh: 我祖母坚信喝一杯热柠檬水能治任何感冒。

senses.example_en: The new president will be sworn in on January 20th.
senses.example_zh: 新总统将于1月20日宣誓就职。

senses.example_en: He lost his temper and swore at the referee during the match.
senses.example_zh: 比赛中他一时失控，冲裁判爆了粗口。

senses.example_en: He swore blind that he had never seen the missing documents before.
senses.example_zh: 他赌咒发誓说自己之前从没见过那份丢失的文件。

senses.meaning: 宣誓作证；在誓言下作保
senses.example_en: The witness was asked to swear under oath before giving her testimony.
senses.example_zh: 证人在出庭作证前被要求宣誓作证。

senses.example_en: The report highlights the importance of investing in renewable energy.
senses.example_zh: 该报告强调了投资可再生能源的重要性。

senses.example_en: Recent cyberattacks highlight the urgent need for better data protection.
senses.example_zh: 近期的网络攻击突显了加强数据保护的迫切需求。

senses.meaning: 进一步凸显；起到突出……的作用
senses.example_en: The crisis serves to highlight existing vulnerabilities in the supply chain.
senses.example_zh: 这场危机进一步凸显了供应链中原有的脆弱环节。

senses.meaning: 通过谈判压低（价格、费用等）
senses.example_en: We managed to negotiate the asking price down by five percent.
senses.example_zh: 我们成功通过谈判将要价压低了百分之五。

senses.example_en: The two companies spent months negotiating a trade deal.
senses.example_zh: 两家公司花了数月时间洽谈一项贸易协定。

senses.example_en: Lawyers met behind closed doors to negotiate the terms of the settlement.
senses.example_zh: 律师们闭门磋商以协商和解条款。

senses.example_en: The driver struggled to negotiate a sharp bend in the heavy rain.
senses.example_zh: 大雨中司机艰难地拐过了一个急转弯。

senses.example_en: Strict policies are needed to preserve the fragile marine environment.
senses.example_zh: 需要严格的政策来保护脆弱的海洋生态环境。

senses.example_en: Security forces were deployed across the city to preserve public order.
senses.example_zh: 安全部队被部署在全城各处以维持公共秩序。

senses.example_en: Community initiatives help preserve ancient traditions and cultural heritage for future generations.
senses.example_zh: 社区倡议有助于为后代保留古老传统和文化遗产。

senses.example_en: The lecturer shared a personal anecdote to illustrate a key point.
senses.example_zh: 讲师分享了一段个人趣事来阐明核心观点。

senses.meaning: 生动地说明；鲜明地展现
senses.example_en: The documentary vividly illustrates the daily hardships faced by refugees.
senses.example_zh: 这部纪录片生动地展现了难民们所面临的日常困境。

senses.example_en: The report illustrates each recommendation with real-world case studies.
senses.example_zh: 该报告用真实案例对每条建议进行了详细说明。

senses.meaning: 打乱原定计划；把事情搞砸
senses.example_en: We had everything planned out, so please don't do anything to upset the apple cart.
senses.example_zh: 我们已经把一切都计划好了，所以请不要做任何节外生枝、破坏计划的事。

senses.example_en: The introduction of invasive species can completely upset the ecological balance.
senses.example_zh: 外来物种的入侵会彻底打破生态平衡。

senses.meaning: 引起肠胃不适；吃坏肚子
senses.example_en: Spicy food often upsets my stomach if I eat it late at night.
senses.example_zh: 如果深夜吃辣，我的胃往往会很不舒服。

senses.example_en: Sudden train cancellations completely upset our travel plans.
senses.example_zh: 列车的突然取消彻底打乱了我们的出行计划。

senses.meaning: 自愿参加；主动报名承担
senses.example_en: Several staff members volunteered for the weekend relief effort.
senses.example_zh: 几名员工主动报名参加了周末的救援行动。

senses.example_en: The witness didn't volunteer any information until she was questioned directly.
senses.example_zh: 在被直接讯问之前，证人没有主动透露任何信息。

senses.meaning: 主动效劳；自愿提供协助
senses.example_en: Local doctors volunteered their services at the temporary clinic free of charge.
senses.example_zh: 当地医生主动在临时诊所自愿提供免费医疗服务。

senses.example_en: The airline had to suspend operations due to severe weather conditions.
senses.example_zh: 由于极端恶劣的天气，该航空公司不得不暂停运营。

senses.meaning: 暂缓作出判断，不妄下定论
senses.example_en: We should suspend judgment until all the evidence has been analyzed.
senses.example_zh: 在所有证据分析完毕之前，我们应暂不下定论。

senses.example_en: The officer was suspended from duty pending an internal investigation.
senses.example_zh: 该警官在等待内部调查期间被停职。

senses.example_en: The new software is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing systems.
senses.example_zh: 这款新软件的设计旨在与现有系统实现无缝整合。

senses.meaning: 将技术融入（教学/管理等）
senses.example_en: Educators are finding innovative ways to integrate technology into classroom teaching.
senses.example_zh: 教育工作者正在寻找创新的方法将技术融入课堂教学中。

senses.meaning: 融入（社会、群体）；使并入/整合到…中
senses.example_en: It takes time for new immigrants to fully integrate into the local community.
senses.example_zh: 新移民完全融入当地社区需要时间。

senses.example_en: After dinner, the guests repaired to the drawing room for coffee.
senses.example_zh: 晚饭后，客人们移步到客厅喝咖啡。

senses.meaning: 修复损害；挽回损失/弥补过失
senses.example_en: It will take decades to repair the environmental damage caused by the spill.
senses.example_zh: 要修复泄漏造成的环境损害将需要几十年的时间。

senses.example_en: Both nations are making diplomatic efforts to repair bilateral relations.
senses.example_zh: 两国正在进行外交努力以修补双边关系。

senses.example_en: The report cited Singapore as a successful example of urban planning.
senses.example_zh: 该报告援引新加坡作为城市规划的成功典范。

senses.example_en: The director cited financial concerns when stepping down from the board.
senses.example_zh: 该董事在退出董事会时提到了财务方面的担忧。

senses.example_en: Students are strictly required to cite academic sources accurately.
senses.example_zh: 学生被严格要求准确引用学术文献来源。

senses.example_en: The regime was condemned for severely violating human rights.
senses.example_zh: 该政权因严重侵犯人权而遭到谴责。

senses.example_en: Installing hidden cameras clearly violates personal privacy.
senses.example_zh: 安装隐蔽摄像头显然侵犯了个人隐私。

senses.example_en: The company blatantly violated safety regulations to cut production costs.
senses.example_zh: 该公司为了降低生产成本公然违反安全法规。

senses.meaning: 分拆（子公司）；推出衍生作品
senses.example_en: The tech giant plans to spin off its cloud computing division into a separate company.
senses.example_zh: 这家科技巨头计划将其云计算部门剥离为一家独立公司。

senses.meaning: 使）拖延，拉长；（车辆）失控打转
senses.example_en: The car hit a patch of black ice and spun out into the ditch.
senses.example_zh: 汽车碾过一块暗冰，失控打转滑进了路沟。

senses.example_en: Without a clear strategy, the research team is just spinning their wheels.
senses.example_zh: 没有明确的策略，研发团队只是在白费力气。

senses.meaning: 使某人头晕目眩；使人不知所措
senses.example_en: The sheer volume of complex data made my head spin.
senses.example_zh: 如此海量且复杂的数据让我头晕目眩。

senses.example_en: Inflation threatens to spin out of control unless the central bank intervenes.
senses.example_zh: 除非央行出手干预，否则通胀恐将失去控制。

senses.example_en: The suspect tried to spin an elaborate story to explain his whereabouts.
senses.example_zh: 嫌疑人试图编造一套精心设计的说辞来解释自己的行踪。

senses.example_en: After years of bitter legal disputes, the two brothers decided to bury the hatchet.
senses.example_zh: 经历了数年激烈的法律纷争后，兄弟俩决定握手言和。

idioms.phrase: bury one's head in the sand

senses.meaning: 采取鸵鸟政策，逃避现实
senses.example_en: You cannot just bury your head in the sand and pretend the financial crisis doesn't exist.
senses.example_zh: 你不能采取鸵鸟政策，假装财务危机根本不存在。

senses.example_en: Aid workers scrambled to bury the dead and prevent disease outbreaks after the earthquake.
senses.example_zh: 地震后，救援人员加紧安葬死难者，以防暴发疫病。

senses.meaning: 隐瞒真相；掩埋/销毁证据
senses.example_en: Whistleblowers accused the corporation of trying to bury damning safety reports.
senses.example_zh: 举报人指控该企业企图隐匿对其极为不利的安全报告。

senses.example_en: She buried herself in her research to cope with the sudden grief.
senses.example_zh: 她埋头于研究工作，以排解突如其来的悲伤。

senses.example_en: Several multinational companies are bidding for the lucrative high-speed rail contract.
senses.example_zh: 数家跨国公司正在竞标这项收益丰厚的高铁工程合同。

senses.meaning: 向...告别；告别（某种生活方式等）
senses.example_en: The retiring professor bid farewell to his colleagues and students yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 这位退休教授昨天向他的同事和学生们正式告别。

senses.meaning: 大有希望/很有可能做某事
senses.example_en: The innovative startup bids fair to become a dominant player in renewable energy.
senses.example_zh: 这家创新型初创企业大有希望成为可再生能源领域的领军者。

senses.example_en: Two wealthy collectors bid against each other until the painting set a record price.
senses.example_zh: 两位富有的收藏家相互竞价，直到那幅画创下拍卖纪录。

senses.example_en: The overseas consortium bid aggressively to acquire the distressed assets.
senses.example_zh: 该海外财团以激进的报价竞标收购这些不良资产。

senses.meaning: 伸出（四肢）；躺下舒展身子；（时间）拉长
senses.example_en: Exhausted from the marathon, he stretched out on the grass to catch his breath.
senses.example_zh: 跑完马拉松筋疲力尽的他躺在草地上歇气。

senses.meaning: 道路、景观等）向远方延伸，连绵起伏
senses.example_en: The golden wheat fields stretched away to the distant horizon.
senses.example_zh: 金黄的麦田一直延伸到遥远的地平线。

senses.example_en: Claiming that you built the entire system alone is really stretching the truth.
senses.example_zh: 声称整个系统是你独自搭建的，未免太夸大其词了。

senses.example_en: Let's stop at the next rest area so we can stretch our legs.
senses.example_zh: 我们在下一个休息区停一下，好下车活动活动腿脚。

senses.meaning: 使预算/资源捉襟见肘，最大限度利用财力
senses.example_en: High medical expenses have severely stretched the family's modest budget.
senses.example_zh: 高昂的医疗支出让这个普通家庭的拮据预算捉襟见肘。

senses.example_en: It is essential to stretch your leg muscles both before and after a run.
senses.example_zh: 跑步前后拉伸腿部肌肉都至关重要。

senses.example_en: The sports drink brand agreed to sponsor the international marathon.
senses.example_zh: 这家运动饮料品牌同意赞助这项国际马拉松赛事。

senses.example_en: A bipartisan group of senators sponsored the historic environmental bill.
senses.example_zh: 两党参议员组成的小组共同提出了这项历史性的环保法案。

senses.meaning: 担保申请人/提供签证担保
senses.example_en: The multinational firm offered to sponsor his work visa in the UK.
senses.example_zh: 该跨国公司提出为他办理在英国的工作签证担保。

senses.meaning: 在水面上）浮上来；突然冒出
senses.example_en: The cork bobbed up to the surface as soon as it was released.
senses.example_zh: 软木塞一松手就立刻浮上了水面。

senses.example_en: He sat quietly in the back row, bobbing his head to the jazz music.
senses.example_zh: 他静静地坐在后排，随着爵士乐的节拍轻轻晃着头。

senses.meaning: 在水面/波浪上颠簸漂浮
senses.example_en: A small wooden fishing boat was gently bobbing on the calm sea.
senses.example_zh: 一艘小型木制渔船在平静的海面上轻轻漂荡。

senses.example_en: The missing documents seemed to have disappeared into thin air.
senses.example_zh: 那份失踪的文件仿佛凭空消失了一样。

senses.example_en: The small fishing boat disappeared without a trace during the typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 那艘小型渔船在台风中消失得无影无踪。

senses.example_en: Once the mist burned off, all signs of the storm disappeared completely.
senses.example_zh: 薄雾散去后，暴风雨的所有痕迹彻底消失了。

senses.example_en: Key species are gradually disappearing from the coral reefs.
senses.example_zh: 主要物种正逐渐从珊瑚礁生态系统中消失。

senses.example_en: The suspect disappeared into the crowded subway station.
senses.example_zh: 嫌疑人隐没在拥挤的地铁站人群中不见了。

senses.meaning: 连接（设备）；（与某人）碰头或建立联系；）发生亲密行为
senses.example_en: Can you help me hook up the sound system to my laptop?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我把音响系统连接到笔记本电脑上吗？

senses.example_en: She was immediately hooked on rock climbing after her first lesson.
senses.example_zh: 上完第一节课后，她就立刻迷上了攀岩。

senses.example_en: He waited patiently by the riverbank for hours before hooking a massive carp.
senses.example_zh: 他在河岸边耐心等了数小时，终于钓到了一条巨大的鲤鱼。

senses.meaning: 接入；融入（系统、网络或文化中）
senses.example_en: The startup aims to hook into the existing payment infrastructure.
senses.example_zh: 该初创公司旨在接入现有的支付基础设施。

senses.meaning: 使事情复杂化；节外生枝
senses.example_en: Sudden regulatory changes further complicated matters for foreign investors.
senses.example_zh: 突如其来的监管政策变动使外国投资者面临的局面进一步复杂化。

senses.example_en: Bad weather threatened to further complicate the rescue mission.
senses.example_zh: 恶劣的天气可能会进一步加剧救援任务的难度。

senses.example_en: Excessive bureaucracy only serves to complicate the application process.
senses.example_zh: 繁文缛节只会让申请流程更加繁复。

senses.example_en: Armed guards sealed off the street following the security alert.
senses.example_zh: 安全警报拉响后，武装警卫封锁了整条街道。

senses.meaning: 锁住/封存（水分、营养、味道等）
senses.example_en: Sear the steak on high heat to seal in the juices.
senses.example_zh: 用大火煎牛排以锁住肉汁。

senses.meaning: 决定某人的命运；使某人注定灭亡/失败
senses.example_en: The goalie's costly mistake sealed the team's fate in the final minutes.
senses.example_zh: 守门员在最后几分钟的致命失误决定了该队的败局。

senses.example_en: A final round of negotiations helped to seal the deal between the two tech giants.
senses.example_zh: 最后一轮谈判推动两大科技巨头敲定了最终协议。

senses.example_en: The pharmaceutical samples must be hermetically sealed before transport.
senses.example_zh: 药品样本在运输前必须进行严格的气密封装。

senses.meaning: 还不错；过得去（用于日常回答近况）
senses.example_en: 'How have you been lately?' — 'Can't complain, work is going well.'
senses.example_zh: “最近过得怎么样？”——“挺好的，工作挺顺利。”

senses.example_en: Commuters bitterly complained about the unannounced fare hikes.
senses.example_zh: 通勤人员对毫无预警的票价上涨怨声载道。

senses.example_en: She decided to complain officially to the board about workplace harassment.
senses.example_zh: 她决定向董事会正式投诉职场骚扰问题。

senses.meaning: 诉说（身体某处疼痛或不适）
senses.example_en: The patient complained of severe chest pain and dizziness.
senses.example_zh: 病人自诉胸部剧烈疼痛并伴有头晕。

senses.example_en: Tenants repeatedly complained about the lack of heating in the building.
senses.example_zh: 租户们反复投诉大楼缺乏暖气的问题。

senses.meaning: 使某人感染（疾病）；用（情绪、观念）感染某人
senses.example_en: Her boundless optimism quickly infected the entire research team.
senses.example_zh: 她无限的乐观迅速感染了整个科研团队。

senses.example_en: Thousands of hospital patients are infected with drug-resistant bacteria each year.
senses.example_zh: 每年有成千上万的住院病人感染耐药菌。

senses.example_en: Foreign conglomerates were accused of coming in to rape and pillage the country's mineral wealth.
senses.example_zh: 外国企业集团被指责涌入该国大肆掠夺其矿产财富。

senses.meaning: 严重破坏生态环境/肆意掠夺土地资源
senses.example_en: Uncontrolled commercial deforestation has raped the fragile ecosystem of the region.
senses.example_zh: 无节制的商业采伐严重摧毁了该地区脆弱的生态系统。

senses.example_en: The modern economy relies heavily on stable semiconductor supply chains.
senses.example_zh: 现代经济高度依赖稳定的半导体供应链。

collocations.phrase: rely on somebody to do something

senses.meaning: 指望/笃定某人会做某事
senses.example_en: You can always rely on her to deliver flawless presentations.
senses.example_zh: 你可以完全放心，她的汇报向来无可挑剔。

senses.example_en: Many coastal towns rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
senses.example_zh: 许多沿海城镇依靠捕鱼作为主要收入来源。

senses.example_en: Astronomers have detected subtle signs of water vapor in the exoplanet's atmosphere.
senses.example_zh: 天文学家在这颗系外行星的大气层中察觉到了微弱的水蒸气迹象。

senses.example_en: The automated code review tool is designed to detect security flaws early in development.
senses.example_zh: 该自动化代码审查工具旨在开发早期检测出安全漏洞。

senses.example_en: Routine airport security failed to detect the contraband inside the cargo.
senses.example_zh: 常规的机场安检查验未能查出藏在货物中的违禁品。

senses.example_en: The central bank warned it would punish commercial banks for non-compliance.
senses.example_zh: 中央银行警告将惩处违规的商业银行。

senses.example_en: The courts are determined to severely punish cybercrime and identity theft.
senses.example_zh: 法院决心从严打击网络犯罪和身份盗窃行为。

senses.meaning: 利用对手失误予以惩罚反击
senses.example_en: The opposing team immediately punished our defensive lapse by scoring a goal.
senses.example_zh: 对方球队立即抓住我方防守疏忽攻入一球，让我们付出了代价。

senses.example_en: Investors interpreted the central bank's statement as a sign of imminent rate cuts.
senses.example_zh: 投资者将央行的声明解读为即将降息的信号。

senses.meaning: 解读/分析数据或研究结果
senses.example_en: Scientists need to be extremely cautious when interpreting preliminary clinical data.
senses.example_zh: 科学家在解读初步临床数据时需要极为谨慎。

senses.example_en: A professional linguist was hired to interpret for the visiting trade delegation.
senses.example_zh: 主办方聘请了一位专业翻译为来访的经贸代表团提供口译服务。

senses.meaning: 将某人从……中营救/拯救出来
senses.example_en: Firefighters managed to rescue several residents from the burning building.
senses.example_zh: 消防员成功从起火的大楼中营救出数名居民。

senses.example_en: The central bank introduced stimulus packages to rescue the faltering economy.
senses.example_zh: 央行出台刺激计划以挽救摇摇欲坠的经济。

senses.meaning: 挽救（濒临破裂的）交易或谈判
senses.example_en: Diplomats worked through the night to rescue the peace deal.
senses.example_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地工作，以挽救这项和平协议。

senses.meaning: 放宽限制；放宽管控措施
senses.example_en: The government decided to relax travel restrictions ahead of the holiday season.
senses.example_zh: 政府决定在假期来临前放宽旅行限制。

senses.example_en: He gradually relaxed his grip on the steering wheel as the panic subsided.
senses.example_zh: 随着恐慌情绪平息，他渐渐放松了握着方向盘的手。

senses.meaning: 坐下来好好放松；歇一歇
senses.example_en: Now that the exams are over, you can sit back and relax.
senses.example_zh: 既然考试都结束了，你可以坐下来好好放松一下了。

senses.meaning: 将……内置；使融入（成为固有或不可分割的一部分）
senses.example_en: Privacy controls should be baked into the software design from day one.
senses.example_zh: 隐私控制功能应该从第一天起就内置到软件设计中。

senses.meaning: 从头开始烘焙（纯手工自制，不用现成配料包）
senses.example_en: She enjoys baking bread from scratch every weekend.
senses.example_zh: 她喜欢每个周末完全自己从零开始烘焙面包。

senses.example_en: The cars had been baking in the scorching sun all afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 汽车在毒辣的太阳底下被晒了一整个下午。

senses.example_en: We hadn't calculated on the train being delayed by two hours.
senses.example_zh: 我们没料到火车竟然晚点了两个小时。

senses.example_en: Investors must carefully calculate the risks before committing capital.
senses.example_zh: 投资者在投入资金前必须仔细评估风险。

senses.meaning: 旨在做某事；蓄意达到某种效果
senses.example_en: His provocative remarks were calculated to provoke an angry response.
senses.example_zh: 他挑衅性的言论旨在激起愤怒的回应。

senses.meaning: 订阅（报刊、频道等）；赞同/同意（某种观点、理念）
senses.example_en: I don't subscribe to the theory that failure is inevitable.
senses.example_zh: 我并不认同‘失败不可避免’这种理论。

senses.example_en: Millions of users currently subscribe to the streaming service.
senses.example_zh: 数百万用户目前订阅了该流媒体服务。

senses.meaning: 股票、基金等）超额认购的；（活动）踊跃报名的
senses.example_en: The company's initial public offering was heavily subscribed by institutional investors.
senses.example_zh: 该公司的首次公开募股得到了机构投资者的踊跃超额认购。

senses.meaning: 重复发明轮子；做徒劳且重复前人的无用功
senses.example_en: We should use existing libraries rather than reinventing the wheel.
senses.example_zh: 我们应该利用现有的代码库，而不是重起炉灶、白费力气。

senses.example_en: He had to invent an excuse for missing yesterday's deadline.
senses.example_zh: 他不得不编了个借口来解释昨天为什么错过截止时间。

senses.example_en: Engineers invented a portable device that purifies ocean water.
senses.example_zh: 工程师们发明了一种能够净化海水的便携式装置。

senses.meaning: 拍开/击退；轻易驳回/回避（批评、问题）
senses.example_en: The minister batted away questions regarding the leaked report.
senses.example_zh: 部长轻易避开了关于泄露报告的提问。

senses.meaning: 探讨；交流/推敲（想法、建议）
senses.example_en: Let's meet tomorrow to bat around a few ideas for the campaign.
senses.example_zh: 我们明天碰个头，探讨交流一下这次活动的几个想法。

senses.meaning: 眼睛都不眨一下；面不改色，泰然自若
senses.example_en: She didn't bat an eye when they told her the unexpected bad news.
senses.example_zh: 当他们把突如其来的坏消息告诉她时，她连眼睛都没眨一下。

senses.meaning: 百发百中；事事顺利，大获全胜
senses.example_en: With three successful product launches this quarter, the team is batting a thousand.
senses.example_zh: 本季度连续三次成功发布新品，团队可谓百战百胜、事事如意。

senses.meaning: 板球、棒球等运动中）先攻/先击球
senses.example_en: After winning the toss, the captain decided to bat first.
senses.example_zh: 在掷硬币胜出后，队长决定先击球。

senses.meaning: 在社交媒体上）发推公布；发布推文
senses.example_en: The journalist tweeted out a link to the leaked documents.
senses.example_zh: 这位记者发推分享了泄露文件的链接。

senses.example_en: Fans were quick to tweet about the dramatic season finale.
senses.example_zh: 粉丝们迅速在推特上热烈讨论戏剧性的季终集。

senses.meaning: 懒得（做某事）；不想费神（做某事）
senses.example_en: It was raining so hard that I couldn't be bothered to go out.
senses.example_zh: 雨下得太大了，我根本懒得出去了。

senses.meaning: 费心做某事；特意做某事
senses.example_en: He didn't even bother to read the contract before signing it.
senses.example_zh: 他签字前甚至都懒得把合同读一遍。

senses.example_en: Don't bother with the dishes tonight; I'll do them in the morning.
senses.example_zh: 今晚别费心洗碗了，我明早来洗。

senses.example_en: The prosecution alleges that the suspect fled the scene immediately.
senses.example_zh: 检方指控嫌疑人案发后立即逃离了现场。

senses.meaning: 据称做了某事；被指控做了某事
senses.example_en: The company is alleged to have bribed local government officials.
senses.example_zh: 该企业被指控贿赂了当地政府官员。

senses.example_en: The project encountered unexpected technical difficulties in its final stage.
senses.example_zh: 该项目在收尾阶段遇到了意料之外的技术难题。

senses.example_en: The proposed tax reforms encountered fierce political resistance.
senses.example_zh: 拟议的税改方案遭遇了强烈的政治阻力。

senses.meaning: 撤销决定；彻底改变政策
senses.example_en: Under immense public pressure, the board decided to reverse its decision.
senses.example_zh: 在巨大的公众舆论压力下，董事会决定撤销这一决议。

senses.example_en: New policies are desperately needed to reverse the downward trend in birth rates.
senses.example_zh: 迫切需要出台新政策来扭转出生率持续下降的趋势。

senses.example_en: She carefully reversed out of the narrow driveway.
senses.example_zh: 她小心翼翼地把车从狭窄的车道上倒了出来。

senses.example_en: The paparazzi constantly invade the celebrity's privacy.
senses.example_zh: 狗仔队不断侵犯那位名人的隐私。

senses.example_en: Hundreds of jubilant fans invaded the pitch after the final whistle.
senses.example_zh: 终场哨响后，数百名欢欣鼓舞的球迷冲入了赛场。

senses.example_en: Hearing the siren made his mind flash back to the day of the explosion.
senses.example_zh: 听到警报声，他的思绪一下子闪回到了爆炸发生的那一天。

senses.meaning: 嫣然一笑；迅速露出笑容
senses.example_en: She flashed a warm smile at the nervous applicant before starting the interview.
senses.example_zh: 在开始面试前，她对那位紧张的应聘者报以一个温和的微笑。

senses.example_en: The oncoming driver flashed his headlights to warn us of a hazard ahead.
senses.example_zh: 迎面开来的车闪烁大灯，提醒我们前方有危险。

senses.example_en: The detective flashed his badge and asked to speak with the manager.
senses.example_zh: 便衣刑警亮出警徽，要求与经理谈谈。

senses.meaning: 不断创新；持续推陈出新
senses.example_en: Tech companies must innovate constantly to stay ahead of the competition.
senses.example_zh: 科技公司必须不断创新，才能在竞争中保持领先地位。

senses.example_en: The startup aims to innovate in the field of green energy storage.
senses.example_zh: 这家初创公司旨在绿色能源存储领域进行创新。

senses.example_en: Do you mind if my little brother tags along with us to the cinema?
senses.example_zh: 你介意我弟弟跟着我们一起去看电影吗？

senses.meaning: 附加上；追加（言论、条款等）
senses.example_en: A few extra conditions were tagged onto the end of the contract.
senses.example_zh: 合同末尾又追加了几项额外条款。

senses.meaning: 在照片中圈出/标记某人
senses.example_en: Please don't tag me in that embarrassing photo on Instagram.
senses.example_zh: 请不要在Instagram上那张尴尬的照片里圈出我。

senses.meaning: 将某人归类为……；给某人贴上……的标签
senses.example_en: Critics were quick to tag him as an unreliable witness.
senses.example_zh: 批评者很快就把他定性为不可靠的证人。

senses.example_en: Global health initiatives have worked tirelessly to eliminate infectious diseases.
senses.example_zh: 全球卫生倡议致力于不知疲倦地根除传染病。

senses.example_en: Regular backups will eliminate the risk of losing critical data.
senses.example_zh: 定期备份可以消除丢失关键数据的风险。

senses.example_en: Automating this process will eliminate the need for manual data entry.
senses.example_zh: 将该流程自动化将免去手动录入数据的必要。

senses.example_en: The national team was eliminated from the tournament in the first round.
senses.example_zh: 国家队在第一轮就被淘汰出了锦标赛。

senses.meaning: 赔罪；弥补（对某人的伤害或过失）
senses.example_en: He tried to make amends for his rude behavior by sending her flowers.
senses.example_zh: 他送花给她，试图弥补自己粗鲁的举止。

senses.example_en: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to amend the outdated labor law.
senses.example_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票通过了对过时劳动法的修订。

senses.example_en: Both parties agreed to amend the contract to extend the delivery deadline.
senses.example_zh: 双方同意修改合同以延长交付期限。

senses.meaning: 到此为止；决定停止；收工
senses.example_en: We've been working for ten straight hours; let's call it quits for today.
senses.example_zh: 我们已经连续工作了十个小时，今天就先到此为止吧。

senses.example_en: He made a New Year's resolution to quit smoking for good.
senses.example_zh: 他许下新年愿望，决定彻底戒烟。

senses.example_en: She suddenly quit her job to pursue a career in photography.
senses.example_zh: 她突然辞职去从事摄影事业。

senses.meaning: 在关键时刻舍弃/背弃某人；（设备、身体等）停止运转
senses.example_en: I promised I would stay until the project was finished, and I won't quit on you.
senses.example_zh: 我承诺过会留到项目结束，我绝不会中途丢下你不管。

senses.meaning: 爬下来；（在辩论或谈判中）让步、认输
senses.example_en: The minister was forced to climb down after intense public backlash.
senses.example_zh: 在强烈的公众反对声中，部长被迫让步。

senses.example_en: We watched the children climb up the old oak tree in the garden.
senses.example_zh: 我们看着孩子们爬上花园里的那棵老橡树。

senses.meaning: 在职场步步高升；攀登公司晋升阶梯
senses.example_en: She spent fifteen years climbing the corporate ladder to become CEO.
senses.example_zh: 她花了十五年时间步步晋升，最终成为了首席执行官。

senses.example_en: Oil prices have continued to climb steeply over the past few weeks.
senses.example_zh: 在过去的几周里，石油价格持续急剧攀升。

senses.example_en: The chairman convened an emergency meeting to address the financial crisis.
senses.example_zh: 董事长召集了紧急会议以应对财务危机。

senses.example_en: The university convened an ethics panel to review the research proposal.
senses.example_zh: 大学召集了一个伦理审查小组来评估该研究提案。

senses.example_en: Passengers were required to don a mask before boarding the train.
senses.example_zh: 乘客在登车前必须戴上口罩。

senses.example_en: Healthcare workers had to don protective gear before entering the isolation ward.
senses.example_zh: 医护人员进入隔离病房前必须穿上防护装备。

senses.example_en: He donned his uniform and prepared for morning inspection.
senses.example_zh: 他穿上制服，准备参加早检。

senses.meaning: 弃船逃生；（计划或企业遇到危机时）及时脱手、撒手不管
senses.example_en: When the startup ran out of funds, several key executives decided to abandon ship.
senses.example_zh: 当这家初创公司资金耗尽时，几位核心高管决定撒手走人。

senses.example_en: Rescuers refused to abandon hope of finding more survivors in the rubble.
senses.example_zh: 救援人员拒绝放弃在废墟中搜寻更多幸存者的希望。

senses.example_en: The government was forced to abandon the plan due to fierce public opposition.
senses.example_zh: 由于公众的强烈反对，政府被迫放弃了该计划。

senses.example_en: Bad weather forced the mountaineers to abandon their attempt to reach the summit.
senses.example_zh: 恶劣的天气迫使登山者放弃了登顶的尝试。

senses.example_en: The charity is working to recruit volunteers for the upcoming community event.
senses.example_zh: 该慈善机构正致力于为即将举行的社区活动招募志愿者。

senses.example_en: Tech firms compete fiercely to recruit top engineering talent.
senses.example_zh: 科技公司为了招揽顶尖工程人才展开了激烈竞争。

senses.meaning: 受到各大机构极力争相招揽的
senses.example_en: As a top college athlete, he was heavily recruited by several professional teams.
senses.example_zh: 作为一名顶尖的大学运动员，他受到了多家职业球队的全力争夺招揽。

senses.meaning: 吸收/招募某人进入（组织、军队或团队）
senses.example_en: He was recruited into the intelligence agency straight out of university.
senses.example_zh: 他一大学毕业就被招募进了情报机构。

senses.example_en: Breathe in deeply through your nose and hold it for three seconds.
senses.example_zh: 用鼻子深吸一口气，屏住三秒钟。

senses.example_en: Relax your shoulders and breathe out slowly through your mouth.
senses.example_zh: 放松肩膀，通过嘴巴缓缓呼气。

senses.example_en: We all breathed a sigh of relief when the exam results finally came out.
senses.example_zh: 考试成绩终于公布时，我们都松了一口气。

senses.meaning: 为……注入新的活力或生机
senses.example_en: The arrival of the new director breathed new life into the struggling theater.
senses.example_zh: 新导演的到来为这家陷入困境的剧院注入了新生机。

senses.example_en: Take a moment to close your eyes and breathe deeply.
senses.example_zh: 花点时间闭上双眼，深呼吸一下。

senses.meaning: 几乎无法呼吸；（因紧张或激动）屏住呼吸
senses.example_en: The air in the crowded room was so stale that I could hardly breathe.
senses.example_zh: 拥挤房间里的空气污浊得让我几乎喘不过气来。

senses.meaning: 在……中安装；使某人正式就职于
senses.example_en: The technician installed the new hard drive in my desktop computer.
senses.example_zh: 技术员把新硬盘安装在了我的台式电脑里。

senses.example_en: Make sure to scan the file for viruses before you install the software.
senses.example_zh: 在安装该软件之前，务必扫描文件是否有病毒。

senses.example_en: The school hired contractors to install security cameras across the campus.
senses.example_zh: 学校聘请了工程人员在校园各处安装监控摄像头。

senses.meaning: 任命/确立某人为（某职位）
senses.example_en: The board voted unanimously to install him as the company's interim CEO.
senses.example_zh: 董事会一致投票任命他为公司的临时首席执行官。

senses.meaning: 把某人惹得烦透了；让某人极其反感
senses.example_en: His constant interruptions annoyed the hell out of everyone in the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 他不停地插话把会议上的所有人都惹得烦透了。

senses.meaning: 深深惹恼；让某人十分不快
senses.example_en: The repeated delays deeply annoyed the stranded passengers.
senses.example_zh: 反复的延误让滞留的乘客们感到十分气恼。

senses.example_en: Please don't annoy the manager with trivial questions while she is busy.
senses.example_zh: 经理忙碌时，请不要用琐碎的问题去烦她。

senses.example_en: I need to stop by the ATM to withdraw some money for groceries.
senses.example_zh: 我需要去自动取款机取点买菜的现金。

senses.example_en: The two nations signed a ceasefire and agreed to withdraw troops from the border.
senses.example_zh: 两国签署了停火协议，并同意从边境撤军。

senses.example_en: Under threat of legal action, the newspaper agreed to withdraw the allegation.
senses.example_zh: 在面临法律诉讼的威胁下，该报社同意撤回指控。

senses.meaning: 退出（比赛、活动或协议）；从……中撤出
senses.example_en: An ankle injury forced the tennis player to withdraw from the tournament.
senses.example_zh: 脚踝受伤迫使该网球选手退出了锦标赛。

senses.meaning: 退入（个人世界）；变得孤僻内向
senses.example_en: After the tragic loss, she withdrew into herself and stopped talking to friends.
senses.example_zh: 在经历不幸的失去后，她封闭了内心，不再和朋友说话。

idioms.phrase: as far as I can recall

senses.meaning: 据我所记；在我的记忆中
senses.example_en: As far as I can recall, the store was closed by eight o'clock yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 据我所记，昨天那家店八点前就关门了。

senses.example_en: Even after twenty years, she still recalls vividly the day she first arrived in Paris.
senses.example_zh: 即使过了二十年，她依然清晰地记得初到巴黎的那一天。

senses.example_en: The automaker had to recall thousands of vehicles due to a faulty brake system.
senses.example_zh: 由于刹车系统故障，该汽车制造商不得不召回数千辆汽车。

senses.example_en: I recognize his face, but I cannot recall where we met before.
senses.example_zh: 我认得他的脸，但想不起来我们之前在哪里见过了。

senses.example_en: They gathered at the church to pray for peace.
senses.example_zh: 他们聚集在教堂里祈求和平。

senses.meaning: 讽刺或强调语气）请问，倒要问问
senses.example_en: And where, pray tell, were you when the alarm went off?
senses.example_zh: 那么请问，警报响起时你究竟在哪儿？

senses.example_en: She fervently prayed that the surgery would be a success.
senses.example_zh: 她虔诚祈祷手术能够成功。

senses.meaning: 向上帝祈求；但愿，真心希望
senses.example_en: I pray to God we don't run out of fuel before reaching the station.
senses.example_zh: 我真希望我们在开到加油站之前油别耗光。

senses.example_en: Let's nick off before the boss comes back from lunch.
senses.example_zh: 趁老板还没吃完午饭回来，我们赶紧溜吧。

senses.meaning: 在最后关头，千钧一发之际
senses.example_en: The rescue team arrived in the nick of time to save the stranded hikers.
senses.example_zh: 救援队在千钧一发之际赶到，救出了被困的登山者。

senses.meaning: 俚语）被逮捕，被警方抓获
senses.example_en: He got nicked for shoplifting expensive perfumes.
senses.example_zh: 他因在商店盗窃名贵香水而被警方逮捕。

senses.meaning: 划破自己（尤指刮胡子时轻微割伤）
senses.example_en: He accidentally nicked his chin while shaving in a hurry.
senses.example_zh: 他匆忙刮胡子时不小心把下巴刮破了。

senses.example_en: She decided to file for divorce after discovering he was cheating on her.
senses.example_zh: 在发现他出轨后，她决定提出离婚。

senses.meaning: 死里逃生，侥幸逃脱死神
senses.example_en: The racing driver cheated death in a horrific crash at over 200 mph.
senses.example_zh: 赛车手在时速超过200英里的惨烈车祸中奇迹般死里逃生。

senses.example_en: Any student caught cheating on an exam will be immediately expelled.
senses.example_zh: 凡在考试中作弊被抓的学生将被立即开除。

senses.meaning: 骗取，诈骗（某人的钱财或权利）
senses.example_en: The rogue accountant cheated the elderly couple out of their life savings.
senses.example_zh: 那个不良会计骗走了这对老夫妇毕生的积蓄。

senses.meaning: 圆满结束，完成；包好（礼物）；穿暖和
senses.example_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
senses.example_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

senses.example_en: She wrapped a warm woolen scarf around her neck against the chill.
senses.example_zh: 她用一条温暖的羊毛围巾裹住脖子以抵御严寒。

idioms.phrase: have someone wrapped around one's finger

senses.meaning: 对某人言听计从；把某人玩弄于股掌之间
senses.example_en: The little girl has her father wrapped around her little finger.
senses.example_zh: 那个小女孩把她父亲吃得死死的，对她言听计从。

senses.example_en: She carefully wrapped the birthday present in colorful paper.
senses.example_zh: 她用彩纸细心地把生日礼物包装好。

senses.example_en: Sitting by the window, he was completely wrapped in thought.
senses.example_zh: 他坐在窗边，完全陷入了沉思之中。

senses.meaning: 追求职业生涯，从事某种职业
senses.example_en: She decided to pursue a career in corporate law after graduation.
senses.example_zh: 毕业后，她决定从事公司法方面的职业。

senses.meaning: 采取法律行动，提起诉讼
senses.example_en: The company threatened to pursue legal action if the copyright infringement continued.
senses.example_zh: 该公司威胁称，如果侵权行为继续，将采取法律行动。

senses.example_en: Detectives relentlessly pursued every lead in the investigation.
senses.example_zh: 侦探们对案件调查中的每一条线索都穷追不舍。

senses.example_en: The local police will coordinate with federal agencies during the operation.
senses.example_zh: 在行动期间，当地警方将与联邦机构紧密配合。

senses.meaning: 协调各方努力，统筹行动
senses.example_en: Nations must coordinate efforts to tackle climate change effectively.
senses.example_zh: 各国必须协调努力，才能有效应对气候变化。

senses.example_en: Our marketing team needs to closely coordinate with product design.
senses.example_zh: 我们的市场团队需要与产品设计部门密切配合。

senses.meaning: 全速前进，快速顺利推进
senses.example_en: Despite the supply chain hiccups, the construction project is steaming ahead.
senses.example_zh: 尽管供应链出现小波折，该建筑工程仍在全力推进。

senses.meaning: 窗户等）蒙上水汽；（使）恼火
senses.example_en: The bathroom mirror steamed up quickly as the hot shower ran.
senses.example_zh: 热水淋浴一开，浴室镜子很快就蒙上了一层水汽。

senses.meaning: 释放压力，宣泄情绪（通常通过运动或娱乐）
senses.example_en: He goes for a vigorous run after work to let off steam.
senses.example_zh: 他下班后常去痛快地跑一场步，以宣泄压力。

senses.meaning: 怒火中烧，气得七窍生烟
senses.example_en: He was practically steaming with anger when he read the defamatory article.
senses.example_zh: 当他读到那篇诽谤性的文章时，简直气得七窍生烟。

senses.example_en: He spent twenty years in prison before DNA evidence proved he was wrongfully convicted.
senses.example_zh: 在DNA证据证明他被冤判之前，他已经在监狱里度过了二十年。

senses.example_en: The jury convicted the former CEO of fraud and money laundering.
senses.example_zh: 陪审团判定这位前首席执行官犯有欺诈和洗钱罪。

senses.example_en: The defendant had been previously convicted of armed robbery.
senses.example_zh: 被告此前曾因持械抢劫被定罪。

senses.meaning: 装作不知；假装不是这样
senses.example_en: The economy is in decline, and it is pointless to pretend otherwise.
senses.example_zh: 经济正在下行，假装一切正常是毫无意义的。

senses.example_en: When asked about the missing documents, the clerk pretended complete ignorance.
senses.example_zh: 当被问及丢失的文件时，那名职员假装毫不知情。

senses.example_en: Let's stop pretending that everything is fine between us.
senses.example_zh: 我们别再自欺欺人假装彼此之间没事了。

senses.meaning: 轻而易举地通过（考试、审查等）
senses.example_en: With weeks of preparation, she sailed through the final exam.
senses.example_zh: 经过数周的充分准备，她轻而易举地通过了期末考试。

senses.meaning: 打擦边球；冒险行事；近乎违规违法
senses.example_en: His tax avoidance schemes are definitely sailing close to the wind.
senses.example_zh: 他的避税方案绝对是在打法律的擦边球。

senses.example_en: The cruise ship is scheduled to set sail tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 这艘邮轮定于明天上午启航。

senses.meaning: 自信昂首地走进；猛烈批评/斥责
senses.example_en: She sailed into the room wearing an elegant evening gown.
senses.example_zh: 她身穿一袭优雅的晚礼服，自信满满地步入房间。

senses.example_en: The country exports agricultural products to over fifty nations worldwide.
senses.example_zh: 该国向全球五十多个国家出口农产品。

senses.meaning: 导出数据至（指定格式或设备）
senses.example_en: Users can easily export the data to an Excel spreadsheet.
senses.example_zh: 用户可以轻松将数据导出为Excel电子表格。

senses.example_en: Applicants must satisfy all entry requirements before submitting the form.
senses.example_zh: 申请人在提交表格前必须满足所有入学要求。

senses.example_en: The new transit system was built to satisfy the growing demand for public transportation.
senses.example_zh: 修建新的公交系统是为了满足日益增长的公共交通需求。

senses.example_en: Just to satisfy my curiosity, how much did you pay for that vintage watch?
senses.example_zh: 纯粹出于好奇，你买这块复古手表花了多少钱？

senses.meaning: 破除迷信；揭穿广泛流传的谬论
senses.example_en: Recent clinical trials have exploded the myth that eating fats makes you fat.
senses.example_zh: 近期的临床试验打破了“吃脂肪就会发胖”的谬论。

senses.example_en: He exploded with anger when he discovered the unauthorized charges on his credit card.
senses.example_zh: 当发现信用卡上未经授权的扣款时，他勃然大怒。

senses.example_en: Demand for clean energy solutions has exploded over the past decade.
senses.example_zh: 过去十年间，对清洁能源解决方案的需求出现了井喷式增长。

senses.meaning: 突然爆发出（大笑、愤怒等情绪）；激化为
senses.example_en: The room exploded into laughter as soon as the comedian delivered the punchline.
senses.example_zh: 喜剧演员一抛出笑点，全场便爆发出哄堂大笑。

senses.example_en: The cut on his knee took nearly three weeks to heal up completely.
senses.example_zh: 他膝盖上的伤口花了将近三周才完全愈合。

senses.example_en: Apply this antibacterial ointment to help the blister heal over quickly.
senses.example_zh: 涂抹这种抗菌药膏有助于水泡快速结痂愈合。

senses.example_en: She was devastated by the breakup, but time heals all wounds.
senses.example_zh: 分手让她痛不欲生，但时间终会抚平一切创伤。

senses.example_en: Both leaders pledged to work together to heal the rift between their nations.
senses.example_zh: 两位领导人都誓言共同努力，消除两国之间的裂痕。

senses.example_en: The company's quarterly revenue far exceeded Wall Street's expectations.
senses.example_zh: 该公司的季度营收远超华尔街的预期。

senses.example_en: The driver was fined heavily for exceeding the speed limit in a residential zone.
senses.example_zh: 该司机因在居民区超速行驶被处以高额罚款。

senses.example_en: The manager exceeded his authority by signing the million-dollar contract without board approval.
senses.example_zh: 该经理未经董事会批准便签署了百万美元合同，涉嫌越权。

senses.example_en: Local authorities are cooperating with federal agencies to solve the case.
senses.example_zh: 地方当局正与联邦机构协作侦破此案。

senses.example_en: The company promised to fully cooperate with the regulatory audit.
senses.example_zh: 该公司承诺全力配合监管部门的审计。

senses.example_en: Teachers and parents need to cooperate closely to support students' mental health.
senses.example_zh: 老师和家长需要紧密配合，以支持学生的心理健康。

senses.example_en: He leaned in too close to the gas grill and singed his eyebrows.
senses.example_zh: 他凑得离燃气烤炉太近，把眉毛给燎焦了。

senses.example_en: The stray spark singed the edges of the curtain before we extinguished it.
senses.example_zh: 飞溅出的火星在被扑灭前烧焦了窗帘的边缘。

senses.meaning: 在（项目、课题、作品等）上开展合作
senses.example_en: Two world-renowned architects collaborated on the design of the museum.
senses.example_zh: 两位世界知名的建筑师共同合作设计了这座博物馆。

senses.example_en: Our lab is collaborating with an overseas university to develop the new vaccine.
senses.example_zh: 我们的实验室正在与一所海外大学合作研发这种新疫苗。

senses.example_en: The marketing and development teams must collaborate closely throughout the launch.
senses.example_zh: 在整个产品发布期间，营销团队和研发团队必须密切合作。

senses.meaning: 提名某人获得（奖项、职位等）
senses.example_en: She was nominated for Best Actress at the Academy Awards.
senses.example_zh: 她获得了奥斯卡最佳女主角提名。

senses.meaning: 任命或指定某人担任某种职务
senses.example_en: The committee nominated him as their official spokesperson.
senses.example_zh: 委员会指定他担任官方发言人。

senses.example_en: The virus is primarily transmitted through respiratory droplets.
senses.example_zh: 该病毒主要通过呼吸道飞沫传播。

senses.example_en: The satellite transmits high-resolution images back to Earth.
senses.example_zh: 卫星将高分辨率图像传回地球。

senses.example_en: A good night's sleep can significantly boost up your energy levels.
senses.example_zh: 充足的睡眠能显著提升你的精力水平。

senses.example_en: The manager organized a team retreat to boost morale after a tough quarter.
senses.example_zh: 在经历了艰难的季度后，经理组织了一次团建以提振士气。

senses.example_en: Passing the preliminary exam really boosted her confidence.
senses.example_zh: 通过初试极大地增强了她的信心。

senses.example_en: The government introduced tax cuts to boost consumer spending.
senses.example_zh: 政府出台了减税政策以刺激居民消费。

senses.example_en: His account of the incident does not correspond with the security footage.
senses.example_zh: 他对事件的描述与监控录像并不相符。

senses.example_en: She corresponded regularly with her former mentor for many years.
senses.example_zh: 多年来她一直与她以前的导师保持频繁通信。

senses.example_en: Please acknowledge receipt of this email by replying with your confirmation.
senses.example_zh: 请回复此邮件确认已收到。

senses.example_en: He is widely acknowledged as one of the pioneers in artificial intelligence.
senses.example_zh: 他被公认为人工智能领域的先驱之一。

senses.meaning: 承认……的必要性或重要性
senses.example_en: The policy makers failed to acknowledge the urgency of climate action.
senses.example_zh: 政策制定者未能认识到应对气候变化的紧迫性。

senses.meaning: 事实、真理或消息）被完全理解；为人所接受
senses.example_en: The reality of what happened took several days to sink in.
senses.example_zh: 过了好几天，大家才真正领会所发生事情的严重性。

senses.meaning: 心一沉；顿感绝望或沮丧
senses.example_en: My heart sank when I saw the rejection letter in the mailbox.
senses.example_zh: 看到邮箱里的拒信时，我的心沉了下去。

senses.meaning: 自生自灭；成败全靠自己
senses.example_en: In such a competitive industry, new startups either sink or swim.
senses.example_zh: 在竞争如此激烈的行业中，初创企业只能自谋生路，非生即死。

senses.example_en: They sank millions of dollars into developing the new software platform.
senses.example_zh: 他们把数百万美元投到了这个新软件平台的研发中。

senses.meaning: 陷入（柔软的椅子等）；沦落入（绝望、沉睡或坏习惯）
senses.example_en: After a grueling shift, he sank into the armchair and fell asleep immediately.
senses.example_zh: 结束了疲惫的轮班后，他陷进扶手椅里立刻睡着了。

senses.meaning: 搜刮冰箱或食物柜找吃的
senses.example_en: The teenagers raided the fridge the moment they got home from practice.
senses.example_zh: 青少年们一结束训练回到家，就直奔冰箱找吃的。

senses.example_en: Armed police raided the warehouse early yesterday morning.
senses.example_zh: 全副武装的警方于昨天清晨突击搜查了那座仓库。

senses.meaning: 给……打气；增强，激发（情绪/肌肉）
senses.example_en: The upbeat music was intended to pump up the crowd before the game.
senses.example_zh: 欢快的音乐旨在赛前点燃观众的热情。

senses.meaning: 抽出（液体）；大量快速生产出
senses.example_en: The studio continues to pump out low-budget sequels every summer.
senses.example_zh: 该制片厂每年夏天都持续大量炮制低成本续集。

senses.example_en: He spends an hour pumping iron at the gym every morning.
senses.example_zh: 他每天早晨都要在健身房撸铁一小时。

senses.example_en: In Oregon, drivers were not legally allowed to pump their own gas for decades.
senses.example_zh: 几十年来，俄勒冈州法律不允许司机自己动手给车加油。

senses.meaning: 向……大量注入（资金、资源等）
senses.example_en: The venture capital firm pumped billions into green energy projects.
senses.example_zh: 该风险投资机构向绿色能源项目注资数十亿美元。

senses.meaning: 挖掘出；翻出（隐私或旧账）
senses.example_en: The media managed to dig up some scandalous details about his past.
