senses.example_zh: 媒体设法翻出了他过去的一些丑闻细节。

senses.example_en: I dug out an old photo album from the attic.
senses.example_zh: 我从阁楼里翻出了一本旧相册。

senses.example_en: The union dug in its heels and refused to accept any wage cuts.
senses.example_zh: 工会固执己见，拒绝接受任何降薪方案。

senses.meaning: 下大功夫；倾其所有（尤指掏钱或调动内在力量）
senses.example_en: The team had to dig deep to win the match in extra time.
senses.example_zh: 球队全力以赴才在加时赛中赢得了比赛。

senses.meaning: 自掘坟墓；让自己陷入更难堪的境地
senses.example_en: Every time he tried to explain his mistake, he just dug a hole for himself.
senses.example_zh: 他每次试图解释自己的错误，结果反而越描越黑。

senses.meaning: 深入探究；大快朵颐，开始吃
senses.example_en: Reporters began to dig into the company's financial records.
senses.example_zh: 记者们开始深入调查该公司的财务记录。

senses.example_en: Someone in the accounting department must have slipped up.
senses.example_zh: 财务部肯定有人粗心犯了错。

senses.meaning: 悄悄溜走；（机会或时间）悄然流逝
senses.example_en: Don't let this incredible opportunity slip away.
senses.example_zh: 别让这个绝佳的机会悄悄溜走。

senses.example_en: I'm so sorry I missed the meeting; it completely slipped my mind.
senses.example_zh: 真抱歉我缺席了会议，我完全忘在脑后了。

senses.meaning: 无意中说漏嘴；错失（机会）
senses.example_en: She let slip that they were planning to get married soon.
senses.example_zh: 她无意间说漏了嘴，透露他们打算近期结婚。

senses.example_en: The patient slipped into a coma following the severe head injury.
senses.example_zh: 患者头部严重受伤后陷入了昏迷。

senses.example_en: Vulnerable children can easily slip through the cracks of the social welfare system.
senses.example_zh: 弱势儿童很容易被社会福利体系所忽视。

senses.meaning: 悄悄溜进；不知不觉陷入（某种状态）；迅速换上（衣服）
senses.example_en: Over the years, the country slipped into a deep economic crisis.
senses.example_zh: 这些年来，该国不知不觉陷入了严重的经济危机。

senses.example_en: You need to back up your data before formatting the hard drive.
senses.example_zh: 格式化硬盘之前，你需要先备份数据。

senses.meaning: 排版文档；设定文档格式
senses.example_en: Please format the document according to the APA guidelines.
senses.example_zh: 请按照APA规范对文档进行排版。

senses.example_en: Taking out a new loan to pay off the old one is just robbing Peter to pay Paul.
senses.example_zh: 借新贷还旧贷不过是拆东墙补西墙而已。

senses.meaning: 剥夺某人的…；抢走某人的…
senses.example_en: The sudden injury robbed him of his dream of competing in the Olympics.
senses.example_zh: 突如其来的伤病剥夺了他参加奥运会的梦想。

senses.example_en: Two masked men attempted to rob a bank downtown yesterday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 昨天下午，两名蒙面男子企图抢劫市中心的一家银行。

senses.example_en: We managed to finish the product launch ahead of schedule—mission accomplished!
senses.example_zh: 我们提前完成了产品发布——大功告成！

senses.example_en: With consistent effort, you will eventually accomplish your long-term goals.
senses.example_zh: 只要坚持不懈，你终将实现自己的长期目标。

senses.meaning: 完成壮举；取得卓越成就
senses.example_en: The young climber accomplished an extraordinary feat by scaling the peak solo.
senses.example_zh: 这位年轻的登山者独自登顶，完成了一项非凡的壮举。

senses.meaning: 对某人大加赞赏；极力吹捧某人
senses.example_en: The director has been singing her praises ever since she joined the team.
senses.example_zh: 自从她加入团队以来，主管就一直对她赞不绝口。

senses.example_en: The teacher praised the student for his remarkable improvement in math.
senses.example_zh: 老师表扬了该学生在数学方面取得的显著进步。

senses.meaning: 受到高度赞扬；广受好评
senses.example_en: Her novel was highly praised by literary critics around the world.
senses.example_zh: 她的小说受到了全世界文学评论家的高度赞誉。

senses.meaning: 使某人享有…的权利/资格
senses.example_en: This membership card entitles you to a 20% discount on all purchases.
senses.example_zh: 持此会员卡购买所有商品均可享受八折优惠。

senses.example_en: Passengers are entitled to compensation if the flight is delayed by over three hours.
senses.example_zh: 如果航班延误超过三小时，乘客有权获得赔偿。

senses.example_en: Once you empty the recycle bin, the files are deleted permanently.
senses.example_zh: 一旦清空回收站，这些文件就会被永久删除。

senses.example_en: He decided to delete his social media account to reduce screen time.
senses.example_zh: 他决定注销社交媒体账号以减少使用屏幕的时间。

senses.example_en: Your personal details can be deleted from the database upon request.
senses.example_zh: 如您提出要求，您的个人信息可从数据库中删除。

senses.meaning: 会议、事件等）拖延；没完没了地持续
senses.example_en: The negotiations dragged on for months without any clear breakthrough.
senses.example_zh: 谈判拖了数月之久，仍未取得任何明确突破。

senses.example_en: There is no need to drag out the dispute any longer.
senses.example_zh: 没有必要再故意拖延这场争端了。

senses.example_en: Rising energy costs could drag down the entire manufacturing sector.
senses.example_zh: 不断上涨的能源成本可能会拖垮整个制造业。

senses.meaning: 拖拖拉拉；迟迟不采取行动
senses.example_en: The government has been dragging its feet on implementing environmental reforms.
senses.example_zh: 政府在推行环保改革方面一直在拖拖拉拉。

senses.example_en: Please don't drag me into your personal arguments.
senses.example_zh: 请不要把我也卷入你们个人的争吵之中。

senses.example_en: Simply drag and drop the image file into the folder.
senses.example_zh: 只需将图像文件拖放到该文件夹中即可。

senses.meaning: 打卡上班 / 打卡下班
senses.example_en: Don't forget to punch in as soon as you arrive at the factory.
senses.example_zh: 一到工厂，别忘了立刻打卡上班。

senses.meaning: 使更有吸引力；给……润色增强；向上猛击
senses.example_en: The editors asked the writer to punch up the opening dialogue.
senses.example_zh: 编辑们要求作者润色并增强开篇对话的吸引力。

senses.meaning: 超水平发挥；以小博大；承担超出自身能力/体量的责任
senses.example_en: The small tech startup is punching above its weight in the global AI market.
senses.example_zh: 这家小型初创科技公司在全球人工智能市场中展现出了远超自身体量的实力。

senses.meaning: 手下留情；言辞有所保留（常用于否定句）
senses.example_en: The film critic didn't pull any punches in her devastating review.
senses.example_zh: 影评人在她毫不留情的犀利批评中毫无保留。

senses.meaning: 在……上打孔；彻底推翻（论点/防线）
senses.example_en: His alibi punched a huge hole in the prosecution's theory.
senses.example_zh: 他的不在场证明彻底击溃了控方的论点。

senses.meaning: 在键盘/仪器上快速输入数字
senses.example_en: She punched the security code into the keypad and the door clicked open.
senses.example_zh: 她在密码键盘上输入安全代码，门应声弹开。

senses.meaning: 穿过；穿梭于；（主题等）贯穿始终
senses.example_en: A recurring theme of alienation threads through all his novels.
senses.example_zh: 一种反复出现的疏离感主题贯穿了他所有的小说。

senses.meaning: 穿针引线；在夹缝中求生存；精准拿捏兼顾两难局面
senses.example_en: The diplomat had to thread the needle between satisfying voters and appeasing foreign allies.
senses.example_zh: 该外交官必须精准权衡，既要满足国内选民，又要安抚外国盟友。

senses.example_en: Grandmother asked me to help her thread the needle because her eyesight was fading.
senses.example_zh: 祖母视力下降了，便叫我帮她给针穿线。

senses.meaning: 在（拥挤的人群、狭窄的空间等）中穿行迂回
senses.example_en: The waiter deftly threaded his way through the crowded dining room carrying a heavy tray.
senses.example_zh: 服务员端着沉重的托盘，熟练地在拥挤的餐厅人群中穿行。

senses.meaning: 与……结为友好城市（配对）；与……结合
senses.example_en: The historic town is twinned with a picturesque village in southern France.
senses.example_zh: 这座历史名镇与法国南部的一座风景如画的村庄结成了友好城镇。

senses.meaning: 使……与……相辅相成；将二者紧密结合
senses.example_en: The project aims to twin environmental conservation with sustainable economic growth.
senses.example_zh: 该项目旨在将环境保护与可持续经济增长紧密结合。

senses.example_en: He managed to pry the rusted lid loose after several attempts.
senses.example_zh: 尝试了几次之后，他终于设法撬松了生锈的盖子。

senses.meaning: 从某人嘴里硬撬出消息
senses.example_en: The detectives struggled to pry any useful information out of the uncooperative witness.
senses.example_zh: 侦探们费尽周折，也没能从那个不配合的证人口中撬出任何有用的信息。

senses.example_en: Firefighters used a crowbar to pry open the jammed car door.
senses.example_zh: 消防员用撬棍撬开了卡死的车门。

senses.example_en: I hate to pry into your personal life, but are you doing alright?
senses.example_zh: 我不想探听你的私生活，但你最近还好吗？

senses.example_en: The founding family fought hard to retain control of the conglomerate.
senses.example_zh: 创始家族奋力抗争，以保留对该企业集团的控制权。

senses.example_en: Offering competitive benefits is crucial to retaining top talent in the industry.
senses.example_zh: 提供有竞争力的福利对于留住行业顶尖人才至关重要。

senses.example_en: This organic soil conditioner helps retain moisture during dry spells.
senses.example_zh: 这种有机土壤改良剂有助于在干旱期保持水分。

senses.example_en: She derives immense satisfaction from helping underprivileged students succeed.
senses.example_zh: 她从帮助弱势学生取得成功的过程中获得了极大的满足感。

senses.example_en: Local communities should derive tangible benefits from eco-tourism development.
senses.example_zh: 当地社区应当从生态旅游开发中获得切实的利益。

senses.example_en: Many English scientific terms derive from classical Greek and Latin.
senses.example_zh: 许多英语科技术语源自古希腊语和拉丁语。

senses.example_en: The corporate executive was prosecuted for insider trading and tax fraud.
senses.example_zh: 该企业高管因涉嫌内幕交易和税务欺诈遭到起诉。

senses.example_en: Due to insufficient forensic evidence, the district attorney declined to prosecute.
senses.example_zh: 由于法医物证不足，地区检察官决定不起诉。

senses.meaning: 推行、继续进行（战争、斗争或活动）
senses.example_en: The government lacked the public support needed to vigorously prosecute the war.
senses.example_zh: 政府缺乏有力推进这场战争所需的民众支持。

senses.meaning: 对索赔/指控/调查结果提出质疑或异议
senses.example_en: Independent researchers disputed the findings presented in the pharmaceutical report.
senses.example_zh: 独立研究人员对该医药报告中给出的结论提出了异议。

senses.example_en: The demarcation of the maritime boundary remains hotly disputed between the two nations.
senses.example_zh: 两国之间对海洋边界的划定依然存在激烈的争议。

senses.meaning: 对选举结果提出异议/抗辩
senses.example_en: The opposition party decided to dispute the election results in the supreme court.
senses.example_zh: 反对党决定在最高法院对选举结果提起抗辩。

senses.meaning: 怒斥不公；对不公表达愤慨
senses.example_en: He spent his youth railing at the social injustices around him.
senses.example_zh: 他年轻时常对自己所处的社会不公大声抗议。

senses.meaning: 猛烈抨击；强烈抗议；愤怒抱怨
senses.example_en: Consumer advocates continue to rail against unfair bank fees.
senses.example_zh: 消费者权益倡导者持续猛烈抨击不合理的银行收费。

senses.example_en: The tradition can be traced back to the medieval period.
senses.example_zh: 这一传统可以追溯到中世纪时期。

senses.example_en: She traced out a rough map on the napkin.
senses.example_zh: 她在餐巾纸上勾勒出一副简易地图。

senses.example_en: Health officials are struggling to trace the source of the outbreak.
senses.example_zh: 卫生官员正努力追查疫情暴发的源头。

senses.example_en: Many immigrants visit the region to trace their ancestral roots.
senses.example_zh: 许多移民前往该地寻根溯源。

senses.meaning: 掩盖疼痛；止痛（但未根治）
senses.example_en: Painkillers can mask the symptoms, but they don't cure the underlying illness.
senses.example_zh: 止痛药可以掩盖症状，但无法根治潜在的疾病。

senses.example_en: She forced a bright smile to mask her deep disappointment.
senses.example_zh: 她挤出灿烂的笑容来掩饰内心极度的失望。

senses.example_en: Hunters often use sprays to mask their scent from prey.
senses.example_zh: 猎人经常使用喷雾来掩盖气味，防止猎物察觉。

senses.meaning: 熟稔生轻蔑；过分亲密易招不敬
senses.example_en: Spending every moment together proved that familiarity breeds contempt.
senses.example_zh: 朝夕相处的事实证明，彼此过分亲密容易产生摩擦与轻视。

senses.example_en: Favoritism in the workplace will inevitably breed resentment among staff.
senses.example_zh: 职场中的偏袒偏私势必会在员工中滋生不满与怨恨。

senses.meaning: 孕育成功；以成功促成更大成功
senses.example_en: Early achievements boosted the team's morale, proving that success breeds success.
senses.example_zh: 早期的成绩提振了团队士气，印证了成功孕育成功的道理。

senses.meaning: 圈养繁殖；人工饲养繁殖
senses.example_en: Pandas are notoriously difficult to breed in captivity.
senses.example_zh: 众所周知，大熊猫在圈养环境下极难繁殖。

senses.example_en: Under intense political pressure, the prime minister resigned from office.
senses.example_zh: 在巨大的政治压力下，首相辞去了公职。

senses.example_en: The board member resigned in protest over the controversial takeover.
senses.example_zh: 该董事会成员因反对这笔备受争议的收购而愤然辞职。

senses.meaning: 听任；无可奈何地顺从/接受
senses.example_en: He resigned himself to the fact that his flight was cancelled.
senses.example_zh: 他不得不无可奈何地接受航班已被取消的现实。

senses.example_en: We revised the proposal to incorporate feedback from the client.
senses.example_zh: 我们修改了方案，将客户的反馈意见纳入其中。

senses.example_en: Her modern choreography incorporates elements of classical ballet.
senses.example_zh: 她的现代编舞融合了古典芭蕾的元素。

senses.example_en: The architect incorporated sustainable materials into the building's design.
senses.example_zh: 建筑师将环保可持续材料融入了该建筑的设计中。

senses.meaning: 使深感难堪；使极为尴尬
senses.example_en: The leak of private emails deeply embarrassed the government.
senses.example_zh: 私人邮件的泄露让政府深感难堪。

senses.example_en: Unforeseen medical expenses had severely embarrassed the family.
senses.example_zh: 意料之外的医疗开支让这个家庭陷入严重的经济窘迫。

senses.meaning: 格斗中）拍垫认输；耗尽；筋疲力尽
senses.example_en: After working seventy hours this week, I've officially tapped out.
senses.example_zh: 这周连续工作了70个小时后，我彻底精疲力竭了。

senses.example_en: The training program aims to tap the leadership potential of young managers.
senses.example_zh: 该培训计划旨在激发年轻管理者的领导潜能。

senses.example_en: Someone tapped him on the shoulder, and he turned around in surprise.
senses.example_zh: 有人轻拍了一下他的肩膀，他惊讶地转过身来。

senses.meaning: 发掘；利用（资源、情感、市场）；打入
senses.example_en: The marketing campaign tapped into consumers' nostalgia for the 1990s.
senses.example_zh: 这次营销活动成功利用了消费者对20世纪90年代的怀旧情绪。

senses.example_en: Researchers were able to isolate the virus within days of the outbreak.
senses.example_zh: 疫情暴发后数天内，研究人员便成功分离出了该病毒。

senses.meaning: 感到被社会孤立；感到与世隔绝
senses.example_en: Working remotely can cause some employees to feel socially isolated.
senses.example_zh: 远程办公可能会让一些员工产生与世隔绝的孤独感。

senses.example_en: Patients with infectious diseases must be isolated from others.
senses.example_zh: 传染病患者必须与其他人群隔离。

senses.example_en: I authorized my lawyer to sign the contract on my behalf.
senses.example_zh: 我授权我的律师代表我签署这份合同。

senses.example_en: The finance director must authorize any payment over ten thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 任何超过一万美元的款项都必须经财务总监批准支付。

senses.example_en: Congress voted to authorize the use of military force.
senses.example_zh: 国会表决通过，授权使用武力。

senses.example_en: The new software update is designed to enhance the quality of audio playback.
senses.example_zh: 此次新软件更新旨在提高音频播放的质量。

senses.example_en: Adopting automated tools can significantly enhance operational efficiency.
senses.example_zh: 采用自动化工具可以显著提高运营效率。

senses.example_en: These measures will greatly enhance public safety in urban areas.
senses.example_zh: 这些措施将极大提升城市区域的公共安全。

senses.example_en: We decided to upgrade to the premium business package for extra storage.
senses.example_zh: 为了获得额外存储空间，我们决定升级为高级商业套餐。

senses.example_en: The IT department will upgrade the system over the weekend to fix security flaws.
senses.example_zh: IT部门将在周末升级系统以修复安全漏洞。

senses.example_en: She was thrilled to get a free upgrade to business class on the long-haul flight.
senses.example_zh: 长途航班上她意外获得了免费升舱至商务舱的待遇，兴奋不已。

senses.example_en: The severe storm was accompanied by thunder and gale-force winds.
senses.example_zh: 这场强风暴伴有雷电和大风。

senses.example_en: He accompanied the soprano on the piano throughout the recital.
senses.example_zh: 在整场独唱音乐会中，他一直用钢琴为那位女高音伴奏。

senses.example_en: His exceptional leadership elevated him to the position of chief executive.
senses.example_zh: 他卓越的领导能力使他晋升为首席执行官。

senses.example_en: Winning the prestigious prize elevated the status of the indie studio.
senses.example_zh: 斩获该权威大奖提升了这家独立工作室的行业地位。

senses.example_en: Brisk walking is sufficient to elevate your heart rate and burn calories.
senses.example_zh: 快走足以提高心率并消耗卡路里。

senses.example_en: It was a painful misunderstanding, but they agreed to forgive and forget.
senses.example_zh: 那是一场痛苦的误会，但他们同意不计前嫌，重归于好。

senses.example_en: Forgive me for saying so, but this business model simply isn't sustainable.
senses.example_zh: 恕我直言，这种商业模式根本无法持久。

senses.example_en: She could never completely forgive him for breaking his promise.
senses.example_zh: 她永远无法完全原谅他违背诺言。

senses.example_en: The bank ultimately agreed to forgive a significant portion of the loan.
senses.example_zh: 银行最终同意免除该笔贷款的很大一部分。

senses.meaning: 顺道走访；顺便过去一趟
senses.example_en: I'll swing by your office this afternoon to drop off the signed documents.
senses.example_zh: 我今天下午会顺道去你办公室把签好的文件送过去。

senses.meaning: 猛转过身；（态度或意见）突然转变
senses.example_en: He swung round sharply when he heard footsteps behind him.
senses.example_zh: 听到身后有脚步声，他猛地转过身来。

senses.meaning: 处于最活跃阶段；全面展开；正如火如荼
senses.example_en: By the time we arrived at midnight, the festival was in full swing.
senses.example_zh: 当我们半夜到达时，节日庆典正进行得如火如荼。

idioms.phrase: get into the swing of things

senses.meaning: 熟悉门路；适应新环境或工作节奏
senses.example_en: It took a few weeks to get into the swing of things at her new job.
senses.example_zh: 她花了几周时间才逐渐适应新工作的生活节奏。

senses.meaning: 扭转投票结果；起决定性选票作用
senses.example_en: Undecided moderate voters are expected to swing the upcoming election.
senses.example_zh: 犹豫不决的温和派选民预计将扭转即将到来的大选局势。

senses.example_en: Severe mood swings can be an early indicator of chronic stress.
senses.example_zh: 剧烈的情绪波动可能是长期处于高压之下的早期征兆。

senses.meaning: 跳上/跳下（公共汽车、火车等）
senses.example_en: We bought a city pass so we could hop on and off the tram anytime.
senses.example_zh: 我们买了城市通票，这样可以随时跳上有轨电车或下车。

senses.example_en: Hop in, I can drop you off at the train station on my way.
senses.example_zh: 快上车，我顺路送你去火车站。

idioms.phrase: a hop, skip, and a jump

senses.example_en: The beach is just a hop, skip, and a jump away from our cottage.
senses.example_zh: 从我们的小屋到海滩只有几步之遥。

senses.meaning: 开个简短电话/线上会议
senses.example_en: Do you have five minutes to hop on a quick call to review the deck?
senses.example_zh: 你有五分钟时间开个简短线上会议过一遍PPT吗？

senses.example_en: Tech workers often job hop early in their careers to maximize their salary growth.
senses.example_zh: 科技从业者在职业生涯早期往往频繁跳槽以追求最大化薪资增长。

senses.example_en: You can rest assured that your personal data is fully encrypted and safe.
senses.example_zh: 您可以完全放心，您的个人数据已全部加密且十分安全。

senses.meaning: 向某人保证某事；使某人确信
senses.example_en: The lead engineer assured management of the project's feasibility.
senses.example_zh: 首席工程师向管理层保证了该项目的可行性。

senses.meaning: 向某人担保/肯定地说明……
senses.example_en: They assured us that the package would be delivered before noon.
senses.example_zh: 他们向我们担保包裹将在中午前送达。

senses.example_en: Crush up the dried herbs finely before adding them to the stew.
senses.example_zh: 把干香草碾碎后再加入炖菜中。

senses.example_en: He stepped outside to crush out his cigarette before the meeting began.
senses.example_zh: 开会前，他走到门外把烟头掐灭了。

senses.example_en: She secretly had a huge crush on her classmate all through college.
senses.example_zh: 大学四年里，她一直悄悄暗恋着自己的同学。

senses.example_en: A sudden knee injury crushed his dreams of qualifying for the national team.
senses.example_zh: 突如其来的膝伤彻底粉碎了他入选国家队的梦想。

senses.example_en: The regime deployed armed forces to crush the peaceful protests.
senses.example_zh: 该政权出动武装力量镇压了和平抗议活动。

senses.example_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
senses.example_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

senses.example_en: He was so furious that he threatened to rip up the partnership agreement.
senses.example_zh: 他非常愤怒，甚至威胁要撕毁合伙协议。

senses.example_en: The fierce tornado ripped through the coastal town in less than an hour.
senses.example_zh: 凶猛的龙卷风在不到一小时内席卷并重创了这座沿海小镇。

senses.meaning: 撕得粉碎；把……批得体无完肤
senses.example_en: Film critics ripped the director's latest big-budget sequel to shreds.
senses.example_zh: 影评人们把这位导演最新执导的大制作续集批得体无完肤。

senses.example_en: The prolonged legal battle threatened to rip the entire family apart.
senses.example_zh: 旷日持久的官司可能让整个家族分崩离析。

senses.meaning: 敲定，确定（细节、协议等）；弄清，查明（真相或原因）
senses.example_en: We need to nail down the exact budget before presenting the proposal to the board.
senses.example_zh: 在向董事会提交方案之前，我们需要敲定确切的预算。

senses.meaning: 圆满完成；表现极其出色，完全搞定
senses.example_en: You were so nervous before the speech, but you totally nailed it!
senses.example_zh: 你演讲前还那么紧张，但实际上你表现得极其出色！

senses.meaning: 面试/试镜表现极佳并成功通过
senses.example_en: She spent days practicing and completely nailed the job interview.
senses.example_zh: 她花了好几天时间练习，最终完美拿下了那场求职面试。

senses.example_en: The journalist asked sharp questions that nailed his lie in seconds.
senses.example_zh: 记者的尖锐提问几秒钟内就戳穿了他的谎言。

senses.meaning: 挫败某人的努力/阻挠某人的计划
senses.example_en: Bad weather and supply shortages frustrated their rescue efforts.
senses.example_zh: 恶劣的天气和物资匮乏挫败了他们的救援行动。

senses.meaning: 对……感到极其沮丧与受挫
senses.example_en: Commuters are deeply frustrated by the constant train delays.
senses.example_zh: 通勤者对列车频繁晚点感到极度沮丧。

senses.meaning: 身体、肌肉或心理）变得紧绷，紧张起来
senses.example_en: Try to breathe deeply and not tense up when the dentist starts working.
senses.example_zh: 牙医开始操作时，尽量深呼吸，不要把身体紧绷起来。

senses.example_en: He tensed his muscles in anticipation of the impact.
senses.example_zh: 他紧绷肌肉，准备迎接即将到来的撞击。

senses.example_en: The guard was court-martialed for deserting his post during the night shift.
senses.example_zh: 那名警卫因夜班擅离职守而受到了军事法庭的审判。

senses.meaning: 勇气、自信等）丧失；离某人而去
senses.example_en: As she stepped onto the stage, all her confidence suddenly deserted her.
senses.example_zh: 当她走上舞台时，所有的自信突然离她而去。

senses.example_en: Crime rates have decreased significantly over the past five years.
senses.example_zh: 过去五年中，犯罪率已显著下降。

senses.meaning: 在价值/规模/数量上缩减
senses.example_en: The property has decreased in value since the nearby highway was built.
senses.example_zh: 自从附近的高速公路建成后，该房产的价值就贬值了。

senses.example_en: A handful of tech giants continue to dominate the global market.
senses.example_zh: 少数几家科技巨头继续主导着全球市场。

senses.meaning: 独揽话语权，主导谈话/讨论
senses.example_en: He tended to dominate the meeting, barely giving anyone else a chance to speak.
senses.example_zh: 他倾向于主导整个会议，几乎不给其他人发言的机会。

senses.meaning: 建筑等）高耸耸立，雄踞天际线
senses.example_en: The cathedral's towering spires dominate the city skyline.
senses.example_zh: 这座大教堂高耸的尖顶雄踞着该城市的天际线。

senses.meaning: 日后终将为某事后悔莫及
senses.example_en: If you drop out of school now, you will live to regret it.
senses.example_zh: 如果你现在辍学，日后终将为此后悔莫及。

senses.example_en: She bitterly regretted having spoken so harshly to her colleague.
senses.example_zh: 她非常后悔当时对同事说了那么重的话。

senses.meaning: 很遗憾地通知/宣布（用于正式商务信函）
senses.example_en: We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful.
senses.example_zh: 我们很遗憾地通知您，您的申请未能通过。

senses.example_en: The bottle has a child-proof cap that is difficult to twist off.
senses.example_zh: 这个瓶子装有儿童安全瓶盖，很难直接拧开。

senses.meaning: 对某人软磨硬泡；强迫施压让某人让步
senses.example_en: I wasn't going to attend the party, but they twisted my arm.
senses.example_zh: 我本不打算去参加聚会，但在他们的软磨硬泡下我还是去了。

senses.meaning: 往伤口上撒盐；故意让人更加痛苦难受
senses.example_en: Reminding him of his failure was just twisting the knife.
senses.example_zh: 向他提起他的失败无异于往他的伤口上撒盐。

senses.example_en: She slipped on the wet grass and twisted her ankle.
senses.example_zh: 她在潮湿的草地上滑倒，扭伤了脚踝。

senses.example_en: Don't twist my words; I never said I was going to resign.
senses.example_zh: 别曲解我的话，我从来没说过我要辞职。

senses.meaning: 坚持认为/坚称（事实）；坚决主张（后接虚拟语气）
senses.example_en: The manager insisted that all safety protocols be strictly followed.
senses.example_zh: 经理坚决主张必须严格遵守所有安全规程。

senses.meaning: 坚定不移地主张/坚决坚持
senses.example_en: He firmly insisted on his innocence throughout the trial.
senses.example_zh: 在整个审判过程中，他始终坚定不移地声称自己是无辜的。

senses.meaning: 坚决要求；硬要；执意坚持
senses.example_en: She insisted on paying for the dinner despite my protests.
senses.example_zh: 尽管我一再推阻，她还是执意要为晚饭买单。

senses.meaning: 光线等）透过来；（信息、消息）逐渐传开
senses.example_en: Sunlight filtered through the dense canopy of trees.
senses.example_zh: 阳光透过茂密的树冠洒了下来。

senses.meaning: 过滤掉；筛选排除（杂质、无关信息等）
senses.example_en: The software is designed to filter out spam emails automatically.
senses.example_zh: 该软件旨在自动过滤掉垃圾邮件。

senses.meaning: 观念、资金或信息）向下渗透，逐级传达
senses.example_en: It takes time for the management's new policies to filter down to the frontline staff.
senses.example_zh: 管理层的新政策需要时间才能传达到基层员工。

senses.example_en: Wetlands naturally filter pollutants from water before it reaches rivers.
senses.example_zh: 湿地能在水流入河流之前自然过滤其中的污染物。

senses.meaning: 过度加滤镜的；经过深度过滤的
senses.example_en: Her photos on social media are always heavily filtered.
senses.example_zh: 她在社交媒体上的照片总是加了很重的滤镜。

senses.meaning: 不假思索地全盘拒绝；断然否定
senses.example_en: The committee dismissed the proposal out of hand without giving any valid reasons.
senses.example_zh: 委员会甚至没有给出正当理由，就断然否决了该提案。

senses.meaning: 驳回指控/主张；对指责不予理会
senses.example_en: The spokesperson dismissed the allegations as completely unfounded.
senses.example_zh: 发言人驳斥这些指控毫无事实根据。

collocations.phrase: dismiss sb from a post / job

senses.meaning: 免去某人职务；解雇某人
senses.example_en: He was dismissed from his post following a serious breach of contract.
senses.example_zh: 因严重违约，他被免去了职务。

senses.meaning: 将某人轻视为……；断定某人不过是……
senses.example_en: Critics initially dismissed him as an amateur.
senses.example_zh: 批评家们起初将他轻视为一个业余爱好者。

senses.example_en: She sacrificed her personal life for her political career.
senses.example_zh: 她为了政治生涯牺牲了自己的个人生活。

senses.example_en: We must never sacrifice product quality for speed of delivery.
senses.example_zh: 我们绝不能为了交付速度而牺牲产品质量。

senses.example_en: Many soldiers sacrificed their lives to defend the country.
senses.example_zh: 许多士兵为了保卫国家献出了宝贵的生命。

senses.example_en: He bent down to tie his shoelaces.
senses.example_zh: 他弯下腰系鞋带。

senses.example_en: Can't you bend the rules just this once for an emergency?
senses.example_zh: 遇到紧急情况，你难道就不能破例变通一次吗？

senses.meaning: 拉着某人喋喋不休（倾诉问题）
senses.example_en: She bent my ear for nearly an hour about her workplace grievances.
senses.example_zh: 她拉着我讲了近一个小时她在职场上的委屈。

senses.example_en: He refused to bend to the will of the corporate board.
senses.example_zh: 他拒绝屈服于董事会的意志。

senses.example_en: Remember to bend your knees when lifting heavy objects.
senses.example_zh: 搬重物时记得屈膝借力。

senses.meaning: 竭尽全力；煞费苦心（讨好或提供帮助）
senses.example_en: The hotel staff bent over backwards to ensure our stay was comfortable.
senses.example_zh: 酒店员工竭尽全力确保我们住得舒适。

senses.example_en: The organization advocates for the rights of marginalized communities.
senses.example_zh: 该组织为边缘群体的权益积极奔走呼吁。

senses.example_en: Environmentalists vigorously advocate the adoption of renewable energy.
senses.example_zh: 环保主义者极力倡导采用可再生能源。

senses.example_en: The senator has long advocated tax reform to support small businesses.
senses.example_zh: 这位参议员长期倡导税制改革以支持小微企业。

senses.meaning: 发生显著改变；大幅改动
senses.example_en: The advent of artificial intelligence has altered the workplace dramatically.
senses.example_zh: 人工智能的到来极大地改变了职场生态。

senses.meaning: 改变航向；转变方针政策
senses.example_en: Faced with declining sales, the company was forced to alter its course.
senses.example_zh: 面对销量下滑，公司不得不改变发展方针。

senses.example_en: I need to get this suit altered before the wedding.
senses.example_zh: 婚礼前我得把这套西装拿去改一下尺寸。

senses.meaning: 介入；干预（冲突、争端或事务）
senses.example_en: The United Nations was called upon to intervene in the escalating border dispute.
senses.example_zh: 联合国受邀介入这场不断升级的边境争端。

senses.example_en: Neighboring countries decided not to intervene militarily in the civil conflict.
senses.example_zh: 邻国决定不对该国内部冲突进行军事干预。

senses.example_en: The government had to intervene directly to stabilize the collapsing financial market.
senses.example_zh: 政府不得不直接出手干预以稳定崩溃的金融市场。

senses.example_en: Tenants were ordered to vacate the premises by the end of the month.
senses.example_zh: 租户被责令在月底前搬离该处住所。

senses.meaning: 让座；辞去职位/让出席位
senses.example_en: She vacated her seat in Parliament to focus on philanthropic work.
senses.example_zh: 她辞去了议会席位，将精力转向慈善工作。

senses.example_en: Guests are kindly requested to vacate their rooms before noon.
senses.example_zh: 请客人在中午十二点前退房。

senses.meaning: 匆匆写出/敲出（报告、稿件）；嘈杂地弹奏
senses.example_en: She managed to bang out a decent draft of the report in just two hours.
senses.example_zh: 她竟然在短短两个小时内就赶出了一份像样的报告草稿。

senses.meaning: 喋喋不休地念叨；没完没了地说
senses.example_en: He keeps banging on about how things used to be better in the old days.
senses.example_zh: 他老是没完没了地念叨过去的日子有多好。

idioms.phrase: bang one's head against a brick wall

senses.meaning: 碰壁；做徒劳无功的努力
senses.example_en: Trying to convince him to change his mind is like banging your head against a brick wall.
senses.example_zh: 想说服他改变心意简直就是白费力气、自讨没趣。

senses.example_en: He stormed out of the conference room and banged the door shut.
senses.example_zh: 他怒气冲冲地冲出会议室，砰地一声甩上了门。

collocations.phrase: bang one's fist on the table

senses.meaning: 捶桌子；拍桌子（以示愤怒或强调）
senses.example_en: The manager banged his fist on the table to demand silence.
senses.example_zh: 经理用力捶了下桌子要求大家安静。

senses.example_en: I wasn't looking where I was going and banged into a lamppost.
senses.example_zh: 我走路没看路，一头撞在了路灯柱上。

senses.example_en: It took months of intense cleaning to finally get rid of the pests.
senses.example_zh: 经过几个月的彻底清理，终于消灭了那些害虫。

senses.meaning: 摆脱…是件大好事（庆幸不再与某人/某事有牵连）
senses.example_en: He caused nothing but trouble, so the company is well rid of him.
senses.example_zh: 他只会惹是生非，公司开除他是再好不过的事了。

senses.meaning: 消除，摆脱（负面情绪、思想或负担）
senses.example_en: She struggled to rid herself of the nagging guilt.
senses.example_zh: 她极力想要摆脱挥之不去的内疚感。

senses.example_en: The organization's ultimate goal is to rid the world of nuclear weapons.
senses.example_zh: 该组织的终极目标是在全世界彻底消除核武器。

senses.example_en: Neighbors gladly lent a helping hand to clean up after the storm.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，邻居们乐于伸出援手帮忙清理。

senses.example_en: Whenever I feel overwhelmed, she is always willing to lend an ear.
senses.example_zh: 每当我感到压力过大时，她总是愿意耐心倾听。

senses.meaning: 给予支持；增加…的可信度/分量
senses.example_en: Recent experimental data lend strong credence to the new theory.
senses.example_zh: 最新的实验数据有力地证实了这一新理论的可信度。

senses.example_en: The novel's dramatic plot lends itself well to theatrical adaptation.
senses.example_zh: 这部小说戏剧性极强的剧情非常适宜改编成舞台剧。

senses.example_en: Between gasps for air, the runner managed to pant out the urgent message.
senses.example_zh: 跑步者一边大口倒气，一边气喘吁吁地吐出紧急消息。

senses.example_en: He collapsed onto the grass, panting heavily for breath after the sprint.
senses.example_zh: 冲刺结束后，他瘫倒在草地上大口大口地喘粗气。

senses.example_en: The dog was panting heavily under the scorching midday sun.
senses.example_zh: 在正午灼热的阳光下，那只狗正粗重地喘着气。

senses.meaning: 为某事向某人道贺/祝贺
senses.example_en: Colleagues gathered to congratulate her on her well-deserved promotion.
senses.example_zh: 同事们聚集在一起祝贺她实至名归的晋升。

senses.example_en: I congratulated myself on having made the early train just in time.
senses.example_zh: 我暗自庆幸自己恰好赶上了那趟早班火车。

senses.example_en: The director warmly congratulated the cast on an exceptional opening night.
senses.example_zh: 导演对全体演职人员在首演之夜的出色表现致以热烈祝贺。

senses.example_en: Few historic cities in the region can rival Rome in artistic heritage.
senses.example_zh: 该地区几乎没有哪座历史名城能在艺术遗产方面与罗马相媲美。

senses.example_en: The smartphone's camera performance closely rivals that of professional equipment.
senses.example_zh: 这款智能手机的拍照性能已足以媲美专业摄影器材。

senses.meaning: 弥补，补偿（缺点、损失或不足）
senses.example_en: His tireless enthusiasm more than compensated for his lack of formal training.
senses.example_zh: 他不知疲倦的热情极大弥补了其缺乏系统训练的不足。

senses.example_en: The chemical company was ordered to fully compensate affected residents.
senses.example_zh: 该化工企业被责令对受波及的居民给予全额赔偿。

senses.example_en: No amount of money can adequately compensate the family for their devastating loss.
senses.example_zh: 再多的金钱也无法完全抚平这场惨痛损失给该家庭带来的伤痛。

senses.meaning: 抢购；争先恐后地抓住（机会/门票等）
senses.example_en: All front-row concert tickets were snapped up within seconds of going on sale.
senses.example_zh: 演唱会前排门票在开售几秒钟内便被一抢而空。

senses.meaning: 对…厉声说话；（动物）猛咬/扑咬
senses.example_en: Exhausted from overwork, she accidentally snapped at her assistant.
senses.example_zh: 由于过度劳累，她忍不住对助理厉声发了火。

senses.example_en: He boldly snapped his fingers at conventional office dress codes.
senses.example_zh: 他公然对传统办公着装要求嗤之以鼻。

senses.example_en: Tourists paused to snap photos of the breathtaking mountain view.
senses.example_zh: 游客们纷纷停下脚步，抓拍令人叹为观止的山景。

senses.meaning: 在压力下崩溃/失控；（物体）不堪负重断裂
senses.example_en: Even experienced executives can snap under persistent, intense pressure.
senses.example_zh: 即使是经验丰富的高管，在持续重压下也可能心理崩溃。

senses.meaning: 迅速摆脱（消极情绪、低迷状态）；打起精神
senses.example_en: You need to snap out of your depression and focus on preparing for the interview.
senses.example_zh: 你必须从消沉中振作起来，集中精力准备面试。

senses.meaning: 火箭、航天器）点火发射，升空
senses.example_en: The space shuttle blasted off into orbit under clear blue skies.
senses.example_zh: 航天飞机在晴朗的蓝天下点火升空进入轨道。

senses.meaning: 大声播放（音乐）；炸出（孔洞/通路）
senses.example_en: Upbeat music blasted out of the speakers throughout the celebration.
senses.example_zh: 在整场庆典期间，扬声器里一直高分贝地播放着欢快的音乐。

senses.meaning: 严厉抨击/痛斥某人（做某事）
senses.example_en: Opposition leaders blasted the administration for its economic mishandling.
senses.example_zh: 反对党领袖严厉抨击政府在经济管理上的失职。

senses.meaning: 炸出一个洞；给…造成沉重打击
senses.example_en: The unforeseen medical expenses blasted a huge hole in their household savings.
senses.example_zh: 意料之外的医疗开销让他们家庭的储蓄蒙受重创。

senses.meaning: 诉诸于；不得不采取（非常规手段或下策）
senses.example_en: Unable to settle the dispute peacefully, both parties ultimately resorted to arbitration.
senses.example_zh: 由于未能和平化解纠纷，双方最终只得诉诸仲裁。

senses.example_en: The police pledged not to resort to force unless public safety was compromised.
senses.example_zh: 警方承诺，除非公共安全受到危及，否则绝不动用武力。

senses.meaning: 采取孤注一掷的下策/极端手段
senses.example_en: Facing imminent bankruptcy, the founders resorted to desperate measures to stay afloat.
senses.example_zh: 面临破产边缘，创始人们不得不采取绝望手段维持公司运转。

senses.meaning: 简而言之；只需说...就足够了
senses.example_en: Suffice it to say, the project was a complete disaster and had to be abandoned.
senses.example_zh: 简而言之，这个项目彻底失败了，不得不放弃。

senses.example_en: A brief explanation will suffice to clarify the situation.
senses.example_zh: 简短的解释就足以说明情况。

senses.example_en: One million dollars should suffice for the initial phase of development.
senses.example_zh: 一百万美元应该足够用于第一阶段的开发。

senses.meaning: 谣言、想法等）流传；在附近散落；漫无目的地走动
senses.example_en: There are several rumors floating around about possible budget cuts.
senses.example_zh: 关于可能削减预算的谣言正在四处流传。

senses.meaning: 时间、景象）悄然流逝；飘然掠过
senses.example_en: I lay on the grass, watching the clouds float by.
senses.example_zh: 我躺在草地上，看着白云悄然飘过。

senses.meaning: 随你高兴；只要你喜欢就好
senses.example_en: If you want to spend your weekend doing taxes, whatever floats your boat.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想把周末用来报税，那就随你高兴吧。

collocations.phrase: float an idea / float a proposal

senses.meaning: 提出想法/建议（以试探外界反应）
senses.example_en: The minister floated the idea of a four-day working week.
senses.example_zh: 部长试探性地提出了推行四天工作制的想法。

collocations.phrase: float a company / float on the stock exchange

senses.example_en: The tech startup plans to float on the London Stock Exchange next year.
senses.example_zh: 这家科技初创公司计划明年在伦敦证券交易所上市。

senses.meaning: 向某人炫耀；故意向某人显摆（实力、财富等）
senses.example_en: He drove by our campus in his new sports car just to flex on his old classmates.
senses.example_zh: 他开着新跑车从我们校区旁经过，纯粹是为了向老同学显摆。

senses.example_en: The country conducted military drills along the border to flex its muscles.
senses.example_zh: 该国在边境举行军事演习以展示其肌肉。

senses.example_en: He paused during the marathon to stretch and flex his tight calves.
senses.example_zh: 马拉松途中他停下来拉伸并活动紧绷的小腿肌肉。

collocations.phrase: cure a disease / cure an illness

senses.example_en: Scientists are working around the clock to find a therapy that can cure the disease.
senses.example_zh: 科学家们正在夜以继日地研发能够治愈这种疾病的疗法。

senses.example_en: Traditionally, farmers would cure bacon with salt and smoke to preserve it for winter.
senses.example_zh: 传统上，农户会用盐和烟熏来腌制培根，以便留到冬季食用。

senses.meaning: 治愈某人的某种疾病；纠正/革除某人的不良恶习
senses.example_en: The bitter experience finally cured him of his gambling addiction.
senses.example_zh: 这次惨痛的经历终于帮他戒掉了赌瘾。

senses.meaning: 打扰，麻烦（某人）；利用（某人的善意、宽容等）
senses.example_en: I hate to impose on you, but could you give me a lift to the airport?
senses.example_zh: 我真不想麻烦你，但你能顺路送我去机场吗？

senses.meaning: 对...）实施制裁/征收关税/下达禁令
senses.example_en: The international coalition decided to impose strict trade sanctions on the regime.
senses.example_zh: 国际联盟决定对该政权实施严厉的贸易制裁。

senses.example_en: The local government imposed tight restrictions on water usage during the drought.
senses.example_zh: 干旱期间，当地政府对用水施加了严格限制。

senses.example_en: A good manager listens to the team rather than imposing their own will on everyone.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的管理者会倾听团队意见，而不是将自己的意志强加于人。

senses.example_en: He owes his rapid career advancement to hard work and excellent mentorship.
senses.example_zh: 他将自己事业的快速发展归功于辛勤工作和良师指导。

senses.meaning: 欠某人人情；改天答谢某人
senses.example_en: Thanks for covering my shift today—I really owe you one!
senses.example_zh: 谢谢你今天替我代班，我真欠你一个人情！

idioms.phrase: owe it to oneself (to do sth)

senses.meaning: 理应为自己做某事；对自己有责任做某事
senses.example_en: After months of non-stop work, you owe it to yourself to take a proper holiday.
senses.example_zh: 连续工作了几个月后，你理应好好休个假善待自己。

collocations.phrase: owe an apology / owe an explanation

senses.example_en: You were completely out of line in the meeting, and you owe her an apology.
senses.example_zh: 你在会议上的言行完全出格了，你欠她一个道歉。

senses.meaning: 深表感激；欠下难以报答的恩情
senses.example_en: The entire community owes a debt of gratitude to the volunteer firefighters.
senses.example_zh: 整个社区都对志愿消防员心怀无限感激。

senses.meaning: 品质、才华、情感）显露出来，清晰展现
senses.example_en: Despite her nervousness, her deep knowledge of the subject shone through.
senses.example_zh: 尽管她有些紧张，但她扎实的专业素养依然表露无遗。

senses.meaning: 出类拔萃，引人注目；照耀出来
senses.example_en: Her sheer determination shone out among all the applicants.
senses.example_zh: 她坚定的决心在所有申请人中格外引人注目。

senses.meaning: 快起床，打起精神来（常作晨间唤醒语）
senses.example_en: Rise and shine, kids! We've got an early train to catch.
senses.example_zh: 快起床啦，孩子们！我们得赶早班火车呢。

senses.meaning: 风雨无阻；无论发生什么
senses.example_en: The marathon will take place on Sunday, come rain or shine.
senses.example_zh: 马拉松比赛将于周日如期举行，风雨无阻。

senses.meaning: 揭露，阐明（问题或隐秘事实）
senses.example_en: The documentary aims to shine a light on the unfair treatment of migrant workers.
senses.example_zh: 该纪录片旨在揭露移民劳工遭受的不公正待遇。

senses.example_en: The stars were shining brightly in the clear night sky.
senses.example_zh: 晴朗的夜空中繁星闪烁。

senses.example_en: Rising sea levels pose a severe threat to coastal communities around the world.
senses.example_zh: 海平面上升对世界各地的沿海社区构成了严重威胁。

senses.example_en: The sudden supply chain disruption posed an immense challenge for the factory.
senses.example_zh: 供应链的突然中断给这家工厂带来了巨大的挑战。

senses.meaning: 提出问题（常指引发深入思考的问题）
senses.example_en: The speaker concluded by posing a critical question to the audience.
senses.example_zh: 演讲者在结尾时向听众提出了一个关键问题。

senses.example_en: The detective posed as a wealthy investor to gather evidence against the scam.
senses.example_zh: 侦探伪装成富有的投资人，以收集针对该骗局的证据。

senses.meaning: 将...归因于；认为（某作品/言论）出自某人之手
senses.example_en: Economists attribute the cooling inflation to aggressive interest rate hikes.
senses.example_zh: 经济学家将通胀降温归因于激进的加息政策。

senses.example_en: She attributed her athletic success to rigorous daily discipline.
senses.example_zh: 她将自己在体育上的成功归结于日复一日的严苛自律。

senses.meaning: 为达目的可以不择手段
senses.example_en: He believed that the end justifies the means, even if it meant betraying colleagues.
senses.example_zh: 他奉行“为达目的不择手段”，即便这意味着要背叛同事。

senses.meaning: 证明成本/开销是值得的
senses.example_en: The potential long-term gains fully justify the initial development costs.
senses.example_zh: 潜在的长期回报完全证明了前期开发投入是合理的。

senses.meaning: 为自己的行为/决定辩护
senses.example_en: The manager struggled to justify his controversial hiring decision to the board.
senses.example_zh: 经理极力向董事会说明自己引发争议的招聘决定是合情合理的。

senses.meaning: 扰乱治安，扰乱公共秩序
senses.example_en: He was arrested and charged with disturbing the peace after shouting outside the bar late at night.
senses.example_zh: 他深夜在酒吧外大喊大叫，随后因扰乱公共治安被捕并遭到起诉。

senses.example_en: Introducing invasive species can severely disturb the ecological balance of the region.
senses.example_zh: 引进外来物种会严重打破该地区的生态平衡。

senses.example_en: Sorry to disturb you, but do you have a few minutes to review this draft?
senses.example_zh: 抱歉打扰你，请问你有几分钟时间看一下这份草案吗？

senses.meaning: 非常感激，十分感谢（口语或礼貌表达）
senses.example_en: "Here is your lost wallet." — "Thank you, sir. I'm much obliged."
senses.example_zh: “这是你遗失的钱包。”——“谢谢您，先生，真是太感谢了。”

senses.meaning: 被迫做某事；有义务/不得不做某事
senses.example_en: Due to budget cuts, the company was obliged to lay off several temporary workers.
senses.example_zh: 由于预算削减，公司不得不解雇了几名临时工。

senses.example_en: If you need an extra day to finish the report, I'd be happy to oblige.
senses.example_zh: 如果你需要多一天时间来完成报告，我很乐意通融。

senses.meaning: 活一天算一天；行将灭亡；大难不死后多活的时日
senses.example_en: The outdated factory has been living on borrowed time since the new emissions laws were passed.
senses.example_zh: 自从新的排放法规出台后，这家老旧工厂就一直在苟延残喘。

senses.meaning: 大举借贷，背负沉重债务
senses.example_en: Small tech startups often borrow heavily in their early years to fund rapid expansion.
senses.example_zh: 初创科技公司在早期往往会大举借债以资助业务快速扩张。

senses.meaning: 向...借；借鉴/套用（思想、词汇等）
senses.example_en: English has borrowed thousands of words from Latin and French throughout history.
senses.example_zh: 在历史上，英语从拉丁语和法语中借用了成千上万个词汇。

senses.meaning: 顺应，适应（新环境、新变化）
senses.example_en: It took the exchange students several months to accommodate to the local cultural norms.
senses.example_zh: 交换生花了好几个月才逐渐适应当地的文化习俗。

senses.meaning: 满足...的需求，迎合...的需要
senses.example_en: The university redesigned its digital library to better accommodate the needs of disabled students.
senses.example_zh: 该大学重新设计了数字图书馆，以便更好地满足残障学生的需求。

senses.example_en: The newly built cruise ship can comfortably accommodate up to 3,000 passengers.
senses.example_zh: 这艘新建的豪华游轮最多可舒适地容纳三千名乘客。

senses.meaning: 日益专业化，日趋专门从事
senses.example_en: Law firms increasingly specialize in emerging areas like cybersecurity and intellectual property.
senses.example_zh: 律师事务所正日益专注于网络安全和知识产权等新兴领域。

senses.example_en: After finishing medical school, she decided to specialize in pediatric surgery.
senses.example_zh: 医学院毕业后，她决定专攻小儿外科。

senses.example_en: The healthcare system was on the verge of collapsing under the immense winter pressure.
senses.example_zh: 在冬季的巨大压力下，医疗系统濒临崩溃。

senses.meaning: 致使某物倒塌；导致（谈判、体系等）破裂
senses.example_en: A sudden drop in consumer demand caused several retail chains to collapse.
senses.example_zh: 消费需求的骤降导致数家连锁零售店相继倒闭。

senses.meaning: 倒在/瘫软在（床、沙发等）；禁不住陷入（笑、泪水）
senses.example_en: Exhausted after the marathon, he collapsed into the nearest armchair.
senses.example_zh: 跑完马拉松筋疲力尽的他一下子瘫倒在最近的扶手椅里。

senses.example_en: The survey results strongly imply that employees are dissatisfied with the current management.
senses.example_zh: 调查结果强烈表明员工对当前的管理层感到不满。

senses.meaning: 似乎暗示着，貌似意味着
senses.example_en: His choice of words seemed to imply that the merger was already a done deal.
senses.example_zh: 他的措辞似乎在暗示该合并案已成定局。

senses.meaning: 必然意味着（常用于否定句）
senses.example_en: A high correlation between two variables does not necessarily imply causation.
senses.example_zh: 两个变量之间的高度相关性并不必然意味着存在因果关系。

senses.example_en: Therapy helps patients recognize irrational thoughts and modify their behavior accordingly.
senses.example_zh: 心理咨询帮助患者识别非理性想法，并相应地改变自己的行为模式。

senses.example_en: Consumers in the region remain cautious about buying genetically modified foods.
senses.example_zh: 该地区的消费者对购买转基因食品依然持谨慎态度。

senses.example_en: The architects had to substantially modify the blueprints to comply with local safety regulations.
senses.example_zh: 建筑师们不得不大幅修改设计图纸，以符合当地的安全法规。

senses.meaning: 屈服于，让步；让位给（更强者或新事物）
senses.example_en: The minister refused to yield to public pressure and stood firmly by the policy.
senses.example_zh: 该部长拒绝向公众压力低头，坚定地支持这项政策。

senses.meaning: 被迫交出；揭开（秘密、隐情）
senses.example_en: Archaeologists spent decades waiting for the ancient tombs to yield up their secrets.
senses.example_zh: 考古学家们花了数十年时间，等待这些古墓揭开它们深藏的秘密。

senses.example_en: Years of laboratory research have finally begun to yield tangible results.
senses.example_zh: 多年的实验室研究终于开始取得实实在在的成果。

senses.meaning: 带来高收益，产出高回报
senses.example_en: Investing in renewable energy continues to yield high returns for forward-thinking funds.
senses.example_zh: 投资可再生能源继续为具有远见卓识的基金带来丰厚回报。

senses.example_en: Poor communication between departments only served to compound the problem.
senses.example_zh: 部门之间沟通不良只是让本已存在的问题雪上加霜。

senses.meaning: 错上加错，使失误进一步扩大
senses.example_en: Attempting to hide the initial financial discrepancy simply compounded the error.
senses.example_zh: 试图掩盖最初的账目出入只会错上加错。

senses.meaning: 复利（也常用动词短语 interest compounds：按复利计算）
senses.example_en: Thanks to compounding interest, saving early can multiply your wealth substantially over time.
senses.example_zh: 得益于复利效应，提早储蓄能在漫长时间里让你的财富大幅翻倍。

senses.example_en: Junior doctors are closely supervised by senior medical staff during their residency.
senses.example_zh: 住院期间，初级医生受到资深医务人员的密切监督。

senses.example_en: She was appointed to supervise the day-to-day operations of the overseas branch.
senses.example_zh: 她被任命负责监督海外分部的日常运营。

senses.meaning: 你怎么敢；你好大的胆子
senses.example_en: How dare you read my private diary without asking!
senses.example_zh: 未经允许你怎么敢看我的私人日记！

senses.example_en: Don't you dare hang up the phone while I'm still talking to you.
senses.example_zh: 我还在跟你说话呢，你敢挂电话试试看。

senses.meaning: 敢于梦想/敢于持不同观点
senses.example_en: True innovators are those who dare to challenge accepted dogmas.
senses.example_zh: 真正的创新者是那些敢于挑战既定教条的人。

senses.example_en: I dare say you are thoroughly exhausted after that grueling flight.
senses.example_zh: 经历了那趟折磨人的飞行，我想你肯定已经筋疲力尽了。

senses.meaning: 使人烦躁；触怒；使神经紧张
senses.example_en: His boastful remarks and loud laugh were beginning to grate on my nerves.
senses.example_zh: 他夸夸其谈的话语和大声狂笑开始让我心烦意乱。

senses.example_en: Sprinkle the hot pasta with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
senses.example_zh: 在热意大利面上撒上现擦的帕尔马干酪碎。

senses.example_en: The rusted iron gate grated against the concrete paving every time it opened.
senses.example_zh: 生锈的铁门每次打开都会与水泥路面摩擦发出刺耳的声音。

senses.meaning: 通过大声喧哗）把……压下去；嘘得……说不下去
senses.example_en: The angry crowd shouted down the politician before he could finish his opening remarks.
senses.example_zh: 愤怒的群众大声起哄，让那位政客开场白还没说完就无法继续了。

senses.meaning: 大声喊出；公开致谢/问候
senses.example_en: He couldn't resist shouting out the answer before the teacher called his name.
senses.example_zh: 老师还没点他的名字，他就忍不住大声喊出了答案。

senses.meaning: 大声宣布；弄得满城皆知
senses.example_en: She was so thrilled about landing her dream job that she wanted to shout it from the rooftops.
senses.example_zh: 拿到理想的工作让她欣喜若狂，恨不得向全世界宣告。

senses.example_en: A group of rowdy spectators began shouting abuse at the match referee.
senses.example_zh: 一群闹事的观众开始大声辱骂主裁判。

collocations.phrase: shout at the top of one's voice/lungs

senses.meaning: 扯着嗓子大喊；竭力嘶喊
senses.example_en: Trapped on the balcony, he shouted at the top of his lungs for help.
senses.example_zh: 被困在阳台上的他扯着嗓子大声呼救。

senses.meaning: 内行人面前休想耍花招；骗不了老手
senses.example_en: Don't try making up excuses with the manager; you can't bullshit a bullshitter.
senses.example_zh: 别想跟经理编借口，老手面前你耍不了花招。

senses.example_en: Stop bullshitting and tell me what really happened to the budget.
senses.example_zh: 别胡扯了，赶紧告诉我预算到底出什么事了。

senses.example_en: He hadn't prepped for the meeting, but somehow managed to bullshit his way through.
senses.example_zh: 他完全没准备会议内容，却硬是靠瞎编糊弄过关了。

senses.example_en: I scanned through the contractual terms before signing my name at the bottom.
senses.example_zh: 在底部签字之前，我快速扫视了一遍合同条款。

senses.meaning: 审视地平线/在人群中搜寻
senses.example_en: The security guards continuously scanned the crowd for any suspicious behavior.
senses.example_zh: 保安人员不断在人群中扫视，搜寻任何可疑行为。

senses.meaning: 扫描文件/二维码/条形码
senses.example_en: Please scan the QR code displayed on the screen to confirm your attendance.
senses.example_zh: 请扫描屏幕上显示的二维码以确认签到。

senses.meaning: 团结互助；齐心协力支持
senses.example_en: When their home was destroyed by the flood, the neighbors rallied round to rebuild it.
senses.example_zh: 当他们的房子被洪水冲毁时，邻里们团结一致伸出援手帮他们重建家园。

senses.meaning: 鼓舞士气；召集人员齐心协力应对难关
senses.example_en: Facing tight deadlines, the CEO held an emergency meeting to rally the troops.
senses.example_zh: 面对紧张的截止日期，首席执行官召开了紧急会议以鼓舞全员士气。

senses.example_en: The campaign succeeded in rallying widespread public support for education reform.
senses.example_zh: 该活动成功为教育改革争取到了广泛的公众支持。

senses.meaning: 股市/股价强劲反弹回升
senses.example_en: European markets rallied strongly after the central bank cut interest rates.
senses.example_zh: 在央行降息后，欧洲股市迎来了强劲反弹。

senses.meaning: 偷偷溜走；逃避（责任、聚会、账单等）
senses.example_en: He skipped out on paying his share of the bill and left us with the total.
senses.example_zh: 他没付自己那份账单就溜了，把全额留给我们付。

senses.example_en: You can skip over the introductory section if you already understand the fundamentals.
senses.example_zh: 如果你已经掌握了基本原理，可以直接跳过引言部分。

senses.meaning: 心脏因恐惧、兴奋等）漏跳一拍，心头一紧
senses.example_en: My heart skipped a beat when I heard sudden footsteps outside the window.
senses.example_zh: 听到窗外突然传来的脚步声，我吓得心头一紧。

senses.example_en: Skipping classes on a regular basis will inevitably lead to failing the final exams.
senses.example_zh: 经常逃课必然会导致期末考试不及格。

senses.example_en: Nutritionists strongly advise patients not to skip meals while trying to lose weight.
senses.example_zh: 营养学家强烈建议患者在减肥期间切勿挨饿省饭。

senses.meaning: 液体）流走；（精力、财富、勇气等）渐渐消失/耗尽
senses.example_en: All the color drained away from her face when she received the tragic news.
senses.example_zh: 听到那个不幸的消息时，她脸上的血色瞬间退得一干二净。

senses.example_en: Three years of research went down the drain when the hard drive corrupted without backup.
senses.example_zh: 硬盘损坏且没有备份，三年的研究心血彻底付诸东流。

senses.example_en: Prolonged legal disputes can drain a startup of valuable financial resources.
senses.example_zh: 旷日持久的法律纠纷会榨干初创公司宝贵的财务资源。

senses.example_en: Boil the pasta for ten minutes, then drain the water thoroughly using a colander.
senses.example_zh: 将意面煮十分钟，然后用滤水器将水彻底沥干。

senses.meaning: 耗尽……的（力量、血液、精力等）
senses.example_en: Months of constant stress had completely drained him of enthusiasm for the project.
senses.example_zh: 数月来持续的压力已经将他对该项目的热情消耗殆尽。

senses.meaning: 煎/炒（食物）；做一顿油煎热食
senses.example_en: Let's fry up some leftover rice and vegetables for a quick lunch.
senses.example_zh: 我们用剩下的米饭和蔬菜炒个饭当快餐吧。

senses.example_en: I won't waste time arguing over trivialities; we have bigger fish to fry.
senses.example_zh: 我不想浪费时间争论琐事，我们还有更重要的事要办。

idioms.phrase: out of the frying pan into the fire

senses.meaning: 刚出狼窝，又入虎口；每况愈下
senses.example_en: Leaving that toxic job for a company with worse culture was jumping out of the frying pan into the fire.
senses.example_zh: 离开那份令人窒息的工作跳槽到一家企业文化更糟的公司，简直是刚出狼窝又入虎口。

senses.example_en: Stir-fry the garlic and shrimp over high heat for two minutes.
senses.example_zh: 用大火翻炒大蒜和虾仁两分钟。

senses.example_en: Deep-fry the coated wings until they are golden and crispy on the outside.
senses.example_zh: 将裹好粉的鸡翅油炸至外表金黄酥脆。

senses.example_en: She decided to devote her entire life to medical research.
senses.example_zh: 她决定将毕生精力奉献给医学研究。

senses.example_en: He devotes most of his spare time to helping disadvantaged children.
senses.example_zh: 他把大部分业余时间都用来帮助弱势儿童。

senses.example_en: The government needs to devote more resources to renewable energy.
senses.example_zh: 政府需要向可再生能源投入更多资源。

senses.example_en: The building has been officially designated an ancient monument.
senses.example_zh: 该建筑已被正式指定为历史遗迹。

senses.example_en: The CEO stepped down without designating a clear successor.
senses.example_zh: 首席执行官离任时未明确指定接班人。

senses.example_en: The valley was designated as a national park in 1982.
senses.example_zh: 该山谷于1982年被指定为国家公园。

senses.meaning: 轻而易举地通过；轻松完成
senses.example_en: He cruised through the exam without doing much revision.
senses.example_zh: 他没怎么复习就轻松通过了考试。

senses.meaning: 以匀速平稳行驶；顺利进展
senses.example_en: The company was just cruising along until new competitors arrived.
senses.example_zh: 在新竞争对手出现之前，公司业务一直稳健顺畅地推进。

senses.example_en: The defending champions cruised to an easy victory in the final.
senses.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在决赛中轻松斩获胜利。

senses.example_en: The aircraft cruises at a speed of 500 miles per hour.
senses.example_zh: 该飞机的巡航时速为500英里。

senses.meaning: 挑拨离间；预先败坏某人的名声以阻碍其被接受
senses.example_en: Her rivals tried to poison the well by spreading false rumors before her presentation.
senses.example_zh: 竞争对手在她演讲前散布谣言，企图预先败坏她的名声。

senses.example_en: Hate speech can poison the minds of impressionable young people.
senses.example_zh: 仇恨言论会毒害心智尚未成熟的年轻人的思想。

senses.example_en: The unresolved dispute has poisoned relations between the two countries.
senses.example_zh: 那起尚未解决的争端恶化了两国之间的关系。

senses.example_en: He was caught trying to spy on rival companies' meetings.
senses.example_zh: 他因企图窃听竞争对手公司的会议而当场被抓。

senses.meaning: 暗中查明；刺探（情报或虚实）
senses.example_en: Scouts were sent ahead to spy out the land before the army advanced.
senses.example_zh: 大军前行之前派出了斥候刺探虚实。

senses.example_en: The diplomat was accused of spying for a foreign intelligence agency.
senses.example_zh: 该外交官被指控为外国情报机构从事间谍活动。

senses.meaning: 人、信件、钱款等）大量涌入；纷纷而至
senses.example_en: Donations have been pouring in since the television appeal.
senses.example_zh: 自电视呼吁播出以来，捐款便源源不断地涌入。

senses.meaning: 倒出；倾诉（心里话或感情）
senses.example_en: She poured out her troubles to her best friend over coffee.
senses.example_zh: 她一边喝咖啡一边向闺蜜倾诉自己的烦恼。

senses.example_en: The rain poured down all afternoon, flooding the streets.
senses.example_zh: 大雨下了一整个下午，淹没了街道。

senses.meaning: 祸不单行；接二连三地发生
senses.example_en: First the car broke down, and now the boiler has burst—when it rains, it pours.
senses.example_zh: 先是车坏了，现在锅炉又炸了——真是祸不单行。

senses.example_en: The manager immediately poured cold water on our ambitious project.
senses.example_zh: 经理立刻给我们雄心勃勃的项目泼了一盆冷水。

senses.example_en: Investors continue to pour money into artificial intelligence startups.
senses.example_zh: 投资者继续向人工智能初创企业砸入大笔资金。

senses.meaning: 在辩论或讨论中）发表意见/介入；称体重
senses.example_en: Several prominent economists weighed in on the inflation debate.
senses.example_zh: 数位知名经济学家介入了这场关于通胀的辩论。

senses.meaning: 沉重地压在……心头；使烦扰
senses.example_en: The burden of the secret weighed heavily on his conscience.
senses.example_zh: 这个秘密的沉重包袱压得他良心不安。

senses.meaning: 使下垂；使负担沉重；使沮丧
senses.example_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
senses.example_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

senses.example_en: Take time to carefully weigh the pros and cons before making a career change.
senses.example_zh: 在转行之前，花点时间仔细权衡利弊。

senses.example_en: The board is currently weighing its options regarding the merger.
senses.example_zh: 董事会目前正在审慎评估有关并购的各项选择。

senses.example_en: The proposal was substantially revised after receiving public feedback.
senses.example_zh: 在收到公众反馈后，该方案进行了大幅修改。

senses.example_en: Analysts had to revise their earnings forecasts following the revenue drop.
senses.example_zh: 在营收下滑之后，分析师们不得不修正其盈利预测。

senses.example_en: Students are spending the weekend revising for their final exams.
senses.example_zh: 学生们正在度过周末为期末考试复习功课。

senses.meaning: 向下/向上修正（预期、数据等）
senses.example_en: The agency revised down its economic growth forecast for the fiscal year.
senses.example_zh: 该机构下调了本财年的经济增长预测。

senses.example_en: It is considered impolite to stare at strangers in public.
senses.example_zh: 在公共场合盯着陌生人看被认为是不礼貌的。

senses.meaning: 以目光逼退；毫不退缩地盯着迫使某人认输
senses.example_en: The union leader managed to stare down government negotiators.
senses.example_zh: 工会领袖在谈判桌上顶住压力，以毫不妥协的气势逼退了政府谈判代表。

senses.meaning: 显而易见；迫在眉睫；不可避免
senses.example_en: The solution to the problem had been staring us in the face the entire time.
senses.example_zh: 解决问题的办法其实一直摆在我们眼前，显而易见。

senses.example_en: Exhausted from the long shift, he just sat staring into space.
senses.example_zh: 长时间值班后疲惫不堪的他只是坐在那里发呆。

senses.meaning: 难以置信地凝视；瞠目结舌
senses.example_en: Residents stared in disbelief at the destruction caused by the tornado.
senses.example_zh: 居民们难以置信地凝视着龙卷风造成的破坏景象。

senses.meaning: 使震惊得说不出话来；惊呆全场
senses.example_en: The shocking announcement stunned the audience into absolute silence.
senses.example_zh: 这条令人震惊的声明让全场观众陷入一片寂静。

senses.example_en: The underdog team stunned the football world with their historic triumph.
senses.example_zh: 这支处于劣势的队伍以历史性的胜利震惊了整个足球界。

senses.meaning: 无比震惊；完全目瞪口呆
senses.example_en: She was absolutely stunned when her name was called as the winner.
senses.example_zh: 当念到她的名字获胜时，她完全惊呆了。

senses.meaning: 部署部队；调派武装力量
senses.example_en: The government decided to deploy troops along the border to maintain security.
senses.example_zh: 政府决定沿边境部署部队以维护安全。

senses.meaning: 调配资源；有效配置资金
senses.example_en: The company needs to deploy its limited resources where they will have the most impact.
senses.example_zh: 公司需要把有限的资源调配到能发挥最大效益的地方。

senses.example_en: The engineering team will deploy the new software update late tonight.
senses.example_zh: 工程团队将在今晚深夜部署新的软件更新。

senses.meaning: 迅速吃光；轻而易举地解决/击败
senses.example_en: He polished off the entire pizza in less than ten minutes.
senses.example_zh: 他不到十分钟就把整张披萨吃得一干二净。

senses.meaning: 润色，推敲；重温/提升技能
senses.example_en: I need to polish up my Spanish before travelling to Madrid.
senses.example_zh: 去马德里之前，我需要重新温习一下我的西班牙语。

senses.meaning: 润色论文；修改打磨简历
senses.example_en: She spent the weekend polishing her resume ahead of the interview.
senses.example_zh: 她在面试前花了一整个周末来打磨自己的简历。

senses.example_en: The campaign was designed to polish the senator's public image.
senses.example_zh: 这场宣传活动旨在改善该参议员的公众形象。

senses.meaning: 深入探究；下钻分析（数据或细节）
senses.example_en: Let's drill down into the quarterly sales figures to see what went wrong.
senses.example_zh: 我们来深入分析一下季度的销售数据，看看究竟哪里出了问题。

senses.example_en: The energy firm obtained permission to drill for offshore oil.
senses.example_zh: 这家能源公司获得了开采近海石油的许可。

senses.meaning: 对某人进行某项技能的严苛训练
senses.example_en: The recruits were drilled in emergency survival skills for three weeks.
senses.example_zh: 新兵们接受了为期三周的紧急生存技能严格集训。

senses.meaning: 反复向……灌输；向……反复强调
senses.example_en: Our coach drilled the importance of teamwork into our heads every day.
senses.example_zh: 我们的教练每天都向我们反复灌输团队合作的重要性。

senses.meaning: 悄悄潜入；不知不觉掺杂/滋生
senses.example_en: A few typographical errors managed to creep into the final report.
senses.example_zh: 几处排版错误不知不觉出现在了最终报告中。

senses.meaning: 悄悄靠近（使受惊吓）；（时间或感觉）不知不觉袭来
senses.example_en: Tiredness seemed to creep up on her as soon as the sun went down.
senses.example_zh: 太阳一下山，疲惫感仿佛就不知不觉袭上了她的心头。

senses.meaning: 使毛骨悚然；令人心里发毛
senses.example_en: The way that abandoned house looks at dusk really creeps me out.
senses.example_zh: 那栋废弃房屋在黄昏时的模样真让我心里发毛。

senses.meaning: 物价/成本小幅爬升；逐渐走高
senses.example_en: Consumer prices have been creeping up gradually over the past six months.
senses.example_zh: 在过去的六个月里，消费品价格一直在小幅稳步爬升。

senses.example_en: The manager brushed aside our safety concerns and pushed ahead with the plan.
senses.example_zh: 经理对我们的安全担忧置之不理，执意推进该计划。

senses.meaning: 拂去；不予理会，冷落驳回
senses.example_en: He tried to brush off the criticism as petty jealousy.
senses.example_zh: 他试图对这些批评不予理会，将其归咎于小人的嫉妒。

senses.meaning: 重温，温习（长期不用的技能或知识）
senses.example_en: I'm taking an online course to brush up on my coding skills.
senses.example_zh: 我正在上一门网络课程，以重温我的编程技能。

senses.example_en: Her shoulder brushed against mine as we walked through the crowded subway car.
senses.example_zh: 在穿过拥挤的地铁车厢时，她的肩膀擦碰到了我的肩膀。

senses.example_en: Dentists recommend that you brush your teeth at least twice a day.
senses.example_zh: 牙医建议每天至少刷牙两次。

senses.example_en: The heavy rain finally began to ease off by late afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 直到傍晚时分，大雨终于开始减弱。

senses.meaning: 让某人安心；打消某人的顾虑
senses.example_en: The doctor's reassuring words did a lot to ease her mind.
senses.example_zh: 医生宽慰的话语在很大程度上打消了她的顾虑。

senses.meaning: 缓解紧张局势；放宽限制
senses.example_en: Both nations agreed to hold bilateral talks to ease border tensions.
senses.example_zh: 两国同意举行双边会谈以缓解边境紧张局势。

senses.example_en: The government introduced subsidies to ease the financial burden on low-income families.
senses.example_zh: 政府出台补贴措施，以减轻低收入家庭的经济负担。

senses.example_en: The coach gave him light exercises to ease him into the regular training routine.
senses.example_zh: 教练给他安排了轻量运动，好让他逐渐适应日常训练强度。

senses.meaning: 依靠，依赖（某人的支持）；向……施压
senses.example_en: She had to lean heavily on her family during those tough months.
senses.example_zh: 在那段艰难的岁月里，她不得不极度依赖家人的支持。

senses.meaning: 竭尽全力；想方设法迎合（亦作 bend over backwards）
senses.example_en: The hotel staff leaned over backwards to make sure our stay was pleasant.
senses.example_zh: 酒店员工竭尽全力，以确保我们住得舒适顺心。

senses.example_en: He leaned forward across the table to hear what she was whispering.
senses.example_zh: 他隔着桌子身体前倾，好听清她在低声耳语什么。

senses.example_en: A dusty old bicycle was leaning against the stone wall.
senses.example_zh: 一辆落满灰尘的旧自行车正靠在石墙边。

senses.meaning: 倾向于；偏向（某种观点或选择）
senses.example_en: I'm leaning towards accepting the remote job offer.
senses.example_zh: 我比较倾向于接受那份远程工作的邀约。

senses.example_en: The floodwaters swept away cars and makeshift bridges within minutes.
senses.example_zh: 洪水在几分钟内冲走了汽车和简易桥梁。

senses.example_en: She quickly swept up the broken glass before anyone stepped on it.
senses.example_zh: 她在别人踩到之前迅速把碎玻璃打扫干净了。

senses.meaning: 席卷；横扫（风暴、疾病、思潮等）
senses.example_en: A wave of strikes swept across the entire manufacturing sector.
senses.example_zh: 罢工浪潮席卷了整个制造业。

senses.meaning: 掩饰丑事；把问题隐瞒遮掩起来
senses.example_en: Management tried to sweep the accounting discrepancies under the rug.
senses.example_zh: 管理层试图掩盖财务账目上的差错。

senses.meaning: 使某人倾倒；让某人迅速坠入爱河
senses.example_en: His romantic gestures completely swept her off her feet.
senses.example_zh: 他浪漫的举动彻底把她迷倒了。

senses.meaning: 风靡全国/全球；席卷世界
senses.example_en: The short-video app swept the globe in a matter of months.
senses.example_zh: 这款短视频应用在短短几个月内就风靡了全球。

senses.example_en: He used a modified screwdriver to jimmy the lock on the toolbox.
senses.example_zh: 他用一把改装过的螺丝刀撬开了工具箱上的锁。

senses.meaning: 用撬棍、工具）撬开（门、锁、窗等
senses.example_en: The burglar managed to jimmy open the rear window while the family was away.
senses.example_zh: 趁屋主一家外出，窃贼用工具撬开了后窗。

senses.example_en: The candidate vowed to fulfill all of his campaign promises if elected.
senses.example_zh: 该候选人誓言如果当选，将履行其所有的竞选承诺。

senses.example_en: Applicants must fulfill all academic requirements before being admitted.
senses.example_zh: 申请人必须满足所有学业要求才能被正式录取。

senses.example_en: Good mentorship helps young researchers fulfill their full potential.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的导师指导有助于年轻研究人员充分发挥出自己的潜能。

senses.example_en: Remember to turn off the lights when leaving the room to conserve energy.
senses.example_zh: 离开房间时请记得关灯以节约能源。

senses.example_en: Sustainable farming practices aim to conserve water and soil resources.
senses.example_zh: 可持续农业实践旨在保护水土资源。

senses.example_en: New national parks were established to conserve endangered wildlife.
senses.example_zh: 建立新的国家公园是为了保护濒危野生动植物。

senses.example_en: The investigators were accused of using coercive tactics to extract a confession.
senses.example_zh: 调查人员被指控使用强迫手段进行逼供。

senses.example_en: The software is designed to extract key information from large volumes of text.
senses.example_zh: 该软件旨在从海量文本中提取关键信息。

senses.example_en: The dentist advised that it would be best to extract the impacted wisdom tooth.
senses.example_zh: 牙医建议最好将这颗阻生智齿拔掉。

senses.example_en: Scientists managed to extract DNA from the ancient fossil.
senses.example_zh: 科学家们成功从这具古老化石中提取出了DNA。

senses.example_en: The company's policy strictly prohibits discriminating on the basis of age or disability.
senses.example_zh: 公司政策严禁基于年龄或残疾进行歧视。

senses.example_en: It is illegal to discriminate against job applicants on the grounds of race or gender.
senses.example_zh: 在求职中基于种族或性别歧视应聘者是违法的。

senses.example_en: Young children often find it hard to discriminate between fantasy and reality.
senses.example_zh: 幼儿往往很难区分幻想与现实。

senses.example_en: The government eventually bowed to public pressure and cancelled the controversial tax.
senses.example_zh: 政府最终屈服于公众压力，取消了这项有争议的税收。

senses.example_en: After three decades in politics, the senator decided to bow out gracefully.
senses.example_zh: 在政坛打拼了三十年后，这位参议员决定体面退场。

senses.example_en: The rebels refused to bow down to the authoritarian regime.
senses.example_zh: 叛军拒绝向独裁政权低头屈服。

senses.example_en: The actors took a bow as the audience erupted into thunderous applause.
senses.example_zh: 当观众爆发出雷鸣般的掌声时，演员们上台谢幕。

senses.example_en: Everyone bowed their heads in a minute of silence for the earthquake victims.
senses.example_zh: 所有人低头为地震遇难者默哀一分钟。

senses.meaning: 把（怨气/杂务/问题）全甩给某人；虐待
senses.example_en: Don't just dump all your frustrations on me after a bad day at work.
senses.example_zh: 工作不顺心后，别把你的负面情绪全发泄在我身上。

senses.example_en: She dumped out the contents of her handbag on the table to look for her keys.
senses.example_zh: 她把手提包里的东西全倒在桌上找钥匙。

senses.example_en: He has been down in the dumps ever since he failed his driving test.
senses.example_zh: 自从驾照考试不及格后，他就一直闷闷不乐。

senses.example_en: The factory was heavily fined for illegally dumping toxic waste into the river.
senses.example_zh: 该工厂因向河中非法倾倒有毒废弃物而被处以重罚。

senses.example_en: Panicked investors began to dump their shares as soon as the market opened.
senses.example_zh: 一开盘，恐慌的投资者们便开始抛售手中的股票。

senses.example_en: Despite the formal apology, she still harbored resentment toward her manager.
senses.example_zh: 尽管得到了正式道歉，她心里对经理依然心存怨恨。

senses.example_en: He secretly harbored ambitions of running for mayor one day.
senses.example_zh: 他暗地里一直怀揣着有朝一日竞选市长的抱负。

senses.example_en: It is a serious crime to knowingly harbor a fugitive from justice.
senses.example_zh: 明知故犯地窝藏在逃犯人属于严重犯罪。

senses.example_en: She distinguished herself in medical school by publishing several high-impact papers.
senses.example_zh: 她在医学院期间发表了数篇高影响力的论文，表现十分出众。

senses.example_en: A good critic should be able to distinguish between genuine art and mere imitation.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的评论家应该能够区分真正的艺术与单纯的模仿。

senses.example_en: What distinguishes this smartphone from other models is its extraordinary battery life.
senses.example_zh: 这款智能手机区别于其他机型之处在于其出色的续航能力。

senses.meaning: 大发雷霆；抓狂；极度激动
senses.example_en: My dad will flip out if he finds out I dented his new car.
senses.example_zh: 要是我爸发现我把他新车给撞凹了，他肯定会抓狂的。

senses.example_en: I flipped through the magazine while waiting for my coffee.
senses.example_zh: 在等咖啡的时候，我随手翻了翻杂志。

senses.example_en: Flip the steak over after two minutes to ensure it cooks evenly.
senses.example_zh: 两分钟后将牛排翻个面，以确保受热均匀。

senses.example_en: Since we couldn't agree on which movie to watch, we decided to flip a coin.
senses.example_zh: 因为不知道看哪部电影好，我们决定抛硬币来做决定。

senses.example_en: High fame brings wealth, but the flip side is a complete loss of privacy.
senses.example_zh: 名声大噪能带来财富，但其负面影响则是彻底失去个人隐私。

senses.example_en: With the flip of a switch, the dark warehouse was illuminated.
senses.example_zh: 轻轻扳动开关，整个黑暗的仓库立刻亮堂起来。

senses.example_en: Successful leaders encourage their teams to embrace change rather than fear it.
senses.example_zh: 成功的领导者会鼓励团队欣然拥抱变革，而不是心生畏惧。

senses.example_en: She embraced the opportunity to study at Oxford with open arms.
senses.example_zh: 她欣然抓住了去牛津大学深造的机会。

senses.example_en: Modern educational institutions strive to embrace diversity in all its forms.
senses.example_zh: 现代教育机构努力在各个层面接纳并包容多元性。
